text: Sang nag-responder ang otoridad sa ambush site, nakit-an ang 30 ka empty shells sang M16 rifles.
english: When the authorities responded to the ambush site, they found 30 empty shells of M16 rifles.

text: Pahayag pa sang pulis, padayon pa subong nga gina-ayam ang mga suspek matapos nga nagpalalagyo sa lain-lain nga direksyon kasunod sang krimen.
english: Police said the suspects are still being hunted after they fled in different directions following the crime.

text: Ini nga ambush amo na ang ika-13 nga violent election-related incident sa Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao.
english: This ambush is the 13th violent election-related incident in the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao.

text: Dakup ang isa ka bodegero sa ginpatigayon nga drug buy bust operation sang Regional Police Drug Enforcement Unit (RPDEU) kag sang Tubungan Municipal Police Station sa Brgy.
english: A warehouseman was arrested in a drug buy bust operation conducted by the Regional Police Drug Enforcement Unit (RPDEU) and the Tubungan Municipal Police Station in Brgy.

text: Igtuble, Tubungan, Iloilo.
english: Igtuble, Tubungan, Iloilo.

text: Ang subject amo si Alyas Alex, 23, bodegero, kag residente sang nasambit nga lugar.
english: The subject was identified as Alex, 23, warehouseman, and resident of the said place.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Alberto Manguilimotan Jr., hepe sang Tubungan MPS, iya ginpahayag nga duha na ka bulan ang monitoring sa subject nga nahibaluan nga may naga sugo lang sa iya nga mag dul-ong sang druga sa 1st district sa Probinsya sang Iloilo kag sa Iloilo City gamit ang motorsiklo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain Alberto Manguilimotan Jr., chief of Tubungan MPS, said that the subject has been monitored for two months.

text: Suno kay Manguilimotan, na-recover sa pag-hinakop sang subject ang 12 tanan ka plastic sachet sang suspected shabu lakip na ang buy bust item nga naga bug-at sang 330 grams kag may standard drug price nga ₱2,244,000.
english: According to Manguilimotan, 12 plastic sachets of suspected shabu including a buy bust item weighing 330 grams and with a standard drug price of ₱2,244,000 were recovered from the suspect.

text: Nakuhaan man ini sang .38 revolver nga armas luthang nga loaded sang 4 ka live ammunition.
english: A .38 revolver loaded with 4 live ammunition was also recovered from the suspect.

text: Sa subong, yara na sa kustodiya sang Tubungan MPS si alyas Alex kag nagapangatubang sang kaso nga paglapas sa Republic Act 9165 ukon Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.
english: Alex is now in the custody of Tubungan MPS and is facing charges of violation of Republic Act 9165 or Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.

text: Posible pahanugutan na ang pila ka mga NBA players nga magsuksok sang mga ‘statement” jerseys sa tion nga mag-umpisa na ang liga.
english: Some NBA players may be allowed to wear statement jerseys once the league resumes.

text: Ang ini nga inisyatibo ang ginadiskusyonan na nanday Oklahoma City Thunder guard Chris Paul, presidente sang National Basketball Players Association kag iban pa nga opisyal sang NBA.
english: This initiative is already being discussed by Oklahoma City Thunder guard Chris Paul, president of the National Basketball Players Association and other NBA officials.

text: Ang nasambit nga basketball jersey ang mahimo pabutangan sang slogan ukon mensahe kaangay sang “Black lives Matter” ukon “I Can’t Breathe”.
english: The basketball jersey can be emblazoned with slogans or messages such as “Black lives Matter” or “I Can’t Breathe”.

text: Ang nasambit nga mga tinaga amo ang ginasinggitan sang mga protesters matapos mapatay sang pulis ang black American nga si George Floyd sa Minneapolis.
english: These words were chanted by protesters after the police killed black American George Floyd in Minneapolis.

text: MANILA – Magatanyag sang special loan restructuring ang Pag-IBIG fund para sa mga miyembro nga wala nakabayad sang utang bangud sa Coronavirus Disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic.
english: MANILA – The Pag-IBIG fund will offer special loan restructuring for members who have not repaid their loans due to the Coronavirus Disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic.

text: Suno sa Pag-IBIG, mahimo nga makabenepisyo ang mga wala nakabayad sa sulod sang anum ka bulan humalin sang nag-umpisa ang pandemya.
english: According to Pag-IBIG, those who have not paid within six months of the pandemic can benefit.

text: Ang wala nabayaran sa sulod sang anum ka bulan ang igakarga sa ginbag-o nga loan scheme rason nga magalawig ang payment method.
english: Those not paid within six months will be loaded into the revised loan scheme, which will extend the payment method.

text: Sa pagpaathag ni Acmad Moti, Chief Executive Officer sang Pag-IBIG Fund, valid ID kag selfie nga gina-uyatan ang ID ang kinahanglan nga requirements kun sa diin wala sang processing fee ang online application.
english: Acmad Moti, Chief Executive Officer of the Pag-IBIG Fund, explained that a valid ID and a selfie holding the ID are the requirements where there is no processing fee for the online application.

text: Magapadala sang text mesage ang Pag-IBIG fund sa mga kalipikado nga miyembro.
english: The Pag-IBIG fund will send a text message to eligible members.

text: Ang nasambit nga programa ang natalana nga aprobahan sang Pag-IBIG board agud nga maumpisahan na ini sa Nobyembre.
english: The program is scheduled to be approved by the Pag-IBIG board to start in November.

text: Nagpirma na ang apat ka senador sang draft resolution nga nagahatag sang giya kun paano atubangon sang Senado ang desisyon sang Supreme Court nga nagbasura sang impeachment articles batok kay Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: The four senators have signed a draft resolution that provides guidance on how the Senate will deal with the Supreme Court's decision to dismiss the impeachment articles against Vice President Sara Duterte.

text: Suno kay Senate Deputy Minority Leader Risa Hontiveros, ang nasambit nga draft resolution subong nagalibot na sa Senado kag ginbase sa mga giya nga halin sa pila ka mga anay mahistrado.
english: According to Senate Deputy Minority Leader Risa Hontiveros, the draft resolution is now circulating in the Senate and is based on guidelines from several former judges.

text: Target nga ipresentar ini sa plenary session sa Agosto 6 para sa diskusyon.
english: It is targeted to be presented at the plenary session on August 6 for discussion.

text: Ginpahayag ni Hontiveros nga indi pa dapat ibasura ang kaso bangud wala pa sang ginpresintar nga ebidensya.
english: Hontiveros said the case should not be dismissed because no evidence has been presented.

text: Dapat, suno sa iya, timbangon sang Senado ang pagrespeto sa Supreme Court kag ang responsibilidad sini nga siguruhon ang accountability sang mga opisyal sang gobyerno.
english: The Senate should, he said, weigh respect for the Supreme Court with its responsibility to ensure accountability of government officials.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, ginapreparar man sang Kamara ang pagpasaka sang motion for reconsideration batok sa desisyon sang Supreme Court.
english: Meanwhile, the House is also preparing to file a motion for reconsideration against the Supreme Court's decision.

text: MANILA – Mas ginpasangkad pa sang Bureau of Customs ang kampanya agud nga matapna ang rice smuggling paagi sa pagpatigayon sang raid sa mga warehouse nga ginadudahan ginatagu-an sang illegally imported grain.
english: MANILA – The Bureau of Customs has expanded its campaign to curb rice smuggling by conducting raids on warehouses suspected of storing illegally imported grain.

text: Suno kay Bureau of Customs Commissioner Rey Leonardo Guerrero, ang rice stocks nga gin-import sang private traders ang natalana nga ipaidalom sa “post-modification and post audit” agud mapasigurado nga ma-assess sang husto ang undervalued shipments.
english: According to Bureau of Customs Commissioner Rey Leonardo Guerrero, the rice stocks imported by private traders are scheduled to undergo a “post-modification and post audit” to ensure that the undervalued shipments are properly assessed.

text: Ang nasambit nga lihok suno kay Guerrero ang kasunod sang pagkwestyon sang Federation of Free Farmers tuhoy sa assessment and valuation system sa rice imports.
english: Guerrero said the move follows the Federation of Free Farmers' questioning of the assessment and valuation system for rice imports.

text: Bangud nga ginakabig nga “critical” commodity ang bugas, ang traders ang mahimo nga maka-avail sang Provisional Goods Declaration sa pagproseso sang shipments.
english: Since rice is considered a “critical” commodity, traders can avail of a Provisional Goods Declaration to process shipments.

text: May kaangtanan diri, may yara na sang gin-deploy nga inspectors sa warehouses nga ginadudahan nga ginatagu-an sang smuggled rice stocks.
english: In this regard, inspectors have already been deployed in warehouses suspected of storing smuggled rice stocks.

text: Saulogon sang Simbahang Katoliko ang 62nd World Day of Prayer for Vocations sa Mayo 11, Domingo.
english: The Catholic Church will celebrate the 62nd World Day of Prayer for Vocations on May 11, Sunday.

text: Magadungan ini sa Fourth Sunday of Easter, nga kilala man bilang Good Shepherd Sunday.
english: It will coincide with the Fourth Sunday of Easter, also known as Good Shepherd Sunday.

text: Ini nga selebrasyon ang gin-establish sang 1964 ni Pope Paul VI kag nagapanawagan sa mga katoliko sa bilog nga kalibutan nga magpangamuyo para sa bokasyon sang pagkapari, pagka-diakono, kag konsagrado nga kabuhi.
english: This celebration was established in 1964 by Pope Paul VI and calls on Catholics around the world to pray for the vocation of the priesthood, diaconate, and consecrated life.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Rev.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Rev.

text: Fr.
english: Fr.

text: Nathaniel Gentizon, Spiritual Director sang St.
english: Nathaniel Gentizon, Spiritual Director of St.

text: Joseph Regional Seminary kag Director sang Commission on Vocation sang Archdiocese of Jaro, iya ginpahayag nga ang tema subong nga tuig amo ang “Pilgrims of Hope: The Gift of Life”, nga una na-highlight sa mensahe ni Pope Francis para sa okasyon.
english: Joseph Regional Seminary and Director of the Commission on Vocation of the Archdiocese of Jaro, he said that this year's theme is “Pilgrims of Hope: The Gift of Life”, which was first highlighted in Pope Francis' message for the occasion.

text: Suno kay Father Gentizon, kaangay sang ginsiling ni Pope nga ang kada bokasyon, mangin ordained ministry, consecrated life, ukon lay service man, ini ang senyales sang paglaum sang Diyos para sa kalibutan kag para sa iy kabataan.
english: According to Father Gentizon, as the Pope said that every vocation, whether ordained ministry, consecrated life, or lay service, is a sign of God's hope for the world and for his children.

text: Ginaengganyo man ang tanan nga mangin “pilgrims of hope” paagi sa paghalad sang ila kabuhi bilang regalo paagi sa isa ka pagpanglakaton sa kalibutan nga may paghigugma kag serbisyo.
english: All are also encouraged to become “pilgrims of hope” by offering their lives as a gift through a world journey of love and service.

text: Nagdepensa si United States President Joe Biden kasunod sang iya performance sa presidential debate batok kay anay President Donald Trump.
english: United States President Joe Biden has defended himself following his performance in the presidential debate against former President Donald Trump.

text: Sa 90 minutos nga debate sa Atlanta, Georgia 9:00 kahapon sang aga (oras sa Pilipinas), talalupangdon nga pila ka beses nga indi na mahangpan ang ginapanghambal sang 81-anyos nga presidente kag nagakalipat pa sang iya isugpon.
english: During the 90-minute debate in Atlanta, Georgia at 9:00 am yesterday (Philippine time), it was noticeable that the 81-year-old president several times could not understand what he was saying and forgot what he was going to say.

text: Matapos gintawag sang kadam-an nga pigado ang iya performance, gin-athag naman sang iya senior campaign aide nga indi mag-atras sa matchup ang Democrat leader kag magadayon man ini pati sa ikaduha nga presidential debate sa Septyembre.
english: After many called his performance poor, his senior campaign aide clarified that the Democrat leader will not back down from the matchup and will continue in the second presidential debate in September.

text: Sa Raleigh, North Carolina, nag-abot si Biden nga mas may pwersa na ang tingog kag may dala nga mga atake batok kay Trump.
english: In Raleigh, North Carolina, Biden arrived with a more forceful voice and with attacks against Trump.

text: Samtang nagasinggitan ang mga tawo sang “Four More Years” ukon dugang nga termino, ginsiling ni Biden nga indi na siya lamharon kag indi na mahapos para sa iya ang maglakat kag maghambal pati na ang pag-debate.
english: As the crowd shouted “Four More Years,” Biden said he was no longer young and it was not easy for him to walk and talk as well as debate.

text: Apang suno sa presidente, nakahibalo siya kun paano maghambal sang kamatuoran kag nakahibalo siya sang iya trabaho.
english: But the president said he knows how to tell the truth and he knows his job.

text: “Folks, I don’t walk as easy as I used to.
english: “Folks, I don’t walk as easily as I used to.

text: I don’t speak as smoothly as I used to.
english: I don’t speak as smoothly as I used to.

text: I don’t debate as well as I used to, but … I know how to tell the truth.
english: I don’t debate as well as I used to, but … I know how to tell the truth.

text: I know right from wrong, and I know how to do this job,” pahayag sini samtang nagasinggit ang iya mga tagasuporta.
english: I know right from wrong, and I know how to do this job,” he said as his supporters shouted.

text:
“I know, like millions of Americans know, when you get knocked down, you get back up.”

Sa amo man nga rally, ginpang-pahat-pahat ni Biden ang mga sala nga ginpangwakal ni Trump sa debate kaangot sa ekonomiya, krimen, kag immigration.
english:
“I know, like millions of Americans know, when you get knocked down, you get back up.”

At the same rally, Biden shared the mistakes Trump made in the debate on the economy, crime, and immigration.

text: Ginsiling sini nga nag-set si Trump sang bag-o nga record sang pinakamataas nga numero sang kabutigan sa isa ka debate.
english: He said Trump set a new record for the highest number of lies in a debate.

text:
Indi lang ini convicted nga kriminal suno kay Biden kundi isa ka “one-man crime wave.”

“I spent 90 minutes on stage debating a guy with the morals of an alley cat,” suno sa current president.
english:
This is not just a convicted criminal, Biden said, but a “one-man crime wave.”

“I spent 90 minutes on stage debating a guy with the morals of an alley cat,” according to the current president.

text:
“I think he set a new record for the number of lies told at a debate.”

“Donald Trump isn’t just a convicted felon.
english:
“I think he set a new record for the number of lies told at a debate.”

“Donald Trump isn’t just a convicted felon.

text: Donald Trump is a one-man crime wave,” dugang sini.
english: Donald Trump is a one-man crime wave,” it added.

text: Ginpahayag ni Atty. Nicholas Kaufman, lead legal counsel ni former President Rodrigo Roa Duterte, nga wala sang interes ang kampo sang anay presidente nga kuhaon nga abogado si anay Presidential Spokesperson Harry Roque.
english: Atty. Nicholas Kaufman, lead legal counsel of former President Rodrigo Roa Duterte, said the former president's camp has no interest in hiring former Presidential Spokesperson Harry Roque as a lawyer.

text: Ginpagguwa ni Kaufman ang ini nga pahayag bangud sang pag-intra ni Roque sa ginapangatubang nga kaso ni Duterte may kaangtanan sa “crimes against humanity”.
english: Kaufman issued this statement because of Roque's involvement in Duterte's crimes against humanity case.

text: Pahayag pa sang abogado, sa una nga adlaw pa lamang wala na sang interes kag plano ang Team Duterte nga kuhaon nga abogado si Roque.
english: The lawyer said that from the first day, Team Duterte had no interest and plan to hire Roque as a lawyer.

text: Suno pa sa iya, ginapakita lamang ni Roque nga siya isa lang ka tawo nga may kapasidad nga magdepensa sa anay Presidente.
english: He said Roque is only showing that he is just one person who has the capacity to defend the former President.

text: Ginklaro ni Kaufman nga mismo si Duterte ang nagsiling nga pauntaton na si Roque sa mga ginapanghimo sini nga pag-intra ukon pagsaw-saw sa iya ginapangatubang nga mga kaso sa ICC.
english: Kaufman clarified that Duterte himself said that Roque would be stopped from interfering in his ICC cases.

text: Ginhambalan man sang abogado si Roque nga untaton na ang pagpa-epal sa kaso kag magbalik na lamang sa Pilipinas para atubangon ang iya kaugalingon nga mga kaso.
english: The lawyer also told Roque to stop appealing the case and return to the Philippines to face his own cases.

text: Nagdesisyon na ang American NBA veteran player Vince Carter nga magretiro.
english: American NBA veteran player Vince Carter has decided to retire.

text: Ini ang ginkumpirma sang iya nga team nga Atlanta Hawks.
english: This was confirmed by his team, the Atlanta Hawks.

text: Naglab-ot sa 22 season kag yara sa 40 ka tuig ang paghampang ni Carter sa NBA.
english: Carter has played in the NBA for 22 seasons and 40 years.

text: Tunga sang tuig sa iya career, nakahampang ini sa Toronto Raptors kag New Jersey Nets antes nagsaylo sa lain-lain nga team kaangay sang Orlando Magic, Phoenix Suns, Dallas Mavericks, Memphis Grizzles kag Sacramento Kings.
english: Half a year into his career, he played with the Toronto Raptors and New Jersey Nets before moving on to different teams like the Orlando Magic, Phoenix Suns, Dallas Mavericks, Memphis Grizzles and Sacramento Kings.

text: Nangin no.
english: It became no.

text: 5 pick sa 1998 NBA draft si Carter kag ginkilala bilang Rookie of the Year kag eight-time All-Star player.
english: 5 pick in the 1998 NBA draft Carter was named Rookie of the Year and an eight-time All-Star player.

text: Tuig 2000 sang magdaog man ini sa slamdunk contest sa NBA.
english: In 2000, he also won the slamdunk contest in the NBA.

text: Naaresto sang Maasin Municipal Police Station (MPS) ang isa ka lalaki sa Brgy.
english: The Maasin Municipal Police Station (MPS) arrested a man in Brgy.

text: Punong, Maasin, Iloilo bangud sa kaso nga pagpanghimulos.
english: Punong, Maasin, Iloilo for rape case.

text: Ang suspek amo si Alyan John, 22-anyos, laborer, Top 5 Most Wanted Person sa Provincial Level, kag residente sang nasambit nga lugar.Nadakpan ang suspek sa ila man mismo nga barangay.
english: The suspect was identified as Alyan John, 22, laborer, Top 5 Most Wanted Person at the Provincial Level, and resident of the said area. The suspect was arrested in their own barangay.

text: Suno sa Maasin PNP, isa ka dako nga kadalag-an ang pag-aresto sa nasambit most wanted person sa probinsya.
english: According to Maasin PNP, the arrest of the most wanted person in the province is a great victory.

text: Subong, yara na sa kustodiya sang kapulisan si Alyas John kon sa diin, nagapangutabang sang kaso nga wala sang rekomendasyon nga piyansa halin sa korte.
english: John is now in police custody where he is pleading guilty without a bail recommendation from the court.

english: Article: Bombo Volunteer Joedel Nollaga

text: Nagahimo na sang mga tikang ang presidente sang Association of Barangay Captains (ABC) sang Distrito sang Lapuz, Iloilo City kasunod sang na-eksperyensyahan nga baha sa amo nga lugar.
english: The president of the Association of Barangay Captains (ABC) of Lapuz District, Iloilo City is already taking steps following the floods experienced in the area.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Punong Barangay Arnel Asturias, ABC president sang Distrito sang Lapuz, iya ginpahayag nga nakig-istorya na ang talatapan sa Iloilo City District Engineering Office (ICDEO) bangud sila man ang nakabalo sa solusyon sa mga ginabaha nga lugar.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Punong Barangay Arnel Asturias, ABC president of Lapuz District, said the office has already spoken to the Iloilo City District Engineering Office (ICDEO) because they also know the solution to the flooded areas.

text: Suno kay Asturias, ginasunod sini pangsekyar ang mga drainage sa amo nga lugar agud masiguro nga indi na mabaha sa tion sang tig-ululan.
english: Asturias said he is monitoring the drainage in the area to ensure that it will not flood during the rainy season.

text: Dugang sini nga may mga posyon sa ila drainage nga madugay mag-subside ang tubig-baha apang ginapangitaan na sang paagi agud masolusyonan.
english: He added that there are potions in their drainage that take a long time to subside the flood water but they are looking for ways to solve them.

text: Plano naman sang natungdan nga butangan sang screen ang pila ka mga kanal agud nga malikawan nga magbara ang mga basura.
english: He plans to install screens in some canals to prevent garbage from clogging.

text: Ginpanawagan sang Department of Interior and Local Government (DILG), ang pagpahamtang sang preemptive evacuation sa mga lugar nga malapit sa baybayon sa Cagayan, Central Luzon, CALABARZON, Bicol Region, Eastern Visayas, Davao, CARAGA kag iban pa nga lugar nga posible maapektuhan sang tsunami halin sa Kamchatka, Russia.
english: The Department of Interior and Local Government (DILG) has called for the imposition of preemptive evacuation in coastal areas in Cagayan, Central Luzon, CALABARZON, Bicol Region, Eastern Visayas, Davao, CARAGA and other areas that may be affected by the tsunami from Kamchatka, Russia.

text: Base sa datos halin sa Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (PHIVOLCS), posible nga mag-abot sa baybayon sang Pilipinas ang minor sea level disturbance ukon tsunami nga may kataason nga isa ka metro, kasunod sang 8.7 magnitude nga linog nga natabo sa east nga bahin sang Kamchatka Peninsula.
english: Based on data from the Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (PHIVOLCS), a minor sea level disturbance or tsunami with a height of one meter is likely to hit the Philippine coast, following an 8.7 magnitude earthquake that occurred in the eastern part of the Kamchatka Peninsula.

text: Ginahingyo sang DILG ang mga lokal nga pamunuan nga magpatuman sang precautionary measures kag mag-andam sang evacuation plans para sa mga apektado nga lugar.
english: The DILG urged local government units to implement precautionary measures and prepare evacuation plans for the affected areas.

text: Ginpahanumdom man ang publiko nga indi anay magpalapit sa baybayon kag magbantay sa mga unusual nga balud.
english: The public was also reminded to stay away from the beach and watch out for unusual waves.

text:
Yara sa idalom sang PHIVOLCS Tsunami Advisory ang masunod nga mga lugar:

-Batanes Group of Islands-Cagayan-Isabela-Aurora-Quezon-Camarines Norte-Camarines Sur-Albay-Sorsogon-Catanduanes-Northern Samar-Eastern Samar-Leyte-Southern Leyte-Dinagat Islands-Surigao Del Norte-Surigao Del Sur-Davao Del Norte-Davao Oriental-Davao Occidental-Davao Del Sur-Davao De Oro

Ginapangabay ang mga pumuluyo nga maghalin sa baybayon kag magpadulong sa mas taas nga lugar agud malikawan ang peligro.
english:
The following areas are under the PHIVOLCS Tsunami Advisory:

-Batanes Group of Islands-Cagayan-Isabela-Aurora-Quezon-Camarines Norte-Camarines Sur-Albay-Sorsogon-Catanduanes-Northern Samar-Eastern Samar-Leyte-Southern Leyte-Dinagat Islands-Surigao Del Norte-Surigao-Davao Del Davao-Davado-Northeastern Western-Davao Del Sur-Davao De Oro

Residents are asked to leave the coast and head for higher ground to avoid danger.

text: MANILA – Nagakahangawa si Senator Win Gatchalian may kaangtanan sa depleted output gikan sa Malampaya natural gas field, ang ika duha sa pinaka daku nga electric power source sa Luzon.
english: MANILA – Senator Win Gatchalian is concerned about the depleted output from the Malampaya natural gas field, the second largest electric power source in Luzon.

text: Suno kay Gatchalian nga chairman sang Senate Committee on Energy, ang absence sang replacement fuel para sa Malampaya natural gas ang makabig nga pamahog sa energy security kag mahimo nga magresulta sa rotational brownouts.
english: Gatchalian, chairman of the Senate Committee on Energy, said the absence of replacement fuel for Malampaya natural gas is considered a threat to energy security and could result in rotational brownouts.

text: Ang Malampaya amo ang naga-supply sang fuel para sa Luzon electricity grid sa sulod na sang duha ka dekada kag nagaserbisyo sa 21 percent sang national electricity demand kag ginalauman nga maubos sa 2024.
english: Malampaya has been supplying fuel for the Luzon electricity grid for two decades and serves 21 percent of the national electricity demand and is expected to run out by 2024.

text: Bangud sini, ginduso ni Gatchalian ang Senate Bill No.
english: Because of this, Gatchalian proposed Senate Bill No.

text: 1819 nga magahatag sang national energy policy and framework para sa development kag regulation sang Philippine midstream natural gas industry.
english: 1819 which will provide a national energy policy and framework for the development and regulation of the Philippine midstream natural gas industry.

text: Sa pagpaathag sang senador, kinahanglan ang complementary law agud mapasangkad ang midstream natural gas industry lakip na ang transportation, transmission, storage kag marketing sang natural gas gikan sa liquefied natural gas ukon LNG.
english: The senator explained that a complementary law is needed to expand the midstream natural gas industry including the transportation, transmission, storage and marketing of natural gas from liquefied natural gas or LNG.

text: Ang proposed legal framework para sa midstream natural gas industry ang makagarantiya sang consumer protection paagi sa transparent kag competitive pricing of services.
english: The proposed legal framework for the midstream natural gas industry will guarantee consumer protection through transparent and competitive pricing of services.

text: Luyag sang DepEd nga 15 ka adlaw lang nga gamiton ang mga eskwelahan bilang mga evacuation centers.
english: The DepEd wants schools to be used as evacuation centers for only 15 days.

text: Suno kay DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara, ini agud indi maapektuhan ang pagtuon sang kabataan.
english: According to DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara, this is to ensure that the children's learning is not affected.

text: Apisar may mga lugar gid man nga padayon nga ginagamit ang eskwelehan bilang evacuation center kaangay sang mga yara sa Kanlaon, ginpasiguro ni Angara nga padayon ang ila pagpakig-angot sa Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) kag National Disaster Risk Reduction Management Council (NDRRMC) para himuon nga prayoridad ang kahimtangan sang mga evacuees kag mga eskwelahan.
english: Although there are areas where schools continue to be used as evacuation centers such as those in Kanlaon, Angara assured that they continue to liaise with the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) and the National Disaster Risk Reduction Management Council (NDRRMC) to make the situation of evacuees and schools a priority.

text: MANILA – Halos ka tunga sang 62 ka mga registered Philippine Offshore Gaming Operators (POGOs) sa pungsod nga may kasubong nga address sa ila service providers ang natukiban nga nagalapas sa requirement sang gobyerno.
english: MANILA – Nearly half of the 62 registered Philippine Offshore Gaming Operators (POGOs) in the country with similar addresses to their service providers were found to be in violation of government requirements.

text: Suno sa Anti-Money Laundering Council, naglab-ot sa 26 ka POGO ang may pareho nga address sa ila service providers.
english: According to the Anti-Money Laundering Council, as many as 26 POGOs have the same address as their service providers.

text: Sa pagpaathag ni Anti-Money Laundering Council Secretariat Executive Director Mel Georgie Racela, indi mahimo nga magpareho ang POGO licensee kag ang service provider.
english: Anti-Money Laundering Council Secretariat Executive Director Mel Georgie Racela explained that the POGO licensee and the service provider cannot be the same.

text: Suno kay Racela, ang requirement sang Philippine Amusement and Gaming Corporation amo nga ang Philippine service provider amo ang dapat nga i-hire sang POGO agud nga ang ekonomiya sang pungsod ang makabenepisyo.
english: According to Racela, the requirement of the Philippine Amusement and Gaming Corporation is that the Philippine service provider should be hired by POGO so that the country's economy can benefit.

text: Ginpahayag ni Racela nga sa subong, padayon ang information gathering sang Anti-Money Laundering Council may kaangtanan sa tag-iya sang mga erring licensed POGOs.
english: Racela said the Anti-Money Laundering Council is currently conducting information gathering regarding the owners of erring licensed POGOs.

text: Mahimo nga sa masunod nga semana, mahatagan naman sang kopya ang Senado.
english: The Senate may be given a copy next week.

text: Apisar sang COVID-19 pandemic, ang POGO industry lang ang ginpahanugutan nga makapadayon sa pagnegosyo sa kondisyon nga ila bayaran ang unpaid taxes sa Bureau of Internal Revenue kag sundon ang strict health protocols.
english: Despite the COVID-19 pandemic, only the POGO industry was allowed to continue doing business on condition that they pay unpaid taxes to the Bureau of Internal Revenue and follow strict health protocols.

text: Gintawag naman ini sang mga senador nga “good riddance” bangud nga ang POGO ang gina-angot sa pagtaas sang kriminalidad kag prostitusyon sa pungsod.
english: The senators called it a “good riddance” because POGO is linked to the increase in crime and prostitution in the country.

text: MANILA-Nagalaum ang Phoenix Fuelmaster Forward nga si Calvin Abueva nga makabalik ini sa paghampang sa tion nga matapos niya ang ginapahimo sang PBA sa iya.
english: MANILA-Phoenix Fuelmaster Forward Calvin Abueva hopes to return to play once he finishes what the PBA is asking him to do.

text: Suno kay Abueva, may yara lang sang pila ka bagay nga ginapa-obra ang PBA board, agud mabawi ang suspensyon batok sa iya.
english: According to Abueva, there are only a few things that the PBA board is working on, to lift the suspension against him.

text: Pila sa mga natapos na niya himuon suno sa PBA player, amo ang pagpangayo sang pasaylo sa board kag sa mga PBA Fans.
english: Among the things he has already done, according to the PBA player, is to apologize to the board and the PBA Fans.

text: Gindoble man sini ang ginapahimo sa iya nga community service, bangud oportunidad na niya ini nga makabulig sa iban pa nga tawo.
english: He also doubled his community service, because it was his opportunity to help other people.

text: Nagpaidalom man siya suno kay Abueva sa drug test, kag may nabilin pa ini nga duha ka sesyon sa iya psychologist.
english: Abueva said he also underwent a drug test, and has two sessions left with his psychologist.

text: Madumduman nga gindagdagan sang indefinite suspension si Abueva, matapos sang ginhimo nga pagpanakit sini sa import nga si Terrence Jones, kag ginapahayag pagpangbastos sini sa kahagugma sang TNT KaTropa player Ray Parks.
english: Abueva was given an indefinite suspension after he assaulted import Terrence Jones and allegedly abused TNT KaTropa player Ray Parks' girlfriend.

text: Patay ang anom ka indibidwal sa Pakistan matapos magluntad ang isa ka lapnagon nga sunog sa Karachi City.
english: Six individuals have been killed in Pakistan after a widespread fire broke out in Karachi City.

text: Ginguba sini ang pila ka bahin sang shopping center sa historic downtown sang nasambit nga syudad sa Pakistan.
english: It destroyed parts of a shopping center in the historic downtown of the city in Pakistan.

text: Gilayon naman ini nga ginpalong sang mga bumbero agud nga pauntaton ang paglapta sang kalayo sa mga negosyo sang mga tawo didto.
english: Firefighters immediately extinguished the fire to stop the spread of the fire to the businesses of the people there.

text: Suno sa isa ka police surgeon sang Karachi City, anum ka mga bangkay ang gindala sa Civil Hospital sang Karachi kag may 11 ka tawo ang nasamaran.
english: According to a Karachi City police surgeon, six bodies were brought to Karachi's Civil Hospital and 11 people were injured.

text:
Dugang pa diri, ginpatuman man sang mga pulis ang “mass disaster protocols.”

Suno sa awtoridad narusdak ang pila ka bahin sang building kag padayon nga naga-bantay ang mga rescue official sa kabilugan nga pagkaguba sang nasambit nga estruktura.
english:
In addition, the police also implemented mass disaster protocols.

According to authorities, parts of the building collapsed and rescue officials are continuing to monitor the overall destruction of the structure.

text: Magabuligay si Olympic gold medalist Hidilyn Diaz kag ang mga ahensya sang gobyerno sa pagtukod sang pinakadako nga weightlifting academy sa pungsod.
english: Olympic gold medalist Hidilyn Diaz and government agencies will work together to establish the largest weightlifting academy in the country.

text: Upod sa proyekto ang Philippine Sports Commission, Department of Education, kag Department of Budget and Management, nga may handum nga pabakuron ang mga programa sang isports sa mga eskwelahan, suno sa direktiba ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: The project is joined by the Philippine Sports Commission, Department of Education, and Department of Budget and Management, which aspires to strengthen sports programs in schools, as directed by President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: Ginpahayag ni Chairman Pato Gregorio sang Philippine Sports Commission nga si Diaz ang mangin pangulo sa pagtudlo sang weightlifting sa masobra 300 ka eskwelahan sa bug-os nga pungsod.
english: Chairman Pato Gregorio of the Philippine Sports Commission said Diaz will be in charge of teaching weightlifting in more than 300 schools nationwide.

text: Ginsuportahan man sang Department of Budget and Management ang inisyatibo, nga may ginplano nga pondo nga P180 milyon para sa proyekto.
english: The Department of Budget and Management also supported the initiative, with a planned fund of P180 million for the project.

text: Tinutuyo sang programa nga mapatindog ang bag-o nga henerasyon sang mga atleta paagi sa HD Weightlifting Academy ni Diaz nga yara sa Rizal.
english: The program aims to build a new generation of athletes through Diaz's HD Weightlifting Academy in Rizal.

text: GIN-IGU sang mabaskug nga linog, nga may magnitude 7.0, ang probinsya sang Abra sadtong aga sang Hulyo 27.
english: A strong earthquake, measuring 7.0 on the Richter scale, struck the province of Abra on the morning of July 27.

text: Sunu sa Phivolcs, Major Earthquake ini sa bracket sang magnitude 7.0-7.9, nga sunod sa Great Earthquake nga yara sa magnitude 8.0 pataas.
english: According to the Phivolcs, it was a Major Earthquake in the bracket of magnitude 7.0-7.9, followed by a Great Earthquake in the magnitude 8.0 and above.

text: Duha ka adlaw pagkatapos sadto, Hulyo 29, ang National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council (NDRRMC) nag-report nga anom (6) ang napatay, apat (4) ang missing, kag 136 ang nasamaran.
english: Two days later, on July 29, the National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council (NDRRMC) reported six (6) dead, four (4) missing, and 136 injured.

text: Sa kabilugan, sobra 79,260 ka tawo ang naapektuhan, kag ang mga  7,331 nga na-displace na-akomodar dayon sa 26 ka evacuation sites.
english: In total, more than 79,260 people were affected, and about 7,331 displaced people were immediately accommodated in 26 evacuation sites.

text: At least 1,583 ka puluy-an ang lubos nga naguba kag 1,535 ka iban ang nasamaran.
english: At least 1,583 homes were completely destroyed and 1,535 others were injured.

text: Ang cost of damage naglab-ut sa P48.3 Million.
english: The cost of damage amounted to P48.3 Million.

text: Mga 51 ka government building ang nasamaran kag 1,214 ka puluy-an ang na-damaged.
english: About 51 government buildings were damaged and 1,214 homes were damaged.

text: Tungod sini, liwat napukaw ang daku nga kahadlok sang aton mga pumuluyo sa mabaskug nga linog, labi na gid sa mga lugar nga may ginapatihan nga earthquake fault malapit sa ila.
english: As a result, our residents are once again afraid of strong earthquakes, especially in areas where there is a suspected earthquake fault nearby.

text: Isa sa sining mga lugar nga naigu sang Major Earthquake diri sa pungsod amo ang probinsya sang Bohol nga gin-igu sang magnitude 7.2 nga linog sadtong Oktubre 15, 2013.
english: One of these areas that was hit by the Major Earthquake in the country was the province of Bohol which was hit by a magnitude 7.2 earthquake on October 15, 2013.

text: Nagpatay ini sang 222 ka mga tawo, nagsamad sang mga 976 pa nga iban, kag nagrumpag sang madamo nga mga puluy-an kag iban pa nga infrastructura.
english: It killed 222 people, injured about 976 others, and destroyed scores of homes and other infrastructure.

text: Kon ano kabaskug ini, ginsiling sang isa ka photographer nga indi siya makatindug agud magkuha sang mga retrato kag kinahanglan pa nga maghapa siya sa dalan nga madamo na sing bitak-bitak.
english: One photographer said that he could not stand to take pictures and had to lie down on the road, which was already cracked.

text: Ginapaabot man ang “The Big One” sa Metro Manila kon diin, sunu sa nadiskubrihan sang mga mangin-alamon, sa tunga mismo nahamtang ang isa ka earthquake fault.
english: “The Big One” is also expected in Metro Manila where, according to scientists, an earthquake fault is located in the middle.

text: Diri sa Iloilo, indi pa malipatan sang aton mga katigulangan ang linog nga kon tawgon Lady KayKay sa libro ni Atty. Rex Salvilla nga Interesting Facts about West Visayas.
english: Here in Iloilo, our ancestors will never forget the earthquake called Lady KayKay in the book of Atty. Rex Salvilla Interesting Facts about West Visayas.

text: Nag-igu ini sa Iloilo sadtong Enero 25, 1948.
english: It hit Iloilo on January 25, 1948.

text: May pwersa ini nga magnitude 8.5.
english: It has a force of magnitude 8.5.

text: Nag-utas ini sang kabuhi sang 14 ka tawo kag nagrumpag sang madamo nga mga puluy-an kag iban pa nga infrastructura sa halos tanan nga bahin sang isla sang Panay, lakip na ang Jaro belfry.
english: It claimed the lives of 14 people and destroyed many homes and other infrastructure in almost all parts of the island of Panay, including the Jaro belfry.

text: Nagdala man ini sang tidal wave sa baybayon sang Oton tubtub sa San Joaquin nga nagrumpag sang mga punot dira.
english: It also brought a tidal wave along the coast of Oton to San Joaquin that knocked down trees there.

text: Naga-enjoy gid sadto ang mga kabataan sa Jaro Carnival angot sa kapistahan ni Nuestra Sra.
english: The children were enjoying the Jaro Carnival in connection with the feast of Nuestra Sra.

text: de la Candelaria sa Pebrero 2.
english: of the Candlemas on February 2.

text: Nagasaot gid ini sila sa lanton sang bantog sadto nga saot nga kon tawgon kay-kay, kag gani ginhingadlan ini nga linog Lady KayKay.
english: They were dancing to the rhythm of the famous dance called kay-kay, and so the earthquake was named Lady KayKay.

text:
***

Wala sing makasiling kon san-o magpabatyag ukon magbalik ang kasubong kabaskug nga linog.
english:
***

No one can say when such a strong earthquake will be felt or return.

text: Kon may ginapatihan man ang mga mangin-alamon, amo lang ang probabilidad nga kon kis-a nagabalik ang kasubong kabaskug nga linog pagkatapos sang madamo nga tinuig, katulad sang 50 anyos pataas.
english: If scientists believe anything, it is the probability that such a strong earthquake sometimes returns after many years, such as 50 years or more.

text: Well, kon matabo gid man ina sa aton panahon wala kita sing mahimo kundi mag-preparar sa pagpanguna sang gobyerno upod sa aton pagpangamuyo.
english: Well, if that ever happens in our time we have no choice but to prepare to lead the government with our prayer.

text:
***

Gintay-og sang magnitude 7.0 nga linog ang probinsya sang Abra sadtong aga sang Miyerkoles, Hulyo 27.
english:
***

A magnitude 7.0 earthquake rocked Abra province on Wednesday morning, July 27.

text: Natabo ato sang mga 8:43 sang aga, sunu sa isa ka report.
english: It happened around 8:43 a.m., according to a report.

text: Ang epicenter sining linog, sunu sa Phivolcs, nahamtang sa banwa sang Lagangilang dira sa Abra.
english: The epicenter of the quake, according to the Phivolcs, was located in the town of Lagangilang in Abra.

text: May pwersa ini, sunu sa Phivolcs kag sunu man sa US Geological Survey, sing magnitude 7.0 (ML) sa Phivolcs Richter Scale local surface measurement, kag sa USGS Moment Magnitude (Mw) nga may ikasarang sa pag-detect sang seismic vibrations sa diin man nga bahin sa idalom kalibutan.
english: It has a force, according to the Phivolcs and also according to the US Geological Survey, of magnitude 7.0 (ML) at the Phivolcs Richter Scale local surface measurement, and at the USGS Moment Magnitude (Mw) which is capable of detecting seismic vibrations anywhere underground.

text: Nagpabatyag dayon ini sang mga 280 ka aftershock (Inquirer) sa sina mismo nga adlaw, Hulyo 27, sa kusog nga magnitude 1.5-5.0 sa lain-lain nga bahin sang Luzon.
english: It then caused about 280 aftershocks (Inquirer) on the same day, July 27, with a magnitude of 1.5-5.0 in different parts of Luzon.

text: Magasige pa ining mga aftershocks, sunu sa kay Usec kag Phivolcs OIC Renato Solidum, sa sulod sang isa pa ka bulan.
english: These aftershocks will continue, according to Usec and Phivolcs OIC Renato Solidum, for another month.

text: Nag-deklarar sang State of Calamity ang Abra sa sunod nga adlaw, Hulyo 28.
english: Abra declared a State of Calamity the next day, July 28.

text: Ginpanugyan ni Usec Solidum nga indi anay magbalik ang mga tawo sa ila mga puluy-an kag mga edificio bag-o ma-sertipayan sang mga otoridad nga masarangan na sini ang masunod nga aftershocks.
english: Usec Solidum advised people not to return to their homes and buildings until the authorities certify that they can handle the next aftershocks.

text: Tungod sini, gintagaan na lang anay sang gobyerno ang mga naapektuhan sang mga tent kon diin makatener anay ang mga pumuluyo sa gwa sang ila mga puluy-an kag sang mga pagkaon samtang nagapabilin sila dira.
english: Because of this, the government has provided tents to the affected residents where they can stay outside their homes and food while they stay there.

text: Samtang, sige pa nga ginatublag sila sang padayon nga mga aftershock./PN
english: Meanwhile, they continue to be plagued by continuous aftershocks./PN

text: Ginadayaw sang pila ka mga senador ang desisyon sang Korte Suprema nga nagamando sa gobyerno nga ibalik ang P60 bilyon nga pondo sang PhilHealth nga gintransfer sa National Treasury sang nagligad.
english: Some senators praised the Supreme Court's decision ordering the government to return the P60 billion PhilHealth fund that was transferred to the National Treasury in the past.

text: Suno kay Senate President Vicente Sotto III kag Sen.
english: According to Senate President Vicente Sotto III and Sen.

text: Sherwin Gatchalian, nakasunod na ang gin-aprubahan nga 2026 budget sa mando sang Korte Suprema, kun sa diin may yara ini sang P60B allocation para sa PhilHealth.
english: Sherwin Gatchalian, the approved 2026 budget is in line with the Supreme Court's order, which includes a P60B allocation for PhilHealth.

text: Nagpasalamat naman si Sen.
english: He thanked Sen.

text: Bong Go sa unanonimous decision kag nagpanawagan sang klaro nga explenasyon kon sa diin nagkadto ang P60B nga pondo.
english: Bong Go in the unanimous decision and called for a clear explanation of where the P60B fund went.

text: Suno sa Senador isa ini ka dako nga kadalag-an para sa mga Pilipino ilabi na sa mga imol nga pasyente nga labi nga nagakinahanglan sang bulig gikan sa gobyerno.
english: The Senator said this is a great victory for Filipinos especially the poor patients who are in greatest need of assistance from the government.

text: Ginpakigbahin man ni Sen.
english: He also shared with Sen.

text: Risa Hontiveros ang iya pagpasalamat sa Korte Suprema sa pag-kay o sang dako nga sala sang gobyerno.
english: Risa Hontiveros expressed her gratitude to the Supreme Court for correcting the government's big mistake.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang ini nga mando sang pagbalik sang pondo nga P60B paagi sa 2026 General Appropriations Act.
english: It is known that this order of return of funds of P60B through the 2026 General Appropriations Act.

text: PERU – Gintay-og sang magnitude 7.2 nga linog ang southern Peru subong nga Byernes.
english: PERU – A magnitude 7.2 earthquake struck southern Peru on Friday.

text: Suno sa United States Geological Survey, ini ang may kadalumon nga 28 kilometers.
english: According to the United States Geological Survey, it is 28 kilometers deep.

text: Nag-igo ini 8 kilometeros sa nakatundan sang Atiquipa kag 600 kilometeros halin sa nabagatnan sang capital sang Peru nga Lima.
english: It struck 8 kilometers west of Atiquipa and 600 kilometers south of the Peruvian capital of Lima.

text: Nagpagwa naman ang Pacific Tsunami Warning Center sang posible nga tsunami waves nga ginabanta magataas sang isa tubtob tatlo ka metros sa baybayon sang Peru.
english: The Pacific Tsunami Warning Center has issued a possible tsunami wave of one to three meters off the coast of Peru.

text: Kaangot sini, nag-isyu man ang Geophysical Institute sang Peru sang tsunami alert nga nagakahulugan nga dapat i-activate sang mga otoridad ang mga protocol agud siguraduhon ang seguridad sang mga pumuluyo bangud sa posible nga tsunami.
english: Meanwhile, the Geophysical Institute of Peru also issued a tsunami alert which means that authorities should activate protocols to ensure the safety of residents due to the possible tsunami.

text: Sa subong, nagapadayon pa ang assessment sang mga otoridad sa halit sa mga istruktura kag kun may pilason ukon napatay sa linog.
english: Authorities are still assessing the damage to structures and whether anyone was injured or killed in the quake.

text: MANILA – Gin-athag sang Food and Drug Administration nga wala sang product registration certificate ang RENO Foods Incorporated agud nga magbaligya sang liver spread.
english: MANILA – The Food and Drug Administration has clarified that RENO Foods Incorporated does not have a product registration certificate to sell liver spread.

text: Ini ang kasunod sang paandam sang nasambit nga health regulatory agency may kaangtanan sa pagbakal sang liver spread sang nasambit nga brand.
english: This follows the warning of the said health regulatory agency regarding the purchase of liver spread of the said brand.

text: Sa statement sang Food and Drug Administration, ang tanan nga food processing companies ang kinahanglan nga may yara sang License to Operate kag Certificate of Product Registration antes makapaguwa sang produkto sa Philippine market.
english: According to the Food and Drug Administration, all food processing companies are required to have a License to Operate and Certificate of Product Registration before releasing products in the Philippine market.

text: Santo sa record sang ahensya, ang RENO Foods Incorporated, ang naka-angkon sang License to Operate bilang “food repacker” sang 2017 pagkatapos sang ginpatigayon nga inspection sang regulatory body kag failure naman kun Certificate of Product Registration ang pagahambalan.
english: According to the agency's records, RENO Foods Incorporated, obtained a License to Operate as a “food repacker” in 2017 after an inspection conducted by the regulatory body and failure when it comes to Certificate of Product Registration.

text: Santo sa regulatory laws, ang processed food operators ang kinahanglan nga mag-secure sang kumpleto nga dokumento kag kinahanglan nga makapasar sa standard sang regulatory body antes makabaligya sang produkto.
english: According to regulatory laws, processed food operators are required to secure complete documentation and must pass the standard of the regulatory body before selling the product.

text: Sa advisory nga napetsahan sang Agosto 26, gin-anunsyo sang Food and Drug Administration nga ang Reno kag apat pa ka food and supplement products ang indi rehistrado.
english: In an advisory dated August 26, the Food and Drug Administration announced that Reno and four other food and supplement products are not registered.

text: Ginpatpat sang Iloilo City General Services Office (GSO) ang mga rason sa likod sang madasig nga pagbaha sa pila ka lugar sa syudad kasunod sang gulpiyada nga pag-inulan-ulan sa syudad.
english: The Iloilo City General Services Office (GSO) has explained the reasons behind the rapid flooding in some areas of the city following the sudden rains in the city.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Engineer Niel Ravena, head sang General Services Office (GSO), iya ginpahayag nga lakip sa mga nagatuga sang clog sa drainage system amo ang sebu ukon mga nagmala nga used oil sang mga estabilsyemento.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Engineer Niel Ravena, head of the General Services Office (GSO), said that among the causes of clogs in the drainage system is sebu or dried used oil of establishments.

text: Suno kay Ravena, nagkoordinar na sila sa City Engineer’s Office agud preparahan ang mahimo nga tikang lakip na ang declogging sang drainage system sang syudad.
english: Ravena said they have already coordinated with the City Engineer's Office to prepare the next steps including the declogging of the city's drainage system.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga ginsapol na sang talatapan ang mga street sweepers nga itudlo ang mga drainage nga naga-clog ukon mahinay ang ilig sang tubig-kanal.
english: He also said that the office has already met with the street sweepers to point out the drainages that are clogged or slow in the flow of water.

text: Gintuad naman sang natungdan nga may pila ka drainage sa Sunburst Park sa City Proper ang naga-clog na.
english: He admitted that some drainage in Sunburst Park in City Proper is already clogged.

text: Ginpasigurado naman ni Ravena nga ginatutokan sang pollution control officers sang talatapan ang nasambit nga mga problema sa drainage.
english: Ravena assured that the pollution control officers of the office are focusing on the drainage problems.

text: Indi pagdagdagan sang multa sang Land Transportation Office (LTO) ang late registration sa mga salakyan kag renewal sang driver’s license sa mga calamity-stricken areas.
english: The Land Transportation Office (LTO) will not increase fines for late registration of vehicles and renewal of driver's licenses in calamity-stricken areas.

text: Ini suno kay LTO acting Chief Greg G. Pua, Jr.
english: This according to LTO acting Chief Greg G. Pua, Jr.

text: ang pagsunod sa mando nanday Presidente Ferdinand “Bongbong” R. Marcos, Jr.
english: the compliance with the order of President Ferdinand “Bongbong” R. Marcos, Jr.

text: kag Department of Transportation (DOTr) Secretary Vince Dizon nga ayudahan ang mga nabiktima sang sunud-sunod nga kalamidad.
english: and Department of Transportation (DOTr) Secretary Vince Dizon to assist the victims of the series of disasters.

text: Sakop man sang memo ang mga salakyan nga ginbakal sang Hulyo 21 tubtob 25, 2025 kag wala naire­histro sang temprano.
english: The memo also covers vehicles purchased from July 21 to 25, 2025 and not registered early.

text: Suno kay Pua, ang pag-isip sa adlaw sang Sales Invoice ang magasugod sa Agosto 8, 2025 para makalikaw sa penalty sa late registration sang new motor vehicles.
english: According to Pua, the counting on the day of the Sales Invoice will start on August 8, 2025 to avoid penalties for late registration of new motor vehicles.

text: Ipatuman man ang 15-day period para sa settlement sa tanan nga traffic apprehension cases nga napetsahan nga Hulyo 21-25, kag ang waiver matapos nag-igo sa pungsod ang mga bagyong “Crising,” “Dante”, kag “Emong”.
english: The 15-day period for settlement will also be implemented in all traffic apprehension cases dated July 21-25, and the waiver after typhoons “Crising”, “Dante”, and “Emong” hit the country.

text: ILOILO CITY- Nahulog kag nagkaya sa kilid sang taytay ang isa ka pick-up truck sa Caingin, La Paz, Iloilo City.
english: ILOILO CITY- A pick-up truck fell and skidded off the side of a bridge in Caingin, La Paz, Iloilo City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay P/Staff Sergeant Dennis Yee, imbestigador sang La Paz Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga apat ang unod sang pick-up nga ginalakipan sang driver kag tatlo ka sakay sini.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, P/Staff Sergeant Dennis Yee, investigator of the La Paz Police Station, said the pick-up was carrying four people, including the driver and three passengers.

text: Suno kay Yee, padulong sa Arevalo kag nag-agi sa La Paz ang salakyan.
english: According to Yee, the vehicle was heading to Arevalo and passed through La Paz.

text: Ginapahayag nga nag-overtake ang salakyan kag nadulaan sang kontrol ang driver nga ginaalegar yara sa impluwensiya sang makahulubog nga ilimnon.
english: The vehicle reportedly overtook and the driver, who was allegedly under the influence of alcohol, lost control.

text: Samtang, ginpahayag naman ni Yee nga wala sila sang breath analyzer agud matumod kun nakainom ang driver sang salakyan nga importante kuntani sang elemento sang imbestigasyon.
english: Meanwhile, Yee said they do not have a breath analyzer to determine if the driver of the vehicle was under the influence of alcohol, which would have been an important element of the investigation.

text: MANILA– Ginpaguwa na sang Samahang Basketbol ng Pilipinas ang roster sang Philippine National Team para sa labing una nga FIBA E-sports Open.
english: MANILA – The Philippine Basketball Association has released the roster of the Philippine National Team for the first ever FIBA ​​E-sports Open.

text: Lakip sa line-up amo sanday Rocky Braña, Philippe Alcaraz IV, Clark Banzon, Al Timajo, Aljon Cruzin, Rial Polog Jr.
english: The line-up includes Rocky Braña, Philippe Alcaraz IV, Clark Banzon, Al Timajo, Aljon Cruzin, Rial Polog Jr.

text: kag Custer Galas.
english: and Custer Galas.

text: Santo sa ginpaguwa nga statement ni FIBA media and marketing service director general Frank Leenders, ang nasambit nga kompetisyon ang importante kag strategic bangud may tinutuyo ini nga mas mapadako pa ang FIBA family.
english: According to a statement issued by FIBA ​​media and marketing service director general Frank Leenders, the said competition is important and strategic because it aims to further enlarge the FIBA ​​family.

text: Dugang pa ni Leenders, subong nga tion sang pagpanghangkat, na-engganyo man sila pinaagi sa National Federations nga nangin charter partners sa sulod sang pila ka bulan.
english: Leenders added that during this time of challenge, they were also encouraged through the National Federations that became charter partners for several months.

text: 16 naman ka mga pungsod ang nalakip sa international open nga pagahiwaton sa maabot nga Hunyo 19 tubtob 21.
english: 16 countries are included in the international open to be held from June 19 to 21.

text: Ang mga pungsod nga magapasakop sa torneyo ang ginalakipan sang Argentina, Australia, Austria, Brazil, Cyprus, Indonesia, Italy, Latvia, Lebanon, Lithuania, New Zealand, Russia, Saudi Arabia, Spain, Switzerland kag Ukraine.
english: Countries participating in the tournament include Argentina, Australia, Austria, Brazil, Cyprus, Indonesia, Italy, Latvia, Lebanon, Lithuania, New Zealand, Russia, Saudi Arabia, Spain, Switzerland and Ukraine.

text: Mahimo man nga matan-aw ang hampang sa Facebook Page sang FIBA, Twitch kag Youtube.
english: The game can also be watched on FIBA’s Facebook Page, Twitch and Youtube.

text: Ginaplano sang Department of Education (DepEd) na ipatuman ang make-up classes sa mga eskwelahan matapos ang isa ka semana nga suspensiyon sang klase bangud sa mga bagyo kag habagat.
english: The Department of Education (DepEd) plans to implement make-up classes in schools after a week-long suspension of classes due to typhoons and southerly winds.

text: Suno kay Education Secretary Sonny Angara, dako ang madula sa mga estudyante kun indi magpatigayon sang make-up classes.
english: According to Education Secretary Sonny Angara, students will lose a lot if they do not conduct make-up classes.

text: Matandaan nga sang Lunes sang nagligad nga semana, suspendido na ang klase sa nanuhay-tuhay nga bahin sang pungsod bangud sa malain nga panahon nga nagresulta sang pagbaha.
english: It can be recalled that on Monday last week, classes were suspended in various parts of the country due to bad weather that resulted in flooding.

text: Gin-athag naman ni Angara nga magadepende sa mga eskwelahan kag sa schedule sang mga manunudlo ang make-up classes.
english: Angara explained that the make-up classes will depend on the schools and the schedule of the teachers.

text: Ginplastar sang Institute of Contemporary Economics ang pila sa mga nagapanguna nga rason kun ngaa madamo sang nagakatabo nga mga aksidente sa dalanon sa pungsod nga nag-utas sang madamo nga kabuhi.
english: The Institute of Contemporary Economics has outlined some of the main reasons why there are so many road accidents in the country that have claimed so many lives.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Joseph Ladrido, Executive Director sang amo nga institute, iya ginpahayag nga kinahanglan nga mahangpan sang publiko nga indi sa tanan nga tion nga ang mga drivers sang nagakaasidente nga salakyan ang dapat basulon.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Joseph Ladrido, Executive Director of the institute, said the public needs to understand that it is not always the drivers of vehicles that are to blame.

text: Suno sa iya, madamo sang contributory factors sa mga aksidente kag ini ang ginalakipan sang indi maayo nga sitwasyon sang mga dalanon, depektibo nga mga traffic signs, mga naga-park nga salakyan, kag madamo nga mga obstructions sa dalan.
english: He said there are many contributory factors to accidents and these include the poor condition of the roads, defective traffic signs, parked vehicles, and many obstructions on the road.

text: Pahayag ni Ladrido, dako ang kakulangan sang gobyerno ilabi na ang mga natungdan nga ahensya sang gobyerno kaangay sang Department of Public Works and Highways agud nga mapabilin kuntani nga standard kag husto ang pag-construct sang mga dalanon.
english: Ladrido said the government especially the concerned government agencies such as the Department of Public Works and Highways have a lot of shortcomings in order to maintain the standard and proper construction of roads.

text: Dugang niya, madamo sang mga polisa nga dapat bag-uhon sang gobyerno bilang epektibo nga tikang agud makabulig sa pagpangita sang solusyon sa sini nga mga problema.
english: He added that there are many policies that the government should change as an effective measure to help find solutions to these problems.

text: Pila sa mga posible nga himuon diri amo ang maid-id nga pagsunod sa standards sa infrastructure remediation kag sa ano man nga road construction, pag-reaallocate sang mayorya sang annual General Appropriations Act budgets sa road kag land transport infrastructureremediation, paghimo sang layi nga nagatukod sang Road Transport Safety office nga naga-consolidate sang tanan nga aspeto sang Transportation Safety policymaking kag pag-supervise sini.
english: Some of the possible actions here are strict compliance with standards in infrastructure remediation and any road construction, reallocating the majority of annual General Appropriations Act budgets to road and land transport infrastructureremediation, enacting a law establishing a Road Transport Safety office that consolidates all aspects of Transportation Safety and Safety policy supervising it.

text: Sa bahin naman sang Land Transportation Office, ginsiling ni Ladrido nga napaslawan ang ahensya nga dedikaran ang ila mandato ilabi na sa enforcement sang traffic laws, rules and regulations.
english: On the part of the Land Transportation Office, Ladrido said the agency failed to dedicate its mandate especially to the enforcement of traffic laws, rules and regulations.

text: Apang ginakilala man sini ang LTO nga naka-produce sang mapuslanon nga driver’s manual nga nagabulig sa mga drivers.
english: But it also recognizes the LTO for producing a useful driver's manual that helps drivers.

text: MANILA– Nadayun nagid ang kasal sang PBA point Guard nga si CJ Perez sa iya longtime partner nga si Sienna Catacutan.
english: MANILA – PBA point guard CJ Perez married his longtime partner Sienna Catacutan.

text: Ini matapos, masobra duha ka bulan nga napostpone ang kasal bangud sa coronavirus disease 2019 pandemic.
english: This is after the wedding was postponed for more than two months due to the coronavirus disease 2019 pandemic.

text: Sa social media post sang PBA player, makita nga nakasuksok na ang duha sang ila wedding ring , matapos ginpatigayun ang cIvil wedding.
english: In the social media post of the PBA player, the two are seen wearing their wedding rings, after the civil wedding was held.

text: Gin-ulan man sang pagtamyaw ang duha gikan sa ila mga abyan kag kaangay nga PBA players nga ginalakipan nanday Marc Pingris, Paul Lee, Ray Parks kag iban pa.
english: The two were also showered with greetings from their friends and fellow PBA players including Marc Pingris, Paul Lee, Ray Parks and others.

text: Nahibaluan nga Marso pa kuntani natalana ang kasal, apang bangud sa coronavirus disease 2019 wala ini nadayun
english: The wedding was scheduled for March, but was canceled due to the coronavirus disease

text: Gin-manduan ni Presidente Rodrigo Duterte ang pila ka mga ahensya sang gobyerno agud nga hingyuon ang mga magagmay nga negosyo para sa produksyon sang face mask agud nga ihatag sang libre sa publiko.
english: President Rodrigo Duterte has instructed several government agencies to solicit small businesses for the production of face masks to be distributed free of charge to the public.

text: Nag isyu sang memorandum ang Presidente nga naga mandu sa Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) nga i-consolidate ang nagkalain-lain nga micro, small, and medium enterprises amo man ang community organizations para sa paghimo sang face mask.
english: The President issued a memorandum directing the Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) to consolidate various micro, small, and medium enterprises as well as community organizations for the production of face masks.

text: Ang DTI kaupod ang Department of Health amo ang maga-determina sa gasto kag maayo nga kalidad sang face mask samtang nagapadayon pa ang COVID-19 pandemic.
english: The DTI together with the Department of Health will determine the cost and quality of face masks while the COVID-19 pandemic continues.

text: Nahibaluan nga mandatory ang pagsuksok sang face mask sa pampubliko nga lugar sa Pilipinas amo man sa mga face shields nga dapat gamiton sa pampubliko nga salakyan kag kun magsulod sa mga commercial establishments.
english: It is known that the wearing of face masks in public places in the Philippines is mandatory as well as face shields that should be used in public vehicles and when entering commercial establishments.

text: ATLANTA, GEORGIA – Nangin mainit ang bayluhanay sang mga tinaga nanday United States President Joe Biden kag former President Donald Trump.
english: ATLANTA, GEORGIA – United States President Joe Biden and former President Donald Trump had a heated exchange of words.

text: Ini ang kadungan man sang ginpatigayon nga 2024 United States Presidential Debate sa Atlanta, Georgia.
english: This also coincides with the 2024 United States Presidential Debate held in Atlanta, Georgia.

text: Ang 78 anyos nga si Trump amo ang presumptive Republican presidential nominee nga mabunggo sa 81 anyos nga si Biden sa 2024 presidential elections sa Nobyembre.
english: The 78-year-old Trump is the presumptive Republican presidential nominee who will bump 81-year-old Biden in the 2024 presidential elections in November.

text:
Wala naman nagkamustahanay ang duha sang nagkit-anay ang mga ini

Lakip sa mga topiko nga gin-debatehan amo ang ekonomiya, abortion, Israel-Hamas kag pandemya.
english:
The two did not greet each other when they met

Among the topics debated were the economy, abortion, Israel-Hamas and the pandemic.

text: Maga-atubangay sila liwat sa Septyembre para sa ikaduha nga hugnat sang debate.
english: They will face off again in September for the second round of debate.

text: MANILA – Nagalab-ot sa 50 billion yen ukon P22.9 billion ang utangon sang Pilipinas sa Japan para sa disaster management kag quick response sa COVID-19 crisis.
english: MANILA – The Philippines owes Japan 50 billion yen or P22.9 billion for disaster management and quick response to the COVID-19 crisis.

text: Suno sa statement sang Department of Foreign Affairs, mismo sanday DFA Secretary Teodoro Locsin Jr.
english: According to a statement from the Department of Foreign Affairs, DFA Secretary Teodoro Locsin Jr.

text: kag Japanese Ambassador Haneda Koji ang nagbayluhanay sang diplomatic notes sa 50-billion yen Post Disaster Standby Loan Phase II paagi sa isa ka simple rites sa DFA office.
english: and Japanese Ambassador Haneda Koji exchanged diplomatic notes on the 50-billion yen Post Disaster Standby Loan Phase II through a simple rites at the DFA office.

text: Ang nasambit nga loan facility ang ginalauman nga makabulig sang daku agud nga makabawi ang ekonomiya sang Pilipinas.
english: The loan facility is expected to help the Philippine economy recover.

text: Sang nagligad nga Hulyo sang natigayon ang exchanged notes sa tunga sang Pilipinas kag Japan may kaangtanan sa COVID-19 Crisis Response Emergency Support Loan.
english: Last July, the exchanged notes between the Philippines and Japan in connection with the COVID-19 Crisis Response Emergency Support Loan were obtained.

text: Nadakpan sa drug buy bust sa General Blanco Street, Brgy.
english: Arrested in drug buy bust in General Blanco Street, Brgy.

text: Maria Clara, City Proper ang isa ka lalaki nga ginapahayag hangkilan nga kawatan sa syudad sang Iloilo.
english: Maria Clara, City Proper is a man who is allegedly a thief in Iloilo City.

text: Ang arestado amo si alias Tagoy, 30, residente sang Barangay Tanza, Iloilo City.
english: The arrested was identified as alias Tagoy, 30, resident of Barangay Tanza, Iloilo City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Roque Gimeno III, hepe sang Iloilo City Police Station 1 kag head sang City Drug Enforcement Unit (CDEU), iya ginpahayag nga kabug-usan nga 17 gramos sang ginapatihan shabu ang nakuha kay alias Tagoy nga nagabalor sang P115,000.
english: Police Captain Roque Gimeno III, chief of Iloilo City Police Station 1 and head of the City Drug Enforcement Unit (CDEU), said a total of 17 grams of suspected shabu worth P115,000 were recovered from alias Tagoy.

text: Antes ang recoveries, nabaklan ang suspek sang isa ka sachet sang suspected shabu kabaylo sang P15,000.
english: Before the recoveries, the suspect was bought a sachet of suspected shabu for P15,000.

text: Yara man isa ka tuig ang monitoring sa suspek bangud ginapahayag nga amo man ini ang nagapanghaylo sa mga bata nga mag-intra sa iligal nga aktibidad kag maila man ini sa otoridad.
english: The suspect is also under monitoring for one year because he is allegedly the one who lures children to participate in illegal activities and is also known to the authorities.

text: Ang ginapahayag nga modus sini sa operasyon amo ang dead drop, Kaliwaan, G-cash, delivery, kag pick-up.
english: Its alleged modus operandi is dead drop, Kaliwaan, G-cash, delivery, and pick-up.

text: Antes ang drug buy bust, ang amo nga lalaki ang may kaso na nga daan nga pagpangawat, tuyo nga pagpangawat, violation sa election gun ban, kag frustrated murder suno sa record sang pulis.
english: Prior to the drug buy bust, the man had previous convictions for robbery, attempted robbery, violation of the election gun ban, and frustrated murder, according to police records.

text: Nag-abot na sanday United States President Joe Biden kag anay Presidente Donald Trump sa Atlanta, Georgia inoras antes ang ila presidential debate nga naangot na sa ila rematch para sa 2024 elections.
english: United States President Joe Biden and former President Donald Trump have arrived in Atlanta, Georgia hours before their presidential debate that has been linked to their rematch for the 2024 elections.

text:
Ginsugata sang local Democrats ang 81-anyos nga presidente sang naghugpa ang Air Force 1 sa Dobbins Air Reserve Base sa Marietta, samtang sakay naman ang 78-anyos nga ex-president sa private jet ukon ang iya ginatawag nga “Trump Force 1.”

Naka-schedule ang debate las 9:00 sa gab-i sa Atlanta, Georgia ( las 9:00 sa aga oras diri sa Pilipinas subong nga Byernes.)

Ini nga reunion sang duha ang ginabantayan gid sang bug-os nga Amerika bangud wala pa sang record sa maragtas nga may isa ka current president nga nag-debate batok sa iya ginsundan nga presidente.
english:
Local Democrats met the 81-year-old president when Air Force 1 landed at Dobbins Air Reserve Base in Marietta, while the 78-year-old ex-president was aboard a private jet or what he calls “Trump Force 1.”

The debate is scheduled for 9:00 pm in Atlanta, Georgia (9:00 am Philippine time this Friday.)

This reunion of the two is being closely watched by the whole of America because there is no record in history of a current president debating against his predecessor.

text: Ini man ang una nga bes nga magatapak ang duha sa debate stage pagkatapos sang ila debate apat ka tuig na ang nagligad.
english: This is also the first time the two will step on the debate stage after their debate four years ago.

text: Sa ikaduha nga hugnat sang amo nga debate sang 2020, mataas ang tension rason nga wala na gani sila nagkamustahanay.
english: In the second round of that debate in 2020, tensions were so high that they did not even greet each other.

text: Wala man nag-concede si Trump kay Biden sa 2020 election, kag inadlaw matapos gin-atake sang iya supporters ang US capitol, wala man sini ginsunod ang tradisyon kag wala ini nagtambong sa inagurasyon sang Democrat.
english: Trump did not concede to Biden in the 2020 election, and the day after his supporters attacked the US capitol, he did not follow tradition and did not attend the inauguration of the Democrat.

text: Indi kaangay sa nagligad nga mga debate, patigayunon ini subong nga adlaw sa cable television studio nga wala sang live audience kasunod sang request sang kampo ni Biden.
english: Unlike previous debates, they will be held today in a cable television studio without a live audience following a request by the Biden camp.

text: Magalawig sang 90 minutos, may duha lamang ka commercial breaks, kag iga-mute ang ila nga mikropono magluwas lang kun ila na turno sa paghambal.
english: It will last 90 minutes, there will be only two commercial breaks, and their microphone will be muted unless it is their turn to speak.

text: Pagkatapos subong nga adlaw, maga-atubangay sila liwat sa Septyembre para sa ikaduha nga hugnat sang debate.
english: After today, they will face off again in September for the second round of debate.

text: Nagpaidalom sa Coronavirus Disease 2019 test ang tanan nga empleyado sang Philippine Basketball Association bilang kabahin sang ila pagpanghanda sa pagbalik sang trabaho.
english: All employees of the Philippine Basketball Association underwent the Coronavirus Disease 2019 test as part of their preparations for the return to work.

text: Ini ang kadungan man sa pagpaidalom sa Metro Manila sa General Community Quarantine subong nga adlaw.
english: This is in conjunction with the General Community Quarantine in Metro Manila today.

text: Magluwas diri, gindisinfect man ang bug-os nga talatapan sang liga.
english: In addition, the entire league office was disinfected.

text: Natalana naman nga magsapol ang Philippine Basketball Association Board of Governors subong nga semana agud istoryahan ang mga pagsulundan para sa mga kopunan nga magasugod na liwat sa pag ensayo.
english: The Philippine Basketball Association Board of Governors is scheduled to meet this week to discuss the rules for the teams that will resume training.

text: Suno kay PBA Commisioner Wille Marcial, pagasundon sang PBA ang mga pagsulundan nga ginhatag sang gobyerno agud ma tsekyar man ang ikaayong lawas sang ila mga empleyado kag mga atleta.
english: According to PBA Commissioner Wille Marcial, the PBA will follow the guidelines given by the government to check the health of its employees and athletes.

text: Nag-isyu sang tsunami advisory ang Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (Phivolcs) subong nga Miyerkules, Hulyo 30, matapos ang magnitude 8.7 nga linog sa baybayon ang Far East Russia.
english: The Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (Phivolcs) issued a tsunami advisory this Wednesday, July 30, after a magnitude 8.7 earthquake struck off the coast of Far East Russia.

text:
Suno sa Phivolcs, ginalauman ang tsunami waves nga mas manubo sa isa ka metro ang kataason sa mga masunod nga lugar humalin ala-1:20 sang hapon tubtob alas-2:40 sang hapon sa mga probinsya sang:

Batanes Group of IslandsCagayanIsabelaAuroraQuezonCamarines Norte at SurAlbaySorsogonCatanduanesNorthern at Eastern SamarLeyte at Southern LeyteDinagat IslandsSurigao del Norte at SurDavao del Norte, Oriental, Occidental, del Sur, kag de Oro

Gin-abisuhan sang Phivolcs ang publiko sa mga nasambit na lugar nga magpabilin nga alerto sa mga indi ordinary nga balod kag magpalayo gilayon sa higad sang baybay.
english:
According to the Phivolcs, tsunami waves of less than one meter in height are expected in the following areas from 1:20 pm to 2:40 pm in the provinces of:

Batanes Group of IslandsCagayanIsabelaAuroraQuezonCamarines Norte at SurAlbaySorsogonCatanduanesNorthern at Eastern SamarLeyte at Southern LeyteDinagat IslandsSurigao del Norte at SurDavao del Norte, Oriental, Occidental, del Sur, kag de Oro

The Phivolcs advised the public in these areas to remain alert to unusual waves and immediately stay away from the coast.

text: Gin-surrender sang isa ka barangay tanod sa Alimodian Municipal Police Station ang iya ginahuptan nga indi lisensyado nga armas.
english: A barangay tanod surrendered his unlicensed firearm to the Alimodian Municipal Police Station.

text: Ang 48-anyos nga tanod ang residente sang Barangay Bulod sa amo nga banwa.
english: The 48-year-old tanod is a resident of Barangay Bulod in the town.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Marion Asparo, hepe sang Alimodian Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga isa ka unit sang 12 gauge homemade long barrel bolt action shotgun nga wala sang serial number ang gintugyan sang tanod sa pulisya.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain Marion Asparo, chief of the Alimodian Municipal Police Station, said the tanod handed over a unit of 12 gauge homemade long barrel bolt action shotgun without serial number to the police.

text: Ginpahayag sini nga madugay na ang armas sa iya possession bilang pagpangaman bangud sa presensya sang New People’s Army (NPA) sa Alimodian sang una.
english: He said the weapon had been in his possession for a long time as a precautionary measure due to the presence of the New People's Army (NPA) in Alimodian in the past.

text: Gindugang sini nga wala man sini nagamit ang pusil, kag gin-turn over nalang sa pulis bangud nalakip naman ang Alimodian sa mga banwa nga hilway na sa impluwensya sang mga rebelde nga grupo.
english: He added that he did not use the gun, and turned it over to the police because Alimodian is one of the towns that are free from the influence of rebel groups.

text: Kabahin ini sang kampanya sang pulisya nga Oplan Tokhang Kontra Armas Luthang kag iga-presentar man sa Alimodian Local Government Unit kaangot sa programa nga “Armas Luthang Baylo Bugas”.
english: This is part of the police campaign Oplan Tokhang Kontra Armas Luthang and will also be presented to the Alimodian Local Government Unit in connection with the “Armas Luthang Baylo Bugas” program.

text: Ini nga programa nagahaylo sa firearm holders/gun owners sa Municipality of Alimodian nga i-surrender ang ila unlicensed/loose firearm kabaylo sang bugas agud nga malikawan ang mga kriminalidad sa banwa.
english: This program encourages firearm holders/gun owners in the Municipality of Alimodian to surrender their unlicensed/loose firearms in exchange for rice in order to prevent crimes in the town.

text: MANILA – Magapatuman sang bigtime oil price rollback ang mga kompaniya sang langis epektibo buwas nga adlaw, Setyembre 15.
english: MANILA – Oil companies will implement a bigtime oil price rollback effective tomorrow, September 15.

text: Santo sa abiso sang oil companies, magalab-ot sa P1.50 kada litro ang buhin sa presyo sang diesel samtang P1.00 sa gasolina.
english: According to the oil companies, the price of diesel will be reduced by P1.50 per liter while gasoline will be reduced by P1.00.

text: Sa kerosene naman, magalab-ot sa P1.45 ang rollback.
english: For kerosene, the rollback will be P1.45.

text: Santo sa Department of Energy, ang year-to-date adjustments ang may net decrease nga P4.22 per liter para sa gasolina, P9.44 sa diesel kag P13.94 para sa kerosene as of September 8, 2020.
english: According to the Department of Energy, the year-to-date adjustments have a net decrease of P4.22 per liter for gasoline, P9.44 for diesel and P13.94 for kerosene as of September 8, 2020.

text: Patay ang isa lalaki matapos gin-alegar hungod nga nagpabunggo sa isa ka closed van sa Guimbal bridge nga amo ang nagaangot sa Barangay Bagumbayan kag Barangay Bongol, Guimbal, Iloilo.
english: A man was killed after he allegedly deliberately crashed into a closed van on the Guimbal bridge that connects Barangay Bagumbayan and Barangay Bongol, Guimbal, Iloilo.

text: Sa impormasyon sang Guimbal Municipal Police Station, sandig sa panaysayon sang testigo, nagalakat ang amo nga lalaki sa kilid sang dalan apang sang natalupangdan sini nga may nagapadulong nga salakyan, nagpatunga ini kag hungod nga nagpabunggo.
english: According to the Guimbal Municipal Police Station, based on the testimony of the witness, the man was walking on the side of the road but when he noticed that there was an oncoming vehicle, he intervened and deliberately collided.

text: Ginpahayag nga daku ang pilas nga naangkon sini sa ulo rason nga gindeklarar nga dead on arrival sa ospital.
