english: He sustained serious head injuries and was declared dead on arrival at the hospital.

text: Wala pa subong sang pangalan nga gina-uyatan ang otoridad apang ginpahayag nga may problema sa paminsaron ang amo nga lalaki kag ulihi nga nakit-an nga nagalagaw malapit sa ospital sang banwa.
english: Authorities have not yet released the name of the suspect but said the man had mental problems and was last seen wandering near the town hospital.

text: Ginpahayag man nga nagapalalagyo ang mga tawo kun magpalapit ini bangud nagapanghaboy sang bato.
english: It was also reported that people run away when he approaches because he throws stones.

text: Suno pa sa pulis, may tattoo nga barb wire sa tuo nga abaga sang biktima, maniwang, semi-kalbo ang haircut, kag ginabanta 25-30 anyos ang edad.
english: According to police, the victim had a barb wire tattoo on his right shoulder, was thin, had a semi-bald haircut, and was believed to be 25-30 years old.

text: Nagapabilin naman sa kustodiya sang Guimbal Municipal Police Station ang driver sang closed van nga pauli na kuntani sa Miagao sang natabo ang insidente.#
english: The driver of the closed van, who was returning to Miagao when the incident occurred, remains in the custody of the Guimbal Municipal Police Station.

text: Nakuha sang mga kaalyado ni anay Presidente Rodrigo “Digong” Duterte ang madamo nga komitiba sa Senado.
english: Allies of former President Rodrigo “Digong” Duterte have won many committees in the Senate.

text: May pinakamadamo amo si Senador Alan Peter Cayetano nga nakuha ang Committee on Accounts, Higher, Technical and Vocational Education Committee, Justice and Human Rights Committee kag Science and Technology.
english: Senator Alan Peter Cayetano had the most seats in the Committee on Accounts, Higher, Technical and Vocational Education Committee, Justice and Human Rights Committee and Science and Technology.

text: Nakuha naman ni Senadora Imee Marcos ang Committee on Cooperatives, Foreign Relations kag Labor, Employment and Human Resource Development.
english: Senator Imee Marcos won the Committee on Cooperatives, Foreign Relations and Labor, Employment and Human Resource Development.

text: Nagkadto naman kay Senadora Pia Cayetano ang Committee on Energy, Ways and Means kag Sustainable Development Goals, Innovation and Futures Thinking.
english: The Committee on Energy, Ways and Means and Sustainable Development Goals, Innovation and Futures Thinking went to Senator Pia Cayetano.

text: Nakuha naman ni Senador Robin Padilla ang tatlo ka komite nga Committee on Constitutional Amendments and Revision of Codes, Cultural Communities and Muslim Affairs kag Public Information and Mass Media Committee.
english: Senator Robin Padilla took over the three committees, the Committee on Constitutional Amendments and Revision of Codes, Cultural Communities and Muslim Affairs and the Public Information and Mass Media Committee.

text: Si Senador Bong Go naman ang nag-uyat sang Committee on health and demography, Youth kag Sports.
english: Senator Bong Go holds the Committee on health and demography, Youth and Sports.

text: Nagkadto naman kay Senador Rodante Marcoleta ang Senate Blue Ribbon Committee kag Trade, Commerce and Entrepreneurship.
english: The Senate Blue Ribbon Committee and Trade, Commerce and Entrepreneurship went to Senator Rodante Marcoleta.

text: SPAIN– Gin-anunsyo ni Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez nga mahimo na magpadayon ang La Liga apang sarado ini para sa publiko.
english: SPAIN – Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez announced that La Liga can resume but it will be closed to the public.

text: Suno kay Sanchez, magluwas sa La Liga, igabalik man ang iban pa nga recreational activities sa Spain.
english: According to Sanchez, besides La Liga, other recreational activities will also be resumed in Spain.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Sanchez nga magapadayon ang hampang sang La Liga sa Hunyo 8 samtang, ginkalipay naman ni La Liga President Janier Tebas ang desisyon ni Sanchez.
english: Sanchez also said that La Liga will continue on June 8 while La Liga President Janier Tebas welcomed Sanchez's decision.

text: Apisar sang pagbalik sang hampang, mapadayon sa gihapon ang pagpatuman sang health protocol.
english: Despite the return of the game, the implementation of health protocols will continue.

text: Nahibaluan nga sang Marso 12 pa nagsugod ang pagsuspinde sang football games sa Spain bangod sa Coronavirus Disease 2019 (COVID-19).
english: The suspension of football games in Spain began on March 12 due to the Coronavirus Disease 2019 (COVID-19).

text: ILOILO CITY- 10 ka kabataan ang nagakautdan sang paa ukon tiil kada adlaw bangud sa giyera sa Gaza.
english: ILOILO CITY- 10 children are losing their legs every day due to the war in Gaza.

text: Base ini sa report sang head sang UN agency nga nagasuporta sa mga Palestinian refugees.
english: This is based on a report by the head of the UN agency that supports Palestinian refugees.

text: Suno kay United Nations Relief and Works Agency for Palestine Refugees in the Near East chief Philippe Lazzarini, ginabanta nga kapin sa 2,000 nga kabataan na ang nautdan sang till sa sulod sang masobra 260 ka adlaw matapos ang brutal nga giyera.
english: According to United Nations Relief and Works Agency for Palestine Refugees in the Near East chief Philippe Lazzarini, it is estimated that more than 2,000 children have been cut off from the till in the more than 260 days since the brutal war.

text: Dugang niya, ang pagpang-utod sa mga paa sang mga bata nga nagakapilisan sa giyera ang nakagatabo sa mga makaluluoy nga kondisyon kag kun kaisa, wala sang anesthesia.
english: He added that the amputation of the legs of children wounded in war takes place in deplorable conditions and sometimes, without anesthesia.

text: Santo man sa data, masobra na sa 21,000 nga kabataan ang missing sa Gaza.
english: According to the data, more than 21,000 children are missing in Gaza.

text: Kapin 17,000 sa ila ang ginapatihan nga nagaliho-liho nalang kag nagapanago samtang yara sa 4,000 naman ang ginapatihan nga nalakip sa mass graves.
english: More than 17,000 of them are believed to be wandering and hiding while about 4,000 are believed to be included in the mass graves.

text: Mas ginpasangkad sang Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO) ang ila nga anti-criminality efforts sa bulan sang Abril antes ang 2025 National and Local Elections.
english: The Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO) has stepped up its anti-criminality efforts in April ahead of the 2025 National and Local Elections.

text: Sa ila kampanya kontra sa illegal nga droga, naaresto ang 48 ka mga indibidwal kung sa diin 13 ang High-Value Individuals (HVI) kag 35 ang Street-Level Individuals (SLI).
english: In their campaign against illegal drugs, 48 ​​individuals were arrested of which 13 are High-Value Individuals (HVI) and 35 are Street-Level Individuals (SLI).

text: Nakumpiskar diri ang 1,585.25 grams sang suspected shabu nga may estimated Standard Drug Price (SDP) nga Php 10,043,010.00.
english: Seized from the suspect were 1,585.25 grams of suspected shabu with an estimated Standard Drug Price (SDP) of Php 10,043,010.00.

text: Natigayon man nga madakpan ang 66 ka mga wanted persons kag ang 22 ka mga Most Wanted Persons.
english: Sixty-six wanted persons and 22 Most Wanted Persons were also arrested.

text: Sa kampanya sa illegal gambling, nakaaresto sang 34 ka mga indibidwal kag nakakumpiskar sang Php 12,176.00 nga bet money.
english: In the illegal gambling campaign, 34 individuals were arrested and Php 12,176.00 bet money was confiscated.

text: Sa mas ginpasangkad nga kampanya kontra sa loose firearms, nagresulta ini sa pagkakumpiskar sang 64 ka mga armas sa 25 ka mga police operations nga ginalakipan sang 19 confiscated unlicensed firearms, 29 nga gin-surrender, kag 16 ka deposited firearms.
english: In a more expanded campaign against loose firearms, this resulted in the seizure of 64 firearms in 25 police operations comprising 19 confiscated unlicensed firearms, 29 surrendered, and 16 deposited firearms.

text: Kaangot diri, kabugusan nga 18 ka mga indibidwal ang naaresto.
english: In this regard, a total of 18 individuals were arrested.

text: Sa campaign against illegal fishing, ang IPPO nag-conduct sang 21 ka mga operasyon, nga nagresulta sa pagkaaresto sang 71 ka mga indibidwal, 44 fishing boats ang na-apprehend kag pagkumpiskar sang balor sang isda nga naglab ot sa Php 45,900.00.
english: In the campaign against illegal fishing, the IPPO conducted 21 operations, resulting in the arrest of 71 individuals, the apprehension of 44 fishing boats and the confiscation of fish worth Php 45,900.00.

text: Ang anti-illegal quarrying campaign nagresulta man sa 14 ka mga police operations, 17 indibidwal ang na-apprehend kag 17 ka mga quarry vehicles ang na-impoundl.
english: The anti-illegal quarrying campaign also resulted in 14 police operations, 17 individuals apprehended and 17 quarry vehicles impounded.

text: Sa bahin sang kampanya kontra sa illegal logging, naaresto diri ang 4 ka mga indibidwal, nakumpiskar ang 2,263 board feet of lumber nga may estimated market value nga Php 86,638.00.
english: In the campaign against illegal logging, 4 individuals were arrested and 2,263 board feet of lumber with an estimated market value of Php 86,638.00 were seized.

text: Gindayaw naman ni IPPO Provincial Director Police Colonel Bayani Razalan ang mga personnel sang Iloilo Police Provincial Office sa ila nga dedikasyon kag serbisyo para sa pumuluyo sang probinsya sang Iloilo.
english: IPPO Provincial Director Police Colonel Bayani Razalan commended the personnel of the Iloilo Police Provincial Office for their dedication and service to the people of Iloilo province.

text: Article: Bombo Hanna Andasa
english: Article: Bombo Hanna Andasa

text: Luyag pa ni 8th Division World Boxing Champ Manny Pacquiao nga makasumpong sa ring sa isa ka mega boxing showdown si Floyd Mayweather Jr sa masunod nga tuig.
english: 8th Division World Boxing Champ Manny Pacquiao wants to face Floyd Mayweather Jr. in the ring in a mega boxing showdown next year.

text: Ini ang nangin pahayag ni Pacquiao isa ka semana matapos ginpanginwala ni Mayweather ang iya plano nga pagbalik sa ibabaw sang ring.
english: Pacquiao's statement came a week after Mayweather denied his plans to return to the ring.

text: Ini man matapos maglapta sa social media ang mga videos ni Mayweather sa diin makit-an nga naga ensayo ini.
english: This is after videos of Mayweather training spread on social media.

text: Suno kay Mayweather indi niya luyag nga makasumpong ang mga bataon nga fighter ukon si Pacquiao man.
english: Mayweather said he doesn't want young fighters or Pacquiao to fight.

text: Apang ginpahayag sang undefeated legend nga posible pa magbag-o ang iya desisyon depende sa presyo sang hampang.
english: However, the undefeated legend said that his decision could change depending on the price of the game.

text: Sa pagpa-athag pa ni Mayweather, naga ensayo sya sa gym agud mapabilin ang kondisyon sang iya lawas.
english: Mayweather explained that he is training in the gym to maintain his body condition.

text: Patay ang 22 ka mga tawo sang naglupok ang lithium batteries sa isa ka daku nga factory sa South Korea.
english: Twenty-two people were killed when lithium batteries exploded at a large factory in South Korea.

text: Natabo ini sa South Korean primary battery manufacturer nga Aricell plant sa Hwaseong city nga nahamtang ginabanta 45-kilometros sa nabagatnan sang kapital nga Seoul.
english: The incident occurred at South Korean primary battery manufacturer Aricell plant in Hwaseong city located approximately 45-kilometers south of the capital Seoul.

text: Sa mga nagkalamatay, 20 ang foreign nationals lakip ang 18 Chinese, isa halin sa Laos, kag wala pa natumod ang nationality sang isa.
english: Of the dead, 20 were foreign nationals including 18 Chinese, one from Laos, and the nationality of the other has not been determined.

text: Base sa footage, tuman ka daku ang aso kag nagpadayon pa ang paglinupok apisar yara na ang mga bumbero samtang nag-collapse naman ang parte sang atop.
english: Based on the footage, the smoke was so thick that the explosion continued despite the presence of firefighters while part of the roof collapsed.

text: Ginapahayag nga may 35,000 battery cells sa storage sang ikaduha nga panalgan sa factory kag may iban pa nga nakatago sa iban nga areas.
english: There are reportedly 35,000 battery cells in the storage of the second floor of the factory and others are hidden in other areas.

text: Madasig nga masunog ang lithium batteries kag mabudlay pa ikontrol gamit ang conventional fire extinguishing methods rason nga madasig ang pagkarab-karab sa planta.
english: Lithium batteries are highly flammable and difficult to control using conventional fire extinguishing methods.

text: Nahibaluan nga leading producer ang South Korea sang sini nga baterya nga ginagamit sa madamo nga items halin sa electric vehicles pakadto sa laptops.
english: South Korea is a leading producer of this battery, which is used in many items from electric vehicles to laptops.

text: Posible nga makasumpong sang American boxer nga si Danny Garcia si 8th Division Boxing Champion Manny Pacquiao sini nga Setyembre.
english: 8th Division Boxing Champion Manny Pacquiao is likely to face American boxer Danny Garcia this September.

text: Ini matapos nga gin-anunsyo sang anay welterweight boxing champion Danny Garcia ang pila ka mga boksidor nga mahimo makasumpong niya subong nga tuig.
english: This comes after former welterweight boxing champion Danny Garcia announced some of the boxers he may face this year.

text: Ginpahayag ni Garcia paagi sa iya social media account nga ginapilian niya si Pacquiao kag ang Amerikano man nga si Errol Spence.
english: Garcia said through his social media account that he is choosing Pacquiao and American Errol Spence.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa subong may yara na sang 36 wins kag 21 knockouts nga record si Garcia kag sang Enero lang subong nga tuig, ginlutos niya ang Ukranian nga si Ivan Redkach.
english: Garcia now has a record of 36 wins and 21 knockouts and in January this year, he defeated Ukrainian Ivan Redkach.

text: CAMBODIA – Ang pagkadula sang iya trabaho kag pagkaubos sang savings sang pinay English teacher sa pungsod Cambodia ang nagtulod sa iya sa pag-umpisa sang isa ka food business.
english: CAMBODIA – The loss of her job and the depletion of savings of a Filipino English teacher in Cambodia led her to start a food business.

text: Sa exclusive interview sang Bombo Radyo sa Ilongga nga si Tiffany Marie Jamabay Realis, direkta sa Cambodia, iya ginpahayag nga daw kaangay nga nadulaan na siya sang paglaom sang nagsirado ang iya ginatudluan nga eskwelahan sang Marso bangud sa Coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic.
english: In an exclusive interview with Bombo Radyo Sa Ilongga, Tiffany Marie Jamabay Realis, directly from Cambodia, said she felt like she had lost hope when her school closed in March due to the Coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic.

text: Ginpahayag ni Realis nga matapos nagpositibo sa COVID-19 sang isa ka canadian nga manunudlo sa ila pungsod, gilayon nga ginmando ni Cambodian prime minister Hun Sen ang pagpasirado sang tanan nga mga eskwelahan.
english: Realis said that after a Canadian teacher tested positive for COVID-19 in his country, Cambodian Prime Minister Hun Sen immediately ordered the closure of all schools.

text: Suno kay Realis, sa renta pa lang sang gina-istaran nga balay kag mga balayran, indi bastante ang ginakita sang iya bana nga factory worker.
english: According to Realis, her husband, a factory worker, does not earn enough for the rent and bills.

text: Agud mabuhi, naisipan ni Realis nga maghimo sang atsara kag iban pa nga mga Filipino food sa diin gamay lang ang capital sini.
english: To survive, Realis decided to make pickles and other Filipino foods with little capital.

text: Halin sa 30 ka jars kada adlaw, ginpahayag sang natungdan nga madamo na sang mga luyag mag-resale sang iya atsara sa diin mahimo ini mabakal sa P70 kada garapon.
english: From 30 jars per day, he said there are many who want to resell his pickles where they can be bought at P70 per jar.

text: Magluwas sa atrasa, nagahimo man sila sang iban pa nga mga pinoy food kaangay sang ginamos, salted egg, kwek-kwek, peanut butter, skinless longganisa, linugaw, chili paste, spaghetti kag fresh lumpia.
english: Besides atasa, they also make other Filipino foods such as ginamos, salted egg, kwek-kwek, peanut butter, skinless longganisa, linugaw, chili paste, spaghetti and fresh lumpia.

text: Ginbisita sang mga katapo sang Batad Municipal Police Station ang mga police personnel nga pilason matapos madisgrasya ang ila patrol car sa Barangay Natividad, Barotac Viejo, Iloilo.
english: Members of the Batad Municipal Police Station visited the police personnel who were injured after their patrol car crashed in Barangay Natividad, Barotac Viejo, Iloilo.

text:
Ang pilason nga pulis amo sanday:

Police Master Sergeant Renante Fuentes (driver), Police Master Segeant Francis John Aricaya kag Police Corporal Joseph Asturias.Sa subong, naka-on leave pa ini sila samtang nagapadayon sa pagapaayo.
english:
The injured police officers were:

Police Master Sergeant Renante Fuentes (driver), Police Master Segeant Francis John Aricaya and Police Corporal Joseph Asturias. They are currently on leave while undergoing treatment.

text: Article: Bombo Hanna Andasa
english: Article: Bombo Hanna Andasa

text: ILOILO CITY- Balik sa presuhan ang isa ka lalaki matapos nadakpan sa drug buy bust operation sa Blk.
english: ILOILO CITY- A man is back in jail after being arrested in a drug buy bust operation in Blk.

text: 7, Brgy Sinikway, Lapuz, Iloilo City.
english: 7, Brgy Sinikway, Lapuz, Iloilo City.

text: Ang arestado nga subject amo si France Arias, 27, residente sang lugar.
english: The arrested subject was identified as France Arias, 27, resident of the area.

text: Nabaklan ini sang duha ka sachet sang suspected shabu sa balor nga P10,000.
english: He was bought two sachets of suspected shabu worth P10,000.

text: Nakuhaan pa gid ini sang dugang nga 32 ka sachets sang suspected shabu.
english: An additional 32 sachets of suspected shabu were also recovered from the suspect.

text: Preso na ini subong sa La Paz Police Station kag natalana nga pasakaan sang kaso nga paglapas sa Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.
english: He is currently detained at the La Paz Police Station and is scheduled to face charges of violation of the Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.

text: Si Arias ang napreso na sadto bangud sa kaso may kaangtanan sa illegal drugs apang nakagwa sang 2020.
english: Arias was previously jailed on illegal drugs charges but was released in 2020.

text: Sa interview naman sang Bombo Radyo kay Punong Barangay Corazon Coo, iya ginpahayag nga siya mismo ang nag-asikaso nga makagwa sa presuhan si Arias.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Punong Barangay Corazon Coo said he personally arranged for Arias to be released from jail.

text: Suno ka Coo, matapos nakagwa, ginpaandaman sini si Arias nga indi na magbalik sa iligal nga buluhaton apang wala gid ini nagpamati.
english: According to Coo, after being released, he warned Arias not to return to illegal activities but he did not listen.

text: Napilian bilang top contender sa first edition sang ONE championship official athlete rankings ang Filipino top bantamweight nga si Kevin Belingon.
english: Filipino top bantamweight Kevin Belingon was selected as the top contender in the first edition of the ONE championship official athlete rankings.

text: Ini ang nagakahulugan nga posible nga makakuha sya sang isa pa ka ONE bantamweight shot batok sa Brazilian boxer nga si Bibiano Fernandes.
english: This means that he is likely to get another ONE bantamweight shot against Brazilian boxer Bibiano Fernandes.

text: Nahibaluan nga naka atubangay na sa ring sang makaapat nga bes ang duha.
english: The two have faced each other in the ring four times.

text: Nagapabilin naman nga numero uno nga contender sa bantamweight class si Belingon apang suno sa natungdan kinhanaglan pa niya sang mas madamo nga eksperyensya sa paghampang sa sulod sang ring.
english: Belingon remains the number one contender in the bantamweight class but he said he needs more experience in the ring.

text: MANILA – Nagpahanumdom ang Anti-Money Laundering Council sa publiko tuhoy sa nagadamo nga reported suspicious online transactions.
english: MANILA – The Anti-Money Laundering Council has reminded the public about the increasing number of reported suspicious online transactions.

text: Santo sa record, nagalab-ot sa 400,000 ang suspicious transactions subong nga tuig nga equivalent naman sa full year total sang 2019.
english: According to records, there are 400,000 suspicious transactions this year, which is equivalent to the full year total of 2019.

text: Suno kay Anti-Money Laundering Council executive director Mel Racela, nagakadapat nga mag-aligmat ang mga nagapatigayon sang online transactions agud nga indi matuntuhan.
english: According to Anti-Money Laundering Council executive director Mel Racela, those who conduct online transactions should be careful not to be fooled.

text: Ginpahayag ni Racela nga ang Anti-Money Laundering Council ang nagabulig sa Philippine National Police Cybercrime group sa pagpatigayon sang imbestigasyon batok sa fraudsters.
english: Racela said the Anti-Money Laundering Council is assisting the Philippine National Police Cybercrime group in conducting investigations against fraudsters.

text: Nahibalu-an nga kabahin sang katungdanan sang Anti-Money Laundering Council amo ang pagpatigayon sang imbestigasyon sa suspicious transactions lakip na diri ang wala sang legal or trade obligation, purpose or economic justification kag iban pa nga anomaliya.
english: It is known that part of the duties of the Anti-Money Laundering Council is to conduct investigations into suspicious transactions including those without legal or trade obligation, purpose or economic justification and other anomalies.

text: Apisar sini, ang Pilipinas suno kay Racela ang may “enough controls” sa pagtapna sang money laundering.
english: However, Racela said the Philippines has “enough controls” to prevent money laundering.

text:
Suspek nga naglabo-patay sa Barangay tanod sa Igbaras, napasakaan na sang kaso

Napasakaan na sang kaso ang suspek nga naglabo-patay sa isa ka barangay tanod sa Brgy.
english:
Suspect who stabbed to death Barangay tanod in Igbaras, charged

A case has been filed against the suspect who stabbed to death a barangay tanod in Brgy.

text: Talayatay, Igbaras, Iloilo.
english: Talayatay, Igbaras, Iloilo.

text: Ang biktima amo si Edwin Elumba Espada, 52-anyos, panday kag Barangay Tanod sang Talayatay, Igbaras.
english: The victim was identified as Edwin Elumba Espada, 52, carpenter and Barangay Tanod of Talayatay, Igbaras.

text: Samtang, ang suspek naman amo si John Ray Barison, 27-anyos kag residente man sang amo nga barangay.
english: Meanwhile, the suspect was identified as John Ray Barison, 27, resident of the same barangay.

text: Madumdoman nga samtang nagapamanday ang biktima sa balay sang ila pakaisa, gulpihada lang nga nag abot ang suspek kag ginlabo ini sa iya liog nga gintunaan sang iya kamatayon.
english: It can be recalled that while the victim was carpentry at their cousin's house, the suspect suddenly arrived and stabbed him in the neck, causing his death.

text: Nakapalagyo ang suspek apang gilayon man nga nadakpan samtang nagapaligo sa suba sakop sang Barangay Tigmarabo, Miagao, Iloilo.
english: The suspect fled the scene but was immediately arrested while bathing in the river in Barangay Tigmarabo, Miagao, Iloilo.

text: Pagkatapos sini, gilayon man nga ginpasakaan sang kaso nga murder apang asta subong wala pa makaguwa ang result sang iya medical examination bangud base sa pamilya nagasuprer ini sang nervous breakdown.
english: After that, he was immediately charged with murder but the result of his medical examination has not yet been released because according to his family, he is suffering from a nervous breakdown.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang bangkay sang biktima ang nakahaya sa ila balay kag nakatalana nga igalubong sa Mayo 13.
english: The victim's body was found in their house and is scheduled to be buried on May 13.

text: MANILA – Gin-aprobahan sang Asian Development Bank ang dugang nga $500-million loan para sa Pilipinas.
english: MANILA – The Asian Development Bank has approved an additional $500-million loan for the Philippines.

text: Ang $500-million ukon masobra sa P24 billion, ang ika-lima na nga loan nga ginhatag sang nasambit nga multilateral lender sa Pilipinas subong nga tuig.
english: The $500-million or more than P24 billion, is the fifth loan the multilateral lender has given to the Philippines this year.

text: Sa statement sang Asian Development Bank, paagi sa new policy-based loan, ang gobyerno ang ginahatagan sang quick access sa emergency financing sa tion nga may yara sang kalamidad tuga sang natural hazards ukon public health emergencies nga nagaresulta sang state of calamity.
english: In a statement, the Asian Development Bank said that through the new policy-based loan, the government is given quick access to emergency financing in the event of a disaster caused by natural hazards or public health emergencies that result in a state of calamity.

text: Sang Abril, gin-aprobahan sang Asian Development Bank ang $1.5-billion loan para sa COVID-19 Response and Expenditure Support Program kag $200 million para sa Social Protection Support Project.
english: In April, the Asian Development Bank approved a $1.5-billion loan for the COVID-19 Response and Expenditure Support Program and $200 million for the Social Protection Support Project.

text: Sang Hunyo, nagalab-ot sa $400 million ang gin-aprobahan para sa Support Capital Market Generated Infrastructure Financing Subprogram 1 kag $500 million para sa Expanded Social Assistance Program.
english: In June, approximately $400 million was approved for Support Capital Market Generated Infrastructure Financing Subprogram 1 and $500 million for the Expanded Social Assistance Program.

text: MANILA- Posible nga pahanugutan sang gobyerno ang pagpatigayon sang non-contact sports kaangay sang tennis, table tennis kag golf sa tion nga pahalugan na ang quarantine restrictions sa iban nga bahin sang pungsod.
english: MANILA- The government is likely to allow non-contact sports such as tennis, table tennis and golf once quarantine restrictions are eased in other parts of the country.

text: Suno kay Department of Trade and Industry Secretary Ramon Lopez, posible nga pahanugutan nga magbukas ang pila ka fitness facilities bilang paghatag sang importansya sa pisikal nga aktibidad.
english: According to Department of Trade and Industry Secretary Ramon Lopez, it is possible that some fitness facilities will be allowed to open in recognition of the importance of physical activity.

text: Ginpahayag ni Lopez nga naistoryahan na sang Inter-Agency Task Force ang tuhoy diri.
english: Lopez said the Inter-Agency Task Force has already discussed the matter.

text: Ginpahayag ni Lopez nga pahanugutan man nga magbukas ang fitness establishments kaangay sang gym apang kinahanglan nga magpatuman sang nagakaigo nga safety measures kaangay sang paggamit sang facemask kag gloves.
english: Lopez said fitness establishments such as gyms will also be allowed to open but must implement appropriate safety measures such as the use of facemasks and gloves.

text: Indi man sa gihapon pagpahanugutan ang contact sports kaangay sang basketball, volleyball kag combat sports agud malikawan ang paglapta sang Coronavirus Disease 2019 (COVID-19).
english: Contact sports such as basketball, volleyball and combat sports are also not allowed to prevent the spread of Coronavirus Disease 2019 (COVID-19).

text: USA– Ginbaligya na sa isa ka auction sa New York ang labing una nga Air Jordan 1 nga gingamit mismo sang NBA Legend nga si Michael Jordan.
english: USA– The first Air Jordan 1 worn by NBA Legend Michael Jordan himself has been sold at an auction in New York.

text: Ang bidding para sa nasambit nga sapatos ang magatakop sa Mayo 17.
english: Bidding for the shoe will close on May 17.

text: Ginhimo mismo sang kumpanya nga Nike ang Air Jordan 1 nga kumbinasyon sang duag pula, puti kag itom sa diin pirmado pa ni sang NBA Legend.
english: Nike made the Air Jordan 1 a combination of red, white and black and was signed by the NBA Legend.

text:
Ang nasambit nga sapatos ang mahimo mabakal sa Sotheby’s auction, sa balor nga $100,000 tubtob $150,000 ukon P5,049,500.00, tubtob P7,574,250.00

Nahibaluan nga ang nasambit nga auction ang gindungan sa ika 35 ka tuig nga anibersaryo sang Air Jordan.
english:
The shoes can be purchased at Sotheby's auction, for $100,000 to $150,000 or P5,049,500.00, to P7,574,250.00

The auction coincided with the 35th anniversary of Air Jordan.

text: Natalana nga ipresentar sang otoridad ang bag-o nga testigo sa kaso sang missing sabungeros.
english: Authorities are scheduled to present a new witness in the missing sabungeros case.

text: Suno kay Justice Secretary Jesus Crispin Remulla, ini magapabakod sang kredibilidad sang whistleblower nga si Julie “Dondon” Patidongan alias Totoy.
english: According to Justice Secretary Jesus Crispin Remulla, this will strengthen the credibility of whistleblower Julie “Dondon” Patidongan alias Totoy.

text: Pahayag ni Remulla, indi lang testimonial evidence kundi real evidence ang involved diri.
english: Remulla said not only testimonial evidence but real evidence is involved.

text: Suno kay Remulla, ang bag-o nga witness isa ka sibilyan nga wala pa naggwa ang pangalan sa mga nauna nga reports.
english: According to Remulla, the new witness is a civilian whose name has not appeared in previous reports.

text: ILOILO CITY- Plano sang gobyerno sang Japan nga magpatuman sang mas mataas nga presyo sang ila serbisyo sa mga bisita nga dumuluong.
english: ILOILO CITY – The Japanese government plans to implement higher prices for its services to foreign visitors.

text: Suno kay Bombo Josel Palma, ini kasunod sang mga reklamo sang mga residente sang Japan sa tuman ka damo nga mga turista kun sa diin ang iban sa ila ang nagabinastos kag wala nagataha sa mga Japanese.
english: According to Bombo Josel Palma, this follows complaints from Japanese residents about the large number of tourists where some of them are rude and disrespectful to the Japanese.

text: Base sa Japan National Tourism Organization , ang foreign tourist arrivals ang yara sa 3.04 million sang Mayo ukon 9.6% nga pagsaka halin sang amo man nga bulan sang 2019.
english: According to the Japan National Tourism Organization, foreign tourist arrivals stood at 3.04 million in May or a 9.6% increase since the same month in 2019.

text: Pahayag ni Palma, apisar madamo nga negosyo ang nagabenepisyo sa mga bisita, nagareklamo ang mga residente nga indi na nila mahimo ang ila mga normal nga aktibidad bangud sa mga turista.
english: Palma said that although many businesses benefit from the visitors, residents complain that they can no longer do their normal activities because of the tourists.

text: Sa subong, 600% increase ang plano nga ipasaka sa mga balayran sa mga kilala nga tourist destinations sa Japan.
english: Currently, a 600% increase is planned in the fees at popular tourist destinations in Japan.

text: TUNGOD sa problema pa sa COVID-19 kag sa kakulangan sang mga hulot buluthuan, nga tungod man sa kakulangan mismo  sang gobyerno sang pondo, ginapanugyan na gid lang anay ang Limited Face-to-Face (F2F) learning sa opening of classes sa Agosto 22, 2022, kon indi na ma-postpone pa ini.
english: Due to the COVID-19 problem and the lack of classrooms, which is also due to the government's own lack of funds, Limited Face-to-Face (F2F) learning is recommended for the opening of classes on August 22, 2022, unless it can be postponed.

text: Buot man silingon sini nga ang iban nga mga estudyante magapabilin anay sa online learning, ukon distance learning paagi sa internet, kag paagi sa modular learning sa puluy-an labi na gid para sa mga naga-kindergarten.
english: It also means that some students will first stick to online learning, or distance learning through the internet, and through modular learning at home especially for those in kindergarten.

text: Pwede man ang mixed ukon hybrid nga pagtuon, nga blended learning ang tawag sini sang mga otoridad sa edukasyon.
english: Mixed or hybrid learning, which education authorities call blended learning, is also possible.

text: Tubtub karon, sunu sa DepEd, madamo na nga mga eskwelahan, pampubliko kag pribado, ang na-qualify sa F2F nga klase.
english: To date, according to the DepEd, many schools, public and private, have qualified for F2F classes.

text: Sa Western Visayas, sunu sa DepEd-6 sadtong Hulyo 7, 2022, mga 50% na sang 5,068 ka mga eskwelahan pampubliko kag pribado ang nakapasar sa evaluation agud makapatuman sang F2F nga mga klase.
english: In Western Visayas, according to DepEd-6 as of July 7, 2022, about 50% of the 5,068 public and private schools have passed the evaluation to implement F2F classes.

text: Mga 2,828 na ini sila tanan, sunu sa DepEd-6.
english: There are about 2,828 of them, according to DepEd-6.

text: In fact, mga 1,366 naman sa ila ang nagapatuman sang F2F nga klase sang nagligad pa nga school year.
english: In fact, about 1,366 of them were implementing F2F classes last school year.

text: Obviously, indi ma-implementar diri ang F2F nga klase sa tanan nga mga estudyante sa kinaandan nga kadamuon sa hulot, katulad sadtong wala pa ang COVID-19, tungod sa requirement sang health protocol.
english: Obviously, F2F classes cannot be implemented here with all students in the usual number of rooms, as before COVID-19, due to the requirement of health protocols.

text: Ang health protocol naga-requirer sang isa ukon duha ka metro sa tunga sang mga estudyante para malikawan ang infection.
english: The health protocol requires one or two meters between students to prevent infection.

text: Sunu gani sa DepEd Order NO.
english: According to DepEd Order NO.

text: 34, series of 2022, ginatagaan ining mga na-qualify sa F2F classes sing option kon ano ang ila bagay itudlo.
english: 34, series of 2022, these qualified F2F classes are given the option of what they are suitable to teach.

text: Ang direct in-person nga pag-klase bala, blended learning sa sulod sang tatlo (3) ka adlaw kag duha (2) ka adlaw nga distance learning, ukon apat (4) ka adlaw nga in-person kag isa (1) ka adlaw nga distance learning.
english: Is it direct in-person classes, blended learning for three (3) days and two (2) days of distance learning, or four (4) days of in-person and one (1) day of distance learning.

text: Kon ano man ang option nga itudlo ginatugyan na ini sang DepEd sa mga eskwelahan depende sa kahimtangan sang lakat sang COVID-19 sa ila lugar, sa kahulas ukon kabudlay, ukon ano kahilway sa peligro ang panghulag sang mga estudyante pakadto sa eskwelahan kag pauli sa ila mga puluy-an, kag kon ano ang mga kagamitan sa ila pagtuon kag healthcare ang available sa ila sa padayon nga pagluntad sang COVID-19.
english: Whatever option is taught, the DepEd will leave it to the schools depending on the situation of the COVID-19 pandemic in their area, the difficulty or difficulty, or how safe the movement of students to school and back to their homes, and what equipment for their learning and healthcare is available during the continued existence of COVID-19.

text:
***

Base sa akon experyensya bilang manunudlo sadto sa high  school sa Iloilo City (Molo) NHS under sa “discovery method” nga pagtudlo sa Geometry bilang Math Major sa Secondary Education, pwede ang in-person (sa hulot buluthuan) kag distance learning (sa puluy-an) nga wala sing problema agud ma-akomodar ang tanan nga mga estudyante gamit ang isa lang ka hulot sa kinaandan nila nga kadamuon.
english:
***

Based on my experience as a high school teacher in Iloilo City (Molo) NHS under the “discovery method” of teaching Geometry as a Math Major in Secondary Education, in-person (in the classroom) and distance learning (at home) can be done without problems to accommodate all students in one room. quantity.

text: By the way, tapos man kita sang B.S. in Commerce, major in Banking & Finance, kag second year Law nga wala ko na ginpasige sang pag-deklarar ni Marcos Sr.
english: By the way, we're done with B.S. in Commerce, major in Banking & Finance, and second year Law that I did not continue when Marcos Sr. declared.

text: sang martial law sadtong 1972.
english: of martial law in 1972.

text: Sa pagtudlo ko paagi sa “discovery method” – ang modern method of teaching sa panahon sang amon ka-batch – pwede ang duha ka klase sang pagtudlo sa isa ka hulot mismo.
english: In my teaching through the “discovery method” – the modern method of teaching in the time of our batchmates – two classes of teaching can be done in one room.

text: Ang isa sini amo ang oral nga pagtudlo sa tunga sang manunudlo kag iya mga estudyante.
english: One of these is oral teaching between the teacher and his students.

text: Ang ikaduha amo ang tion sang “seat work” kon diin ginatagaan ang mga estudyante sang dugang nga mga problema nga sila mismo ang magamatu-matu sa paghibalo (independent learning) sa nabilin nga tion sang ila class period.
english: The second is the time of “seat work” where students are given additional problems that they will independently learn for the rest of their class period.

text: Tsekon sang manunudlo ang resulta sang “seat work” nila sa pagsulod na nila sa klase sa masunod nga adlaw.
english: The teacher will check the results of their seat work when they enter class the next day.

text: Reviewhon ang ila gintun-an sang nagligad nga adlaw kon kinahanglan kag ugaling sugdan ang bag-o nga leksyon sa klasehan.
english: Review what they learned the previous day if necessary and then start a new lesson in class.

text: Kon himuon nga regular ang ining duha ka klase sang pagtuon, pwede ini ma-apply sa F2F nga pagtuon sang tanan nga mga estudyante, nga ang katunga sa ila atubangon in-person sang manunudlo sa una nga adlaw, kag mag-“independent learning” sa sunod nga adlaw sa ila puluy-an, nga dayon buslan sa hulot sang nabilin nga katunga sang klase nga maga-independent learning man sa puluy-an pagkatapos, and so on.
english: If these two classes of learning are made regular, they can be applied to the F2F learning of all students, with half of them being faced in-person by the teacher on the first day, and doing “independent learning” the next day at home, which will then be replaced in the classroom by the remaining half of the class who will also be learning independently at home afterwards, and so on.

text: In effect, indi na kinahanglan ang dugang nga hulot klasehan agud ma-akomodar ang nabilin nga katunga kay pwede na magamit nila ang pareho nga hulot sa ila bulos-bulos nga pagtuon in-person upod ang manunudlo kag sa ila “independent learning” sa puluy-an.
english: In effect, there is no need for additional classroom space to accommodate the remaining half because they can use the same room for their alternate in-person learning with the teacher and their “independent learning” at home.

english: Isn't it?/PN

text: Indi gihapon pagtugutan sang Iran Revolutionary Guards ang pag-export sang bisan isa ka litro sang langis halin sa Middle East kun magapadayon ang mga pagpang-atake sang Estados Unidos kag Israel batok sa ila.
english: The Iranian Revolutionary Guards will still not allow the export of a single liter of oil from the Middle East if the US and Israeli attacks against them continue.

text: Suno sa Iran Revolutionary Guard, i-shut down nila ang strategic Strait of Hormuz, kun sa diin nagalabay ang yara sa 20% sang oil transits sang kalibutan bulang balos sa nagapadayon nga inaway.
english: According to the Iranian Revolutionary Guard, they will shut down the strategic Strait of Hormuz, through which about 20% of the world's oil transits pass in retaliation for the ongoing war.

text: Kasunod sini, ginpaandaman ni President Donald Trump nga mas pabaskugon pa sang Amerika ang pag-atake sa Iran kun padayon ini nga magapamatok sa distribusyon sang oil supplies.
english: Subsequently, President Donald Trump warned that the United States will intensify its attacks on Iran if it continues to oppose the distribution of oil supplies.

text: Suno kay Trump, dako na ang kahalitan nga naangkon sang militar sang Iran kag ginapaabot niya nga matapos ang tensyon antes pa ang apat ka semana nga timeframe nga ginhatag sang Amerika sa ila.
english: Trump said the Iranian military had already suffered considerable damage and expected tensions to end before the four-week timeframe America had given them.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Trump nga ang gyera matapos lang kun mag-surrender ang gobyerno sang Iran.
english: Trump also said the war would only end if the Iranian government surrendered.

text: Pahayag naman sang Israel nga nagatuyo ang mga ini nga patumbahun ang defense system sang Iran samtang naga-focus naman ang US sa pag-intercept sang Iranian missile kag nuclear capabilities.
english: Israel says it aims to knock down Iran's defense system while the US focuses on intercepting Iranian missile and nuclear capabilities.

text: Words by: Bombo Ian Gajete
english: Words by: Bombo Ian Gajete

text: Ginsiling sang Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) nga 23 ka Chinese vessels ang na-monitor sa West Philippine Sea (WPS) sang nagligad nga semana sa tunga sang malain nga tiempo.
english: The Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) said 23 Chinese vessels were monitored in the West Philippine Sea (WPS) last week amid bad weather.

text: Suno kay Rear Admiral Roy Vincent Trinidad, AFP spokesperson for the WPS, pito ka Chinese Coast Guard (CCG) kag pito ka People’s Liberation Army (PLA) Navy ships ang nakit-an sa Bajo de Masinloc sa tunga-tunga sang Hulyo 21 kag 27.
english: According to Rear Admiral Roy Vincent Trinidad, AFP spokesperson for the WPS, seven Chinese Coast Guard (CCG) and seven People's Liberation Army (PLA) Navy ships were spotted in Bajo de Masinloc between July 21 and 27.

text: May dugang pa nga apat ka CCG kag duwa ka PLA Navy vessels sa Ayungin Shoal, isa ka PLA Navy ship sa Sabina Shoal, kag isa ka CCG kag isa ka PLA Navy ship malapit sa Pag-asa Island.
english: There are also four CCG and two PLA Navy vessels in Ayungin Shoal, one PLA Navy ship in Sabina Shoal, and one CCG and one PLA Navy ship near Pag-asa Island.

text: Wala naman sang agresibo nga akto sang Chinese forces ang na-record sa pinakaulihi nga monitoring period.
english: No aggressive acts by Chinese forces were recorded during the latest monitoring period.

text: GERMANY – Gintugutan na ni German Chancellor Angela Merkel ang liwat nga pagbukas sang ila nga football league sa Bundesliga.
english: GERMANY – German Chancellor Angela Merkel has approved the reopening of their football league in the Bundesliga.

text: Suno sa German Football League magasugod na ang nasambit nga liga sa Mayo 15 apang nagakadapat ini nga patigayunon close door agud malikawan nga maglapta ang Coronavirus Disease 2019.
english: According to the German Football League, the league will start on May 15 but should be held close door to prevent the spread of Coronavirus Disease 2019.

text: Bangud diri, ang Bundesliga ang ika-labing una nga football league sa Europa nga magabukas.
english: As a result, the Bundesliga will be the first football league in Europe to open.

text: Madumduman nga ginkansela ang tanan nga mga sporting events sa Europa bangud sa coronavirus pandemic.
english: It can be recalled that all sporting events in Europe were canceled due to the coronavirus pandemic.

text: Mas nagdamo ang Filipino seafarers nga nagapangindi na sa pagsakay sa mga barko nga magalayag sa Red Sea kag sa Gulf of Aden — ang mga lugar kun sa diin masami nga naga-atake ang rebelde nga Houthis.
english: More and more Filipino seafarers are refusing to board ships that will sail in the Red Sea and the Gulf of Aden — the areas where the Houthis rebels often attack.

text: Suno sa Department of Migrant Workers (DMW), 78 na ka mga Pinoy ang nag-manifest nga indi sila maglabay sa nasambit nga war-like areas nga mas mataas sa una na-report nga 25.
english: According to the Department of Migrant Workers (DMW), 78 Filipinos have already manifested that they will not pass through the said war-like areas, which is higher than the previously reported 25.

text: Natalana nga mag-atubang ang ahensya sa dugang nga grupo sang seafarers kag iban pa nga stakeholders para sa isa pa ka hugnat sang konsultasyon.
english: The agency is scheduled to meet with an additional group of seafarers and other stakeholders for another round of consultation.

text: Tuyo sang diskusyon nga amyendahan ang existing rules kag agud mahatagan sang mas maayo nga proteksyon ang Filipino seafarers.
english: The purpose of the discussion is to amend the existing rules and to provide better protection to Filipino seafarers.

text: Sang Hunyo 12, matandaan nga nag-atake ang Yemeni Houthi movement sa barko nga MV Tutor sa southern Red Sea gamit ang unmanned surface vehicle kag anti-ship missile.
english: On June 12, the Yemeni Houthi movement attacked the ship MV Tutor in the southern Red Sea using an unmanned surface vehicle and an anti-ship missile.

text: 21 ka Filipino crew members ang nakaluwas kag nakapauli sa Pilipinas, apang isa sa ila upod ang ginapatihan nga na-trap sa engine room sang barko nga naglugdang inadlaw matapos ang atake.
english: 21 Filipino crew members survived and returned to the Philippines, but one of them was believed to be trapped in the engine room of the ship that sank the day after the attack.

text: Sang Marso, duha man ka Filipino crew members ang napatay kag duha man ang nasamaran bangud na-igu man ang barko nga MV True Confidence sang anti-ship ballistic missile nga ginpalupad man sang Houthi rebels sa Red Sea.
english: In March, two Filipino crew members were also killed and two others injured when the ship MV True Confidence was also hit by an anti-ship ballistic missile also launched by Houthi rebels in the Red Sea.

text: Ini magluwas pa sa nauna nga pagpang-atake lakip na ang sang Nobyembre 2023 kun sa diin 17 ka Pinoy crew sakay sa barko nga Galaxy Leader ang ginbihag sang Houthis sa Yemen kag tubtub subong wala pa nakapauli.
english: This is in addition to previous attacks including the one in November 2023 where 17 Filipino crew aboard the ship Galaxy Leader were captured by the Houthis in Yemen and have not yet returned home.

text: ILOILO CITY-Magasugod na subong nga semana ang pagtalakay sang Kongreso sa budget sang tagsa ka departamento sang gobyerno sa idalom sang P4.5 trillion nga 2021 budget.
english: ILOILO CITY – Congress will begin this week to discuss the budget of each government department under the P4.5 trillion 2021 budget.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Iloilo 3rd District Representative Lorenz Defensor, iya ginpahayag nga tinguhaan nila sa kongreso nga mapadasig ang pagpasar sa budget kag wala sang matabo nga delay.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Iloilo 3rd District Representative Lorenz Defensor said they will try to speed up the passage of the budget in Congress and there will be no delay.

text: Suno kay Defensor, sa pagpasar sa budget nasandig ang pagsalig sang tawo bangud diri nagadepende ang mangin palaabuton sang ekonomiya kag sang pumuluyo ilabi pa nga padayon nga ginaatubang sang Pilipinas ang COVID-19 pandemic.
english: According to Defensor, the passage of the budget depends on the confidence of the people because the future of the economy and the people depends on it especially as the Philippines continues to face the COVID-19 pandemic.

text:

text: Suno sa natungdan, tama ka gamay ang alokasyon para sa nasambit nga mga ahensya ilabi na subong nga ginaatubang sang pungsod ang isyu sa food security kag madamo man ang nadulaan sang trabaho.
english: He said the allocation for these agencies is very small especially now that the country is facing the issue of food security and many have lost their jobs.

text: May kaangtanan naman sa isyu sa Philippine Health Insurance Corporation ukon PhilHealth, ginpahayag ni Defensor nga apisar nabutang ini sa kontrobersya bangud sa korapsyon sa ahensya, katungdanan sa gihapon sang gobyerno nga pondohan ini.
english: On the issue of the Philippine Health Insurance Corporation (PhilHealth), Defensor said that although it is in controversy due to corruption in the agency, it is still the government's duty to fund it.

text: Apang, suno kay Defensor, indi man dapat malipatan sang gobyerno ang obligasyon sini nga pasakaan sang kaso ang mga tawo nga responsable sa pagkadula sang pondo sa PhilHealth.
english: However, Defensor said the government should not forget its obligation to prosecute those responsible for the loss of PhilHealth funds.

text: May nakit-an ang National Police Commission (NAPOLCOM) nga probable cause batok sa 12 ka mga pulis nga ginaakusahan nga involved sa kaso sang missing sabungeros.
english: The National Police Commission (NAPOLCOM) has found probable cause against 12 policemen accused of involvement in the missing sabungeros case.

text: Ang 12 ka mga pulis ang ginalakipan sang tatlo ka officials kag siyam ka non-commissioned officers.
english: The 12 policemen include three officials and nine non-commissioned officers.

text: Bangud sa finding, mapadayon ang administrative case batok sa mga pulis nga mahimo naman mapahalin sa serbisyo.
english: Because of the finding, the administrative case against the policemen will continue and they could be dismissed from service.

text: Base sa report, ginsiling ni NAPOLCOM Investigation and Monitoring director Edman Pares nga ang finding ang ginbase sa affidavit sang whistleblower nga si Julie “Dondon” Patidongan.
english: Based on the report, NAPOLCOM Investigation and Monitoring director Edman Pares said the finding was based on the affidavit of whistleblower Julie “Dondon” Patidongan.

text: Ginpasaka nanday Patidongan kag mga pamilya sang missing sabungeros ang complaint sang nagligad nga semana.
english: Patidongan and the families of the missing sabungeros filed the complaint last week.

text: Samtang, ginsiling naman ni NAPOLCOM vice chairperson kag executive officer Atty. Rafael Calinisan nga duha ka grupo ang nagpalapit sa iya agud i- settle ang kaso sang missing sabungeros.
english: Meanwhile, NAPOLCOM vice chairperson and executive officer Atty. Rafael Calinisan said two groups approached him to settle the case of the missing sabungeros.

text: Ini ang natabo antes nag-file sang complaint sanday Patidongan kag ang mga pamilyas.
english: This happened before Patidongan and the families filed a complaint.

text: Base sa report, ginakabig ni Calinisan nga dako nga bulig sa finding ang suporta ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: According to the report, Calinisan considers the support of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. to be a big help in the finding.

text: nga una na nagpasalig nga himuon ang tanan agud masolbar ang kaso sang mga missing sabungeros.
english: who earlier promised to do everything to solve the case of the missing sabungeros.

text: Dako ang paglaum sang boksidor nga si Mark Magnifico Magsayo nga mabalik na sa normal ang tanan agud makabalik na siya sa pag-ensayo.
english: Boxer Mark Magnifico Magsayo is hopeful that everything will return to normal so that he can return to training.

text: Suno kay Mark apisar nga naka home quarantine siya subong padayon ang iya pag-ensayo sa iya balay apang mas manami kun sa gym bangud sa kumpleto ang mga equipments nga mahimo niya magamit kaangay nalang sang punching bag.
english: According to Mark, although he is under home quarantine, he continues to train at home but it is better if he goes to the gym because he has complete equipments that he can use such as a punching bag.

text: Paagi sa iya social media account, nagpanawagan ang boksidor sa gobyerno nga tugutan ang mga pribado nga gyms nga makapadayon sang operasyon.
english: Through his social media account, the boxer called on the government to allow private gyms to continue operating.

text: Suno sa iya mangin dako ini nga bulig indi lang sa iya lakip man sa mga tawo nga nakadepende sa patag sang hinampang ang palangabuhian kaangay nalang sang mga atleta kag mga trainers.
english: He said this will be a big help not only to him but also to the people who depend on the field of sports for their livelihood such as athletes and trainers.

text: Ginsulit ni Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu ang alegasyon sini nga ginapunggan na sang Estados Unidos sang Amerika ang pagpadala sang mga armas sa Israel samtang nga padayon ang gyera sini sa Gaza.
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has reiterated his allegation that the United States of America is already blocking the shipment of weapons to Israel while its war in Gaza continues.

text: Una na ini nga ginpanginwala sang Biden administration apang sa latest statement ni Netanyahu sa atubang sang iya Gabinete, ginsiling sini nga daku ang gin-nubo sang U.S. weapons nga ginapadala sa Israel halin sang apat ka bulan na ang nagligad.
english: The Biden administration has previously denied this but in Netanyahu’s latest statement before his Cabinet, he said U.S. weapons shipments to Israel have been greatly reduced since four months ago.

text: Wala sini gindetalye kun ano ini nga sahi sang hinganiban apang una na sini ginpahayag nga sinemana na nga wala nakalusot ang panawagan sa American officials nga padasigon man ang pagpadala sang mga armas.
english: He did not elaborate on the type of weapon but said earlier that weeks of calls to American officials to expedite the shipment of weapons have not gone through.

text: Nahibaluan nga gina-review sang Amerika ang shipment sang 2,000-pound kag 500-pound nga mga bomba sang Mayo bangud sa kahangawa nga gamiton ini sang Israel sa isa ka daku nga opensiba sa Rafah.
english: It is known that the United States is reviewing the shipment of 2,000-pound and 500-pound bombs in May due to concerns that Israel will use them in a major offensive in Rafah.

text: Sulit-sulit man nga ginpahayag ni President Joe Biden nga indi ini magpadala sang mga hinganiban nga gamiton sa Rafah kun sa diin nagatinir ang mga sibilyan.
english: President Joe Biden has also repeatedly said he will not send weapons to be used in Rafah where civilians are staying.

text: Apang ginklaro man sang presidente nga padayunon sang US ang suporta sa Iron Dome, ang system nga amo ang nagahatag sang proteksyon sa Israel sa kada may magpalupad sang rocket batok sa ila.
english: But the president also made it clear that the US will continue to support the Iron Dome, the system that provides protection to Israel whenever a rocket is launched against them.

text: Nahibaluan nga nabutang sa daku nga kwestyon ang anay suod nga relasyon sang US kag Israel bangud sa gyera sa Gaza.
english: The war in Gaza has thrown the once close ties between the US and Israel into serious question.

text: Apisar ginasuportahan ni Biden ang kampanya sang Israel nga hilwayon ang mga bihag kag panason ang Hamas militants, ginapabutyag naman sini ang kahangawa sa pagsaka sang numero sang patay sa mga sibilyan sa Palestine kag ang humanitarian crisis nga dala sang gyera.
english: Although Biden supports Israel's campaign to free the hostages and eliminate Hamas militants, he expresses concern over the rising number of civilian deaths in Palestine and the humanitarian crisis brought about by the war.

text: Nagaplano na nga tun-an sang Iloilo City Government kag iban pa nga stakeholders ang magamay nga isla sa Iloilo River nga Makita sa Sunset Bloulevard.
english: The Iloilo City Government and other stakeholders are planning to study the small island in the Iloilo River located on Sunset Boulevard.

text: Ini ang ginatawag sang mga residente kag environmentalists nga Isla Verde.
english: It is called Isla Verde by residents and environmentalists.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Engr.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Engr.

text: Neil Ravena, Head sang Iloilo City General Services Office, iya ginpahayag dako na ang kontribusyon sang isla sa ecosystem sa lugar bangud sang mangroves kag mga kasapatan nga nagapuyo sa isla.
english: Neil Ravena, Head of the Iloilo City General Services Office, said the island has already contributed a lot to the ecosystem in the area because of the mangroves and animals that live on the island.

text: Suno kay Ravena, ginapasalig niya ini nga ireserba ang nasambit nga isla kasunod sang pagahimuon nga dredging sang Department of Public Works and Higways (DPWH) sa suba.
english: Ravena said he assures them that the island will be reserved following the dredging of the river by the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH).

text: Dugang pa sang natungdan, dako ang nabulig sang Isla Verde bangud napahinay niya ini ang pagtaas sang tubig sa mga kaiping nga Barangay sang Sooc, Arevalo sa tion nga magta-ob ang dagat.
english: He added that Isla Verde has helped a lot because it has slowed down the rise of water in the neighboring Barangays of Sooc, Arevalo when the sea rises.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, maga-conduct sang pagtuon ang GSO kaupod sa DPWH CENRO kag mga experts gikan sa University of the Philippines-Visayas (UPV) agud mahibaluan ang baiodiversity sa lugar.
english: Meanwhile, the GSO will conduct a study in collaboration with the DPWH CENRO and experts from the University of the Philippines-Visayas (UPV) to determine the biodiversity in the area.

text: Ang nasambit nga isla nahuman paagi sa pagtipon sang lay-on sa mga gamut sang mangroves tubtob nga naglapad kag ginatindugan na sang sari sari nga variety sang mangroves kag ginapuy-an sang mga pispis kag iban pa nga kasapatan.
english: The island was formed by collecting mud from the roots of mangroves until it expanded and is now inhabited by various varieties of mangroves and inhabited by birds and other animals.

text: Mas hugton pa sang Philippine Sports Commission ang mga ginapatuman nila nga lihok agud masigurado nga padayon ang ila nga suporta sa mga miyembro sang national team.
english: The Philippine Sports Commission will tighten its measures to ensure its continued support to the members of the national team.

text:
Ini matapos nga nagpagwa sang direktiba ang Department of Budget and Management may kaangtanan sa mga proyekto nga kanselahon kag mga aktibidad nga gindumilian na sang Inter-Agency Task Force on Emerging Infectious Diseases sa diin isa diri ang pagkansela sa tanan nga sports activities tubtob Desyembre subong nga tuig,

Nahisugtan man sang board nga bawion ang financial support sa 10th ASEAN Paragames.
english:
This comes after the Department of Budget and Management issued a directive regarding projects to be canceled and activities that have already been banned by the Inter-Agency Task Force on Emerging Infectious Diseases, including the cancellation of all sports activities until December this year,

The board also agreed to withdraw financial support for the 10th ASEAN Paragames.

text: Sa pihak sini, tumanon sa gihapon sang Philippine Sports Commission ang una na nila nga nahisugtan sang ASEAN Paragames agud masabat ang initial nga operations expenses.
english: Meanwhile, the Philippine Sports Commission will continue to comply with the agreement reached with the ASEAN Paragames to meet the initial operations expenses.

text: Ginkabo ni anay Presidential Spokesperson Harry Roque ang nangin panawagan ni President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos, Jr., tuhoy sa edukasyon.
english: Former Presidential Spokesperson Harry Roque rejected the call of President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos, Jr., on education.

text: Sa ikaapat nga State of the National Address (SONA) ni PBBM, gin-engganyo sini ang mga ginikanan nga kumbinsihon ang ila nga mga anak, ilabi na ang kabataan nga makatapos sa kolehiyo matapos niya nga ginbida ang mga programa nga ginplastar sang iya nga administrasyon para sa mga estudyante.
english: In his fourth State of the National Address (SONA), PBBM urged parents to convince their children, especially children to graduate from college after he highlighted the programs put in place by his administration for students.

text: Yari ang pahayag ni Marcos:“Napakataas ngayon ng bilang ng kabataan nating pumasok sa kolehiyo o sa TESDA.
english: Here is Marcos' statement: “The number of our children entering college or TESDA is very high.

text: Pilipinas na ang pumapangalawa sa buong ASEAN sa dami ng mga kabataang pumasok sa kolehiyo at sa Tech-Voc.
english: The Philippines is the second largest country in ASEAN in terms of the number of young people entering college and Tech-Voc.

text: Mas marami na rin ang nakakapagtapos.
english: More people are also graduating.

text: Kaya mga magulang: sulitin na ninyo ang mga pagkakataong ito.
english: So parents: take advantage of these opportunities.

text:
Dahil hangad natin na sa lalong madaling panahon, ang bawat isang pamilya ay may anak na nakapagtapos ng kolehiyo o sa TESDA.”

Yari naman ang sabat ni Roque:“At isang tulad mo na college dropout at walang degree pa talaga nanggaling ang panawagan?”

Matandaan nga isa ang educational background sa isyu nga ginahaboy sang mga kritiko ni PBBM batok sa iya tuhoy sa mga ginapahayag nga peke nga academic credentials sini.
english:
Because we want as soon as possible, every family will have a child who graduated from college or TESDA.”

Here's Roque's answer: "And a college dropout like you without a degree really got the call?"

It can be recalled that educational background is one of the issues raised by PBBM's critics against him regarding his alleged fake academic credentials.

text: Dismayado ang Catholic Bishops’ Conference of the Philippines (CBCP) sa ginpatigayon nga State of the Nation Address (SONA) ni President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.
english: The Catholic Bishops’ Conference of the Philippines (CBCP) is disappointed with the State of the Nation Address (SONA) of President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.

text: matapos wala niya ginsambit ang isyu sang online gambling.
english: after he failed to mention the issue of online gambling.

text: Suno kay Rev.
english: According to Rev.

text: Fr.
english: Fr.

text: Jerome Secillano, Executive Secretary sang CBCP Episcopal Commission on Public Affairs, wala nila napamatian ang ginahulat nila nga tikang kag pahayag halin mismo sa presidente nga magahatag sang klaro nga lihok batok sa online gambling.
english: Jerome Secillano, Executive Secretary of the CBCP Episcopal Commission on Public Affairs, said they did not hear the expected steps and statements from the president himself that will give clear action against online gambling.

text: Dugang pa ni Fr.
english: Fr. added.

text: Secillano, kuntani ginpahamtang sang presidente ang focus sa kampanya kontra online gambling bangud ini ang rason sang kadamo na nga kabataan nga naadik, kag pamilya nga naguba.
english: Secillano said the president should have focused on the campaign against online gambling because it is the cause of many children who are addicted, and families who are broken.

text: Matandaan nga kapila na ka beses nagpanawagan ang CBCP sa gobyerno nga batonon bilang seryoso nga isyu ang online gambling, kag mangin aktibo sa pagpangkontra sini agud maprotektahan ang kabataan kag pamilya Pilipino.
english: The CBCP has repeatedly called on the government to take online gambling as a serious issue, and be active in combating it in order to protect Filipino children and families.

text: SPAIN – Temporaryo nga ginpaiway ang pagpatigayon sang Coronavirus Disease 2019 testing sa mga atleta sang Spanish soccer league.
english: SPAIN – Coronavirus Disease 2019 testing of athletes of the Spanish soccer league has been temporarily suspended.

text: Suno sa La liga, indi mahimo nga mapatigayon ang testing sa mga atleta, coaches kag medical staff tubtob wala pa maaprubahan sang gobyerno sang Spain ang protocol.
english: According to La Liga, testing cannot be conducted on athletes, coaches and medical staff until the Spanish government approves the protocol.

text: Bangud sa pagpaiway sang testing, sigurado na nga madelay man ang pagsugod sang pila ka mga liga.
english: Due to the postponement of testing, it is certain that the start of some leagues will be delayed.

text: Suno naman kay La liga President Javier Tebas, mas ginaprayoridad subong sang gobyerno ang iban pa nga mga pumuluyo nga natapikan sang nasambit nga virus.
english: La Liga President Javier Tebas said the government is now giving more priority to other residents who have been infected with the virus.

text: Naka-full alert na ang Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO), isa ka semana antes ang Mayo 12, 2025 midterm elections bilang kabahin sang ila preparasyon sa seguridad.
english: The Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO) is on full alert, a week before the May 12, 2025 midterm elections as part of their security preparations.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Major Rolando Araño, Spokesperson sang Iloilo Police Provincial Office, iya ginpahayag nga nagahulat pa sila sang dugang nga augmentation personnel halin sa regional office agud masiguro ang husto nga kadamuon sang mga pulis nga ma-assign sa mga polling precincts.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Major Rolando Araño, spokesperson of the Iloilo Police Provincial Office, said they are still waiting for additional augmentation personnel from the regional office to ensure the right number of policemen will be assigned to the polling precincts.

text: Suno kay Araño, may yara lang sila nga gina-fix sa iban nga bagay agud maplastar na ang tanan mga deployment.
english: According to Araño, they are just fixing something else so that all the deployments can be placed.

text: Ginpasiguro man ni Araño nga may contingency plan ang IPPO kun may kakulangan sa police personnel, agud malikawan ang ano man nga problema sa adlaw sang eleksyon.
english: Araño also assured that the IPPO has a contingency plan in case of shortage of police personnel, to avoid any problems on election day.

text: Gin-athag man sang natungdan nga sa subong wala pa sila sang may nabataon nga report ukon reklamo tuhoy sa vote buying, apang padayon ang ila coordination sa COMELEC kag sa mga partner agency.
english: He also explained that they have not yet received any reports or complaints regarding vote buying, but they are continuing to coordinate with the COMELEC and partner agencies.

text: Nagapanugyan man si Araño sa mga pumuluyo nga magbinuligay kag gilayon nga mag-coordinate sa mga kapulisan kun may yara sang mga problema sa tion sang pagboto agud nga may kalinong kag matalalunsay nga 2025 midterm elections.
english: Araño also advised the residents to cooperate and immediately coordinate with the police if there are any problems during the voting so that there will be a peaceful and smooth 2025 midterm elections.

text: Nag-abot na sa South Korea ang aircraft carrier sang Estados Unidos sang Amerika para sa natalana nga joint military drills agud nga mabatuan ang mga pagpamahog sang North Korea.
english: The United States aircraft carrier has arrived in South Korea for scheduled joint military drills to counter North Korean threats.

text: Natabo ini isa ka adlaw matapos ginpatawag sang South ang Russian ambassador to Seoul agud nga pamatukan ang bag-o nga agreement nga ginpirmahan nanday President Vladimir Putin kag Kim Jong Un sa Pyongyang sang nagligad nga semana kun sa diin nakasaad nga magabuligay ang Russia kag ang North Korea kun may pagpang-atake sa ila.
english: This comes a day after the South summoned the Russian ambassador to Seoul to oppose the new agreement signed by President Vladimir Putin and Kim Jong Un in Pyongyang last week in which Russia and North Korea promised to cooperate in the event of an attack.

text: Suno naman sa South Korean Navy, ang pag-abot sang US aircraft carrier nga Theodore Roosevelt sa Busan Naval Base ang naga-demonstrar sang mapag-on nga kumbinasyon sang depensa sang South Korea kag Estados Unidos kag ang ila mabaskog man nga commitment nga magbalos sa anuman nga pagpamahog halin sa Pyongyang.
english: According to the South Korean Navy, the arrival of the US aircraft carrier Theodore Roosevelt at Busan Naval Base demonstrates the strong defense combination of South Korea and the United States and their strong commitment to respond to any threat from Pyongyang.

text: Pito ka bulan na ang nagligad, nag-abot man anay sa South ang isa pa ka US aircraft carrier nga USS Carl Vinson bilang pagpakita man sang pwersa batok sa North.
english: Seven months ago, another US aircraft carrier, the USS Carl Vinson, also arrived in the South as a show of force against the North.

text: Subong nga bulan natalana ang joint exercises nga pasakupan sang US, South Korea, kag Japan — bagay nga ginapakamalain sang North kag ginatawag nga rehearsal para sa invasion.
english: This month is scheduled for joint exercises involving the US, South Korea, and Japan — something the North has condemned and called a rehearsal for an invasion.

text: MANILA – Ginahulat sang Department of Agriculture ang update gikan sa counterpart agency may kaangtanan sa pag-ban sang chicken imports halin sa Brazil.
english: MANILA – The Department of Agriculture is waiting for an update from the counterpart agency regarding the ban on chicken imports from Brazil.

text: Nauna diri, gin-anunsyo sang Department of Agriculture nga ginadumili-an ang pagbaton sang Brazilian poultry products kasunod sang report sang China nga kontaminado sang COVID-19 ang pila sa mga produkto gikan sa nasambit nga South American country.
english: Earlier, the Department of Agriculture announced a ban on the acceptance of Brazilian poultry products following China's report that some of the products from the South American country were contaminated with COVID-1

text: Sa sulat nga ginpadala sang Pilipinas sa Brazil, nakasaad nga desidido ang Department of Agriculture offiicials nga masolbar ang nasambit nga isyu kag ang pag-ban sa mga produkto ang “precautionary measure” lamang.
english: In a letter sent by the Philippines to Brazil, the Department of Agriculture officials said they are determined to resolve the issue and that the ban on the products is only a “precautionary measure”.

text:
Ang Brazilian government ang required nga magpasa sang mga masunod nga dukomento:

-Listahan sang foreign meat establishments nga naga-export sa Pilipnas-Kopya sang Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock and Food Supply (MAPA) issued national guidelines tuhoy sa control and prevention sang COVID-19 cases sa meat establishments-Certified copies sang food safety manuals ilabi na sang mga foreign meat establishments nga nalakip sa report sang China-Current rate sang COVID-19 testing sa meat establishment workers kag-Revised guidelines sang production, packaging kag storage sang poultry mechanically deboned meat
english:
The Brazilian government is required to submit the following documents:

-List of foreign meat establishments exporting to the Philippines-Copy of the Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock and Food Supply (MAPA) issued national guidelines on the control and prevention of COVID-19 cases in meat establishments-Certified copies of food safety manuals especially of meat establishments included in reports China-Current rate of COVID-19 testing in meat establishment workers and-Revised guidelines of production, packaging and storage of poultry mechanically deboned meat

text: Ginakabig nga dako nga dungog kag kadalag-an sang isa Ilonggo designer nga nalakip ang ginhimo sini nga costume sa top 5 winner sang best in national costume sa sa Miss Universe Philippines.
english: It is considered a great honor and achievement for an Ilonggo designer that his costume was included in the top 5 winner of best in national costume in the Miss Universe Philippines.

text: Ini amo si Ruffy Itaas nga naghimo sang ‘Santermo’ costume nga ginsuksok ni Angeline Cordero Kailani nga tiglawas sang Iloilo sa amo nga pageant.
english: This is Ruffy Itaas who made the 'Santermo' costume worn by Angeline Cordero Kailani who represented Iloilo in the pageant.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Rady kay Ruffy Itaas, iya ginnpahayag nga ang pagkilala sa iya ginhuman nga national costume ang paghatag man sang nagakadapat man nga pagpasidungog sa talento sang mga Ilonggo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Rady, Ruffy Itaas said that the recognition of his national costume is also a tribute to the talent of Ilonggos.

text: Suno kay Itaas, indi ini ang una nga bes nga naghimo siya sang national costume sang mga kandidata sa national pageant kag isa ini ka maayo nga oportunidad nga mapakigbahin niy ang iya passion.
english: According to Itaas, this is not the first time he has made national costumes for the candidates in the national pageant and this is a good opportunity for him to share his passion.

text: Pahayag niya, apisar mythical creature ang tema sang national costume, ginsiguro man sini nga ma-highlight gihapon ang katahum ni Kailani.
english: He said that although the theme of the national costume is a mythical creature, it also ensured that the beauty of Kailani is still highlighted.

text: Naggamit ini ini sang recycled materials kaangay sang plastic bottles kag iban pa.
english: It used recycled materials like plastic bottles and others.

text: Bangud sa amo nga kadalag-an, mas naghatag ini sang inspirasyon sa iya agud hatagan pa gid sang kabuhi ang iya passion sa pagdesinyo kag paghimo sang costume.
english: Due to such success, it further inspired him to give more life to his passion for costume designing and making.

text: Target sang Samahang Basketbol ng Pilipinas kag ni Tab Baldwin, program director sang Gilas Pilipinas ang kadalag-an sa 2023 FIBA Basketball World Cup nga igahost sang Japan kag Indonesia.
english: The Philippine Basketball Association and Tab Baldwin, program director of Gilas Pilipinas, are targeting victory in the 2023 FIBA ​​Basketball World Cup to be hosted by Japan and Indonesia.

text: Suno kay Baldwin, kun eksperyensya lang ang pagabasehan, makabig nga “underdogs’ pa sila kun ipaanggid sa iban nga kopunan apang indi naman sila magapaulihi kun talento lang ang paga-istoryahan.
english: According to Baldwin, if they are based on experience, they are still considered “underdogs” compared to other teams but they will not be left behind when it comes to talent.

text: Sa pihak sang limitado nga oras agud magpeparar, nagapati ang kopunan nga malutos nila ang ila kasunpong gikan sa Indonesia.
english: Despite the limited time to prepare, the team believes they can defeat their opponent from Indonesia.

text: Apisar nga ginalauman sang kopunan nga madamo pa ang posible matabo subong kag sa tuig 2023, nagapati sya nga isa na ka dako nga kadalag-an para sa Pilipinas ang makasulod sa qualifying campaign sang FIBA Asia Cup 2021.
english: Although the team expects more to happen now and in 2023, it believes that it is a big victory for the Philippines to enter the qualifying campaign of the FIBA ​​Asia Cup 2021.

text: ILOILO CITY- Brutal nga kamatayon ang naagom sang isa ka solterito sa Barangay Aquino-Nobleza East, Janiuay, Iloilo matapos nga ginbuno kag ginlihapan pa ang iya butkon sang suspek.
english: ILOILO CITY- A young man was brutally killed in Barangay Aquino-Nobleza East, Janiuay, Iloilo after he was stabbed and stabbed in the arm by a suspect.

text: Ang biktima amo si Christian Loraña, 15 samtang ang suspek amo si Mateo Renovar nga lunsay residente sang amo nga lugar.
english: The victim was identified as Christian Loraña, 15 while the suspect was identified as Mateo Renovar, both residents of the same area.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay PCPT Alwin Salmon, hepe sang Janiuay Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga base sa ila pagpangusisa, nagapungko ang biktima sa kilid sang dalan sang hinali lang nga ginpalapitan sang suspek kag ginbuno sang makapila ka beses.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, PCPT Alwin Salmon, chief of the Janiuay Municipal Police Station, said that based on their investigation, the victim was sitting on the side of the road when the suspect suddenly approached him and stabbed him several times.

text: Gindala pa ang biktima sa Janiuay District Hospital apang gindeklarar nga dead on arrival sang doktor.
english: The victim was rushed to the Janiuay District Hospital but was declared dead on arrival.

text: Naaresto naman ang suspek kag narekober sa iya ang kutsilyo nga gin-gamit sa krimen.
english: The suspect was arrested and the knife used in the crime was recovered from him.

text: Ginpahayag nga may diperensya sa paminsaron ang suspek.
english: The suspect was reportedly mentally retarded.

text: Gin-ako ni Lakers superstar LeBron James nga madismaya sya sa tion nga indi mahatagan sang tsansa ang Los Angeles nga makalab-ot sa playoffs subong nga tuig.
english: Lakers superstar LeBron James has admitted that he will be disappointed if Los Angeles is not given a chance to reach the playoffs this year.

text: Madumduman nga temporaryo nga ginpaiway sang NBA ang mga hampang subong nga season bangud sa kahangawa sa COVID-19.
english: The NBA temporarily suspended games this season due to COVID-19 concerns.

text: Suno kay James, apisar nga positibo siya sa madangatan sang Lakers pat-ud niya nga mas parayoridad sa gihapon ang ikaayong lawas sang mga atleta.
english: James said that although he is positive about the Lakers' future, he is sure that the health of the athletes is still a priority.

text: Una na nga ginbalabagan ni James ang paghampang sa playing venues nga wala sang fans mangin sa posibilidad sang pagtililipon sa isa ka lugar nga wala sang NBA teams agud makumpleto ang season paagi sa isa ka sports quarantine.
english: James has previously ruled out playing in venues without fans or the possibility of gathering in a place without NBA teams to complete the season through a sports quarantine.

text: Apang sa subong, pabor na ang 16-time All star sa anuman nga ideya agud masiguro ang kahilwayan sang mga players kag staffs sang NBA.
english: But for now, the 16-time All star is in favor of any idea to ensure the freedom of NBA players and staffs.

text: Bilang kabahin sang kilos-protesta antes sang ika-apat nga State of the Nation Address (SONA) ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., ginpangsunog sang mga myembro sang Bagong Alyansang Makabayan (Bayan) Southern Tagalog ang duha ka effigy nga ginhingadlan nila nga “ZomBBM” kag “Sara-nanggal”.
english: As part of a protest ahead of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.'s fourth State of the Nation Address (SONA), members of the Bagong Alyansang Makabayan (Bayan) Southern Tagalog burned two effigies they named “ZomBBM” and “Sara-nanggal”.

text: Suno sa grupo, ang nasambit nga mga effigy nagapakita sang “mga halimaw sang katilingban” nga nagapadayon sang pagpang-abuso sa mga pumuluyo.
english: According to the group, the said effigies depict “monsters of society” who perpetuate the abuse of citizens.
