text: Ang “ZomBBM”, nga halin sa terminolohiya nga “zombie” kag BBM (Bongbong Marcos), nagalaragway kay Marcos bilang sunod-sunuran sa interes sang Estados Unidos.
english: “ZomBBM”, which is derived from the terminology “zombie” and BBM (Bongbong Marcos), describes Marcos as a follower of the interests of the United States.

text: Sa likod sang effigy, may imahe ni former U.S. President Donald Trump, nga ginatudlo sang grupo bilang simbolo sang imperyalismo nga Amerikano nga ginapasunod ni Marcos.
english: Behind the effigy, there is an image of former U.S. President Donald Trump, which the group points to as a symbol of the American imperialism pursued by Marcos.

text: Samtang, ang “Sara-nanggal” ang naghalin sa ngalan ni Bise Presidente Sara Duterte kag sa halimaw nga “manananggal” sa diin ginlaragway nga may ginbulag nga lawas kag nagagwa ang daku nga kantidad sang kwarta sa iya idalom.
english: Meanwhile, “Sara-nanggal” comes from the name of Vice President Sara Duterte and the monster “manananggal” which is described as having a separated body and a large amount of money coming out from under it.

text: Ini nagasimbolo sang isyu sang korapsyon sa iya opisina.
english: This symbolizes the issue of corruption in his office.

text: Nahanungod sini, ginpahanumdom sang grupo ang impeachment nga ginpasaka batok kay Duterte sang Pebrero 5, nga may kaangtanan sa gina-question nga paggamit sang pondo sang Office of the Vice President (OVP) kag Department of Education (DepEd).
english: In this regard, the group recalled the impeachment filed against Duterte on February 5, in connection with the questionable use of funds by the Office of the Vice President (OVP) and Department of Education (DepEd).

text: Apisar pa man nga ginbalik sang Senado ang kaso sa Kamara kag gin-deklarar sang Korte Suprema nga unconstitutional ang impeachment process, ginpahayag ni SC spokesperson Camille Ting nga indi sini ginapasiguro nga wala sang sala si Duterte sa ginahimo nga alegasyon sang korapsyon.
english: Although the Senate returned the case to the House and the Supreme Court declared the impeachment process unconstitutional, SC spokesperson Camille Ting said it does not guarantee that Duterte is innocent of the allegations of corruption.

text:
Summer solstice sa subong sa diin ang Pilipinas kag ang iban nga mga pungsod sa northern hemisphere ang maka-eksperyensya sang mas malawig nga adlaw kag manubo nga gab-i.

Suno sa United States National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration, ang position sang northern axis sang kalibutan ang nakatutok sa adlaw sa tion sang summer solstice.
english:
Summer solstice is now where the Philippines and other countries in the northern hemisphere will experience longer days and shorter nights.

According to the United States National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration, the position of the earth's northern axis is oriented toward the sun during the summer solstice.

text: Ini ang naga-umpisa 4:51 am subong nga Byernes.
english: It starts at 4:51 am this Friday.

text: Apang diri naman sa Pilipinas, maka-eksperyensya kita sang masobra 13 ka oras nga daytime.
english: But here in the Philippines, we experience more than 13 hours of daytime.

text: Ang adlaw nagbutlak 5:28 am kag magatunod naman ini 6:27 sa gab-i.
english: The sun rose at 5:28 am and will set at 6:27 pm.

text: ILOILO CITY-Nakuhaan sang masobra P1 million nga balor sang iligal nga druga ang lalaki nga subject sa buy bust operation sa Zone 10, Calaparan, Arevalo, Iloilo City.
english: ILOILO CITY-More than P1 million worth of illegal drugs were recovered from a man subject in a buy bust operation in Zone 10, Calaparan, Arevalo, Iloilo City.

text: Ang arestado amo si Vincent Provido alyas Tagoy, 37, residente sang Zamora, Iloilo City Proper apang nagarenta sang ilistaran sa Calaparan.
english: The arrested was identified as Vincent Provido alias Tagoy, 37, resident of Zamora, Iloilo City Proper but renting a house in Calaparan.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay PCpt Glen Soliman, team leader sang Regional Police Drug Enforcement Unit, iya ginpahayag nga una ng nabaklan si Provido sang isa ka sachet sang shabu nga nagabalor P50,000 kag narekober pa gid sa iya ang tatlo ka sachets sang shabu nga nagabug-at sang 170 gramos nga nagabalor sang P1,156,000.
english: PCpt Glen Soliman, team leader of the Regional Police Drug Enforcement Unit, said Provido was first bought with one sachet of shabu worth P50,000 and three sachets of shabu weighing 170 grams worth P0,056 were recovered from him.

text: Suno kay Soliman, sa Iloilo City naga-operate si Provido kag sa Metro Manila nagahalin ang iya supply.
english: According to Soliman, Provido operates in Iloilo City and its supply comes from Metro Manila.

text: Dugang ni Soliman, ginakabig si Tagoy bilang High Value Individual kag madugay naman ini nga gina-monitor apang nagasaylo-salyo lang sang ilistaran sa tion nga makamutik ini nga ginapanilagan siya sang otoridad.
english: Soliman added that Tagoy is considered a High Value Individual and has been monitored for a long time but only moves from place to place when he notices that he is being watched by the authorities.

text: Nag-isyu sang marching order si President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. issued a marching order.

text: nga magpatigayon sang audit kag performance review sa mga flood control projects sa tagsa ka mga rehiyon sa pungsod.
english: to conduct an audit and performance review of flood control projects in each of the regions in the country.

text: Ini kasunod sang pagsita niya sa mga palpak nga mga proyekto bangud nga ginkurakot sang mga natungdan nga opisyal matapos nga ginpondohan sang dako.
english: This follows his seizure of failed projects because they were corrupted by the concerned officials after being funded heavily.

text: “Sa mga nakikipagsabwatan upang kunin ang pondo ng bayan at nakawin ang kinabukasan ng ating mga mamamayan, mahiya naman kayo sa inyong kapwa Pilipino!
english: “To those who are conspiring to take the people's funds and steal the future of our citizens, shame on your fellow Filipinos!

text: ang kabahin sang paandam ni Marcos.
english: is part of Mark's warning.

text: Ginmanduan ni Marcos ang DPWH nga magsumiter gilayon sa iya opisina sang listahan sang natumod nga mga proyekto sa tanan nga rehiyon nga naumpisahan kag natapos sa nagligad nga tatlo ka tuig.
english: Marcos directed the DPWH to immediately submit to his office the list of identified projects in all regions that were started and completed in the past three years.

text: Kasunod sini, pagausisaon sang Regional Project Monitoring Committee ang listahan sang amo nga mga proyekto kag magahatag sang report sang mga wala matapos kag ang mga ginaalegar nga “ghost projects”.
english: Subsequently, the Regional Project Monitoring Committee will review the list of such projects and provide a report of those that have not been completed and those that are alleged to be “ghost projects”.

text: Dumalo ang ilang celebrities at personalidad sa ika-apat na State of the Nation Address (SONA) ni Pangulong Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: Several celebrities and personalities attended the fourth State of the Nation Address (SONA) of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: na ginanap ngayong Lunes sa Batasang Pambansa sa Quezon City.
english: held this Monday at the Batasang Pambansa in Quezon City.

text: Bagama’t walang inihandang seremonyas o photo setup sa red carpet dahil sa masamang panahon, sinigurado pa rin ng mga panauhin na nakasuot sila ng angkop at pormal para sa okasyon.
english: Although there was no ceremony or photo setup on the red carpet due to the bad weather, the guests still made sure that they were dressed appropriately and formally for the occasion.

text: Kabilang sa mga dumalo ang ilang kilalang pangalan sa showbiz at iba pang larangan sa pulitika.
english: Among the attendees were some well-known names in showbiz and other political fields.

text: Isa si Heart Evangelista sa mga celebrities na dumalo sa ika-SONA ni PBBM.
english: Heart Evangelista was one of the celebrities who attended PBBM's SONA.

text: Suot ang puting Filipiniana na may folded details habang nakasuot ng klasikong Barong Tagalog at itim na pantalon si Senate President Chiz Escudero at ang anak na si Quino.
english: Wearing a white Filipiniana with folded details while Senate President Chiz Escudero and his son Quino wore classic Barong Tagalog and black pants.

text: Hindi rin nagpahuli si Pia Wurtzbach na nagsuot ng modernized white terno na may sheer skirt.
english: Pia Wurtzbach also did not miss wearing a modernized white suit with a sheer skirt.

text: Bitbit niya ang isang white clutch at simple pero eleganteng alahas, kabilang ang isang Philippine flag pin bilang patriotic accent.
english: She carried a white clutch and simple but elegant jewelry, including a Philippine flag pin as a patriotic accent.

text: Samantala, dumalo rin si Leyte 4th District Representative Richard Gomez na naka-simple ngunit klasikong burdadong barong.
english: Meanwhile, Leyte 4th District Representative Richard Gomez also attended the event wearing a simple yet classic embroidered barong.

text: Ang anak na si Juliana Gomez ay suot ang isang makulay na modernong Filipiniana na may draped at knotted fabric details.
english: Daughter Juliana Gomez is wearing a colorful modern Filipiniana with draped and knotted fabric details.

text: Nagpirma sanday Russian President Vladimir Putin kag North Korean leader Kim Jong Un sang kasugtanan nga depensahan ukon buligan nila ang isa kag isa kun may pagpang-atake nga matabo sa ila.
english: Russian President Vladimir Putin and North Korean leader Kim Jong Un signed an agreement to defend or assist each other in the event of an attack.

text: Wala pa ginpaguwa ang pahat-pahat nga detalye sa amo nga agreement, apang amo ini ang ginalantaw nga pinakamabaskog nga koneksyon sang Moscow kag Pyongyang halin sang nagtapos ang Cold War.
english: Details of the agreement have not been released, but it is seen as the strongest connection between Moscow and Pyongyang since the end of the Cold War.

text: Pareho nga ginlaragway sang duha ka mga lider nga isa ini ka sahi sang pagsaka sang lebel sang ila relasyon nga nagasakop sa security, trade, investment, cultural kag humanitarian ties.
english: Both leaders described it as a kind of level-up of their relations covering security, trade, investment, cultural and humanitarian ties.

text: Pareho nga ginabalabagan sang West ang tinutuyo sang duha ka mga pungsod kag ini ang una nga bes nga nagbisita si Putin sa amo nga nuclear-armed state sa sulod sang masobra duha ka dekada.
english: Both countries are obstructed by the West and this is the first time Putin has visited such a nuclear-armed state in more than two decades.

text: Ini nga comprehensive strategic partnership sa tunga sang duha ka nasyon amo ang ginalantaw nga magapasangkad sang pagsaylo sang military technology sa Pyongyang kabaylo sang suplay sang mga hinganiban nga kinahanglan naman sang Moscow sa gyera sini sa Ukraine.
english: This comprehensive strategic partnership between the two countries is expected to expand the transfer of military technology to Pyongyang in exchange for the supply of weapons that Moscow needs in its war in Ukraine.

text: Sa meeting nanday Putin kag Kim, nagpasalig man ang North Korean leader sang “full support” sa Russia sa iya ginpahayag special military operation sini sa Kyiv.
english: During the meeting between Putin and Kim, the North Korean leader also pledged “full support” to Russia in its alleged special military operation in Kyiv.

text: Gin-ako sang International Olympic Committe nga mas dako ang pondo nga ila gintalana subong nga ginpaiway na ang Tokyo Olympics tubtob sa masunod nga tuig bangud sa Coronavirus Pandemic.
english: The International Olympic Committee has acknowledged that the funds they have allocated are larger now that the Tokyo Olympics have been postponed until next year due to the Coronavirus Pandemic.

text: Suno kay Christophe Dube, executive director sang Olympic Games, tanan nga kontrata para sa Olympics ang kinahanglan nga ire-secure tubtob 2021.
english: According to Christophe Dube, executive director of the Olympic Games, all contracts for the Olympics need to be re-secured until 2021.

text: Lakip diri ang mga kasugtanan para sa 41 venues, Olympic village nga may 5,000 apartments, mga hotel, transportasyon, mangin ang supply sang goods kag serbisyo.
english: These include agreements for 41 venues, an Olympic village with 5,000 apartments, hotels, transportation, as well as the supply of goods and services.

text: Ginabanta nga magalab-ot sa masobra $2 bilyon ukon masobra sa P1 bilyon ang magamit nga pondo bangud sa postponement sang Olympics sa diin kabahin diri ang pagasabton sang Japanese government.
english: It is estimated that more than $2 billion or more than P1 billion will be used due to the postponement of the Olympics, part of which will be borne by the Japanese government.

text: Ipinahayag ni Pangulong Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: sa kanyang ika-apat na State of the Nation Address (SONA) nitong Lunes na libre na ngayong taon ang dialysis sessions para sa mga miyembro ng PhilHealth.
english: in his fourth State of the Nation Address (SONA) on Monday that dialysis sessions are free this year for PhilHealth members.

text: “Sa mga nagda-dialysis, ang mga session nito na tatlong beses sa isang linggo, libre na sa buong taon.
english: “For those on dialysis, its sessions, which are three times a week, are free for the whole year.

text: Libre na rin po pati ang mga kinakailangang gamot,” anunsyo ni Marcos.
english: Even the necessary medicines are free,” Marcos announced.

text: Bukod dito, sinabi rin ng Pangulo na tinaasan na ng gobyerno ang coverage ng PhilHealth para sa kidney transplant procedures — mula sa dating ₱600,000 ay ginawa na itong ₱2.1 milyon.
english: Besides, the President also said that the government has increased PhilHealth's coverage for kidney transplant procedures — from the previous ₱600,000 to ₱2.1 million.

text: Saklaw na rin ng PhilHealth ang mga gamot na kailangan pagkatapos ng transplant.
english: PhilHealth also covers the medicines needed after the transplant.

text: Ayon sa Department of Health (DOH), patuloy ang pagtaas ng bilang ng mga kaso ng chronic kidney disease sa bansa, kabilang na ang mga apektadong bata.
english: According to the Department of Health (DOH), the number of cases of chronic kidney disease in the country continues to increase, including affected children.

text: Isa ito sa mga dahilan kung bakit pinalawak ang benepisyo para sa mga pasyenteng may sakit sa bato.
english: This is one of the reasons why the benefit was expanded for patients with kidney disease.

text: Nagaapelar ang mga pamilya nga pangitaon ang iban pa nga missing nga hajj pilgrims kasunod sang pagsaka sang numero sang nagkalamatay bangud sa amo nga tuigan nga aktibidad sang mga Muslim nga ginpatigayon sa pihak sang tuman ka init nga tyempo.
english: Families are appealing to find other missing hajj pilgrims following the increase in the number of deaths due to the annual Muslim activity held despite the extremely hot weather.

text: Naglampas na sa 900 ang napatay base sa figures nga gin-release sang nagkalain-lain nga mga pungsod.
english: More than 900 people have died, according to figures released by various countries.

text: Kasunod ini sang na-rekord nga 51.8 degrees Celsius nga temperatura sa Mecca nga amo ang holiest city sang Islam sa Saudi Arabia sang nagligad nga Lunes.
english: This follows a record 51.8 degrees Celsius temperature in Mecca which is the holiest city of Islam in Saudi Arabia last Monday.

text: Ginabanta yara sa 1.8-million ka mga tawo halin sa nanuhay-tuhay nga mga pungsod ang nagpasakop sa inadlaw nga pilgrimage nga kalabanan ginpatigayon sa guwa apisar pa nagatagiti ang init.
english: An estimated 1.8-million people from various countries took part in the day-long pilgrimage, which was mostly held outdoors despite the scorching heat.

text: May isa ka Arab diplomat nga nagkumpirma nga sa Egyptians pa lamang, nagtimbuok na sa “at least 600” ang napatay nga mas mataas sa 300 nga na-report sang nagligad nga adlaw.
english: An Arab diplomat confirmed that in Egypt alone, the death toll has risen to “at least 600,” higher than the 300 reported the previous day.

text: Lakip naman sa na-report nga missing amo ang wala na-rehistro kag wala sang official hajj permit rason nga wala naka-access sa air-conditioned facilities kun sa diin makapabugnaw kuntani ang pilgrims.
english: Among the reported missing were those who were not registered and did not have official hajj permits, which prevented them from accessing air-conditioned facilities where pilgrims could have cooled down.

text: Sa subong, ginabaha ang Facebook kag iban pa nga social media networks sang mga laragway sang mga missing kag sang mga hingyo nga magpaguwa na sang dugang nga mga impormasyon.
english: Meanwhile, Facebook and other social media networks are flooded with images of the missing and requests to release more information.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang hajj ang isa sa lima ka pillars sang Islam kag ang timing sini ang ginatumod sang Islamic lunar calendar.
english: Hajj is one of the five pillars of Islam and its timing is determined by the Islamic lunar calendar.

text: Magluwas sa na-report nga mga patay sa Egypt, nagkumpirma man ang Jordan, Indonesia, Iran, Senegal, Tunisia kag autonomous Kurdistan region sang Iraq nga may yara man sang pilgrims nga napatay halin sa ila nga mga lugar apang wala sang particular nga rason nga ginsapubliko.
english: In addition to the reported deaths in Egypt, Jordan, Indonesia, Iran, Senegal, Tunisia and the autonomous Kurdistan region of Iraq also confirmed that there were also pilgrims who died from their areas but no particular reason was made public.

text: Wala sang ginhatag nga impormasyon ang Saudi Arabia kun pila gid ang fatalities, apang na-report sini nga may masobra 2,700 cases sang “heat exhaustion” sang adlaw lamang sang Domingo.
english: Saudi Arabia did not provide information on the exact number of fatalities, but reported more than 2,700 cases of heat exhaustion on Sunday alone.

text: Sang nagligad nga tuig, masobra man sa 200 ka pilgrims ang napatay nga kalabanan halin sa Indonesia.
english: Last year, more than 200 pilgrims, mostly from Indonesia, also died.

text: MANILA – Isa ang Pilipinas sa masobra sa 100 ka mga pungsod nga may pinakabarato nga sweldo.
english: MANILA – The Philippines is one of more than 100 countries with the cheapest wages.

text: Santo international e-commerce website nga picodi.com, yara sa ika-95 nga pwesto ang Pilipinas gikan sa 110 ka mga pungsod kun sweldo ang pagahambalan.
english: According to the international e-commerce website picodi.com, the Philippines ranks 95th out of 110 countries in terms of salaries.

text: Yara sa P15,200 ang average salary sa Pilipinas nga tuman ka layo sa number 1 nga Switzerland nga may P296,000 nga average salary.
english: The average salary in the Philippines is P15,200, far from number 1 Switzerland with an average salary of P296,000.

text: Mas manubo man ang sweldo sa Pilipinas kun ipaanggid sa iban nga pungsod sa Southeast Asia kasubong sang Malaysia, Thailand kag Vietnam.
english: Salaries in the Philippines are also lower compared to other Southeast Asian countries such as Malaysia, Thailand and Vietnam.

text: Ang nasambit nga survey ang ginpatigayon sang Agosto 2020 paagi sa pagkolekta sang data gikan sa website nga Numbeo, isa ka crowd-sourced database.
english: The survey was conducted in August 2020 by collecting data from the website Numbeo, a crowd-sourced database.

text: May kaangtanan diri, ginkasubo sang labor group nga Associated Labor Unions (ALU) – Trade Union Congress of the Philippines ang nasambit nga resulta.
english: In this regard, the labor group Associated Labor Unions (ALU) – Trade Union Congress of the Philippines regretted the said result.

text: Nagpaandam kag nagbilin sang mga pahanumdom ang Iloilo Provincial Health Office (IPHO) sa mga ginikanan kasunod sang nakit-an nga pagsaka sang kaso sang hand, foot, and mouth disease (HFMD) sa probinsya.
english: The Iloilo Provincial Health Office (IPHO) has issued warnings and reminders to parents following the increase in cases of hand, foot, and mouth disease (HFMD) in the province.

text: Sandig sa data sang opisina halin sang Enero 1 tubtub sang Abril 26 subong nga tuig, nagdangat sa 487 ang mga kaso sang nasambit nga balatian kun sa diin 473 gid ang kabataan nga nagaedad sang siyam ka tuig panubo.
english: According to the office's data from January 1 to April 26 this year, there were 487 cases of the disease, of which 473 were children under the age of nine.

text: Sa sini nga numero, 52 gid ang lapsag nga wala pa gani nabulanan ang edad.
english: Of this number, 52 are babies who are less than a month old.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Maria Socorro Colmenares-Quiñon, head sang opisina, iya ginpahayag nga makaalarma nga infected na pati ang mga lapsag.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Maria Socorro Colmenares-Quiñon, head of the office, said it is alarming that even babies are infected.

text: Nagapakita ini suno sa natungdan nga nagalab-ot sa mga bata ang balatian bangud sa carriers nga posible amo ang mga hamtong na nga amo man ang nagadala sang virus sa balay.
english: He said this shows that the disease is spreading to children because of the carriers who may be adults who also bring the virus home.

text: Base man sa assessment sang opisina, nagasaka ang suspetsa sa household transmission bangud may mga ginikanan nga nagasiling nga wala man nagaguwa sa ila balay ang mga bata antes ang balatian.
english: Based on the assessment of the office, the suspicion of household transmission is increasing because some parents say that their children did not leave their homes before the disease.

text: Nagpanugyan ini sa mga ginikanan nga i-monitor gid ang kondisyon sang bata kun makataan sang sintomas kaangay sang hilanat, rashes, kag mouth lesions.
english: He advised parents to monitor their children's condition if they develop symptoms such as fever, rashes, and mouth lesions.

text: Kun may makit-an nga senyales, dapat gid nga mag-isolate agud nga indi na maglaton sa iban.
english: If you have any symptoms, you should isolate yourself to avoid spreading the disease.

text: Gina-abisuhan man ang tanan nga masami gid maghugas sang kamot kag maggamit sang alcohol-based sanitizers.
english: Everyone is also advised to wash their hands frequently and use alcohol-based sanitizers.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang iban pa nga sintomas sini nga kondisyon amo ang pagkadula sang gana sa pagkaon, pagsakit sang tutunlan, kag pagpalangapoy.
english: It is known that other symptoms of this condition include loss of appetite, sore throat, and fatigue.

text: Sa Iloilo, ang may pinakamataas nga recorded cases amo ang Carles nga may 54, Concepcion nga may 41, Barotac Nuevo nga may 29, Balasan nga may 29, Santa Barbara nga may 28, Cabatuan nga may 24, Igbaras nga may 22, Lambunao nga may 20, Dumangas nga may 18, kag Tigbauan nga may 17.
english: In Iloilo, the highest recorded cases were Carles with 54, Concepcion with 41, Barotac Nuevo with 29, Balasan with 29, Santa Barbara with 28, Cabatuan with 24, Igbaras with 22, Lambunao with 20, Dumangas with 18, and Tigbauan with 17.

text: Sa kanyang ika-apat na State of the Nation Address (SONA) nitong Lunes, nangako si Pangulong Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: In his fourth State of the Nation Address (SONA) on Monday, President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. promised to

text: na magpapatayo ng karagdagang 40,000 silid-aralan sa buong bansa bago matapos ang kanyang termino.
english: who will build an additional 40,000 classrooms across the country before the end of his term.

text: “Katuwang ang pribadong sektor, sisikapin nating madagdagan pa ng 40,000 na silid-aralan bago matapos itong administrasyon.
english: “Together with the private sector, we will strive to add another 40,000 classrooms before the end of this administration.

text: Maglalaan tayo ng sapat na pondo dito alang-alang sa ating mga mag-aaral,” pahayag ng Pangulo.
english: We will allocate enough funds here for our students,” the President said.

text: Dagdag pa ni Marcos, hihilingin niya ang buong suporta ng Kongreso upang matustusan at maisakatuparan ang nasabing plano.
english: Marcos added that he will seek the full support of Congress to finance and implement the plan.

text: Batay sa datos ng Department of Education (DepEd), kasalukuyang may kakulangan na humigit-kumulang 165,000 silid-aralan sa buong bansa—isang isyung matagal nang hinaharap ng sektor ng edukasyon sa Pilipinas.
english: Batay sa datos ng Department of Education (DepEd), kasalukuyang may kakulangan na humigit-kumulang 165,000 silid-aralan sa buong bansa—isang isyung matagal nang hinaharap ng sektor ng edukasyon sa Pilipinas.

text: MANILA – Ginaduso sang Department of Labor and Employment ang redeployment sang Overseas Filipino Workers nga nadulaan sang trabaho bangud sa COVID-19 pandemic.
english: MANILA – The Department of Labor and Employment is proposing the redeployment of Overseas Filipino Workers who lost their jobs due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

text: Suno kay Department of Labor and Employment Secretary Silvestre Bello III, lakip sa mga pungsod nga mahimo trabahuan sang mga displaced OFWs amo ang China, Russia, Czech Republic kag Taiwan.
english: According to Department of Labor and Employment Secretary Silvestre Bello III, among the countries where displaced OFWs can work are China, Russia, the Czech Republic and Taiwan.

text: Ginpahayag ni Bello nga nagalab-ot sa 354,000 ka Overseas Filipino Workers ang nadulaan sang trabaho kag kalabanan ang halin sa Middle East.
english: Ginpahayag ni Bello nga nagalab-ot sa 354,000 ka Overseas Filipino Workers ang nadulaan sang trabaho kag kalabanan ang halin sa Middle East.

text: Sa subong, naglab-ot na sa 165,000 ka Overseas Filipino Workers sa Middle East ang na nakapauli sa Pilipinas kag bangud sini, nagnubo sang 16.3% ang remittances santo sa report sang Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas.
english: So far, 165,000 Overseas Filipino Workers in the Middle East have returned to the Philippines and as a result, remittances decreased by 16.3% according to the report of the Central Bank of the Philippines.

text: May kaangtanan diri, may yara sa gihapon sang deployment ban sa luwas sang pungsod ang nurses kag medical workers bangud sa nagataas nga COVID-19 cases sa pungsod.
english: In this regard, there is still a deployment ban abroad for nurses and medical workers due to the increasing number of COVID-19 cases in the country.

text: Ang nurses kag medical professionals lamang nga may existing contracts kag ang mga nakakumpleto sang requirements antes ang Marso 8 ang exempted sa deployment ban.
english: Only nurses and medical professionals with existing contracts and those who complete the requirements before March 8 are exempt from the deployment ban.

text: Bagong kasaysayan ang isinulat ni Alex Eala matapos ang panalo sa unang round ng US Open.
english: Alex Eala wrote a new history after winning the first round of the US Open.

text: Ngayon, haharap siya sa mas batikang kalaban mula sa Spain.
english: Now, he will face a more experienced opponent from Spain.

text: Maghaharap sina Alex Eala ng Pilipinas at Cristina Bucsa ng Spain sa second round ng 2025 US Open ngayong Miyerkules sa New York, bagamat hindi pa inaanunsyo ang eksaktong oras ng laban.
english: Alex Eala of the Philippines and Cristina Bucsa of Spain will face off in the second round of the 2025 US Open this Wednesday in New York, although the exact time of the match has not yet been announced.

text: Si Eala ang kauna-unahang Pilipinong manlalaro na nagtala ng panalo sa Grand Slam main draw matapos talunin si Clara Tauson ng Denmark.
english: Eala became the first Filipino player to win a Grand Slam main draw after defeating Clara Tauson of Denmark.

text: Samantala, si Bucsa ay dinala sa ikalawang round matapos ang panalo laban kay Claire Liu.
english: Meanwhile, Bucsa was advanced to the second round after winning against Claire Liu.

text: Ayon sa tala ng Women’s Tennis Association, parehong may lakas at karanasan ang dalawang players—kaya inaasahan ang isang dikit na laban sa pagitan nila.
english: According to the Women's Tennis Association, both players are strong and experienced—so a little battle between them is expected.

text: Nagpirma ang Commission on Elections (COMELEC) Region VI sang Memorandum of Agreement (MOA) lakip ang pila ka mga digital payment platforms agud nga mapasangkad ang pagsulundan sa money transfer services sa tion sang 2025 midterm elections.
english: The Commission on Elections (COMELEC) Region VI signed a Memorandum of Agreement (MOA) including several digital payment platforms to expand regulations on money transfer services during the 2025 midterm elections.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Dennis Ausan, Regional Director sang Commission on Elections, iya ginpahayag nga sa idalom sang amo nga kasugtanan, pagalimitahan ang balor nga mahimo ma-transfer online, pila ka adlaw antes ang eleksyon.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Dennis Ausan, Regional Director of the Commission on Elections, said that under the agreement, the amount that can be transferred online will be limited, a few days before the election.

text: Suno kay Ausan, ang sakop sang MOA nga payment platforms ang mas hugton ang pag-monitor online sa mahimo makaduluda nga transakyon sa tion sang eleksyon.
english: Ausan said the MOA's payment platforms will tighten online monitoring of potentially suspicious transactions during the election.

text: Gintuad man sini nga ang tikang ang mahimo makaprotekta sa posible paglapnag sang online vote buying.
english: He also acknowledged that the measure could protect against the possible spread of online vote buying.

text: Wala man ginpanginwala ni Ausan nga dako nga pagpanghangkat sa ila bahin ang pagdata sang vote buying, online.
english: Ausan also did not deny that the data of vote buying, online, is a big challenge for them.

text: Nagpanawagan man ang natungdan sa publiko nga mangin mabinantayon kag magpakig-angot sa ila talatapan pananglitan may makit-an nga makaduluda nga transakyon.
english: He also appealed to the public to be vigilant and contact his office in case of suspicious transactions.

text: Samtang, nagpasalig ang Commission on Elections Region VI nga hitsu na ang talatapan para sa palaabuton nga May 12, 2025 midterm elections.
english: Meanwhile, the Commission on Elections Region VI assured that the office is ready for the upcoming May 12, 2025 midterm elections.

text: Ini nga pasalig ang ginbuy-an ni Atty. Dennis Ausan sa ginpatigayon nga Regional Joint Security Control Center press conference kaupod ang Philippine Coast Guard (PCG), Philippine Army kag sang Police Regional Office 6 (PRO-6).
english: This assurance was issued by Atty. Dennis Ausan at the Regional Joint Security Control Center press conference with the Philippine Coast Guard (PCG), Philippine Army and the Police Regional Office 6 (PRO-6).

text: Gindakop sang kapulisan ang isa ka empleyada sang Department of Environment and Natural Resources–Environmental Management Bureau (DENR-EMB) bangud sa ginpahayag pagpangkilkil.
english: Police arrested an employee of the Department of Environment and Natural Resources-Environmental Management Bureau (DENR-EMB) for alleged extortion.

text: Kasunod ini sang reklamo sang tag-iya sang gasolinahan sa Barangay Ugad, Cabagan, Isabela.
english: This follows a complaint by the owner of a gas station in Barangay Ugad, Cabagan, Isabela.

text: Ang suspek amo si alyas ” Mona”, 35-anyos.
english: The suspect was identified as Mona, 35 years old.

text: Ang nagreklamo amo si “Neila”, 56 anyos.
english: The complainant was “Neila”, 56 years old.

text: Nadakpan ang suspek paagi sa entrapment operation kun sa diin nakuha sa iya ang marked money kag cellphone.
english: The suspect was arrested through an entrapment operation where he was recovered with marked money and a cellphone.

text: Gin-alegar sang tagreklamo nga ginapangayuan siya masami sang suspek sang kwarta.
english: The complainant alleged that the suspect often asked her for money.

text: Yara na sa kustodiya sang Cabagan Police Station ang suspek.
english: The suspect is now in the custody of the Cabagan Police Station.

text: Ginsorpresa sang modern Pinoy pop-alt rock heroes nga IV of Spades ang ila fans paagi sa pagpaguwa sang bag-o nga ambahanon matapos ang lima ka tuig nga pagpahuway.
english: Modern Pinoy pop-alt rock heroes IV of Spades surprised their fans by releasing a new song after a five-year hiatus.

text: Magluwas sa new song, tuman ang kalipay sang mga taga-suporta nga apat gid sa original members sang banda ang yara sa kanta nga amo sanday Unique Salonga, Zild Benitez, Blaster Silonga, kag Badjao de Castro.
english: Besides the new song, the fans are very happy that four of the original members of the band are in the song namely Unique Salonga, Zild Benitez, Blaster Silonga, and Badjao de Castro.

text: May yara man sang music video nga gin-release kadungan sini.
english: A music video was also released at the same time.

text: Matandaan nga sang Agusto 2020 sang gin-anunsyo ang indefinite hiatus sang banda kun sa diin ginsiling sang mga myembro nga padayunon nila ang ila iban nga personal interests apang kinahanglan anay magpahuway bilang grupo.
english: It can be recalled that in August 2020, the band announced an indefinite hiatus where the members said they would continue their other personal interests but had to rest as a group.

text: Natabo ang hiatus duha ka tuig matapos nagbiya sa band ang lead vocalist nga si Unique para sa solo career.
english: The hiatus came two years after lead vocalist Unique left the band for a solo career.

text: Antes ang pagpahuway sang banda, may yara sila sang CLAPCLAPCLAP!
english: Before the band’s break, they had a CLAPCLAPCLAP!

text: album sang 2019 kun sa diin isa sa nangin pinaka-popular amo ang “Come Inside of My Heart”.
english: album in 2019 where one of the most popular was “Come Inside of My Heart”.

text: Natukod ang IV of Spades sang 2014 kag kilala sa hits nga “Mundo”, Dulo ng Hangganan, Captivated, I Ain’t Perfect kag iban pa.
english: IV of Spades was formed in 2014 and is known for the hits “Mundo”, Dulo ng Hangganan, Captivated, I Ain’t Perfect and others.

text: Nagpahibalo si Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr.
english: Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr.

text: sang dako nga pagbag-o sa rice import strategy sang pungsod.
english: of a major change in the country's rice import strategy.

text: Ini matapos nga magpagguwa sang isa ka advisory nga nagasiling mas manubo ang kinahanglan nga importasyon sang bugas para sa una nga quarter sang 2026.
english: This comes after issuing an advisory saying less rice imports are needed for the first quarter of 2026.

text: Nakatalana nga kakson sang Pilipinas ang apat ka bulan nga import ban sa una nga semana sang Enero.
english: The Philippines is scheduled to lift its four-month import ban in the first week of January.

text: Ini nga tikang ang makahatag sang palaagyan sa Bureau of Plant Industry (BPI) nga liwat magbaton kag magproseso sang application para sa rice importation.
english: This move will allow the Bureau of Plant Industry (BPI) to once again receive and process applications for rice importation.

text: Apisar may pila ka rice varieties nga ginpahanugutan nga makasulod sang tion sang moratorium, kadam-an sa mga commercial shipments ang temporaryo nga gin-untat samtang gina-review sang gobyerno ang local production.
english: Although some rice varieties were allowed to enter during the moratorium, most commercial shipments were temporarily suspended while the government reviewed local production.

text: Nakahibalo ka bala nga may trabaho nga makalot ka lang sang likod sang tawo apang bayaran ka sang linibo ka pesos?
english: Did you know that there is a job where you can just scratch someone’s back but get paid thousands of dollars?

text: May mga tawo abi nga nabudlayan magtulog kag lakip sa ila nga ginahimo amo nga ginapakalot nila ang ila likod para nga makapiyong-piyong sila kag mamu-ukan.
english: Some people have difficulty sleeping and one of their habits is to scratch their backs so that they can close their eyes and sleep.

text: Amo ina ang rason kun ngaa natukod ang labing-una nga professional back-scratching service nga ginatawag nga The Scratcher Girls.
english: That's why the first professional back-scratching service called The Scratcher Girls was founded.

text: Ang nangin utok gid sini amo ang 55-anyos nga sio Toni George nga isa man sa mga tawo nga nanamian gid magpakalot sa iya likod gani nga ginasugo niya pati ang iya mga apo para nga himuon ini.
english: The mastermind behind this is 55-year-old sio Toni George who is also one of the people who likes to scratch his back so much that he even orders his grandchildren to do it.

text: Sang ulihi, napinsaran niya nga wala siya naga-isahanon, gani, what if maghimo na lang siya sang back-scratching service kag pabayaron ang mga customer?
english: Eventually, it occurred to him that he wasn’t alone, so, what if he just did a back-scratching service and made customers pay for it?

text: Amo gid sina ang natabo, apang antes gintukod ang The Scratcher Girls brand, madamo pa nga pagtuon ang ila ginhimo.
english: That’s exactly what happened, but before building The Scratcher Girls brand, they did a lot more study.

text: Propesyunal ini nga serbisyo bangud therapist ang nagahimo sini kag nagagamit sang iya kuko sa likod, limbs, scalp kag mangin sa dulunggan sang customer para nga maka-relax sila.
english: This is a professional service because the therapist does it and uses his nails on the back, limbs, scalp and even in the ears of the customer so that they can relax.

text:
Light scratching kag tracing movements ang ginahimo sang therapist para mabuligan ang customer nga ma-release ang “endorphins” kaangay sang serotonin kag ma-connect ukon mabalanse ang “energy fields.”

Nagapanukot ang studio sang $130 ukon masobra P7,600 per hour para sa sini nga back-scratching kag tracing services.
english:
Light scratching and tracing movements are performed by the therapist to help the customer release endorphins such as serotonin and connect or balance the energy fields.

The studio charges $130 or more than P7,600 per hour for these back-scratching and tracing services.

text: Popular man ini sa US ilabi na sa ASMR community (autonomous sensory meridian response).
english: It is also popular in the US especially in the ASMR community (autonomous sensory meridian response).

text: Ang tag-iya gid mismo kag ang iya therapists ang masami nagabyahe sa major metropolitan areas kaangay sang New York, Los Angeles kag Philadelphia agud nga mas madugangan pa gid ang ila nga mga customer kag mas mapakilala ang ila studio.
english: The owner himself and his therapists often travel to major metropolitan areas such as New York, Los Angeles and Philadelphia to increase their customer base and promote their studio.

text: TAG-ULULAN  diri sa pungsod halin sa bulan sang Hunyo tubtub Setyembre, kag tubtub pa gani kon kis-a sa Disyembre.
english: THE rainy season here in the country lasts from June to September, and sometimes even into December.

text: Tungod sini, liwat naman nga ginakabalak-an, kag ginakahadlokan pa gani, naton ang dala sini nga malain nga panahon sa sining mga binulan.
english: Because of this, we are once again worried, and even afraid, of the bad weather that will bring it in these months.

text: Labi na gid karon sa pagluntad na sang Global Warming sa kalibutan nga nagatuga sang malala nga Climate Change nga nagadala na sang  “extreme weather” sa indi lang naton mapaktan.
english: Especially now with the existence of Global Warming in the world that is causing severe Climate Change that is bringing “extreme weather” beyond our control.

text: Indi kita dapat malipat sa Super Typhoon Yolanda nga nag-igu sa Visayas, labi na gid sa Leyte, sadtong Nobyembre 8, 2013.
english: We must not forget the Super Typhoon Yolanda that hit the Visayas, especially Leyte, on November 8, 2013.

text: Sunu sa mga lokal nga mga opisyales, halos 90% gid sang bug-os nga Tacloban City, punongbanwa sang Leyte, ang naghagmak sa 150 mph (241 kph) nga pwersa sang sining bagyo.
english: According to local officials, almost 90% of the entire Tacloban City, the capital of Leyte, was hit by the 150 mph (241 kph) force of the typhoon.

text: Ining Category 5 nga bagyo nagdala man sang mala-tsunami nga “storm surge”, nga sa kabug-usan nga kahalitan sining bagyo mga 6,300 gid ka tawo ang napatay kag nagsamad sang mga 30,000 pa.
english: This Category 5 typhoon also brought a tsunami-like storm surge, with the total damage of this typhoon killing about 6,300 people and injuring about 30,000 more.

text: Sa pagsugod lang sang bulan sang Hulyo, mga apat na sang mga 20 ka bagyo nga masami nagaduaw sa aton pungsod kada tuig.
english: At the beginning of the month of July, about four of the 20 typhoons that usually visit our country every year.

text: Matuod, ma-experyensya naton diri ang bugay sang ulan sa aton mga kaumhan.
english: True, we can experience the blessing of rain in our fields here.

text: Apang kon magsobra, nagadala man ini sing mga pagbaha kag, sa pagtupa sang bagyo, madamo naman sa aton mga puluy-an ang maguba, subong man ang madamo nga mga infrastruktura.
english: But when it goes too far, it also brings flooding and, when a storm hits, many of our homes will be destroyed, as will many infrastructures.

text: May madisgrasya naman nga mga kabuhi kag madamo man ang mawad-an sang mga pangabuhian.
english: There will be accidents and many will lose their livelihoods.

text: Liwat naman maga-atake ang madamo nga balatian, katulad sang trangkaso, leptospirosis sa nagaubog sa mahigko nga baha, dengue halin sa lamok, kag iban pa, luas pa dira ang nagaluntad na nga Covid-19 kag mga variant sini.
english: Many diseases will attack again, such as influenza, leptospirosis in dirty floods, dengue from mosquitoes, and others, in addition to the existing Covid-19 and its variants.

text: Lakip man ang paglala, ukon indi man ikamatay, sang pila ka pumuluyo nga may mga pondo nga mga balatian katulad sang high blood pressure, heart failure, kag ang mga naga-grabe nga indi na matabangan ukon madala sa ospital tungod sa kalain sang panahon.
english: This includes the worsening, or non-fatal, of some residents with chronic diseases such as high blood pressure, heart failure, and those who are getting worse and cannot be helped or taken to hospital due to bad weather.

text: Tungod sini, amlig gid kita sa mga kahalitan nga madala sang sining mga bagyo, dala ang pangamuyo nga tani wala na ang bagyo nga kasubong sa Super Typhoon Yolanda kag iban pa nga natural disaster.
english: Therefore, we are protected from the damage caused by these typhoons, with the prayer that there will be no more typhoons like Super Typhoon Yolanda and other natural disasters.

text: Ang gobyerno gani ni Mayor Jerry Trenas naga-preparar na sa “worst case” nga scenario.
english: The government of Mayor Jerry Trenas is already preparing for the “worst case” scenario.

text: Madamo sa aton mga pumuluyo nga nagapuluyo sa baybayon sang siyudad ang napasaylo na ni Mayor Trenas palayo sa mga baybayon.
english: Many of our residents who live on the beaches of the city have already been relocated by Mayor Trenas away from the beaches.

text: Apang madamo pa ang nagapabilin sa pagpuyo dira.
english: But many more remain to live there.

text: Tungod sini, gin-unahan na sang gobyerno sang siyudad ang mga plano agud masaylo sila sa mga mas hilway sa peligro nga mga lugar.
english: As a result, the city government has advanced plans to relocate them to safer areas.

text: Katulad sang mga shelter homes sa mga gym kag mga eskwelahan nga yara sa mataas nga lugar.
english: Similar to shelter homes in gyms and schools that are in high places.

text: Ready naman ang kinahanglanon nga mga pagkaon kag gamit sa ila temporaryo nga pagtener sa mga lugar nga ini.
english: The necessary food and equipment are ready for their temporary stay in these areas.

text: Kag ang iban pa nga pwede mahimo agud matabangan ang mga biktima sang malain nga panahon.
english: And other things that can be done to help the victims of bad weather.

text:
***

Ang tag-ulululan nagadala man sang oportunidad nga mapasanyog ang paggamit sang mga hydropower plant, nga indi lang daku nga bulig sa away batok sa Climate Change kay wala ini nagabuga sang makahalalit nga Greenhouse Gas (GHG).
english:
***

The rainy season also brings an opportunity to promote the use of hydropower plants, which are not only a big help in the fight against Climate Change as they do not emit harmful Greenhouse Gas (GHG).

text: Kon panahon sang kapaltahan sang fossil fuel-fed nga mga planta, daku nga bulig ang hydropower plant tungod madale ini makahatag sing back-up power tungod mas less complicated ang pag-operate sini.
english: In times of failure of fossil fuel-fed plants, the hydropower plant is a big help because it can quickly provide back-up power because it is less complicated to operate.

text: Sa karon, at least 21% sang electricity ang gina-provide sang mga hydroelectric plant diri sa pungsod nga bagay sa aton maulanon nga  pungsod.
english: Currently, at least 21% of the electricity is provided by hydroelectric plants here in the country which is suitable for our rainy country.

text: Ginapasanyog pa gani sang gobyerno ang elektrisidad nga mahatag sini sa 35% paglab-ut sang 2030 sa idalom sang Renewable Energy Act of 2008.
english: The government is even boosting its electricity supply to 35% by 2030 under the Renewable Energy Act of 2008.

text: Sa 2030 pa?
english: As early as 2030?

text: Ang Pakistan, por ejemplo, nagakuha na sang 31% sang ila elektrisidad halin sa hydropower plant.(Pakistan Country Commercial Guide, January 27, 2022).
english: Pakistan, for example, already gets 31% of its electricity from hydropower plant.(Pakistan Country Commercial Guide, January 27, 2022).

text: Samtang may isa na kita ka hydropower plant  – nga kabahin sang P11.2 Bilyon nga Jaluar River Multi-Purpose Dam sa Calinog, Iloilo.
english: Meanwhile, we already have one hydropower plant – part of the P11.2 Billion Jaluar River Multi-Purpose Dam in Calinog, Iloilo.

text:
***

Correction gali sa aton earlier report (July 13 issue) kon diin nagsiling kita nga “Mayor nila (Norway) nga electricity provider ang mga hydropower plant.” Nahimo naton ini  nga error sa aton side comment sa “EV Capital of the World” (Website:Norway), forgetting ang dugang ta nga source (Wikipedia) nga nagasiling nga ang Norway daku nga exporter sang oil kag natural gas, nga mayor naga-provide sang electricity para sa ila madamo nga EV vehicles.
english:
***

Correction to our earlier report (July 13 issue) where we said that “their (Norway) electricity provider is the hydropower plants.” We made this error in our side comment on “EV Capital of the World” (Website:Norway), forgetting our additional source (Wikipedia) that says that Norway is a large exporter of oil and natural gas, which mainly provides electricity for their many EV vehicles.

text: SORRY./PN
english: SORRY./PN

text: Pataya ang isa ka 17-anyos nga iloy kag anom ka bulan nga lapsag sini matapos ginhatok-hatok labo sa Barangay Talogoy, Malita, Davao Occidental.
english: A 17-year-old mother and her six-month-old baby were stabbed to death in Barangay Talogoy, Malita, Davao Occidental.

text: Ang suspek amo ang live-in partner sang babaye.
english: The suspect is the live-in partner of the woman.

text: Base sa imbestigasyon, ang lawas sang mga biktima ang yara na sa state of decomposition kag ginapatihan nga pila ka adlaw na nga patay ang mga ini ang nasapwan ang ila lawas.
english: Based on the investigation, the bodies of the victims are already in a state of decomposition and it is believed that they were dead for several days when their bodies were found.

text: Nakaangkon ang mga biktima sang pila sa ulo kag liog.
english: The victims sustained multiple gunshot wounds to the head and neck.

text: Narekober naman sang otoridad ang binangon nga ginapatihan nga gin-gamit sa krimen.
english: Police recovered the binangon believed to have been used in the crime.

text: Natukiban nga nag-atubangay sa barangay ang suspek kag ang biktima bangud sa inaway sa pamilya.
english: It was discovered that the suspect and the victim had a fight in the barangay over a family fight.

text: Ginalantaw nga pagpangimon ang motibo sa kirmen.
english: Jealousy is believed to be the motive behind the murder.

text: EUROPE – Nahisugtan sang mga players sang Juventus Football Club kag ila manager nga si Maurizio Sarri nga indi anay magbaton sang sweldo sa sulod sang apat ka bulan agud makasupot ang ila nga kopunan.
english: EUROPE – Juventus Football Club players and their manager Maurizio Sarri have agreed not to receive a salary for four months in order to support their team.

text: Ini bangud sa dako nga kapierdehan nga ginaka eksperyensyahan sang kopunan matapos nga ginsuspinde ang mga hampang sa Europe bangud sa Coronavirus Disease 2019 pandemic.
english: This is due to the huge losses experienced by the team after the suspension of matches in Europe due to the Coronavirus Disease 2019 pandemic.

text: Paagi diri, ginatan-aw nga makasupot ang kopunan sang ginabanta sa 90 milyon euros ukon masobra sa P5 bilyon.
english: Through this, the team is expected to save an estimated 90 million euros or more than P5 billion.

text: Lakip sa Juve squad ang football superstar nga si Portugal forward Cristiano Ronaldo kag Wales midfielder Aaron Ramsey
english: The Juve squad includes football superstar Portugal forward Cristiano Ronaldo and Wales midfielder Aaron Ramsey

text: Indi magtambong si Senator Robin Padilla sa State of the Nation Address (SONA) ni President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.
english: Senator Robin Padilla will not attend President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.’s State of the Nation Address (SONA).

text: Suno kay, Padilla ang detention kag ang posible nga trial ni former President Rodrigo Duterte sa International Criminal Court (ICC) ang iya rason.
english: According to Padilla, the detention and the possible trial of former President Rodrigo Duterte in the International Criminal Court (ICC) are his reasons.

text: Pahayag niya, apisar suportado niya ang Presidente, apang ang iya indi pagtambong sa SONA ang isa ka akto sang protesta bilang solidarity kay Duterte.
english: He said that although he supports the President, his absence from the SONA is an act of protest in solidarity with Duterte.

text:
Yari ang pahayag ni Padilla:

“Buo ang suporta namin ni Pangulong Bongbong Marcos Jr.
english:
Here is Padilla’s statement:

“We have the full support of President Bongbong Marcos Jr.

text: sa mga batas na kumikilala sa kultura, tradisyon at pananampalataya ng mga Muslim na siyang tunay na daan sa pagkakapantay-pantay tungo sa inaasam na kapayapaan ng taongbayan.
english: in laws that recognize the culture, traditions and beliefs of Muslims that he is the true path to equality towards the expected peace of the people.

text: Ngunit ang pagdalo sa kanyang SONA ay hindi ko magagawa bilang protesta habang si dating Pangulong Rodrigo Roa Duterte ay nasa piitan at napipintong husgahan sa isang banyagang hukuman.”
english: But attending his SONA is not something I can do as a protest while former President Rodrigo Roa Duterte is in prison and being tried in a foreign court.”

text: JAPAN – Gindugok sa gihapon sang madamo nga tawo ang 2020 Tokyo Olympics cauldron sa naaminhan-nasidlangan nga bahin sang Japan sa pihak sang pagpamahog sang Coronavirus Disease 2019.
english: JAPAN – Many people still flocked to the 2020 Tokyo Olympics cauldron in northeastern Japan despite the threat of Coronavirus Disease 2019.

text: Suno sa mga organaizers, naglab-ot sa 50,000 katawo ang naghulat sang pila ka oras sa 500 ka metro nga pila makit-an lang ang Olympic flame nga nahamtang sa Sendai station sa Miyagi.
english: According to organizers, up to 50,000 people waited for several hours in a 500-meter queue just to see the Olympic flame located at Sendai station in Miyagi.

text: Ang nasambit nga lugar ang napilian agud mangin kahabin sang ‘Recovery Olympics’ nga nagapakita sang pagtibawas sang rehiyon nagikan sa tsunami, linog kag nuclear meltdown nga naghalit sa ila lugar sang 2011.
english: The area was selected to be part of the Recovery Olympics, which showcases the region's recovery from the tsunami, earthquake and nuclear meltdown that devastated the area in 2011.

text: Nagpaandam naman ang mga organizers nga posible suspindehon nila ang viewing sang event kun padayon nga magdamo ang mga tumalan-aw.
english: The organizers warned that they may suspend the viewing of the event if the number of spectators continues to increase.

text: Nahibaluan nga magasugod ang nationwide torch relay sa Marso 26 sa Village sports complex sa Fukushima.
english: The nationwide torch relay will begin on March 26 at the Village sports complex in Fukushima.

text: MANILA – Naglab-ot sa 3.3 million ang numero sang mga Pilipino nga nadulaan sang trabaho bangud sa COVID-19 pandemic.
english: MANILA – The number of Filipinos who lost their jobs due to the COVID-19 pandemic has reached 3.3 million.

text: Ang nasambit nga numero nga gina-uyatan sang Department of Labor and Employment ang tuman ka gamay kun ipaanggid sa record sang Social Weather Stations nga 45.5 percent ukon 27.3 million individuals nga nadulaan sang trabaho.
english: The figure held by the Department of Labor and Employment is very small compared to the record of the Social Weather Stations of 45.5 percent or 27.3 million individuals who lost their jobs.

text: Suno kay Department of Labor and Employment Secretary Silvestre Bello III, wala ginabali sang ahensya ang resulta sang survey apang ang ginabasehan nila amo ang ginapasa sang mga employer.
english: According to Department of Labor and Employment Secretary Silvestre Bello III, the agency does not break the results of the survey but they base it on what the employers submit.

text: Ginpahayag ni Bello nga mas accurate ang data nga ginahatag sang employer bangud nga kumpleto ang detalye.
english: Bello said the data provided by the employer is more accurate because the details are complete.

text: Sa pagpaathag ni Bello, may yara sang permanente nga nadulaan sang trabaho samtang may yara naman nga temporaryo lamang.
english: Bello explained that some have permanently lost their jobs while others have temporarily lost their jobs.

text: May kaangtanan diri, ginpasalig sang tiglikom nga paagi sa Bayanihan Act II, mahatagan sang ayuda ang mga Pilipino nga nadulaan sang trabaho.
english: In this regard, the secretary assured that through Bayanihan Act II, assistance will be provided to Filipinos who lost their jobs.

text: Nagapadayon gihapon ang Commission on Elections (Comelec) Region VI sa pag-monitor sa mga lokalidad agud matumod kun may mga lugar pa sa rehiyon nga idugang sa areas of concern samtang nagahilapit ang Mayo 12 nga national and local elections.
english: The Commission on Elections (Comelec) Region VI continues to monitor the localities to identify if there are more areas in the region to be added to the areas of concern as the May 12 national and local elections approach.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Dennis Ausan, regional director sang Comelec Western Visayas, iya ginpahayag nga maid-id ang monitoring amo man ang evaluation kag assessment bangud may yara sang Joint Security Control Center sa kada locality.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Dennis Ausan, regional director of Comelec Western Visayas, said the monitoring as well as evaluation and assessment is thorough because there is a Joint Security Control Center in each locality.

text: May yara naman sang resolusyon sa Regional Joint Security Control Center kaangot sa election areas of concern apang suno kay Ausan, indi pa sa subong mabuyagyag ang kaundan sini bangud sandig sa pagsulundan sang en banc, ang Comelec chairman lamang ang makasapubliko sang lista para masiguro nga nagasalanto ang data sa central office sang poll body.
english: There is also a resolution in the Regional Joint Security Control Center regarding election areas of concern but according to Ausan, its contents cannot be disclosed yet because according to the rules of the en banc, only the Comelec chairman can publish the list to ensure that the data in the central office of the poll body is consistent.

text: Matandaan nga sa nagligad nga press conference, ginpahayag nga may walo ka mga banwa sa probinsya ang ginrekomendar nga ilakip sa areas of concern kasunod sang serye sang mga pagsinapol nga ginpatigayon sang Provincial Joint Security Control Center kag security agencies.
english: It can be recalled that in the last press conference, it was announced that eight towns in the province were recommended to be included in the areas of concern following a series of meetings conducted by the Provincial Joint Security Control Center and security agencies.

text: Sa latest data naman sang poll body nga gin-release sang Marso 2025, 11 ka local government units sa Region VI ang napaidalom sa yellow category ukon may history sang election-related incidents kun sa diin nalakip ang Ajuy, Lemery, kag San Dionisio sa Iloilo.
english: According to the latest data of the poll body released in March 2025, 11 local government units in Region VI are under the yellow category or have a history of election-related incidents including Ajuy, Lemery, and San Dionisio in Iloilo.

text: Anum naman ang nagtupa sa orange category ukon areas nga may serious armed threats kun sa diin nalakip ang Janiuay, Alimodian, Maasin, Badiangan, kag San Joaquin sa Iloilo.
english: Six others fell into the orange category or areas with serious armed threats, including Janiuay, Alimodian, Maasin, Badiangan, and San Joaquin in Iloilo.

text: Ang 90 ka iban pa ng LGUs sa Western Visayas ang na-classify nga sa idalom sang green category nga nagakahulugan nga wala sang pamahog sang election-related violence apang ginabantayan sa gihapon sang awtoridad.#
english: The other 90 LGUs in Western Visayas are classified as under the green category which means there is no threat of election-related violence but is still being monitored by the authorities.

text: Gin-anunsyo ang militar sang Israel nga untaton sini anay ang pag-atake sa south Gaza agud hatagan sang ligwa ang pagsulod sang mga ayuda para sa Palestinians nga binulan na nga gina-gutom.
english: The Israeli military has announced that it will temporarily halt attacks on southern Gaza to facilitate the entry of aid for Palestinians who have been starving for months.

text: Natabo ini nga “local, tactical pause of military activity” sa Rafah matapos nga walo ka soldado sang Israel ang napatay sa pagsigabong sa southern Gaza kag may duha man nga napatay sa separado nga insidente sa naaminhan nga bahin sang Strip nga amo ang pinakadaku nga nadula sa Israeli army halin sang ginsuguran sini ang gyera batok sa Hamas.
english: The “local, tactical pause of military activity” in Rafah came after eight Israeli soldiers were killed in a firefight in southern Gaza and two others were killed in a separate incident in the northern part of the Strip, the biggest loss to the Israeli army since it began its war against Hamas.

text: Ini nga anunsyo ang kadungan man sa pagmarka sang mga Muslim sa kalibutan sang Eid al-Adha ukon ang feast of sacrifice.
english: The announcement also coincides with Muslims around the world marking Eid al-Adha or the feast of sacrifice.

text: Gin-abi-abi naman sang United Nations ang tikang sang Israel nga may pag-untat anay sa away kag kinahanglan suno sa ila nga damuon ang ayuda nga mapasulod ilabi na ang pagkaon kag tubig nga kinahanglan sang Gazans.
english: The United Nations welcomed Israel's ceasefire and said it needed more aid, especially food and water, for the Gazans.

text: Nahibaluan nga antes sini, sulit-sulit na nga nagpaandam ang UN agencies kag ang aid groups nga daku ang kakulangan sang pagkaon sa Gaza Strip bangud sa pagsirado sa alagyan sa Rafah nga patabok sa Egypt.
english: Earlier, UN agencies and aid groups had repeatedly warned of severe food shortages in the Gaza Strip due to the closure of the Rafah border crossing into Egypt.

text: Nag-walk out sa plenaryo sang Kamara si Davao City 1st District Representative Paolo “Pulong” Duterte kaupod ang tatlo pa ka mga mamalidha halin sa Davao matapos ang pagbukas sang 20th Congress.
english: Davao City 1st District Representative Paolo “Pulong” Duterte walked out of the plenary session of the House of Representatives along with three other lawmakers from Davao after the opening of the 20th Congress.

text: Kaupod ni Duterte nga nag-walk out sanday Davao City 2nd District Rep.
english: Duterte was accompanied by Davao City 2nd District Rep.

text: Omar Duterte, PPP Party-list Rep.
english: Omar Duterte, PPP Party-list Rep.

text: Harold Duterte, kag Davao City 3rd District Rep.
english: Harold Duterte, and Davao City 3rd District Rep.

text: Isidro Ungab.
english: Isidro Ungab.

text: Naggwa ang apat ka mamalidha sa tunga-tunga sang pagboto sang House Speaker.
english: Four lawmakers walked out in the middle of the House Speaker’s vote.

text: Ginpaathag sang anak ni anay Presidente Rodrigo Duterte nga wala sila nalakip sa mayorya ukon sa minorya gani ginakabig nila ang ila nga kaugalingon bilang independent.
english: The son of former President Rodrigo Duterte explained that they are not in the majority or the minority so they consider themselves as independent.

text:
Nagapangagda ang local government sang Passi City sa pagsaksi sa volleyball matches subong nga hapon, Mayo 3, kun sa diin featured ang ‘next generation of champions.’

Yari ang schedule sang mga sambuwa sa ginatawag nga “PASSIKLABAN: The Volleyball Next-Gen”:

• 4:00 PM – Passi City vs Santa Clarita International School

• 5:30 PM – Central Philippine University vs Bacolod Tay Tung High School

Suno kay Passi City Mayor Atty. Stephen Palmares, wala sang kinahanglan nga bayaran kun maglantaw sa sini nga mga hampang gani mahimo gid dal-on ang mga pamilya kag mga abyan.
english:
The local government of Passi City invites you to witness the volleyball matches this afternoon, May 3, where the 'next generation of champions' are featured.

Here is the schedule of matches in the so-called “PASSIKLABAN: The Volleyball Next-Gen”:

• 4:00 PM – Passi City vs Santa Clarita International School

• 5:30 PM – Central Philippine University vs Bacolod Tay Tung High School

According to Passi City Mayor Atty. Stephen Palmares, there is no need to pay to watch these games so you can bring your family and friends.

text: “Let’s cheer loud and proud for our future volleyball stars,” post naman sang local government unit.
english: “Let’s cheer loud and proud for our future volleyball stars,” the local government unit posted.

english: (Photo: LGU Passi City)

text: Ginpahayag ni US President Donald Trump nga nagsugtanay na ang mga lider sang Thailand kag Cambodia nga magsapol agud istoryahan ang ipatuman nga ceasefire, kasunod sang tatlo ka adlaw nga madugo nga engkwentro sa tunga sang ila mga pwersa, nga nagtuga sang kamatayon sang kapin 30 ka tawo.
english: US President Donald Trump said the leaders of Thailand and Cambodia had agreed to meet to discuss a ceasefire, following three days of bloody clashes between their forces, which left more than 30 people dead.

text: Sa iya social media post halin sa Scotland, ginpahayag ni Trump nga gin-istorya niya ang lider sang duwa ka pungsod kag ginpaandaman nga indi sila makakuha sang favorable trade agreements sa Amerika kun magapadayon ang gyera.
english: In a social media post from Scotland, Trump said he spoke to the leaders of the two countries and warned them that they would not be able to get favorable trade agreements with the United States if the war continued.

text: Suno kay Thailand Acting Prime Minister Phumtham Wechayachai, naga-ugyon sila sa prinsipyo sang ceasefire apang gusto nila sang sinsero nga lihok halin sa Cambodia.
english: Thailand Acting Prime Minister Phumtham Wechayachai said they agree with the principle of ceasefire but want a sincere move from Cambodia.

text: Kasunod sini, ginahingyo man ni Phumtham kay Trump nga estoryahon ang Cambodia nga mag-agree sa bilateral talks.
english: Phumtham also urged Trump to talk to Cambodia to agree to bilateral talks.

text: Nagpahayag man sang kabalaka ang United Nations kag ASEAN sa posibilidad sang paglala sang sitwasyon sa border.
english: The United Nations and ASEAN also expressed concern over the possibility of a deterioration of the border situation.

text: Sa pihak sini, padayon nga nagabangigay ang duha ka pungsod kun sin-o ang una nga naglunsyar sang atake.
english: Meanwhile, the two countries continue to argue over who launched the attack first.

text: Matandaan nga nag-ugat ang away sang duha ka pungsod bangud sa madugay nga wala sang pag-ilintindihanay sa border sini, particular sa mga lugar kun sa diin nahamtang ang mga sinang-una nga templo sang Hindu kaangay sang Preah Vihear nga anay nangin sentro sang away sang 2008.
english: It can be recalled that the conflict between the two countries stemmed from a long-standing misunderstanding on their border, particularly in areas where ancient Hindu temples are located such as Preah Vihear which was the center of the conflict in 2008.

text: Sa pihak sang anunsyo ni Trump, wala pa sang detalye nga ginpagguwa angot sa kun san-o kag sa diin matabo ang pag-estoryahanay sang duka ka mga pungsod.
english: Despite Trump's announcement, no details have been released on when and where the talks between the two countries will take place.

text: Gin-athag ni Passi City Mayor Atty. Stephen Palmares nga indi matuod ang nagalapta nga impormasyon nga wala na siya naga-suporta sa reelection bid ni Iloilo Fourth District Representative Ferj Biron.
english: Passi City Mayor Atty. Stephen Palmares said it is not true that he no longer supports the reelection bid of Iloilo Fourth District Representative Ferj Biron.

text: Ini kasunod sang nagguwa nga mga impormasyon sa social media nga siya kag si Department of Agrarian Reform Undersecretary Jesry Palmares ang nagbawi na sang ila nga pag-upod sa kandidatura sang kongresista.
english: This follows information on social media that he and Department of Agrarian Reform Undersecretary Jesry Palmares have withdrawn their support for the congressman's candidacy.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo sa alkalde, iya ginpahayag nga nagalapta ini nga mga “fake news” bangud nagahilapit na gid ang Mayo 12 nga eleksyon.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, the mayor said these “fake news” are spreading because the May 12 elections are approaching.

text: Panugyan sini, indi pagpatihan ang kaangay sini nga mga impormasyon magluwas lang kun may yara sang official statement halin mismo sa iya.
english: He advised not to believe such information unless there is an official statement from him.

text: Ginsulit man sini ang suporta niya kag ni Usec Palmares sa kandidatura ni Anilao Mayor Lee Ann Debuque sa pagka-bise gobernador sang probinsya sang Iloilo.
english: He also reiterated his and Usec Palmares' support for the candidacy of Anilao Mayor Lee Ann Debuque for vice governor of Iloilo province.

text: Nagtipon ang mga tiglawas sang masobra 100 ka mga pungsod kag organisasyon sa isa ka major conference sa Switzerland sa tuyo nga istoryahan ang Russian invasion sa Ukraine.
english: Representatives of more than 100 countries and organizations gathered at a major conference in Switzerland with the aim of discussing the Russian invasion of Ukraine.

text: Target ni Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky nga gamiton ang meeting agud magpanawagan sang suporta sa iya 10-point peace plan nga ginplastar sang 2022.
english: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky aims to use the meeting to call for support for his 10-point peace plan laid out in 2022.

text: Kun ma-ugyunan na sang iban nga nasyon ang proposal para tapuson ang gyera, igapasa ini sa Russia kag may yara sang ikaduha nga peace summit kun sa diin hitsuhon na gid kag tapuson ang gyera.
english: Once the other countries agree on the proposal to end the war, it will be passed to Russia and there will be a second peace summit where the war will be finalized and ended.

text: Lakip sa plano ni Zelensky amo ang pag-demand sang pagtapos na sa kalakasan, pagbalik sang territorial integrity sang Ukraine, pag-isol sang tropa sang Moscow halin sa Kyiv kag pagbalik man sang ﻿pre-war borders sang Ukraine sa Russia.
english: Zelensky’s plan includes demanding an end to the violence, the restoration of Ukraine’s territorial integrity, the withdrawal of Moscow’s troops from Kyiv and also the return of Ukraine’s ﻿pre-war borders with Russia.

text: Nagapanawagan man ini sang pag-establisar sang special tribunal para nga ma-prosecute ang war crimes nga ginahimo sang Russian military.
english: It also calls for the establishment of a special tribunal to prosecute war crimes committed by the Russian military.

text: Kalabanan sa Western governments ang nagpadala sang ila nga mga tiglawas, lakip na si US Vice President Kamala Harris nga amo ang magarepresentar sang Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: Most Western governments have sent their representatives, including US Vice President Kamala Harris who will represent the United States of America.

text: Sa sini nga summit, igahatag sini ang panibag-o nga aid package sa Ukraine nga nagabalor sang $1.5 billion para matukod liwat ang mga imprastraktura nga naguba bangud sa gyera.
english: At this summit, it will present a new aid package to Ukraine worth $1.5 billion to rebuild infrastructure destroyed by the war.

text: May heads of state man halin sa European states lakip ang France, Germany kag UK, samtang yara man si Japanese Prime Minister Fumio Kishida.
english: There were also heads of state from European states including France, Germany and the UK, while Japanese Prime Minister Fumio Kishida was also present.

text: Wala sa sini nga pagtilipon ang pungsod China kag Russia.
english: China and Russia were not present at the meeting.

text: Wala sang senyales nga magpasugot ang Russia sa plano sang Ukraine ilabi na bangud antes ang summit, naghimo man si Russian President Vladimir Putin sang kaugalingon nga peace plan nga kalabanan indi man pagpasugtan sang Ukraine.
english: There is no sign that Russia will agree to the Ukrainian plan especially since before the summit, Russian President Vladimir Putin also made his own peace plan that Ukraine will mostly not agree to.

text: Sunod-sunod nga gin-atake sang United States military ang radar sites nga gina-operate sang Houthi rebels sa Yemen, ang grupo nga amo ang sa likod sa mga pagpang-atake sa mga barko nga nagalayag sa Red Sea.
english: One after another, the United States military struck radar sites operated by Houthi rebels in Yemen, the group behind the attacks on ships sailing the Red Sea.

text: Suno sa US Central Command, pito ka radars, isa ka drone, kag duha ka surface vessels nga wala sang crew ang ila nga ginpangguba sa sulod lamang sang 24 oras.
english: According to US Central Command, seven radars, one drone, and two unmanned surface vessels were destroyed in just 24 hours.

text: Ini nga radars suno sa militar amo ang ginagamit sang Houthis agud nga atakehon ang maritime vessels kag ibutang sa ital-ital ang commercial shipping.
english: These radars, according to the military, are used by the Houthis to attack maritime vessels and disrupt commercial shipping.

text: Ini nga operasyon sang Estados Unidos ang kasunod sa natabo sa Greek-owned vessel sa Red Sea nga nagpangayo sang rescue bangud naguba gid ang engine room sini sang gin-atake sang rebelde.
english: The US operation follows the incident of a Greek-owned vessel in the Red Sea that called for rescue because its engine room was badly damaged during a rebel attack.

text: 21 sa 22 ka mga Pinoy ang na-rescue halin sa amo nga barko, samtang isa pa ang nagapabilin nga missing.
english: 21 of the 22 Filipinos were rescued from the ship, while another remains missing.

text: Suno sa Central Command, ini nga barko ang ginbuligan sang USS Philippine Sea kag partner forces sini, samtang ang Tutor naman nga ginbombahan sang Houthis ang yara gihapon sa Red Sea.
english: According to the Central Command, the ship was assisted by the USS Philippine Sea and its partner forces, while the Tutor, which was bombed by the Houthis, is still in the Red Sea.

text: Nahibaluan nga halin sang Nobyembre 2023, masobra na 50 ka atake sa shipping ang nahimo sang Houthis kun sa diin tatlo man ka Pinoy ang napatay, isa ka vessel ang ila ginpalugdang, kag isa ka barko man ang ila nga ginsakop kag gindala sa Yemen kun sa diin may mga Pinoy man nga nakasakay.
english: Since November 2023, the Houthis have carried out more than 50 shipping attacks, killing three Filipinos, sinking a vessel, and capturing a ship and taking it to Yemen with Filipinos on board.

text: Liwat nga naeliher si Senador Francis “Chiz” Escudero bilang Senate President matapos makakuha sang 19 boto, batok sa 5 boto para kay Senador Vicente “Tito” Sotto III.
english: Senator Francis “Chiz” Escudero was re-elected as Senate President after receiving 19 votes, against 5 votes for Senator Vicente “Tito” Sotto III.

text: Natabo ang botohay sa pagbukas sang una nga regular nga sesyon sang 20th Congress subong nga Lunes, Hulyo 28, 2025.
english: The vote took place at the opening of the first regular session of the 20th Congress on Monday, July 28, 2025.

text: Base sa patakaran ng Senado, ang napierde nga kandidato sa eleksyon para sa Senate President ang otomatiko nga mangin minority leader.
english: According to Senate rules, the losing candidate in the election for Senate President automatically becomes the minority leader.

text: Makaupod sini ang mga senador nga nagboto sa iya bilang bag-o nga minorya.
english: This will include the senators who voted for him as the new minority.

text: Samtang, ang mga nagboto kay Escudero ang bag-o nga mayorya.
english: Meanwhile, those who voted for Escudero are the new majority.

text: Ang eleksyon ginhiwat bag-o pa man ang State of the Nation Address (SONA) ni Presidente Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: The election was held before President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.'s State of the Nation Address (SONA).

text: Nagpasalamat ang Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) kay Philippine National Police (PNP) Chief Gen.
english: The Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) thanked Philippine National Police (PNP) Chief Gen.

text: Nicolas Torre III sa donasyon nga naglab-ot sa masobra sa P16 million halin sa event nga “Boxing for a Cause: Laban sa Nasalanta” nga ginpatigayon sa Rizal Memorial Coliseum sa Manila.
english: Nicolas Torre III for the donation of more than P16 million from the event “Boxing for a Cause: Laban sa Nasalanta” held at the Rizal Memorial Coliseum in Manila.

text: Suno kay DSWD Assistant Secretary kag spokesperson nga si Irene Dumlao, ang dako nga kandtidad sang kwarta ang makabulig gid sa mga minilyon ka mga pamilya nga naapektuhan sang habagat kag sang mga bagyo.
english: According to DSWD Assistant Secretary and spokesperson Irene Dumlao, the large amount of money will help the millions of families affected by the south and typhoons.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang boxing match nga gin-organisa sang PNP kag gindag-an ni Torre paagi sa default win ang nakasupot sang masobra P300,000 halin sa entrance fees kag dugang nga P16 million halin sa mga donasyon.
english: It was learned that the boxing match organized by the PNP and won by Torre by default win raised more than P300,000 from entrance fees and an additional P16 million from donations.

text: Ang kabug-usan nga balor ang paga-turnover sa DSWD subong nga semana.
english: The total value will be turned over to the DSWD this week.

text: Samtang, naglab-ot naman sa P293 million ang kabug-usan nga ayuda ang napanghatag sang DSWD sa mga apektado nga indibidwal kag pamilya sang Hulyo, 26, 2025.
english: Meanwhile, the total amount of assistance distributed by the DSWD to the affected individuals and families as of July 26, 2025 reached P293 million.

text: Dapat nga hatagan sang libre nga swab tests para sa COVID-19 ang mga mamumugon sa sektor sang hospitality, tourism kag manufacturing amo man ang mga frontliners kag economic priority employees.
english: Workers in the hospitality, tourism and manufacturing sectors as well as frontliners and economic priority employees should be given free swab tests for COVID-19.

text: Samtang pahayag naman sang Department of Labor and Employment, kinahanglan nga may yara sa gihapon sang sick leave benefits, medical insurance coverage lakip na ang supplemental pay allowance para sa mga empleyado nga nag-positibo sa COVID-19 ukon mga close contacts nga kinahanglan ipa-idalom sa 14 day quarantine.
english: Meanwhile, the Department of Labor and Employment said there should still be sick leave benefits, medical insurance coverage as well as supplemental pay allowance for employees who test positive for COVID-19 or close contacts who need to undergo 14 day quarantine.

text: Naga-isahanon ang Department of Education Region 6 sa mga rehiyon sa Pilipinas nga may Regional Achievement Measure nga naga-cover sang tanan nga grade levels.
english: The Department of Education Region 6 is the only region in the Philippines to have a Regional Achievement Measure that covers all grade levels.

text: Sang damlag lang, ginpakigbahin sa publiko sang Philippine Statistics Authory nga masobra 18 million nga mga junior and senior high school graduate sa pungsod ang indi makabasa kag makahangop.
english: Recently, the Philippine Statistics Authority shared with the public that more than 18 million junior and senior high school graduates in the country are illiterate.

text: Ang Regional Achievement Measure ang nagaserbe nga regional tool sa pag-assess kag pag-monitor sang performance sang estudyante sa literacy kag numeracy sa tanan nga grade levels.
english: The Regional Achievement Measure serves as the regional tool to assess and monitor student performance in literacy and numeracy across all grade levels.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay DepEd Region 6 Spokesperson Mr. Hernani Escullar, Jr., iya ginpahayag nga apisar wala pa sang impormasyon nga nabaton ang rehiyon kun sa diin nahamtang ang talatapan sa data sang PSA, may yara naman ini sang mga programa kag inventions nga nakahanda na.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, DepEd Region 6 Spokesperson Mr. Hernani Escullar, Jr., he said that although the region has not yet received information where the PSA data office is located, it has programs and inventions that are ready.

text: Suno kay Escullar, kumpyansa ang Department of Education Region 6 nga nagahatag ini sang kalidad nga edukasyon sa mga learners.
