english: Escullar said the Department of Education Region 6 is confident that it is providing quality education to learners.

text: Ginpakigbahin sang natungdan ang mga nagkalain-lain nga national kag regional programs sang DepEd kaangay sang Enhanced Regional Numeracy Test (ERUNT) sa idalom sang proyekto kaangay sang Pagbasa kag Pagsuma.
english: He participated in various national and regional programs of DepEd such as the Enhanced Regional Numeracy Test (ERUNT) under projects such as Reading and Counting.

text: Dugang niya, nagaserbe nga potentional model para sa localized assessment kag targeted intervention ang proactive approach sang DepEd Region 6.
english: He added that the proactive approach of DepEd Region 6 serves as a potential model for localized assessment and targeted intervention.

text: Magluwas sa talatapan, may yara man sang iban nga program nga suportado sang mga organisasyon kaangay sang Tib-ong Bumulutho Program sa diin naka-focus ini sa reading kag numeracy remediation activities.
english: Besides the office, there are also other programs supported by organizations such as the Tib-ong Bumulutho Program which focuses on reading and numeracy remediation activities.

text: Samtang sa Iloilo, ang Provincial Government sa kolaborasyon sang DepEd kag Synergia Foundation, may yara sang ginapatigayon nga pre-assessment tests sa Grade 3 learners sa probinsya agud maka-establisar sang baselines para sa reading competencies.
english: Meanwhile, in Iloilo, the Provincial Government in collaboration with DepEd and Synergia Foundation, is conducting pre-assessment tests for Grade 3 learners in the province to establish baselines for reading competencies.

text: Patay ang magpakaisa nga lalaki matapos ginluthang sang riding-in-tandem suspects sa Zone 1, Barangay Baldoza, La Paz, Iloilo City kaina sang kaagahon.
english: Two men were shot dead by riding-in-tandem suspects in Zone 1, Barangay Baldoza, La Paz, Iloilo City this morning.

text: Ang mga biktima amo sanday Jomar Mendoza, ginapahayag nga residente sang San Nicolas, La Paz; kag Edmund Mendoza alias Turling, 32, residente sang Baldoza, La Paz.
english: The victims were identified as Jomar Mendoza, allegedly resident of San Nicolas, La Paz; and Edmund Mendoza alias Turling, 32, resident of Baldoza, La Paz.

text: Ginabanta nga masobra 10 ka basiyo sang 45 caliber pistol ang nakit-an sa crime scene.
english: More than 10 rounds of ammunition from a 45 caliber pistol were recovered from the crime scene.

text: Sa inisyal nga impormasyon, nagapangape lamang ang duha kag naga-istoryanay sa higad sang dalan sang nag-abot ang suspects.
english: According to initial information, the two were having coffee and talking on the side of the road when the suspects arrived.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Barangay Kagawad Jerry Dumlao, iya ginpahayag nga naka-istoryahanay pa ang suspects kag ang mga biktima antes ang pagluthang.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Barangay Kagawad Jerry Dumlao said the suspects and the victims had a conversation before the shooting.

text: Ginbalikan pa suno sa natungdan si Alias Turling agud nga i-finishing.
english: He said Alias ​​Turling was returned for finishing.

text: Suno kay Dumlao, nakaagi nga nadakpan sa drug buy bust operation si Edmund Mendoza sang una.
english: According to Dumlao, Edmund Mendoza was arrested in a drug buy bust operation before.

text: Sa subong, wala na sa listahan sang drug personalities si Edmund suno sa kagawad kag naga-obra na sa bugasan.
english: Edmund is no longer on the list of drug personalities, according to the kagawad, and is working in the rice fields.

text: Sa interview naman sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Major Shella Mae Sangrines, spokesperson sang Iloilo City Police Office, iya ginpahayag nga sa inisyal nga impormasyon, may armas nga na-recover halin sa hawak ni Alias Turling.
english: Police Major Shella Mae Sangrines, spokesperson of the Iloilo City Police Office, said that according to initial information, a firearm was recovered from the waist of Alias ​​Turling.

text: Sa inisyal nga pagpakig-angot ni Sangrines sa iloy sang biktima, daku ang posibilidad nga kilala sini ang ginaduha-duhaan nga mga suspects.
english: From Sangrines' initial contact with the victim's mother, it is likely that she knew the suspects.

text: MANILA – Kabug-usan nga P97.191 billion ang natipon sang Bureau of Customs nga balor sang duties kag taxes gikan sa imported nga gatong paagi sa Fuel Marking Program.
english: MANILA – The Bureau of Customs has collected a total of P97.191 billion worth of duties and taxes from imported fuel through the Fuel Marking Program.

text: Santo sa pahayag sang Bureau of Customs, magapadayon ang kampanya sang gobyerno sa pagkolekta sang lawful revenues.
english: According to the Bureau of Customs, the government will continue its campaign to collect lawful revenues.

text: Ang Fuel Marking Program nga nag-umpisa sang Setyembre 2019 ang padayon apisar sang community quarantine.
english: The Fuel Marking Program which started in September 2019 continues despite the community quarantine.

text: As of August 6, ang Customs’ revenue collection gikan sa imported fuel ang yara na sa P97,191,009,937.55.
english: As of August 6, Customs’ revenue collection from imported fuel stood at P97,191,009,937.55.

text: Santo sa BOC-Enforcement Group’s report, ang total volume sang fuel umpisa sang September 2019 tubtub August 6, 2020 ang naglab-ot sa 10, 912, 742,121 liters.
english: According to the BOC-Enforcement Group's report, the total volume of fuel from September 2019 to August 6, 2020 reached 10, 912, 742,121 liters.

text: Kun island group ang pagabasehan, ang Luzon ang may largest volume nga naglab-ot sa 8 billion liters, ginasundan sang Mindanao nga may 2.19 billion liters kag Visayas nga may 539 million liters.
english: In terms of island group, Luzon has the largest volume with 8 billion liters, followed by Mindanao with 2.19 billion liters and Visayas with 539 million liters.

text: Ang Fuel Marking Program ang ginlunsyar sang gobyerno agud madula na ang pataka nga baligyaanay sang gatong kun sa diin ang Department of Finance, Bureau of Customs kag Bureau of Internal Revenue ang nagapanguna sa nasambit nga programa.
english: The Fuel Marking Program was launched by the government to eliminate the fraudulent sale of fuel where the Department of Finance, Bureau of Customs and Bureau of Internal Revenue are leading the said program.

text: Nagtimalos ang Lebanese armed group nga Hezbollah paagi sa drone kag rocket attack nga nag-target sa mga base-militar sang Israel.
english: The Lebanese armed group Hezbollah retaliated with drone and rocket attacks targeting Israeli military bases.

text: Ini nga tikang sang Hezbollah amo ang pinakadaku nga atake nga nahimo sang kaalyado sang Iran halin sang natabo ang Israel-Hamas war.
english: This move by Hezbollah is the largest attack carried out by Iran’s ally since the Israel-Hamas war.

text: Ginakahangaw-an man nga magresulta sini sa all-out war sa tunga sang Tel Aviv kag amo nga grupo.
english: It is also feared that this could lead to an all-out war between Tel Aviv and that group.

text: Suno pa sa Hezbollah, ang ila pag-atake sa northern Israel ang kabahin sang ila pagtimalos matapos napatay ang ila senior commander nga si Taleb Abdullah ukon si Abu Taleb bangud sang air raid sang Israeli military sa Jouaiya sa southern Lebanon sini lang nga semana.
english: Hezbollah said its attacks in northern Israel were part of its revenge after its senior commander Taleb Abdullah or Abu Taleb was killed in an air raid by the Israeli military in Jouaiya in southern Lebanon this week.

text: Naggamit ang Lebanese group sang 150 rockets kag 30 explosive drones agud nga iguon ang 15 ka Israeli positions lakip na sa Golan Heights.
english: The Lebanese group used 150 rockets and 30 explosive drones to hit 15 Israeli positions including in the Golan Heights.

text: Base sa inisyal nga reports halin sa Israel, duha ang pilason kag nagluntad ang 15 ka insidente sang sunog bangud sa rockets.
english: According to initial reports from Israel, two people were injured and there were 15 fire incidents due to rockets.

text: Gin-report naman sang Israeli military nga na-intercept nila ang madamo nga rockets apang may iban nga nagtuga sang sunog.
english: The Israeli military reported intercepting several rockets but some caused fires.

text: Ginkumpirma man nga wala sang casualties sa atake sang Hezbollah.
english: It was also confirmed that there were no casualties in the Hezbollah attack.

text: Nahibaluan nga halin sang nagsugod ang gyera sa Gaza sang Oktubre 2023, may binalusay man sang lupok sa border sang Israel kag Lebanon.
english: It is known that since the war in Gaza began in October 2023, there has also been an exchange of fire on the border between Israel and Lebanon.

text: Ginrason sang Hezbollah nga nagahulag sila pabor sa Hamas nga pareho sa ila, gina-kabig man sang Israel, UK, kag iban pa nga pungsod bilang mga terorista nga organisasyon.
english: Hezbollah argued that they were acting in favor of Hamas which, like them, is also regarded by Israel, the UK, and other countries as terrorist organizations.

text: Iloilo – Ginatutukan subong sang Iloilo Police Provincial Office ang pagpahamtang sang checkpoints kag pagpatrolya kasunod sang asud-asud nga insidente sang pagpangluthang sa nanuhay-tuhay nga mga lugar sa probinsya sang Iloilo.
english: Iloilo – The Iloilo Police Provincial Office is now focusing on setting up checkpoints and patrolling following the frequent shooting incidents in various parts of Iloilo province.

text: Matandaan nga ginluthang-patay si Allen Sanchez sang Marso 23 sa Barangay Linobayan, Tigbauan Iloilo sang indi pa mahingadlan nga mga tawo.
english: Allen Sanchez was shot dead on March 23 in Barangay Linobayan, Tigbauan, Iloilo by unidentified gunmen.

text: Samtang, maswerte naman nga nabuhi si Glen Paloma matapos nga ginluthang sang apat ka mga lalaki sa Barangay Calaboa, Leganes, Iloilo sang Marso 26.
english: Meanwhile, Glen Paloma was lucky to survive after being shot by four men in Barangay Calaboa, Leganes, Iloilo on March 26.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang duha ka mga biktima ang nakaagi na preso bangud sa pagbayolar sa layi kag pagkaangot sa iligal nga droga.
english: The two victims were previously imprisoned for violating the law and involvement in illegal drugs.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Major Rolando Araño, spokesperson sang Iloilo Police Provincial Office, iya ginpahayag nga wala sang dapat kabalak-an ang mga pumuluyo sa probinsya sang Iloilo bangud sa mga ginpreparar nga security measures sang mga kapulisan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Major Rolando Araño, spokesperson of the Iloilo Police Provincial Office, said there is nothing to worry about in the province of Iloilo due to the security measures prepared by the police.

text: Suno kay Araño, ginpahugot na sang talatapan ang monitoring ilabi na sa ‘movement’ sang mga tawo nga naangot sa illegal drug trade.
english: Araño said the office has tightened monitoring especially on the movement of people involved in the illegal drug trade.

text: Ginpahayag dugang sang natungdan nga kontrolado sang mga ini ang sitwasyon sa pagpabilin sang kalinong kag katawhay sa probinsya.
english: He added that they are in control of the situation to maintain peace and order in the province.

text: Sa subong, may yara na sang persons of interest ang mga kapulisan sa mga suspetsado nga nagpangluthang sa mga biktima.
english: Police now have persons of interest in the suspects who shot the victims.

text: Nagapabulong naman si Paloma sa ospital matapos nga nakaangkon sang pilas sa nagkalain-lain nga bahin sang lawas.
english: Paloma is undergoing treatment at the hospital after sustaining injuries in various parts of her body.

text: Patay ang 49 ka mga tawo matapos nasunog ang isa ka building sa Kuwait kun sa diin naga-istar ang ginabanta 200 ka foreign workers.
english: At least 49 people have been killed after a building in Kuwait where about 200 foreign workers were living caught fire.

text: Wala pa sang ginpaguwa nga kumpirmasyon ang Department of Migrant Workers apang sa inisyal nga reports nga nagaguwa halin sa Kuwait, lakip sa mga biktima ang mga residente sang India, Pilipinas, Pakistan, Egypt, kag Nepal.
english: The Department of Migrant Workers has not yet released confirmation but according to initial reports coming out of Kuwait, the victims include residents of India, the Philippines, Pakistan, Egypt, and Nepal.

text: Suno sa health ministry, kaagahon sang natabo ang sunog sa anum ka panalgan nga building nga nahamtang sa nabagatnan sang Kuwait City.
english: According to the health ministry, the fire broke out in the morning in a six-story building located south of Kuwait City.

text: Una nga nagpahibalo ang interior ministry nga 35 ang patay apang gin-revise kag ginpasaka sa 49 matapos nga nasulod na sang forensic teams ang building.
english: The interior ministry initially announced 35 dead but revised it to 49 after forensic teams entered the building.

text: Nagpaandam man ang otoridad nga posible pa madugangan ang casualties bangud may mga kritikal pa subong ang kondisyon sa ospital.
english: The authorities also warned that the casualties could increase as there are still critical conditions in hospital.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang Kuwait ang masami destinasyon sang foreign workers halin sa South kag Southeast Asia kun sa diin kalabanan ang employed sa construction kag service industries.
english: Kuwait is a frequent destination for foreign workers from South and Southeast Asia, most of whom are employed in the construction and service industries.

text: Tiniyak ng Department of Agriculture (DA) na hindi inaasahang tataas ang retail price ng bigas sa kabila ng P1.12 bilyong pinsala sa sektor ng agrikultura dulot ng mga bagyong Crising, Dante, Emong, at ng Southwest Monsoon o Habagat.
english: The Department of Agriculture (DA) assured that the retail price of rice is not expected to rise despite the P1.12 billion damage to the agricultural sector caused by typhoons Crising, Dante, Emong, and the Southwest Monsoon.

text: Ayon sa DA, hindi malaki ang nasira sa sektor ng palay at sapat pa rin ang kasalukuyang rice stocks ng bansa.
english: According to the DA, the damage to the rice sector is not great and the country's current rice stocks are still sufficient.

text: Karamihan umano sa mga tanim ay nasa early vegetative stage at bahagyang nasira lamang, kaya’t mas madali itong makarekober.
english: Most of the plants are in the early vegetative stage and are only slightly damaged, so it is easier to recover.

text: Batay sa ulat ng DA-Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Operations Center, umabot sa 26,566 metric tons ang kabuuang production loss, na nakaapekto sa 45,408 na magsasaka at mangingisda sa 43,741 ektarya ng mga taniman sa iba’t ibang rehiyon.
english: According to the DA-Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Operations Center, the total production loss reached 26,566 metric tons, affecting 45,408 farmers and fishermen on 43,741 hectares of crops in different regions.

text: Pinakamalaking epekto ay nasa sektor ng bigas na may halagang P664.36 milyon na naitalang pinsala.
english: The biggest impact was in the rice sector with P664.36 million worth of damage recorded.

text: Sumunod ang isda sa halagang P202.35 milyon, high-value crops sa P162.16 milyon, mais sa P55.70 milyon, livestock at poultry sa P8.37 milyon, at cassava sa P1.98 milyon.
english: Fish followed with P202.35 million, high-value crops with P162.16 million, maize with P55.70 million, livestock and poultry with P8.37 million, and cassava with P1.98 million.

text: Tuloy-tuloy ang pagmomonitor ng ahensya upang masigurong sapat ang suplay at hindi maapektuhan ang presyo ng mga pangunahing pagkain
english: The agency is continuously monitoring to ensure adequate supply and not affecting the price of basic food items

text: Iloilo – Gin-athag ni League of Municipalities-Iloilo President Trixie Fernandez nga wala sang “culture of violence” sa probinsya sang Iloilo.
english: Iloilo – League of Municipalities-Iloilo President Trixie Fernandez clarified that there is no “culture of violence” in Iloilo province.

text: Ini ang kasunod sang ginpatigayon nga threat assessment sa mga local officials matapos ang natabo nga assassination kay Negros Oriental Governor Roel Degamo.
english: This follows the threat assessment conducted on local officials after the assassination of Negros Oriental Governor Roel Degamo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Fernandez, iya ginpahayag nga mahimo ipalab-ot sa mga kapulisan ang reklamo sa tion nga may mabaton nga pamahog sa kabuhi.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Fernandez said the complaint can be filed with the police if there is a threat to life.

text: Nahibaluan nga nakabaton sang threat sanday Iloilo 4th District Rep.
english: It was learned that Iloilo 4th District Rep.

text: Ferjenel “Ferj” Biron kag mga anak sini nga sanday Dumangas Mayor Braeden John “BJ” Biron kag Barotac Nuevo Mayor Bryant Paul “BP” Biron.
english: Ferjenel “Ferj” Biron and his children Dumangas Mayor Braeden John “BJ” Biron and Barotac Nuevo Mayor Bryant Paul “BP” Biron.

text: Magluwas diri, nakabaton man sang pagpamahog sa kabuhi si Dueñas Mayor Robert Martin Pama kag ang kaalyado sang pamilya Biron nga si Dumangas, Iloilo Vice Mayor Ronaldo “Onal” Golez.
english: Dueñas Mayor Robert Martin Pama and Biron family ally Dumangas, Iloilo Vice Mayor Ronaldo “Onal” Golez also received death threats.

text: Suno kay Fernandez, “case to case basis” ang magpa-request sang security sa mga kapulisan.
english: According to Fernandez, it is “case to case basis” to request security from the police.

text: Kaangot diri, suno sa natungdan, nagapasalamat ini sa Police Regional Office 6 bangud sa sang peacekeeping kag peacemaking sa probinsya sang Iloilo.
english: In this regard, he said he thanked the Police Regional Office 6 for the peacekeeping and peacemaking in Iloilo province.

text: Proud kag malipayon si Awra Briguela sang gin-share ang graduation photos sini sa senior high school sa University of the East.
english: Awra Briguela was proud and happy when she shared her graduation photos from senior high school at the University of the East.

text: Sa iya post, puno sang pagpasalamat ang 21-anyos nga aktres sa iya nangin mga inspirasyon nga lab-uton ang iya handum apisar sang mga pagpanghangkat.
english: In her post, the 21-year-old actress expressed her gratitude to those who inspired her to achieve her dream despite the challenges.

text: “Simula pa lang ito ng mas malalaking pangarap,” suno kay Awra.
english: “This is just the beginning of a bigger dream,” Awra said.

text:
“Gusto ko lang magpasalamat sa lahat ng taong naniwala at nagtiwala sa akin, lalo na sa sarili kong minsang inakala na hindi ko kaya.”

Ginpakigbahin sini nga indi man mahapos ang pagbalik sa eskwelahan ilabi na bangud halos lima ka tuig siya nga nag-untat halin sang pandemya, kag duha ka bulan na nga nag-umpisa ang klase antes siya nagsulod sa klase.
english:
“I just want to thank everyone who believed and trusted me, especially myself who once thought I couldn't do it.”

She shared that going back to school wasn’t easy especially since she took almost five years off since the pandemic, and it was two months before school started before she entered the classroom.

text: “Akala ko rin mahihirapan akong makisana sa mga kaklase at guro ko kasi siyempre, ilang buwan na silang magkakasama, samantalang ako ay kakapasok lang.
english: “I also thought I would have a hard time getting along with my classmates and teachers because of course, they had been together for a few months, while I was just entering school.

text: Noong una, may hiyaan pa, pero hindi rin nagtagal, unti-unti akong naging kumportable sa kanila,” pahayag sini.
english: At first, there was still a shyness, but it didn't last long, I gradually became comfortable with them,” he said.

text: Dugang niya: “At ngayon, ang mga taong ‘yon, maituturing ko nang tunay na mga kaibigan na kasama kong nagsumikap, lumaban, at ngayon, kasama ko ring magtatapos.
english: He added: “And now, those people, I can consider true friends who worked with me, fought with me, and now, finish with me.

text: Gusto ko pang magpasalamat kina Principal Venturina at Assistant Principal Almeyda, dahil hindi nila ako pinabayaan at binigyan nila ako ng pagkakataong makahabol.
english: I would like to thank Principal Venturina and Assistant Principal Almeyda, because they did not abandon me and gave me the opportunity to catch up.

text:
Isa sila sa mga unang naniwala na kaya ko.”

Una na nga gin-share ni Awra nga nahatagan siya sang Principal’s Choice Award halin sa University of the East Basic Education Department.
english:
They were one of the first to believe I could.”

Awra earlier shared that she was awarded the Principal’s Choice Award from the University of the East Basic Education Department.

text: Nakahibalo man si Awra nga madamo pa siya sang atubangon nga mga pagpanghangkat sa kolehiyo, apang pahayag sini, madasig lang ang tyempo kag updan niya ini sang kapisan kag pagpati sa kaugalingon.
english: Awra also knows that he will face many challenges in college, but he said that time is fast and he will accompany it with courage and self-confidence.

text: Matandaan nga nag-umpisa si Awra bilang child star sa teleserye nga Probinsyano.
english: It can be recalled that Awra started out as a child star in the television series Probinsyano.

text: Sang 2023, nalakip siya sa kinagamo sa Makati City tubtub nga gindakop sang mga pulis kag gin-release lang matapos makapiyansa.#
english: In 2023, he was involved in riots in Makati City until he was arrested by the police and released only after posting bail.#

text: Indi na bag-o ang implementation sang alert level 0 bangud sa iban nga pungsod, ginapatuman na ini.
english: The implementation of alert level 0 is not new because in other countries, it is already being implemented.

text: Ini ang nangin reaksyon sang isa ka health expert sa plano sang Department of Health (DOH) nga ipaidalom ang pila ka bahin sang pungsod sa alert level 0 bangud sang naganubo nga kaso sang COVID-19.
english: This was the reaction of a health expert to the plan of the Department of Health (DOH) to place some parts of the country under alert level 0 due to the decreasing cases of COVID-19.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Philip Ian Padilla, isa ka health expert, iya ginpahayag nga sa idalom sang alert level 0, wala na sang restriction kag indi mandatory ang pagsuksok sang face mask kag daw kaangay sa pre-COVID situation.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Philip Ian Padilla, a health expert, said that under alert level 0, there are no restrictions and the wearing of face masks is not mandatory and is similar to the pre-COVID situation.

text: Suno kay Padilla, indi na ini bag-o bangud sa iban nga pungsod, wala naman sang restrictions nga ginaptuman.
english: According to Padilla, this is not new because in other countries, there are no restrictions being implemented.

text: Indi delikado ang pagpaidalom sa alert level 0 kun insakto ang datos nga nagasulod sa database apang suno kay Padilla, kinahanglan nga tun-an anay sang maayo.
english: It is not dangerous to go under alert level 0 if the data entered into the database is correct but according to Padilla, it needs to be studied carefully.

text: Apang, kung may yara sa gihapon sang unvaccinated sa isa ka setting, mahimo sa gihapon nga mag-mutate ang virus kag malatnan ang mga nabakunahan gani importante gid nga bakunado ang tanan.
english: However, if there are still unvaccinated people in a setting, the virus can still mutate and infect the vaccinated so it is very important that everyone is vaccinated.

text: Nagdaug ang Filipina tennis star nga si Alex Eala sa first round sang US Open.
english: Filipina tennis star Alex Eala won the first round of the US Open.

text: Ginlutos niya ang World Number 15 nga si Clara Tauson sang Denmark nga may score nga 6-3, 2-6, 7-6(11).
english: She defeated World Number 15 Clara Tauson of Denmark 6-3, 2-6, 7-6(11).

text: Nagdominar si Eala sa una nga set apang nakabawi si Tauson sa ikaduha nga set.
english: Eala dominated in the first set but Tauson recovered in the second set.

text: Pagsulod sa third set, halos mapierde ang Pinay tennis sensation apang nagpangibabaw ang iya talento batuk kay Tauson.
english: Entering the third set, the Filipina tennis sensation almost lost but her talent prevailed against Tauson.

text: Samtang, magahulat si Eala kon sin-o ang iya atubangon sa ikaduha nga round sang US Open.
english: Meanwhile, Eala will wait to see who he faces in the second round of the US Open.

text: Sang tuig 2018, halos naalimunaw na ang madugay na nga handum ni John Marvin Marañon nga mangin isa ka abogado kaangay sang iya amay.
english: In 2018, John Marvin Marañon's long-standing dream of becoming a lawyer like his father almost disappeared.

text: Nakaangkon siya sang avascular necrosis, isa ka kondisyon nga rason kun ngaa nangin bedridden siya sa sulod sang isa ka tuig.
english: He developed avascular necrosis, a condition that left him bedridden for a year.

text: “New Year sadto sang 2018, while nagaselebrar ang iban, ako ya nagasininggit sa kasakit,” pahayag sini.
english: “It was New Year in 2018, while others were celebrating, I was screaming in pain,” he said.

text: Gindugang sini nga amo ini ang rason sang iya pag-untat sa law school.
english: He added that this was the reason he dropped out of law school.

text: “Bisan ang hangin… bisan ang slightest touch, nagasakit gid ang lawas ko,” pahayag pa ni John.
english: “Even the wind... even the slightest touch, my body hurts,” John said.

text: Dugang niya, duha ka tuig niya nga ginpunggan pati ang pag-ubo kag sip-on bangud tuman ka sensitibo ang iya lawas.
english: He added that he had been holding back coughing and sneezing for two years because his body was so sensitive.

text: Sa bulig sang iya iloy nga isa ka nurse, iya amay, iya pamilya, iya mga abyan, kag hugot nga pagtuo sa Ginuo, nakabalik siya sa pag-eskwela sa law school sang tion nga may pandemya — tion nga nag-shift online ang mga klase.
english: With the help of her nurse mother, her father, her family, her friends, and a strong faith in the Lord, she was able to return to law school during the pandemic — a time when classes shifted online.

text: Pagbalik sang face-to-face classes, naggamit siya sang walker kag nagtinguha gid nga makalakat kaangay sa iya classmates.
english: When face-to-face classes returned, he used a walker and tried hard to walk like his classmates.

text: Bisan ano ka budlay kag bisan sang pisikal, mental, kag emosyonal nga mga pagpanghangkat, amat-amat sini nga ginlab-ot ang iya nagpahuway nga handum.
english: No matter how hard it was and even the physical, mental, and emotional challenges, it slowly achieved its rested dream.

text: Sini nga 2024, isa siya sa nakapasar sa Bar exams.
english: This 2024, he will be one of those who passed the Bar exams.

text: “Never give up on your dreams.
english: “Never give up on your dreams.

text: Never lose hope.
english: Never give up hope.

text: No disability nor illness nor problem can hinder a determined person in his quest for excellence,” pagpakigbahin pa sang tumandok sang Leganes, Iloilo nga produkto sang Central Philippine University (CPU).
english: No disability nor illness nor problem can hinder a determined person in his quest for excellence,” shared the native of Leganes, Iloilo who is a product of Central Philippine University (CPU).

text: “Cling to the Lord because the Lord will give you the strength when all of your strength is gone,” dugang sini sa interview sa Good Morning Philippines sa Bombo Radyo Iloilo.
english: “Cling to the Lord because the Lord will give you the strength when all of your strength is gone,” he added in an interview with Good Morning Philippines on Bombo Radyo Iloilo.

text: Ginpahayag sini nga antes siya mag-practice sa iya nga propesyon, tinguhaan sini anay nga maka-recover matapos nagpaidalom sa hip replacement surgery.#
english: He said that before he practices his profession, he will try to recover after undergoing hip replacement surgery.

text: Nakaabot na sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika si President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. has arrived in the United States of America.

text: para sa duha ka adlaw nga working visit.
english: for a two-day working visit.

text: Nag-abot ang punong ehekutibo sa New York Domingo sang hapon (New York time) paagi sa chartered flight.
english: The chief executive arrived in New York Sunday afternoon (New York time) by chartered flight.

text: Domingo sang aga (oras diri sa Pilipinas) ang naghalin si Marcos diri sa pungsod.
english: Marcos left the country on Sunday morning (Philippine time).

text: Kaupod niya sa byahe sanday First Lady Liza Marcos, Foreign Affairs Secretary Maria Theresa Lazaro, Migrant Workers Secretary Hans Leo Cacdac, Presidential Peace Adviser Carlito Galvez Jr., kag Presidential Communications Secretary Dave Gomez.
english: He was accompanied on the trip by First Lady Liza Marcos, Foreign Affairs Secretary Maria Theresa Lazaro, Migrant Workers Secretary Hans Leo Cacdac, Presidential Peace Adviser Carlito Galvez Jr., and Presidential Communications Secretary Dave Gomez.

text: Lakip sa iya nga schedule samtang yara sa New York amo ang high-level engagements sa United Nations.
english: His schedule while in New York includes high-level engagements with the United Nations.

text: Ginalauman nga ipanawagan sini sa mga lideres sa Middle East kag sa tanan nga involved sa gyera nga tahuron ang international law kag ang UN Charter.
english: It is expected to call on leaders in the Middle East and all those involved in the war to respect international law and the UN Charter.

text: Ginalantaw sang Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) nga ang UN ang husto nga lugar kun sa diin makapanawagan sang kalinong ilabi na bangud masobra duha ka milyon ka mga Pilipino ang yara sa rehiyon.
english: The Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) sees the UN as the right place to call for peace especially since more than two million Filipinos are in the region.

text: Magapakigkita man mismo si Marcos kay UN Secretary-General António Guterres agud madiskusyunan ang mga development sa Middle East.
english: Marcos will also personally meet with UN Secretary-General António Guterres to discuss developments in the Middle East.

text: Suno naman kay Enrique Manalo, ang Permanent Representative sang Pilipinas sa United Nations sa New York, iplastar man sang presidente ang commitment sang Pilipinas sa pagtuman sa international law bilang paagi agud nga ma-promote ang kalinong sa kalibutan.
english: Enrique Manalo, the Permanent Representative of the Philippines to the United Nations in New York, said the president will also lay out the Philippines' commitment to comply with international law as a way to promote world peace.

text: Gin-anunsyo naman sang Malacañang nga gin-assign sanday Executive Secretary Ralph Recto, Education Secretary Sonny Angara, kag si Agrarian Reform Secretary Conrado Estrella III bilang caretakers sang gobyerno sa Pilipinas samtang yara pa sa luwas sang pungsod ang presidente.#
english: Malacañang announced that Executive Secretary Ralph Recto, Education Secretary Sonny Angara, and Agrarian Reform Secretary Conrado Estrella III have been assigned as caretakers of the Philippine government while the president is abroad.

text: SA REKLAMO sang mga pasahero sa mga waiting station kag transport hub sa siyudad sang Iloilo nga indi dayon ma-akomodar sang mga salakyan pampubliko, ang problema indi man seguro tungod kulang ang mga salakyan.
english: IN THE COMPLAINT of passengers at waiting stations and transport hubs in Iloilo City that they cannot be immediately accommodated by public transportation, the problem is probably not because of the lack of vehicles.

text: Posible nga sobra pa gani seguro ang kadamuon sang mga salakyan nga nagaserbisyo sa dalanon.
english: It is possible that there are even more vehicles serving the road.

text: Ngaa nakasiling kita sina?
english: Why can we say that?

text: Ina, sa nakita naton, tungod may mga salakyan nga wala ukon diutay lang ang pasahero nga nagasunod sa salakyan nga puno sing pasahero sa ruta nga, sa masami, madamo ang nagahulat nga pasahero.
english: That, from what we have seen, is because there are vehicles with no or few passengers following a vehicle full of passengers on a route that, more often than not, has many waiting passengers.

text: Pero posible man nga sobra lang ang mga salakyan sa sina nga ruta, kon diin ang pila sini pwede masaylo sa iban nga mga ruta nga nagakinahanglan sang dugang nga mga salakyan para sa indi na ma-akomodar nga mga pasahero, labi na gid ang mga nagasaku.
english: But it is also possible that there are simply too many vehicles on that route, where some of them can be moved to other routes that require more vehicles to accommodate passengers, especially busy ones.

text: Katulad abe sang nagahingagaw sa pagsulod sa upisina ukon eskwelahan, kag ang luyag maghingagaw makapauli sing temprano.
english: It's like being in a hurry to get into the office or school, and the one who wants to be in a hurry can go home early.

text: Ini nga problema mas makadismaya kon nagakatabo ini sa mga waiting station ukon transport hub nga tungod sa kakulang sang mga salakyan dira indi dayon makasakay ang mga pasahero, samtang sa kabug-usan, bastante man ang kadamuon nila.
english: This problem is even more frustrating when it happens at waiting stations or transport hubs where due to lack of vehicles passengers cannot board immediately, while overall, there are enough of them.

text: Agud masolbar ini kinahanglan lang seguro ang pagpatuman sang mas epektibo nga “time & motion” nga inisyatibo, kon diin ang tion sang paghalin kag pagbalik sang mga salakyan makasabat dayon sang kinahanglanon sang mga pasahero paagi sa “scheduling” kag “spacing” sang byahe nila.
english: To solve this, it is probably necessary to implement a more effective “time & motion” initiative, where the time of departure and return of vehicles can immediately meet the needs of passengers through the “scheduling” and “spacing” of their trips.

text: Bastante na seguro ang 45 ka adlaw sa pag-suspender sang bag-o nga plano sa trapiko agud matadlong ang mga depekto sang una nga “time & motion” initiative.
english: The 45 days of suspension of the new traffic plan is probably enough to correct the defects of the first “time & motion” initiative.

text: Importante man nga ma-involve diri ang mga drayber sa siyudad kag mga drayber sang mga salakyan nga nagasulod sa siyudad, kag iban pa ka mga stakeholder para sa bentaha sang kadam-an kon indi gid man sang tanan.
english: It is also important to involve city drivers and drivers of vehicles entering the city, and other stakeholders for the benefit of the majority if not all.

text: Kinahanglan man seguro ang opinyon sang pila ka mga experto sa trapiko.
english: The opinion of some traffic experts is probably also needed.

text:
***

SINING ulihi lang nagbisita sa kay Mayor Trenas ang mga ehekutibo sang Global Electric Transport, nga ginapangunahan ni anay Taguig Mayor Freddie Tinga, nga upod ang president sang MORE Electric and Power Corporation nga si Roel Castro.
english:
***

MORE Electric and Power Corporation president Roel Castro recently visited Mayor Trenas with Global Electric Transport executives, led by former Taguig Mayor Freddie Tinga.

text: Sa sini nga pagbisita sining mga ehekutibo sang GET kag MORE Power, gindayaw nila ang daku nga pag-uswag sang siyudad.
english: During this visit, these GET and MORE Power executives praised the city's tremendous progress.

text: Ginproponer man nila kay meyor ang ila plano sa pagtukod sang mga electric vehicles (EV) diri.
english: They also proposed to the mayor their plan to build electric vehicles (EV) here.

text: May natukod na nga mga 50 ka electric minibus ining GET dira sa NCR, Cebu City kag Davao City.
english: GET has already installed about 50 electric minibuses in NCR, Cebu City and Davao City.

text: Undoubtedly, indi lang makabulig ining mga EV sa problema sang kalibutan batok sa makahalalit nga Climate Change kundi makasabat man ini sa subong nga problema sang aton pungsod sa padayon karon nga pagsaka sang bili sang langis (oil) tungod sa padayon nga gyera sa tunga sang Russia kag Ukraine.
english: Undoubtedly, these EVs will not only help the world's problem against the devastating Climate Change but will also address our country's current problem of the continuous rise in the price of oil due to the ongoing war between Russia and Ukraine.

text: Labi na gid kay wala kita sing daku nga makuhaan sang langis diri sa pungsod.
english: Especially since we don't have a lot of oil in the country.

text: Kon may ara man, diutay lang kaayo.
english: If anything, very few.

text: Mga 33,000 ka bariles lang sang langis ang aton ma-producir sa kada adlaw, samtang mga 429,000 ka bariles ang aton ginagamit diri.
english: We can only produce about 33,000 barrels of oil per day, while we use about 429,000 barrels here.

text: Sa EV wala kita diri problema halin sa pagbuga sang makahalalit nga greenhouse gas (GHG) sang mga planta nga ginapadalagan sang langis kag coal.
english: With EV we have no problem here from harmful greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions of oil and coal powered plants.

text: In fact, may “zero emission” ini sang GHG.
english: In fact, it has “zero emission” of GHG.

text: Makakinot man sa gatong ining mga EV, nga ginapamatud-an sang GET sa ila gintukod nga mga minibus sa NCR, Cebu kag Davao.
english: These EVs are also fuel-efficient, which GET proves with its built minibuses in NCR, Cebu and Davao.

text: Napamatud-an man ini sang iban nga mga pungsod.
english: Other countries have also proved this.

text: Ginapangunahan ini sang Norway, nga kilala sa kadamo sang EV nga ginagamit sang ila mga pumuluyo.
english: This is led by Norway, which is known for the large number of EVs used by its citizens.

text: Mayor nila nga electricity provider ang mga hydropower plant.
english: Their main electricity provider is hydropower plants.

text: May isa na kita diri sa Iloilo nga pwede na maka-operate next year.
english: We already have one here in Iloilo that can operate next year.

text: Diri sa pungsod, may kasuguan kita diri nga Renewable Energy Act of 2008 (RA 5913) nga ginapatuman.
english: Here in the country, we have a law here called the Renewable Energy Act of 2008 (RA 5913) that is being implemented.

text: Ugaling kay mahinay kaayo ang pagpatuman sini nga nagakinahanglan na ang bulig sang private sector, katulad sang GET, agud mapasanyog ini.
english: However, its implementation is so slow that it requires the help of the private sector, such as GET, to promote it.

text: Sa pagsugod sang pagpasanyog sang EV diri sa siyudad pwede anay ang “hybrid” nga type, nga nagagamit sang gasolina kag elektrisidad (gamit ang battery) nga bulos-bulos ang paggamit ukon kon kinahanglan.
english: At the beginning of the EV promotion here in the city, the “hybrid” type can be used, which uses gasoline and electricity (using batteries) alternately or as needed.

text: Kon madamo na ang nagagamit sang EV, pwede na seguro ma-install na ang mga charging stations diri sa siyudad para sa mga long-distance ukon pabalik-balik nga pagbyahe.
english: If more people use EVs, charging stations can be installed in the city for long-distance or round trips.

text: Tani masugdan na dayon ining proyekto sa EV nga plano sang GET in partnership sa siyudad./PN
english: Hopefully this EV project planned by GET in partnership with the city will be started immediately./PN

text: Naglugdang ang isa ka pumpboat sa tunga sang Lupi Festival fluvial parade sa isa ka suba sa Lumban, Laguna kahapon sang aga.
english: A pumpboat capsized in the middle of the Lupi Festival fluvial parade in a river in Lumban, Laguna yesterday morning.

text: Suno sa Lumban Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (MDRRMO), hinali lang nga ginsulod sang tubig ang pumpboat gani nagpanik ang mga tawo kag nagtakilid ang sakayan tubtob naglugdang.
english: According to the Lumban Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (MDRRMO), water suddenly entered the pumpboat causing people to panic and the boat tilted until it sank.

text: Masiglangoy naman pakadto sa pangpang ang ginabanta 40 ka mga tawo nga sakay sini.
english: About 40 people on board were able to swim to shore.

text: Nakaluwas naman sa katalagman ang tanan nga sakay sang pumpboat.
english: All the passengers of the pumpboat were rescued.

text: Iloilo – Gina-engganyo ni Mayor Trixie Fernandex ang Philippine National Police nga mahimo magdugang sang mga babayi nga pulis bangud sa kapasidad sang mga ini.
english: ILOILO CITY – Mayor Trixie Fernandex is encouraging the Philippine National Police to increase the number of female police officers due to their capacity.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mayor Fernandez, League of Municipalities-Iloilo President, iya ginpahayag nga mas nagapangibabaw ang mga kalalakinhan nga pulis gani, nagakadapat nga hatagan sang kaangay man nga pagtratar ang mga babayi nga pulis.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Mayor Fernandez, League of Municipalities-Iloilo President, said that male police officers are more dominant and therefore, female police officers should be given the same treatment.

text: Suno kay Fernandez, napamatud-an sang mga kababainhan ang paminatasan sini bilang mapag-on kag mabinungahon.
english: According to Fernandez, the women have proven their behavior as resilient and fruitful.

text: Kaangot diri, ginpahayag dugang sang natungdan nga ang unique skillset sang mga policewomen kaangay sang advanced problem solving skill kag social skills ang tuman ka importante sa pag-atubang sang mga tawo.
english: In this regard, she added that the unique skillset of policewomen such as advanced problem solving skills and social skills are very important in dealing with people.

text: Para kay Fernandez, may kumpyansa ini kun ang mga policewomen ang nagapartisipar sa peace keeping bangud sa panigurado nga “safe” ini.
english: For Fernandez, she is confident when policewomen participate in peace keeping because of the assurance that it is safe.

text: Nahibaluan nga subong nga Marso ginaselebrar ang National Women’s month.
english: It is known that this March is celebrated as National Women's month.

text: MANILA – Makabig sa gihapon nga ‘manageable’ ang utang sang Pilipinas apisar sang COVID-19 pandemic.
english: MANILA – The Philippines' debt is still considered manageable despite the COVID-19 pandemic.

text: Suno sa Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas, naglab-ot sa P9 trillion ang national debt sa katapusan sang Hunyo kun sa diin 32% diri ang foreign debt.
english: According to the Central Bank of the Philippines, the national debt reached P9 trillion at the end of June, of which 32% is foreign debt.

text: Sang pag-umpisa sang 2020, naglab-ot sa P1.3 trillion ang utang sang Pilipinas suno sa Bureau of Treasury.
english: At the beginning of 2020, the Philippines' debt reached P1.3 trillion according to the Bureau of Treasury.

text: Apisar sini, ginpahayag ni BSP Governor Benjamin Diokno nga mahimo sa gihapon nga makapadayon sa pagbayad sang maturing foreign obligations ang Pilipinas bangud sa improved external debt nga naangkon sa sulod sang 20 ka tuig nga pagpatigayon sang critical structural reforms.
english: Despite this, BSP Governor Benjamin Diokno said the Philippines can still continue to pay maturing foreign obligations due to the improved external debt acquired during the 20 years of implementing critical structural reforms.

text: Magluwas sa maayo nga economic management, nakabulig sa ekonomiya ang reporma sa industry and foreign exchange liberalization, tax and debt management kag sa financial sector.
english: In addition to good economic management, reforms in industry and foreign exchange liberalization, tax and debt management and the financial sector have helped the economy.

text: Antes ang ginpatigayon nga quarantine, ang Pilipinas ang yara sa robust external debt position.
english: Before the quarantine, the Philippines was in a robust external debt position.

text: Maga-file sanday House Speaker Martin Romualdez sang motion for reconsideration kaangot sa nangin desisyon sang Korte Suprema nga i-deklarar nga “unconstitutional” ang impeachment complaint batok kay Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: House Speaker Martin Romualdez will file a motion for reconsideration regarding the Supreme Court's decision to declare the impeachment complaint against Vice President Sara Duterte unconstitutional.

text: Ginklaro sang House Speaker nga ginatahod niya ang desisyon sang Korte Suprema, apang nagapati siya nga may mga parte sang kaso nga dapat tun-an liwat.
english: The House Speaker made it clear that he respects the Supreme Court’s decision, but he believes there are parts of the case that need to be re-studied.

text: “We shall respect the decision of the court but we’ll also exhaust our remedies which is we’ll also be preparing a motion for reconsideration,” suno kay Romualdez.
english: “We shall respect the decision of the court but we’ll also exhaust our remedies which is we’ll also be preparing a motion for reconsideration,” according to Romualdez.

text: “We hope that there could be probably some refinements on the decision,” dugang niya.
english: “We hope that there could be probably some refinements on the decision,” he added.

text: More on this shortly.
english: More on this shortly.

text: Gin-ransack sang wala pa makilal-an nga mga persona ang isa ka puluy-an sa Barangay Tamboilan, Dumangas, Iloilo.
english: Unidentified persons ransacked a house in Barangay Tamboilan, Dumangas, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Master Sergeant John Mark Tuazon, imbestigador sang Dumangas Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga wala gid sang tawo ang balay sang ini ang ginsulod sang wala pa makilal-an nga persona, bangud ang tag-iya ang yara nagatenir sa Iloilo City.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Master Sergeant John Mark Tuazon, investigator of the Dumangas Municipal Police Station, said the house was empty when it was entered by an unidentified person, as the owner was staying in Iloilo City.

text: Suno kay Tuazon, nagpauli ang tag-iya nga makuha kuntani sang mga documents sang iya mga kabataan sang natukiban sini nga guba ang kandado sang ila pwertahan.
english: According to Tuazon, the owner returned home to get the documents of his children when he discovered that the lock of their door was broken.

text: Nagdiretso ini siya sulod kag didto nakita niya nga nagalinapta na ang mga gamit sini.
english: He went straight inside and saw that his belongings were scattered.

text: Dugang pa sang natungdan, natigayon nga nataban ang isa ka laptop, duha ka ipad, kag masobra 100,000 nga kwarta kag iban pa nga mga gamit kag alahas.
english: He added that a laptop, two ipads, and more than 100,000 pesos in cash and other items and jewelry were recovered.

text: Sa subong, padayon pa ang imbistigasyon kag may yara naman sang ginasundan nga person of interest ang mga otoridad.
english: The investigation is still ongoing and the authorities are following a person of interest.

text: Luyag ni Majority Leader Sen.
english: Majority Leader Sen.

text: Miguel Zubiri nga isa ka finance expert ang magadumala sa Philippine Health Insurance Corp.
english: Miguel Zubiri, a finance expert, will head the Philippine Health Insurance Corp.

text: (PhilHealth) kasunod sang mga alegasyon sang korapsyon nga nagakatabo sa ahensya.
english: (PhilHealth) following allegations of corruption happening in the agency.

text: Gin-rekomenda sang senador nga mangin pinuno sang PhilHealth amo si Socioeconomic Planning Secretary Karl Kendrick Chua.
english: The senator recommended Socioeconomic Planning Secretary Karl Kendrick Chua to head PhilHealth.

text: Suno kay Zubiri, wala siya sang nahibaluan nga reklamo sa trabaho ni Chua kag gindayaw man sini ang work ethics nga may yara ang finance expert.
english: Zubiri said he was not aware of any complaints about Chua’s work and also praised the work ethic that the finance expert has.

text: Nangin acting secretary sang National Economic and Development Authority (NEDA) si Chua sang Abril matapos mag-resign ang anay secretary sang ahensya nga si Ernesto Pernia.
english: Chua became acting secretary of the National Economic and Development Authority (NEDA) in April after former agency secretary Ernesto Pernia resigned.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang Presidente kag CEO sang PhilHealth nga si Ricardo Morales ang natalana nga mag medical leave sa masunod nga semana bangud sa sakit nga lymphoma.
english: PhilHealth President and CEO Ricardo Morales is scheduled to take medical leave next week due to lymphoma.

text: Tigbauan, Iloilo  – Wala pa sa gihapon sang himata nga nag-claim sa lalaki nga ginapatihan biktima sang summary execution sa Barangay Linobayan, Tigbauan Iloilo.
english: Tigbauan, Iloilo – No relative has claimed the man who is believed to be the victim of summary execution in Barangay Linobayan, Tigbauan, Iloilo.

text: Ang biktima amo si Allen Sanchez, 58, kag residente sang Zone 5, Barangay Sto.
english: The victim was identified as Allen Sanchez, 58, resident of Zone 5, Barangay Sto.

text: Niño Norte, Arevalo, Iloilo City.
english: Niño Norte, Arevalo, Iloilo City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Colonel Ronaldo Palomo, iya ginpahayag nga ginahulat nalang ang himata sang biktima antes umpisahan ang autopsy.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Colonel Ronaldo Palomo said the victim's relatives are waiting for the autopsy to begin.

text: Suno kay Palomo, wala ini nagapati nga may yara sang vigilante group sa probinsya sang Iloilo nga naangot sa pagpatay kay Sanchez.
english: Palomo said he does not believe there is a vigilante group in Iloilo province linked to Sanchez's murder.

text: Matandaan nga nasapwan ang biktima nga nakabaklid sa talamnan kag may yara sang duct tape ang bibig kag nakagapos ang kamot.
english: The victim was found lying on his back in the field with duct tape on his mouth and hands tied.

text: Nahibaluan nga nakaagi na preso si Sanchez sa Bureau of Jail Management and Penology- Iloilo District Jail Facility sa Barangay Nanga, Pototan kag sa Iloilo City District Jail sa Barangay Ungka, Jaro bangud sa kaso nga pagpangawat.
english: Sanchez has been incarcerated at the Bureau of Jail Management and Penology-Iloilo District Jail Facility in Barangay Nanga, Pototan and at the Iloilo City District Jail in Barangay Ungka, Jaro for robbery.

text: Samtang, nagapadayon ang otoridad sa pagtumod sa motibo sang krimen.
english: Meanwhile, authorities are still investigating the motive of the crime.

text: Naghimo na liwat ang South Korea sang propaganda broadcasts batok sa North Korea sa labing-una nga tion sa sulod sang anum ka tuig bilang balos sa ginhimo sang North nga pagpalupad sang mga balloon sa South nga nagaunod sang mga basura kag higko.
english: South Korea has again made propaganda broadcasts against North Korea for the first time in six years in response to the North's act of flying balloons into the South containing garbage and dirt.

text: Sang weekend, ginapahayag nga 300 gid ka North Korean balloons ang na-detect kag ginabanta 80 diri ang nakaabot gid sa teritoryo sang South kun sa diin nakit-an nga may unod nga scrap paper kag plastic sheets.
english: Over the weekend, 300 North Korean balloons were reportedly detected and about 80 of them reached Southern territory where they were found to contain scrap paper and plastic sheets.

text: Sang nagligad nga bulan, matandaan nga nagpadala man ang North sang 200 balloons nga may unod nga mga basura bilang pagtumalos man sa propaganda leaflets nga gin-alegar halin man sa south.
english: Last month, the North also sent 200 balloons containing garbage in retaliation for propaganda leaflets allegedly from the south.

text: Bangud sini, ginkumpirma sang South Korea Joint Chiefs of Staff nga nag-conduct sila sang loudspeaker broadcast kahapon sang hapon apang wala ginsapubliko kun diin nga areas ini gin-play.
english: The South Korean Joint Chiefs of Staff confirmed that they conducted a loudspeaker broadcast yesterday afternoon but did not disclose in which areas it was played.

text: Ini nga tikang ang ginalantaw nga magapasingki pa sang kaakig sang North rason nga nagpatawag na sang meeting ang defense minister sa top military commanders para preparahan ang balos sang North nga posible isa na ka direct military action.
english: The move is expected to fuel the North's anger, prompting the defense minister to call a meeting with top military commanders to prepare the North's response, which may be a direct military action.

text: Matandaan nga sang 2015, sang nagpatigayon ang South sang loudspeaker broadcasts sa labing-una nga tion sa sulod sang 11 ka tuig, nagpalupad ang North sang artillery rounds sa border rason nga nagbalos man ang South apang wala sang reported nga casualties.
english: It can be recalled that in 2015, when the South conducted loudspeaker broadcasts for the first time in 11 years, the North fired artillery rounds at the border causing the South to retaliate but no casualties were reported.

text: Ginakabig sang Pyongyang ang “loudspeaker propaganda broadcasts” bilang isa na ka akto sang gyera.
english: Pyongyang considers “loudspeaker propaganda broadcasts” an act of war.

text: Ini nga broadcasts nga amo man anay ang taktika nga gingamit sang 1950-1953 Korean War ang nagaunod sang mga balita halin mismo sa South kag North Korea kag sa luwas sang pungsod, mga impormasyon kaangot sa demokrasya kag kabuhi sa South, kag may yara pa sang popular K-pop music.
english: These broadcasts, which were the same tactic used during the 1950-1953 Korean War, contain news from South and North Korea themselves and abroad, information about democracy and life in the South, and even popular K-pop music.

text: Gina-claim sang South Korean military nga ini nga broadcasts ang mabatian bisan 10km na ang kalayuon halin sa border kun adlaw kag 24km ang kalayuon kun gab-i.
english: The South Korean military claims that these broadcasts can be heard even 10km from the border during the day and 24km away at night.

text: METRO MANILA – Nagnubo sang halos katunga ang total number sang cigarette tax stamps nga ginpaguwa sang Bureau of Internal Revenue kadungan sang ginpatuman ang lockdown sa Metro Manila kag iban pa nga bahin sang Luzon.
english: METRO MANILA – The total number of cigarette tax stamps issued by the Bureau of Internal Revenue has decreased by almost half during the implementation of the lockdown in Metro Manila and other parts of Luzon.

text: Suno sa Department of Finance, naglab-ot lamang sa 537.13 million ang cigarette tax stamps sang Marso tubtub Hunyo nga 59 percent nga mas manubo sa 1.32 billion tax stamps sang nagligad nga tuig sa kasubong nga period.
english: According to the Department of Finance, only 537.13 million cigarette tax stamps were issued in March to June, 59 percent lower than the 1.32 billion tax stamps last year in the same period.

text: Ang kantidad sang nasambit nga cigarette tax stamps ang nagnubo sa P18.88 billion gikan sa P59.46 billion.
english: The amount of the said cigarette tax stamps decreased to P18.88 billion from P59.46 billion.

text: Sang Mayo, naglab-ot lamang sa P299.89 million nga balor sang cigarette stamp taxes ang nahatag kun ipaanggid sa P17.33 billion sang 2019.
english: In May, only P299.89 million worth of cigarette stamp taxes were paid compared to P17.33 billion in 2019.

text: Sang Hunyo, naglab-ot sa P9.26 billion nga balor sang cigarette stamp ang nahatag kag mas manubo ini sa P13.03 billion nga na record sang nakaligad nga tuig.
english: In June, P9.26 billion worth of cigarette stamps were distributed, lower than the P13.03 billion recorded last year.

text: Iloilo – Ginkalipay sang Police Regional Office 6 ang nangin madinalag-on nga buy-bust operations sa Western Visayas.
english: Iloilo – The Police Regional Office 6 welcomed the successful buy-bust operations in Western Visayas.

text: Ini matapos nga nagdangat sa masobra sa P 7.2 Million ang na-recover sang kapulisan sa ginpatigayon nga special week-long simultaneous anti-criminality operations ukon “Birada Semana” umpisa sang Marso 13 tubtob 19, 2023.
english: This comes after the police recovered more than P 7.2 million during the special week-long simultaneous anti-criminality operations or “Birada Semana” from March 13 to 19, 2023.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Major Mary Grace Borio, spokesperson sang Police Regional Office 6, iya ginpahayag nga nangin dako nga bulig ang ginhatag sang Iloilo City Police Office kag Bacolod City Police Office sa pagkaaresto sang mga durugista.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Major Mary Grace Borio, spokesperson of the Police Regional Office 6, said the Iloilo City Police Office and Bacolod City Police Office have been a big help in the arrest of drug pushers.

text: Suno kay Borio, 235 ang ginpatigayon nga operasyon sang kapulisan kun sa diin 248 diri ang wanted persons.
english: According to Borio, 235 operations were conducted by the police of which 248 were wanted persons.

text: Sa numero nga ini, 43 ang Most Wanted Persons kag 205 ang wanted persons.
english: Of these, 43 are Most Wanted Persons and 205 are wanted persons.

text: Samtang, wala man ginpanginwala sang natungdan nga may yara sa gihapon sang nagakatabo nga illegal drug trade sa Western Visayas.
english: Meanwhile, he did not deny that there is still illegal drug trade in Western Visayas.

text: Para kay Borio, bangud sa nagluntad nga illegal drug trade, mas nangin seryoso ang mga kapulisan pinaagi sa padayon nga operasyon sa pagpapas sang mga durugista.
english: According to Borio, due to the illegal drug trade, the police have become more serious through continuous operations to eradicate drug pushers.

text: Binigyang linaw ng Korte Suprema na maari pang maghain ng mosyon ang kamara para maiparekunsidera ang inilabas nitong bagong resolusyon.
english: The Supreme Court clarified that the chamber can still file a motion to reconsider the new resolution.

text: Ito mismo ang inihayag ni Supreme Court Spokesperson Atty. Camille Sue Mae Ting, kasunod ng deklarasyong ‘unconstitutional’ sa ‘articles of impeachment’ laban kay Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: This was revealed by Supreme Court Spokesperson Atty. Camille Sue Mae Ting, following the declaration of 'unconstitutional' in the 'articles of impeachment' against Vice President Sara Duterte.

text: Ayon kasi sa naturang tagapagsalita, may pagkakataon ang mababang kapulungan ng kongreso na isumite sa Korte Suprema ang ‘motion for reconsideration’ hinggil sa naturang desisyon.
english: According to the spokesman, the lower house of Congress has the opportunity to submit a motion for reconsideration to the Supreme Court regarding the decision.

text: Aniya’y bagama’t ‘immediately executory’ o agaran ang pagpapatupad nito, maari pa rin itong gawin ng House of Representatives upang idulog sa korte ang kanilang panig.
english: Even if it is immediately executory, the House of Representatives can still do it to take their side to court.

text: Maalala kasi na inanunsyo ni Spokesperson Atty. Camille Ting ang pagdedeklara ng Kataastaasang Hukuman sa kinakaharap na impeachment complaint ng ikalawang pangulo na hindi naayon sa konstitusyon ng bansa.
english: I remember that Spokesperson Atty. Camille Ting the Supreme Court's declaration of the upcoming impeachment complaint of the second president as unconstitutional.

text: Kaugnay pa rito’y nakasaad sa desisyong inilabas ng Korte Suprema ang mga nakita nitong dahilan kung bakit inisyu ang naturang hatol.
english: In this regard, the decision issued by the Supreme Court states the reasons why it issued the said judgment.

text: Base sa desisyong napagbotohan ng mahistrado, ang paglabag sa ‘1 year rule’ at ‘right to due process’ ang siyang nakitang rason para maging ‘unconstitutional’ ang articles of impeachment.
english: Based on the decision voted by the judge, the violation of the '1 year rule' and 'right to due process' is the reason he saw to make the articles of impeachment 'unconstitutional'.

text: Kung saan nagkaisa ang mahistrado dito sa nagging resulta ng botohan na ‘unanimous decision’ sa bilang na 13 ang pabor, walang tutol, dalawa ang inhibit.
english: Where the magistrate here agreed in the result of the vote 'unanimous decision' in the number of 13 in favour, none against, two inhibited.

text: Kaya’t bunsod nito’y ipinaliwanag pa ni Atty. Camille Sue Mae Ting ang naging posisyon ng Korte Suprema sa nakitang paglabag sa ‘1 year ban rule’ ng paghahain ng impeachment complaint laban sa isang opisyal ng gobyerno.
english: That's why Atty. Camille Sue Mae Ting has taken the position of the Supreme Court in finding violation of the '1 year ban rule' of filing an impeachment complaint against a government official.

text: Kabilang rin sa naging basehan ng Korte Suprema sa inilabas na desisyon ay ang agarang pagpasa sa impeachment complaint ng hindi umano dumadaan sa tinatawag na due process.
english: The Supreme Court also based its decision on the immediate filing of the impeachment complaint without going through the so-called due process.

text: Kaya’t ang naturang articles of impeachment ay ibinasura at ipinawalang bisa ng Kataastaasang Hukuman sa deklarasyong ‘unconstitutional’ ang naturang reklamo laban kay Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: The Supreme Court therefore nullified the articles of impeachment and declared the complaint against Vice President Sara Duterte unconstitutional.

text: Naglunsyar sang Joint Anti-Fake News Action Committee (JAFNAC) ang Philippine National Police (PNP) sa multi-Purpose Hall sa Camp Crame – Quezon City, Metro Manila agud atubangon ang padayon nga paglapta sang misinformation kag disinformation sa pungsod.
english: The Philippine National Police (PNP) launched the Joint Anti-Fake News Action Committee (JAFNAC) at the multi-Purpose Hall in Camp Crame – Quezon City, Metro Manila to address the continuous spread of misinformation and disinformation in the country.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police General Rommel Francisco Marbil, Chief sang Philippine National Police, iya ginpahayag nga gintukod ang Joint Anti-Fake News Action Committee nga kabahin sang inter-agency approach nga ginatuyo ang pagtapna sang mga nagalapta nga fake news ilabi na gid sa social media platforms.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police General Rommel Francisco Marbil, Chief of the Philippine National Police, said the Joint Anti-Fake News Action Committee was established as part of an inter-agency approach aimed at curbing the spread of fake news especially on social media platforms.

text: Suno kay Marbil, target sang Joint Anti-Fake News Action Committee nga pasabton ang mga nagapalapta sang fake news kag maghimo sang sistema agud madali nga ma-takedown ang mga impormasyon sa social media kag iban pa nga online platforms.
english: Marbil said the Joint Anti-Fake News Action Committee aims to hold those who spread fake news accountable and develop a system to easily takedown information on social media and other online platforms.

text: Ang nasambit nga lihok ang gintambungan sang mga vital officials nga nagikan sa nagkalain-lain nga ahensya, kaangay sang Philippine Coast Guard (PCG), Department of Interior and Local Government (DILG), kag Presidential Communications Office (PCO).
english: The event was attended by vital officials from various agencies, such as the Philippine Coast Guard (PCG), Department of Interior and Local Government (DILG), and Presidential Communications Office (PCO).

text: Plano man sang PNP nga magpatukod sang national monitoring system gamit ang AI-powered dashboard para sa real-time detection sang mga trend sang disinformation.
english: The PNP also plans to establish a national monitoring system using an AI-powered dashboard for real-time detection of disinformation trends.

text: Naluwas sang Israeli military ang apat ka buhi pa nga Israeli hostages nga nangin bihag sang Hamas sa Gaza sa sulod na sang walo ka bulan.
english: The Israeli military has rescued four surviving Israeli hostages who have been held captive by Hamas in Gaza for eight months.

text: Ginpangalanan sang militar ang mga na-rescue nga amo sanday Noa Argamani, 26, Almog Meir Jan, 22, Andrey Kozlov, 27, kag Shlomi Ziv, 41.
english: The military named those rescued as Noa Argamani, 26, Almog Meir Jan, 22, Andrey Kozlov, 27, and Shlomi Ziv, 41.

text: “They are in good medical condition and have been transferred to the ‘Sheba’ Tel-HaShomer Medical Center for further medical examinations,” suno sa Israel Defense Forces (IDF).
english: “They are in good medical condition and have been transferred to the ‘Sheba’ Tel-HaShomer Medical Center for further medical examinations,” according to the Israel Defense Forces (IDF).

text: Suno sa army, lakip ang apat sa gin-kidnap sang Hamas militans sa Nova music festival sang Oktubre 7 nga amo ang adlaw nga ginkibot sang Hamas militants ang southern Israel kag nagpangpatay sang mga residente.
english: The army said the four were among those kidnapped by Hamas militants at the Nova music festival on October 7, the day Hamas militants surprised southern Israel and killed residents.

text: Suno kay Israeli army spokesman Rear Admiral Daniel Hagari, isa ka complex daytime operation ang ila ginhimo sa duha ka separado nga buildings sa Gaza agud lamang maluwas ang mga bihag.
english: According to Israeli army spokesman Rear Admiral Daniel Hagari, they conducted a complex daytime operation in two separate buildings in Gaza just to rescue the hostages.

text: Isa man ka soldado ang nasamaran bangud sa operasyon, apang klaro suno sa militar ang ila mensahe nga determinado sila nga ubuson-hilway ang mga bihag nga ginauyatan pa sang militante nga grupo.
english: One soldier was also wounded in the operation, but the military said their message is clear that they are determined to free all the hostages still held by the militant group.

text: Samtang, gin-report naman sang government media office sa Gaza nga 210 ka tawo ang napatay kag masobra 400 ang nasamaran bangud sa operasyon sang Israel agud maluwas ang mga bihag.
english: Meanwhile, the government media office in Gaza reported that 210 people were killed and more than 400 wounded in the Israeli operation to rescue the hostages.

text: Ginpahayag nga ini nga casualties ang gindala sa duha ka mga ospital sa Gaza nga amo ang Al-Awda Hospital sa Nuseirat kag Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital sa Deir Al-Balah.
english: These casualties were reportedly taken to two hospitals in Gaza, namely Al-Awda Hospital in Nuseirat and Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital in Deir Al-Balah.

text: Ini nga operasyon ang ginpatigayon sa ikawalo na nga bulan sang gyera sang Israel batok sa Palestinian Hamas militants sa Gaza.
english: The operation comes in the eighth month of Israel's war against Palestinian Hamas militants in Gaza.

text: Isa ini ka pagtimalos sa pag-atake sang Hamas sang Oktubre 7, 2023 kun sa diin 1,194 ang napatay kag gindala pa sang militante ang 251 hostages kun sa diin ang yara pa sa Gaza kag 41 ang kumpirmado na nga nagkalamatay.
english: This is in retaliation for the Hamas attack on October 7, 2023 in which 1,194 people were killed and the militants took 251 hostages, some of whom are still in Gaza and 41 have been confirmed dead.

text: Sa pagtimalos naman sang Israel paagi sa ground offensive sa Gaza, yara na sa 36,801 ka Palestinians ang nagkalamatay.#
english: In Israel's retaliation with a ground offensive in Gaza, 36,801 Palestinians have been killed.

text: Ginpakamalaot ni Cardinal Pablo Virgilio David sang Kalookan ang grabe nga kurapsyon sa gobyerno nga ginasiling niya amo ang kabangdanan sang malala nga pagbaha nga ginatubang sang Pilipinas subong.
english: Cardinal Pablo Virgilio David of Kalookan has condemned the rampant corruption in the government that he says is the cause of the severe flooding that the Philippines is facing today.

text: Sa iya pahayag, ginbuyagyag sang anay presidente sang Catholic Bishops’ Conference of the Philippines (CBCP) nga dapat tan-awon ang kaangtanan sang kurapsyon sa mga proyekto nga ginapatuman sang gobyerno.
english: In his statement, the former president of the Catholic Bishops’ Conference of the Philippines (CBCP) revealed that the link between corruption and projects implemented by the government should be looked into.

text: Ginpabutyag niya nga ang mga kapalpakan sa pagpahamtang sang mga proyekto nga may kaangtanan sa drainage kag flood control ang nagadugang sa paglala sang pagbaha.
english: He expressed that failures in the implementation of projects related to drainage and flood control are adding to the worsening of flooding.

text: “Ang dapat basulon sa grabe nga pagbaha nga aton ginatubang amo ang nagpanghinitabo nga kurapsyon sa aton gobyerno,” suno kay Cardinal David.
english: “The blame for the severe flooding we are facing is the corruption in our government,” Cardinal David said.

text:
“Dapat tan-awon sang maayo kun paano gin-gamit ang pondo kag proyekto base sa report sang Commission on Audit.”

Ginpunto man sang Cardinal nga nabahaan man ang pila ka mga simbahan sa mga lugar sang Malabon kag Navotas, kabahin sang mga lugar nga masami maiguan sang pagbaha.
english:
“We should look closely at how the funds and projects were used based on the report of the Commission on Audit.”

The Cardinal also pointed out that some churches in the areas of Malabon and Navotas, part of the areas that are often affected by flooding, were also flooded.

text: Naghina na ang Bagyo Emong samtang nagapadayon ini sa paghulag sa katubigan sang Extreme Northern Luzon.
english: Typhoon Emong has weakened as it continues to move through the waters of Extreme Northern Luzon.

text: Isa na lamang ini ka tropical depression base sa pinakaulihi nga update sang PAGASA.
english: It is now a tropical depression based on the latest PAGASA update.

text: Ulihi nga nakita ang sentro sang bagyo sa kalayuon nga 500km sa Northeast sang Itbayat, Batanes.
english: The center of the typhoon was last seen 500km Northeast of Itbayat, Batanes.

text:
May dala ini nga kabaskugon sang hangin nga nagalab-ot sa 55km/h malapit sa sentro kag may pagbugso nga nagaabot sa 70km/h.

Nagapadayon sa iya nga direksyon nga North-Northeast ang bagyo sa kasarangan nga kadasigon nga 45km/h.

Samtang wala sang direktang epekto ang Bagyo Emong sa kadam-an nga parte sang Pilipinas, ang southwest monsoon ukon habagat ang magapadayon nga magahatag sang mga pag-ulan sa Luzon kag sa western nga bahin sang Visayas.
english:
It brought winds of up to 55km/h near the center and gusts of up to 70km/h.

The typhoon continues in its North-Northeast direction with moderate winds of 45km/h.

While Typhoon Emong has no direct impact on most parts of the Philippines, the southwest monsoon will continue to bring rains to Luzon and the western part of the Visayas.

text: Ginalauman nga magapadayon ini sa masunod nga mga adlaw, gani ginapahanumdom ang publiko nga maghalong kag mag-monitor sang mga anunsyo halin sa mga lokal nga otoridad kag PAGASA.
english: This is expected to continue in the coming days, so the public is reminded to be vigilant and monitor announcements from local authorities and PAGASA.

text: Nagasaylo-saylo lang sang banwa ang isa ka babayi nga ginbansagan sang Iloilo City Police Office nga “ATM Queen” kag ulihi nga nakapang-biktima sa isa ka mall sa Molo, Iloilo City.
english: A woman who was dubbed the “ATM Queen” by the Iloilo City Police Office was just moving around the town and later became a victim in a mall in Molo, Iloilo City.

text: Ang identified nga suspek amo si Lunalyn De Pedro, 40, nga ang ulihi na-tumod nga address amo ang Brgy.
english: The identified suspect was identified as Lunalyn De Pedro, 40, whose last known address was Brgy.

text: Gustilo, Lapaz, Iloilo City.
english: Gustilo, Lapaz, Iloilo City.

text: Sa latest report sang ICPO, ginpahayag nga ang pinakaulihi nga reported nga biktima ni De Pedro amo ang 62-anyos nga tigulang nga babayi nga nag-withdraw sa Automated Teller Machine (ATM) sa GT Mall sa Molo sang nagligad nga Pebrero 25.
english: According to the latest report of the ICPO, the latest reported victim of De Pedro is a 62-year-old woman who withdrew from an Automated Teller Machine (ATM) at GT Mall in Molo on February 25.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Major Shella Mae Sangrines, spokesperson sang ICPO, iya ginpahayag nga nagpakuno-kuno pa ang suspek nga isa ka maayo nga tawo nga makabulig sa tigulang tubtub nga nataban sini ang P130,000.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Major Shella Mae Sangrines, spokesperson of the ICPO, said the suspect pretended to be a good man who could help the elderly until he stole the P130,000.

text: Sandig sa police records, may 13 na ka kaso si De Pedro nga Theft, Malicious Mischief, Swindling (Estafa) kag paglapas sa Access Device Regulation Act of 1998 ukon Credit Card Violation Act.
english: According to police records, De Pedro has 13 cases of Theft, Malicious Mischief, Swindling (Estafa) and violation of the Access Device Regulation Act of 1998 or Credit Card Violation Act.

text: Nakomiter ini nga mga krimen sa syudad sang Iloilo, sa Sara, Iloilo, Bacolod City, kag sa Lipa City, Batangas.
english: These crimes were committed in Iloilo City, Sara, Iloilo, Bacolod City, and Lipa City, Batangas.

text: Ginpahayag ni Sangrines nga indi na bag-uhan sa presuhan ang suspek apang naka-guwa bangud sa pyansa.
english: Sangrines said the suspect is not new to jail but was released on bail.

text: Ginpaguwa sang pulis ang picture sang suspek kag gin-abisuhan ang publiko nga i-report sa otoridad kun makit-an agud gilayon nga maaresto.
english: Police released a picture of the suspect and advised the public to report any sightings to the authorities for immediate arrest.

text: Magapain ang Iloilo Provincial Government sang indi magnubo sa P1.5 million kada tuig para sa Provincial Ordinance No.
english: The Iloilo Provincial Government will allocate at least P1.5 million per year for Provincial Ordinance No.

text:
2025-338 ukon “An Ordinance Establishing the Search for the Most Outstanding City/Municipal Police Stations in the Province of Iloilo.”

Ang pondo ang magahalin sa Peace and Order Program sang Office of the Governor.
english:
2025-338 or “An Ordinance Establishing the Search for the Most Outstanding City/Municipal Police Stations in the Province of Iloilo.”

The funding will come from the Peace and Order Program of the Office of the Governor.

text: Katuyuan sang nasambit nga ordinansa amo nga makilala ang high-performing police stations kag mapasangkad pa ang ka-epektibo sang local law enforcement.
english: The purpose of the said ordinance is to identify high-performing police stations and further enhance the effectiveness of local law enforcement.

text: Si Iloilo 2nd District Board Member June Mondejar amo ang author sang ordinansa.
english: Iloilo 2nd District Board Member June Mondejar is the author of the ordinance.

text: Sakop sang Provincial Ordinance No.
english: Under Provincial Ordinance No.

text: 2025-338 ang tanan nga police stations sa component city kag kabanwahanan sa probinsya.
english: 2025-338 all police stations in component cities and towns in the province.

text: I-assess ang performance sa tanan nga areas sa crime prevention, functionality, coordination, kag innovation sa public safety operations.
english: Assess performance in all areas in crime prevention, functionality, coordination, and innovation in public safety operations.

text: Sa idalom sang programa, ang winners ang magabaton sang substantial support: P250,000 para sa champions, P200,000 para sa first runners-up, kag P150,000 para sa second runners-up sa Category A (city and 1st class municipalities) kag Category B (2nd to 4th class municipalities).
english: Under the program, the winners will receive substantial support: P250,000 for champions, P200,000 for first runners-up, and P150,000 for second runners-up in Category A (city and 1st class municipalities) and Category B (2nd to 4th class municipalities).

text: Ang pondo ang gamiton sa pagpatuman sang mga programa nga nalakip sa City/Municipal Public Order and Safety kag Anti-Drug Abuse Council.
english: The funds will be used to implement programs included in the City/Municipal Public Order and Safety and Anti-Drug Abuse Council.

text: (Article: Bombo Lynd-C Bade)
english: (Article: Bombo Lynd-C Bade)

text: Gindugang sang United Nations ang Israel sa “blacklist” sang mga pungsod nga nagahimo sang pagpang-abuso kag pagpanghalit sa mga kabataan kaangay sa gyera sa Gaza.
english: The United Nations has added Israel to the “blacklist” of countries that commit abuses and harm to children similar to the war in Gaza.

text: Suno kay Israeli Ambassador to the UN Gilad Erdan, nabaton na sini ang official notification kaangot sa nangin desisyon ni UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres.
english: Israeli Ambassador to the UN Gilad Erdan said he has received the official notification regarding the decision of UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres.

text: “I responded to the shameful decision and said that our army is the most moral in the world.
english: “I responded to the shameful decision and said that our army is the most moral in the world.

text: The only one being blacklisted is the Secretary-General who incentivizes and encourages terrorism and is motivated by hatred towards Israel,” statement ni Erdan.
english: The only one being blacklisted is the Secretary-General who incentivizes and encourages terrorism and is motivated by hatred towards Israel,” statement by Erdan.

text: Kaupod sang Israel sa sini nga lista amo ang Russia, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Somalia, Syria kag Haiti.
english: Along with Israel on this list are Russia, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Somalia, Syria and Haiti.

text: Mahimo nga maggamit sang iban nga mga nasyon ini nga blacklist bilang signal nga limitahan ukon dumilian na ang pagbaligya sang armas sa mga pungsod nga naga-komiter sini nga pagpang-abuso kag pagpanghalit sa kabataan.
english: Other countries may use this blacklist as a signal to limit or ban arms sales to countries that commit this abuse and harm to children.

text: Gin-abi-abi naman sang Palestine ini nga desisyon sang United Nations apang ginsiling nga tuman na ka atrasado ang desisyon bangud klaro nga nagakatabo na ang genocide sa sulod sang binulan na nga gyera.
english: Palestine welcomed the UN decision but said it was too late because genocide was clearly taking place during the months-long war.
