text: Halin sang ginsuguran ang gyera sa Gaza sang Oktubre 2023, masobra na sa 36,700 Palestinians ang napatay bangud sa pagpang-atake sang Israel bilang balos sa Hamas militants, kag lakip diri nga numero ang 15,571 ka kabataan sandig sa data sang Gaza government media office.
english: Since the start of the war in Gaza in October 2023, more than 36,700 Palestinians have been killed by Israeli retaliatory attacks on Hamas militants, and that number includes 15,571 children according to data from the Gaza government media office.

text: Photo: JEHAD ALSHRAFI (ANADOLU VIA GETTY IMAGES)
english: Photo: JEHAD ALSHRAFI (ANADOLU VIA GETTY IMAGES)

text: Kumpirmado nga yara na sa Singapore si acting Davao City Mayor Sebastian Baste Duterte.
english: Acting Davao City Mayor Sebastian Baste Duterte is confirmed to be in Singapore.

text: Suno sa National Bureau of Investigation, nakabaton sila sang impormasyon gikan sa koordinasyon ng Immigration nga nagbiya pagwa sang pungsod si Baste kahapon sang aga kaupod ang iya pamilya kag staff.
english: According to the National Bureau of Investigation, they received information from the Immigration coordination that Baste left the country yesterday morning with his family and staff.

text: Indi pa maathag kun ano ang tuyo sini sa Singapore.
english: It is not clear what it intends to do in Singapore.

text: Kadungan ini sang ginalauman kuntani nga charity boxing match batok kay Philippine National Police (PNP) Chief General Nicolas Torre III.
english: This coincides with the expected charity boxing match against Philippine National Police (PNP) Chief General Nicolas Torre III.

text: Nagsugod ini sang nanghangkat si Baste sang tapungulay, apang sang nagsabat na si Torre nga maatubangay sila sa boxing match, nagplastar ang anak nga Duterte sang iya nga mga kondisyon kun sa diin nalakip nga dapat i-mando ni President Bongbong Marcos sa tanan nga elected officials nga magpaidalom sa drug test.
english: It started when Baste challenged him to a fight, but when Torre replied that they would face each other in a boxing match, Duterte's son laid out his conditions, including that President Bongbong Marcos should order all elected officials to undergo drug tests.

text: Natalana kuntani nga patigayunon ang ila pag-atubangay buwas, Hulyo 27 sa Rizal Memorial Coliseum sa Manila kun sa diin may na-set up na nga boxing ring.
english: The fight was scheduled to take place tomorrow, July 27 at the Rizal Memorial Coliseum in Manila where a boxing ring has already been set up.

text: Una na nagpahayag si Torre nga kun indi man magsipot si Baste sa ila boxing match, magapanagtag na lang ini sang ayuda sa mga Pilipino nga apektado sang bagyo kag baha.
english: Earlier, Torre said that if Baste does not attend their boxing match, he will distribute aid to Filipinos affected by the typhoon and floods.

text: Determinado ang pulis kag militar nga indi makalusot ang iban pa nga mga suspek nga nagpatay kay Negros Oriental Governor Roel Degamo.
english: The police and military are determined that the other suspects who killed Negros Oriental Governor Roel Degamo will not escape.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag sang kapulisan nga ginapatihan masobra 10 ka tawo ang naghimbon sa pagpatay sa gobernador.
english: Earlier, police said more than 10 people are believed to have conspired to kill the governor.

text: Sa sini nga mga suspek, apat pa lang ang naaresto.
english: Of these suspects, only four have been arrested.

text: Suno kay PNP Spokesperson Pol.
english: According to PNP Spokesperson Pol.

text: Col.
english: Col.

text: Jean Fajardo, nagapati ang Special Joint Task Force-Negros nga yara pa mismo sa Negros Oriental ang perpetrators, apang indi limitado diri ang operasyon sang pulis kag militar.
english: Jean Fajardo, the Special Joint Task Force-Negros believes that the perpetrators are still in Negros Oriental, but the operation of the police and military is not limited here.

text: Ginabantayan na subong mangin ang kaiping nga mga lugar.
english: Neighboring areas are now being monitored.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag ni BGen.
english: Earlier, BGen.

text: Marion Sison, commander sang 3rd Infantry Division kag head sang Special Joint Task Force Negros, nga lagson sang otoridad ang tanan nga private armed groups nga posible konektado sa krimen.
english: Marion Sison, commander of the 3rd Infantry Division and head of the Special Joint Task Force Negros, said the authorities will pursue all private armed groups that may be connected to the crime.

text: Masobra 600,000 nga mga trabaho ang itanyag sa online job fair nga pangunahan sang Civil Service Commission sa Setyembre 14 tubtob 18.
english: More than 600,000 jobs will be offered at the online job fair to be led by the Civil Service Commission on September 14 to 18.

text: Suno kay CSC Commissioner Aileen Lizada, wala sang baydan ang mga ahensya nga luyag mag upod sa job fair amo man sa mga tawo nga nagapangita sang trabaho.
english: According to CSC Commissioner Aileen Lizada, there is no charge for agencies who wish to participate in the job fair as well as for people looking for work.

text: Pahayag niya, apisar nga yara lang sa sulod sang balay kag wala sang civil service eligibility ang mahimo gid nga maka-apply.
english: He said that even those who are indoors and do not have civil service eligibility can apply.

text: Nahibaluan nga base sa data sang Philippine Statistics Authority sang Hunyo, nagdangat na sa 7.3 million nga mga Pilipino ang nadulaan sang trabaho bangud sa pandemya.
english: Based on data from the Philippine Statistics Authority in June, 7.3 million Filipinos have lost their jobs due to the pandemic.

text: Ginpatay ang babaye nga alkalde sa isa ka banwa sa Mexico pila ka oras lamang matapos ang selebrasyon bangud sa pag-eleher sa labing-una nga babaye nga presidente sa maragtas sang pungsod.
english: The female mayor of a Mexican town was killed just hours after celebrations for the election of the first female president in the country's history.

text: Ang biktima amo si Cotija Mayor Yolanda Sánchez nga gintiro mismo sa amo nga banwa nga iya ginapamunuan halin sang Septyembre 2021.
english: The victim was Cotija Mayor Yolanda Sánchez who was shot dead in the town she has been leading since September 2021.

text: Siya man ang labing-una nga babaye nga gin-eleher sa amo nga pwesto.
english: She was also the first woman to be elected to the post.

text: Ginpahayag nga 19 ka beses ini nga gintiro kag napatay sa ospital kaupod sa iya bodyguard kasunod sa pagpang-atake.
english: He was reportedly shot 19 times and died in hospital along with his bodyguard following the attack.

text: Wala pa sang naaresto nga suspek apang ginapatihan nga ang gunmen ang kabahin sang organized crime group.
english: No suspect has been arrested but the gunmen are believed to be part of an organized crime group.

text: Ginpahayag nga nakabaton na ini sang death threats halin sang nagpungko bilang mayor sang 2021 kag nahimo man nga hostage sang armado nga kalalakinhan sang 2023 sa sulod sang tatlo ka adlaw.
english: He has reportedly received death threats since taking office as mayor in 2021 and was also held hostage by armed men in 2023 for three days.

text: Nahibaluan nga halin sang Septyembre sang nagligad nga tuig, masobra na sa 20 ka mga kandidato ang ginpangpatay sa Mexico suno sa official figures, apang ginpahayag nga halos 40 na ini kun basehan naman ang independent surveys.
english: Since September last year, more than 20 candidates have been killed in Mexico according to official figures, but it is said that it is almost 40 based on independent surveys.

text: Ang presidential race sang nagligad nga adlaw ang ginpangunahan ni Claudia Sheinbaum nga magapanumpa sa Oktubre 1 subong nga tuig.
english: The presidential race the other day was led by Claudia Sheinbaum who will be sworn in on October 1 this year.

text: Kampante ang economic team sang Duterte Administration nga malampuwasan sang Pilipinas ang health kag economic crisis tuga sang Coronavirus Disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic.
english: The economic team of the Duterte Administration is confident that the Philippines will overcome the health and economic crisis caused by the Coronavirus Disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic.

text: Suno kay Department of Finance Secretary Carlos Dominguez III kag pinuno sang economic team, ginahimo sang gobyerno ang tanan agud mabalik ang ekonomiya sang pungsod.
english: According to Department of Finance Secretary Carlos Dominguez III and head of the economic team, the government is doing everything to revive the country's economy.

text: Pahayag niya, indi manigar nga ang ekonomiya sa subong ang yara sa “bad spot” apang positibo sila nga mas magasangkad pa ang ekonomiya ipaanggid sadto.
english: He said there is no denying that the economy is currently in a “bad spot” but they are positive that the economy will expand more than before.

text: Nagalaom naman ang Development Budget Coordination Committee nga ang ekonomiya sang Pilipinas subong nga tuig ang magataas sa 2 tubtob 3.4 percent apang 7.1 tubtob 8.1 percent naman nga GDP growth sa tuig 2021.
english: The Development Budget Coordination Committee expects the Philippine economy to grow by 2 to 3.4 percent this year but 7.1 to 8.1 percent GDP growth in 2021.

text: Ginkalipay si Senador Ronald “Bato” Dela Rosa sa desisyon sang Korte Suprema (SC) nga ideklarar nga “unconstitutional” ang impeachment complaint batuk kay Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: Senator Ronald “Bato” Dela Rosa welcomed the decision of the Supreme Court (SC) to declare the impeachment complaint against Vice President Sara Duterte “unconstitutional”.

text: “Sang gin-declare ini sang SC nga Unconstitutional, sigurado ako nga gintuytuyan man sila sang Balaan nga Espiritu,” siling ni Dela Rosa sa isa ka post sa Facebook.
english: “When the SC declared it Unconstitutional, I am sure they were also guided by the Holy Spirit,” Dela Rosa said in a Facebook post.

text: “Ginpyerde sang Espiritu Santo ang mga kusog sang kalautan!
english: “The Holy Spirit has defeated the forces of evil!

text: Aleluya!” dugang niya.
english: Hallelujah!” he added.

text: Suno sa SC, ginadumilian sang isa ka tuig nga pagsulundan ang reklamo sa House impeachment batuk kay Duterte.
english: According to the SC, the one-year rule prohibits complaints in the House impeachment against Duterte.

text: By: Bombo Ray Badiang
english: By: Bombo Ray Badiang

text: Na-deliver na ang 417 ka mga Automated Counting Machine (ACM) nga gamiton para sa Iloilo City sa palaabuton nga May 12, 2025 midterm elections.
english: A total of 417 Automated Counting Machines (ACM) have been delivered to be used for Iloilo City in the upcoming May 12, 2025 midterm elections.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mr. Jonathan Sayno, Election Assistant II sang Iloilo City Commission on Elections (COMELEC), iya ginpahayag nga yara na subong nakapahamtang sa ila talatapan ang nasambit nga mga machine.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Mr. Jonathan Sayno, Election Assistant II of the Iloilo City Commission on Elections (COMELEC), said the machines are now installed in their office.

text: Suno kay Sayno, i-distribute ang ACM sa Mayo 6 sa tagsa ka voting centers sa syudad kag ipaidalom ini sa final testing and sealing sa Mayo 7, 2025.
english: Sayno said the ACM will be distributed on May 6 to each voting center in the city and will undergo final testing and sealing on May 7, 2025.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga kasunod sang amo nga tikang kag wala na sang may makit-an nga depekto, mahimo na ini i-preparar para sa May 12 midterm elecions.
english: He also said that following the move and no defects are found, it can be prepared for the May 12 midterm elections.

text: Pa-utangon sang Japan ang Pilipinas sang loan package balor 50 billion yen ukon P23.54 billion agud mabuligan ang emergency measures sa pagpakig-away batuk sa pandemya.
english: Japan will lend the Philippines a loan package worth 50 billion yen or P23.54 billion to support emergency measures in the fight against the pandemic.

text: Ang loan ang maga-suporta sa social protection, relief kag economic recovery stimulus measures sang Pilipinas.
english: The loan will support the Philippines' social protection, relief and economic recovery stimulus measures.

text: Suno kay Japanese Ambassador to the Philippines Koji Haneda, ang mabaskog nga relasyon sang Japan kag Pilipinas ilabi na sa bahin sang ekonomiya ang napamatud-an na sa madugay nga tion.
english: According to Japanese Ambassador to the Philippines Koji Haneda, the strong relations between Japan and the Philippines especially in the economic field have been proven for a long time.

text: As of May 2020, may yara na sang $4.55 billion ukon kapin P226 billion nga utang ang Pilipinas sa nagkalain-lain nga mga financial institutions
english: As of May 2020, the Philippines has $4.55 billion or more than P226 billion in debt to various financial institutions

text: Gintuad ni Iloilo 2nd District Board Member June Mondejar nga ‘satisfied’ siya sa nangin performance ni Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO) Director Bayani Razalan antes pa man ini na-relieve sa pwesto.
english: Iloilo 2nd District Board Member June Mondejar admitted that she was 'satisfied' with the performance of Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO) Director Bayani Razalan before he was relieved of his post.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Board Member Mondejar, iya ginpahayag nga bisan siya ang nakibot sa pag-relieve sa nasambit nga opisyal sang IPPO.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Board Member Mondejar said that even he was surprised by the relief of the said IPPO official.

text: Suno kay Mondejar, dako ang nangin kontribusyon ni Razalan sa paghimo sang mga ordinansa para sa probinsya sa patag sang peace and order.
english: According to Mondejar, Razalan has made a great contribution in making ordinances for the province in the field of peace and order.

text: Indi paman sini mahambal ang rason sa likod sang relief ni Razalan apang wala sini gindula nga mahimo bangud sa pulitika ang nangin basehan sang Philippine National Police (PNP).
english: He could not say the reason behind Razalan's relief but did not rule out the possibility that politics was the basis of the Philippine National Police (PNP).

text: Nagalaum man si Mondejar nga mapahibalo si Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor Jr.
english: Mondejar also hopes to inform Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor Jr.

text: sa rason sang pag-relieve kay IPPO Director Bayani Razalan.
english: on the grounds of relief of IPPO Director Bayani Razalan.

text: Iloilo – Gindayaw ni Police Regional Office 6 director Police Brigadier General Leo Francisco ang mga policewomen sang Western Visayas bangud sa talalupangdon nga mga performance sang mga ini.
english: Iloilo – Police Regional Office 6 director Police Brigadier General Leo Francisco praised the policewomen of Western Visayas for their outstanding performances.

text: Ini matapos nakit-an ni Francisco ang ikasarang sang mga policewomen nga mabatasan ang tagiti sang init kun ipaangid sa mga kalalakinhan nga mga pulis.
english: This is after Francisco observed the ability of policewomen to withstand the heat compared to male policemen.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Francisco, iya ginpahayag nga mas mabakod ang kababainhan nga pulis kun ipaangid sa mga kalalakinhan nga nagakalipong sa mga programa.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Francisco said women police officers are stronger than men who are dizzy in programs.

text: Suno kay Francisco, pinasahi ang ginapakita nga karisma sang mga policewomen bangud sa kapasidad sang mga ini nga ipabilin ang katawhay kag kalinong sa mga dalanon sa tion nga nagapatrolya ang mga ini.
english: According to Francisco, the charisma of the policewomen is unique because of their capacity to maintain peace and order on the streets while they are on patrol.

text: Samtang, ginpahayag sang natungdan nga ginaapresyar sini ang tanan ka mga kababainhan bangud sa kaisog sang mga ini.
english: Meanwhile, she said she appreciates all the women for their courage.

text: Preparado na si Olympic pole vaulter EJ Obiena sa iya nga pagpasakop sa Japan para sa isa ka tournament.
english: Olympic pole vaulter EJ Obiena is ready to join Japan for a tournament.

text: Magapasakop si Obiena sa qualifying round sa maabot nga Septyembre 13 kag sa Septyembre 15 naman para sa finals sa Tokyo.
english: Obiena will participate in the qualifying round on September 13 and the finals in Tokyo on September 15.

text: Ini kasunod sa hiwaton nga World Athletics Championship sa amo nga pungsod.
english: This follows the World Athletics Championship to be held in the country.

text: Sa madumduman sadtong 2023, nakuha sini ang silver medal sa nasambit nga tournament paagi sa 6.00 meters clearance.
english: In 2023, he won the silver medal in the tournament with a 6.00 meters clearance.

text: Lauman ang senintimos nga pagnubo sa presyo sang diesel kag kerosene sa masunod nga semana.
english: Diesel and kerosene prices are expected to drop by a penny next week.

text:
Sandig sa international fuel trading sa nagligad nga apat ka adlaw, yari ang posible nga adjustment suno sa Department of Energy-Oil Industry Management Bureau:

Diesel – posible nga rollback nga P0.45 per literKerosene – posible nga rollback nga P0.25 per liter

Posible naman magsaka sang P0.70 kada litro ang presyo sang gasolina.
english:
Based on international fuel trading over the past four days, here are the possible adjustments according to the Department of Energy-Oil Industry Management Bureau:

Diesel – possible rollback of P0.45 per literKerosene – possible rollback of P0.25 per liter

The price of gasoline is likely to rise by P0.70 per litre.

text: Suno sa DOE, wala pa nalakip sa expected amount sang adjustments ang operating cost sang oil companies kag iban pa nga premiums.
english: According to the DOE, the expected amount of adjustments does not include the operating cost of oil companies and other premiums.

text: Lakip sa ginhinambit nga mga factor nga maangot sa estimated adjustments amo ang nagakatabo sa nagkalain-lain nga bahin sang kalibutan nga makabig geopolitical concerns.
english: Among the factors mentioned that are related to the estimated adjustments are what is happening in different parts of the world that are considered geopolitical concerns.

text: Halimbawa diri amo ang pag-atake sang Ukraine sa oil infrastructure sang Russia, ang pagsaka sang tension sa tunga sang Estados Unidos kag Venezuela, kag ang global crude oil supply surplus.
english: Examples of this include Ukraine’s attack on Russia’s oil infrastructure, rising tensions between the United States and Venezuela, and the global crude oil supply surplus.

text: Mahimo madeterminar ang final adjustments pagkatapos sang Mean of Platts Singapore trading subong nga Byernes.
english: Final adjustments can be determined after Mean of Platts Singapore trading this Friday.

text: Gina-anunsyo sang fuel companies ang opisyal nga price adjustments kada Lunes, kag gina-implementar naman sa kada Martes sang aga.
english: Fuel companies announce official price adjustments every Monday, and implement them every Tuesday morning.

text: Sang nagligad nga Disyembre 2, P2.90 ang gin-nubo sa diesel samtang P3.20 naman ang rollback sa kerosene.#
english: Last December 2, diesel was reduced by P2.90 while kerosene was rolled back by P3.20.

text: TUNGOD sa ongoing nga gyera sa tunga sang Russia kag Ukraine nangin “unpredictable”, ukon wala kaseguruhan, ang lakat sang negosyo sa langis (oil) sa madamo nga mga pungsod.
english: BECAUSE of the ongoing war between Russia and Ukraine, the oil business in many countries has become “unpredictable”.

text: Nangin tulod-butong ang negosyo sang oil sang Russia sa Uropa, labi na gid sa NATO countries nga apin sa Ukraine, nga naga-apektar man gani sa iban nga mga pungsod sa gwa sang “sphere of conflict”.
english: Russia's oil trade has become a bottleneck in Europe, especially in NATO countries alongside Ukraine, which is also affecting other countries outside the sphere of conflict.

text: Tungod man ini kay ginapilit sang US kag iban pa nga myembro sang NATO ang pagpatuman sang mga “sanction” pang-ekonomiya batok sa Russia agud mapasugot na ini sa isa ka “peace deal”.
english: This is also because the US and other NATO members are insisting on the implementation of economic sanctions against Russia in order to get it to agree to a peace deal.

text:
***

Mas gustuhon sang mga negosyante ang estable nga lakat sang presyo (stable pricing) sang mga produkto, bisan mataas pa ini, sangsa “erratic”, ukon wala kaseguruhan, nga nagabutang sa duha-duha sang ila maginansya.
english:
***

Traders prefer stable pricing of products, even if it is high, to “erratic”, or uncertainty, which puts their profitability in doubt.

text: Tungod sini mangin maamligon gid  ini  sila sa kon diin ibutang ang ila kapital agud kon madisgrasya ang lakat sang negosyo indi sila matam-an.
english: Because of this, they will be very careful about where to put their capital so that if the business goes wrong, they will not be left behind.

text: Kag lakip man diri ang ila problema sa oil.
english: And that includes their oil problem.

text: Sa pagnubo sang “supply”, sa idalom sang Law of Supply and Demand, magasaka ang presyo sang oil kag ang mga produkto sini nga diesel fuel kag gasolina.
english: With a decrease in supply, under the Law of Supply and Demand, the price of oil and its products, diesel fuel and gasoline, will rise.

text: Nga nagakatabo na.
english: Which is already happening.

text: Malain pa kay tungod sa pagsugod na sang “recovery” halin sa pandemic, ang pag-uswag sang mga negosyo kag palangitan-an sang mga tawo magapasaka man ini sang “supply” sang nagalagaw nga kwarta, nga makapasaka (inflation) sang mga bili sang mga balaklon.
english: Worse, with the beginning of the recovery from the pandemic, the growth of businesses and people's livelihoods will also increase the supply of circulating money, which will increase the prices of goods.

text: Makabulig diri ang sige na pagbukas sang mga negosyo.
english: The continued opening of businesses will help.

text:
***

Ti, ano ang mahimo naton sa sining problema sang karon nga pagtinaas sang bili sang oil kag sang panguna nga balaklon sang mga pumuluyo?
english:
***

Well, what can we do about this problem of the current rise in the price of oil and the basic commodity of the people?

text: Mapilipitan kita seguro sa pag-suspend anay sang pila ka lihok batok sa Climate Change agud magtutok anay sa mas “immediate” nga problema naton sa “supply” kag bili sang oil.
english: We will probably be forced to suspend some action against Climate Change in order to focus on our more immediate problem of oil supply and price.

text: Dapat tutok lang anay kita sa pagpaseguro sang aton “energy security” kag “affordability” sang mga panguna nga balaklon.
english: We should focus on ensuring our energy security and affordability of basic commodities.

text: Kinahanglan naton anay ang pagpataas sang aton local oil production halin sa 33,754 barrels kada adlaw (source: Worldmeter 2016) agud maibanan ang aton ginabakal (import) nga oil nga mga 429,000 ka bariles kada adlaw.
english: We first need to increase our local oil production from 33,754 barrels per day (source: Worldmeter 2016) to reduce our oil imports of about 429,000 barrels per day.

text: Indi man kita anay magbaligya (export) sa luas sang mga 14,774 ka bariles kada adlaw sang aton gina-producir diri nga oil, nga sa kon ano man nga “economic weirdo” naga-export pa gali kita sini!
english: Let's not export more than the 14,774 barrels per day of oil we produce here, which in some “economic weirdo” we are still exporting!

text: Dapat man naton anay palabihon ang pag-generate sang mga energy nga mas “sustainable” kag mas “efficient” agud mapun-an ang aton kakulangan sa energy halin sa oil imports, katulad sang renewable solar, hydropower, kag wind power.
english: We must also prioritize the generation of more sustainable and efficient energies to fill our energy shortage from oil imports, such as renewable solar, hydropower, and wind power.

text: Paagi sini mapasanyog naton ang pagtukod sang electric kag solar-powered nga mga salakyan.
english: Through this we can promote the construction of electric and solar-powered vehicles.

text: Samtang padayon man kita sa pagtuon agud mangin mas “efficient” anay ang indi ta pa mabuslan nga energy providers sing “less disastrous” nga mga renewable energy.
english: Meanwhile, we continue to learn to make our energy providers more efficient with less disastrous renewable energies.

text: Kinahanglan man naton ang malaka nga pagbyahe sang mga private vehicles kag mas “efficient” nga mga ruta sang mga salakyan pampubliko.
english: We also need frequent private vehicle trips and more “efficient” public transport routes.

text: Pasanyugon ta man ang paggamit sang bisikleta sa pagsulod kag pagpauli halin sa ginatrabahuan.
english: We will also promote the use of bicycles to get to and from work.

text: Samtang, naga-offer ang Asian Development Bank sang bulig agud pondohan ang pagpauntat na sang pila ka coal-powered plants sa Southeast Asia – Indonesia, Philippines kag Vietnam – agud mapadasig ang pagbulos sang mga proyekto sa renewable energy sa ila.
english: Meanwhile, the Asian Development Bank is offering assistance to fund the shutdown of several coal-powered plants in Southeast Asia – Indonesia, the Philippines and Vietnam – to accelerate their replacement by renewable energy projects.

text: Nga indi maghulat pa sa target sang pungsod sa pag-cut sa 35% sang coal-powered energy naton sa 2030 nga ginapanugyan sang Renewable Energy Act of 2008 kag RA 2013.
english: That does not wait for the country's target to cut 35% of our coal-powered energy by 2030 as recommended by the Renewable Energy Act of 2008 and RA 2013.

text: Mahimo kuno ini sang ADB bisan subong dayon kon sugot ang mga gobyerno sining mga pungsod nga may mataas ang paggamit sang coal-powered energy.
english: The ADB says it can do this even now if the governments of these countries with high use of coal-powered energy agree.

text: Sa kabug-usan, 57% gid sang energy generation sang pungsod ang halin sa mga coal-powered plant.
english: Overall, exactly 57% of the country’s energy generation comes from coal-powered plants.

text: Parti sa pagpanubo sang presyo sang langis, basi pwede man ang pagpanubo sang oil tax sa P1/L na lang.
english: As for reducing the price of oil, maybe it's possible to reduce the oil tax to P1/L.

text: Basi matagaan ta man subsidy ang agricultura kag iban pa nga production sector agud mapanubo ang presyo sang ila mga produkto.
english: Maybe we can also give subsidies to agriculture and other production sectors to lower the price of their products.

text: Kag basi makabulig pa kita ayuda sa natam-an gid nga mga trabador.
english: And maybe we can help help the workers who are in need.

text: Padayunon ta man ang health protocols kag pangbakuna agud mapasanyog ang mga aktibidad sa ekonomiya sang mga hilway sa Covid-19 nga mga negosyo kag mga pumuluyo nga makahatag man sing dugang nga buhis sa gobyerno.
english: We will also continue the health protocols and vaccination to boost the economic activities of Covid-19 free businesses and citizens that will also provide additional taxes to the government.

text: Indeed, kinahanglan naton ang ini nga mga lihok kag iban pa agud mapamag-an ang aton problema sa oil kag mapasanyog pa ang aton ekonomiya./PN
english: Indeed, we need these and other measures to alleviate our oil problem and further boost our economy./PN

text: Na-obserbahan sang Iloilo City General Services Office (GSO) kaupod Iloilo City Environment and Natural Resources Office (CENRO) nga may tubig pa ang Metro Pacific Iloilo Water (MPIW) kun ikumpara sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: The Iloilo City General Services Office (GSO) together with the Iloilo City Environment and Natural Resources Office (CENRO) observed that Metro Pacific Iloilo Water (MPIW) has more water compared to last year.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Engineer Niel Ravena, Head sang General Services Office, iya ginpahayag nga nagsugod sila monitor sang supply sang tubig sugod man sang nagtaas ang heat index.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Engineer Niel Ravena, Head of the General Services Office, said they started monitoring the water supply since the heat index rose.

text: Suno kay Ravena, ginatutokan sang talatapan ang pagbantay sang supply sang tubig ilabi na ang mga barangay sa syudad nga masami nagakaubsan kon tig-ilinit.
english: According to Ravena, the office is focusing on monitoring the water supply especially in the barangays in the city that often run out during the summer.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga isa sa problema nga ginahikot sang talatapan amo ang mga bubon nga wala na sang sulod nga masami man ginagamit sa pagpamunyag sa mga tanom.
english: He also said that one of the problems that the office is working on is the empty wells that are often used to water plants.

text: Nagpasalig man ini nga may team sila nga nagapatigayon sang monitoring sa kada duha ka semana kaangot sa quantity sang mga bubon kag nagaguwa nga sa subong, indi pa ini alarming.
english: He also assured that they have a team that conducts monitoring every two weeks regarding the quantity of wells and it turns out that at present, it is not alarming.

text:
Nagdangat sa halos P623,000 ang nataban sang tatlo ka mga lalaki nga nagsulod kag nag-hold up sa opisina sang J&T Express sa Mc Arthur Drive, Brgy Qintin Salas, Jaro, Iloilo City pasado ‘las syete kagab-i.

Sa panaysayon sang mga personnel sang delivery company, samtang naga-conduct sila sang inventory, nagsulod ang mga suspek nga may dala nga armas kag nag-deklarar sang hold-up kag nagpamahog nga wala sang may mahulag.
english:
Three men stole nearly P623,000 from the J&T Express office in Mc Arthur Drive, Brgy Qintin Salas, Jaro, Iloilo City around 7 pm last night.

According to the personnel of the delivery company, while they were conducting an inventory, the suspects entered with a gun and declared a hold-up and threatened that no one would move.

text: Sa paglaragway sang mga personnel, lunsay naka-bonnet ang mga suspek.
english: According to personnel, the suspects were all wearing bonnets.

text: Ginapahayag nakuha gikan sa opisina ang cash nga naglab-ot sa P622,966, wallet nga may automatic teller machine cards kag identification cards, kag cellphone.
english: Cash amounting to P622,966, a wallet containing automatic teller machine cards and identification cards, and a cellphone were allegedly recovered from the office.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Alias Lester nga isa man sa rider nga naka-remit na sa amo nga delivery company kagab-i, sandig sa panaysayon sang nakakita, pag-abot sang hold-upper, nagpangtaya ini sang pusil sa anum ka mga personnel, gin-sirado ang roll-up, kag ginpaluhod antes ginkuha ang kuwarta.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Alias ​​Lester, one of the riders who remitted to the delivery company last night, said that when the hold-upper arrived, he pointed a gun at six personnel, closed the roll-up, and knelt down before taking the money.

text: Gilayon nga nagpalagyo ang mga suspek sakay sa motorsiklo.
english: The suspects immediately fled the scene on a motorcycle.

text: Ginpahayag man nga wala pa sang na-install nga closed-circuit television kag wala man sang guwardiya sa opisina bangud bag-o pa lang ini nakasaylo sa amo nga area.
english: It was also reported that there is no closed-circuit television installed and there is no guard in the office because it has recently moved to the area.

text: Padayon pa ang imbestigasyon kag ang follow-up operation sang mga pulis sa amo nga insidente.
english: The police are still investigating and conducting follow-up operations on the incident.

text: Iloilo City – Amat-amat na nga nagakatahap ang mga durugista sa syudad sang Iloilo bangud sa sagunson nga drug buy-bust operations.
english: ILOILO CITY – Drug pushers in Iloilo City are becoming increasingly suspicious due to a series of drug buy-bust operations.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Major Shella Mae Sangrines, spokeserson sang Iloilo City Police Office, iya ginpahayag nga sa 33 ka mga drug operations, 45 nga mga durugista ang napreso.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Major Shella Mae Sangrines, spokesperson of the Iloilo City Police Office, said that in 33 drug operations, 45 drug pushers were arrested.

text: Suno kay Sangrines, magluwas sa kampanya batok sa iligal nga droga, nangin madinalag-on man ang pagdakop sang 42 ka mga wanted personalities kun sa diin, walo sa mga ini ang ginakabig nga most wanted persons.
english: According to Sangrines, besides the campaign against illegal drugs, 42 wanted personalities were also successfully arrested, eight of whom are considered the most wanted persons.

text: Ginpahayag dugang sang natungdan nga ini ang nagapakita sang agresibo nga pagtutok sang mga kapulisan sa idalom sang liderato ni Police Colonel Joeresty Coronica batok sa iligal nga droga, illegal gambling, kag iban nga krimen sa Iloilo City.
english: He added that this shows the aggressive focus of the police under the leadership of Police Colonel Joeresty Coronica against illegal drugs, illegal gambling, and other crimes in Iloilo City.

text: Samtang suno kay Sangrines, nagpasalig si Coronica nga padayunon sini ang naumpisahan partikular sa pagpapas sang mga nagagamit sang iligal nga droga.
english: Meanwhile, Sangrines said Coronica promised to continue what he started particularly in eradicating illegal drug users.

text: Ginkakas na sang Department of Trade and Industry ang limitasyon sa numero sang mga ginabakal nga food products sa mga supermarket.
english: The Department of Trade and Industry has lifted the limit on the number of food products purchased in supermarkets.

text: Suno kay Department of Trade and Industry Undersecretary Ruth Castelo, may bastante na nga supply sang raw materials ang food amnufacture kag sigurado nga indi na magka-problema pa sa supply sang food products.
english: According to Department of Trade and Industry Undersecretary Ruth Castelo, the food manufacturer already has sufficient supply of raw materials and is sure that there will be no problems in the supply of food products.

text: Apang magapabilin sa gihapon ang limitasyon sa pagbakal sang disinfecting alcohol, hand sanitizers, disinfecting liquids kag face masks.
english: However, the limit on the purchase of disinfecting alcohol, hand sanitizers, disinfecting liquids and face masks will remain in place.

text:
Base sa memoradum nga ginpaguwa sang DTI, yari ang quantity limit:

Disinfecting alcohol – 5 bottles for sizes 1 liter and below; 3 bottles for sizes more than 1 literHand sanitizer – 5 bottles for sizes 1 liter and below; 3 bottles for sizes more than 1 literDisinfecting liquids – 5 bottles for sizes 1 liter and below; 3 bottles for sizes more than 1 literFace masks (N95 and N88) – 1 box of 50 pieces
english:
Based on the memorandum issued by the DTI, here is the quantity limit:

Disinfecting alcohol – 5 bottles for sizes 1 liter and below; 3 bottles for sizes more than 1 literHand sanitizer – 5 bottles for sizes 1 liter and below; 3 bottles for sizes more than 1 literDisinfecting liquids – 5 bottles for sizes 1 liter and below; 3 bottles for sizes more than 1 literFace masks (N95 and N88) – 1 box of 50 pieces

text: Iloilo – Indi na bag-o ang probinsya sang Iloilo para sa incoming Iloilo Police Provincial Office Director.
english: Iloilo – The province of Iloilo is not new to the incoming Iloilo Police Provincial Office Director.

text: Nahibauan nga napilian ni Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor Jr.
english: It was learned that Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor Jr.

text: si Police Colonel Ronaldo Palomo nga mangin masunod nga Director base sa iya credentials.
english: Police Colonel Ronaldo Palomo to be the next Director based on his credentials.

text: Sa exclusive interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Palomo, iya ginpahayag nga tumandok ini sang Passi City kag naghalin sa pamilya sang mangunguma.
english: In an exclusive interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Palomo said he is a native of Passi City and comes from a family of farmers.

text: Antes magsulod sa serbisyo bilang pulis, naggradwar si Palomo sa Western Institute of Technology kag nakatudlo pa sa St.
english: Before joining the police force, Palomo graduated from the Western Institute of Technology and taught at St.

text: Joseph School – Hijas de Jesus sa Barangay San Miguel, Jordan, Guimaras.
english: Joseph School – Hijas de Jesus in Barangay San Miguel, Jordan, Guimaras.

text: Suno kay Palomo, nagsulod ini sa Philippine National Police Academy sang 1996 kag nakagradwar sang 1998.
english: Palomo said he joined the Philippine National Police Academy in 1996 and graduated in 1998.

text: Ginpahayag dugang sang natungdan nga gin-assign ini sa Region 6 kag nagserbe bilang hepe sa mga banwa sang San Miguel, Pototan kag San Enrique, Iloilo.
english: He added that he was assigned to Region 6 and served as chief in the towns of San Miguel, Pototan and San Enrique, Iloilo.

text: Gin-assign man si Palomo sa Aklan kag Guimaras, Region 12, kag Region 8.
english: Palomo was also assigned to Aklan and Guimaras, Region 12, and Region 8.

text: Sang ginsaylo ini sa Occidental Mindoro, diri na kag napinsaran sini ang schooling agud mangin isa ka full-fledged colonel.
english: When he was transferred to Occidental Mindoro, it was here that he thought about schooling to become a full-fledged colonel.

text: Nakatutok sa subong ang natungdan sa pag-revisit sa mga unsolved cases sa Iloilo.
english: He is currently focused on revisiting unsolved cases in Iloilo.

text: Nagdasig ang Bagyo Emong kag malapit na lang nga mag-landfall sa Ilocos Sur ukon sa naaminhan nga bahin sang La Union.
english: Typhoon Emong has intensified and is about to make landfall in Ilocos Sur or the northern part of La Union.

text:
Kun matabo ang landfall subong nga aga, ini na ang ikaduha nga bes nga maga-landfall ini matapos natabo man sa Agno, Pangasinan 10:40 kagab-i.

Ulihi nga nakit-an ang bagyo sa coastal waters sang Bangar, La Union dala ang kabaskugon sang hangin nga 120 km/h malapit sa sentro kag pagmadlos nga tubtub sa 165 km/h. Nagahulag ini sa direksyon nga pa-naaminhan nasidlangan sa kadasigon nga 20 km/h.

Yari ang mga lugar nga may wind signal numbers:

SIGNAL NUMBER 4:

The southwestern portion of Ilocos Sur and the northern and central portions of La Union

SIGNAL NUMBER 3:

The southern portion of Ilocos Norte, the rest of Ilocos Sur, the rest of La Union, the western portion of Apayao, Abra, the western portion of Kalinga, the western portion of Mountain Province, the western portion of Benguet, and the northern portion of Pangasinan

SIGNAL NUMBER 2:

The rest of Ilocos Norte, the rest of Pangasinan, the northern portion of Zambales, the rest of Apayao, the rest of Kalinga, the rest of Mountain Province, the rest of Benguet, Ifugao, Batanes, Cagayan including Babuyan Islands, the northern and western portions of Isabela, the northwestern portion of Quirino, the western and central portions of Nueva Vizcaya, the northwestern portion of Nueva Ecija, and the northern portion of Tarlac

SIGNAL NUMBER 1:

The rest of Isabela, the rest of Quirino, the rest of Nueva Vizcaya, the northern and central portions of Aurora, the rest of Nueva Ecija, the rest of Tarlac, the western and central portions of Pampanga, the rest of Zambales, and the northern portion of Bataan

Pagkatapos sang landfall subong nga aga, magatabok ang bagyo sa kabukiran sang Northern Luzon kag magatuhaw sa Babuyan Channel antes karon sa udto.
english:
If the landfall happens this morning, it will be the second time it will landfall after it also happened in Agno, Pangasinan at 10:40 pm.

The typhoon was last spotted in the coastal waters of Bangar, La Union with winds of 120 km/h near the center and gusts of up to 165 km/h. It is moving in a northeast direction at a speed of 20 km/h.

Here are the areas with wind signal numbers:

SIGNAL NUMBER 4:

The southwestern portion of Ilocos Sur and the northern and central portions of La Union

SIGNAL NUMBER 3:

The southern portion of Ilocos Norte, the rest of Ilocos Sur, the rest of La Union, the western portion of Apayao, Abra, the western portion of Kalinga, the western portion of Mountain Province, the western portion of Benguet, and the northern portion of Pangasinan

SIGNAL NUMBER 2:

The rest of Ilocos Norte, the rest of Pangasinan, the northern portion of Zambales, the rest of Apayao, the rest of Kalinga, the rest of Mountain Province, the rest of Benguet, Ifugao, Batanes, Cagayan including Babuyan Islands, the northern and western portions of Isabella, the northern and western portions of Quihwestern, and the western part central portions of Nueva Vizcaya, the northwestern portion of Nueva Ecija, and the northern portion of Tarlac

SIGNAL NUMBER 1:

The rest of Isabela, the rest of Quirino, the rest of Nueva Vizcaya, the northern and central portions of Aurora, the rest of Nueva Ecija, the rest of Tarlac, the western and central portions of Pampanga, the rest of Zambales, and the northern portion of Bataan

After landfall this morning, the typhoon will cross the mountains of Northern Luzon and emerge in the Babuyan Channel before noon today.

text:
Sunod nga magahulag ini paaaminhan-nasidlangan kag magalabay malapit sa Babuyan Islands karon sa hapon kag malabay malapit sa Batanes sa tunga-tunga sang hapon kag gab-i.

Ginalantaw man sa track and intensity forecast nga magahina ini gamay antes ang ikaduha nga landfall bangud man sa kabukiran sang northwestern Luzon.#
english:
It will next move northeast and pass near the Babuyan Islands this afternoon and pass near Batanes in the mid-afternoon and evening.

The track and intensity forecast is also expected to weaken slightly before the second landfall due to the mountains of northwestern Luzon.

text: Madamo ang nagabilib sa isa ka 93-anyos nga media mogul sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika bangud apisar sa iya nga edad, nagpakasal pa ini sa ika-lima na nga tion.
english: Many admire a 93-year-old media mogul in the United States of America because despite his age, he married for the fifth time.

text: Ini amo si Rupert Murdoch, isa ka Australian billionaire, nga kilala nga may net worth nga $9.77 billion ukon P573-billion.
english: This is Rupert Murdoch, an Australian billionaire, who is known to have a net worth of $9.77 billion or P573-billion.

text: Ang ginpakaslan sini amo ang iya nobya nga Elena Zhukova, 67, isa ka retired molecular biologist.Ginpatigayon ang ila nga kasal sa Bel-Air, California.
english: He married his girlfriend Elena Zhukova, 67, a retired molecular biologist. They were married in Bel-Air, California.

text: Ang mas interesente pa amo nga nagkilalahay gali sila nga duha kadungan sang kasal ni Rupert sa iya ikatatlo nga asawa, ang Chinese entrepreneur nga si Wendi Deng sang 1999.
english: What’s even more interesting is that the two actually met at the same time as Rupert’s marriage to his third wife, Chinese entrepreneur Wendi Deng in 1999.

text: Matunog ang pangalan ni Murdoch nga nagapanguna sa media empire sa Estados Unidos sa sulod sang pito ka dekada.
english: Murdoch's name is loud, leading a media empire in the United States for seven decades.

text: Siya ang chairman emeritus sang News Corporation nga nagapanag-iya sang Fox News, Wall Street Journal, Sun kag Times.
english: He is chairman emeritus of the News Corporation which owns Fox News, Wall Street Journal, Sun and Times.

text: Sang nagligad nga tuig sang nagpanaog siya bilang chairman sa Fox kag News Corp kun sa diin ang iya anak nga si Lachlan ang na-designar nga magpamuno sa duha ka mga kumpaniya.
english: Last year when he stepped down as chairman of Fox and News Corp, his son Lachlan was appointed to lead the two companies.

text: Ang media companies nga iya gindumala ang may masangkad nga nalab-utan kaangay sa outlets, satellites, Hollywood studios, libro, newspapers kag TV stations sa tatlo ka kontinente.
english: The media companies he has managed have a wide reach such as outlets, satellites, Hollywood studios, books, newspapers and TV stations on three continents.

text: Antes ang iya pagpakasal subong nga tuig, nangin asawa man niya ang anay supermodel nga si Jerry Hall apang nagtapos sa divorce sang 2022.
english: Before her marriage this year, she was also married to former supermodel Jerry Hall but ended in divorce in 2022.

text: Iloilo City – Indi pag kunsintihon ni Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas ang pagpanakit sa mga indibidwal nga nagakadakpan sa mga buy-bust operations sa syudad sang Iloilo.
english: Iloilo City – Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas will not condone the harassment of individuals who are caught in buy-bust operations in Iloilo City.

text: Ini matapos nga napatay ang isa ka durugista sa Barangay Lanit Jaro, Iloilo City bangud nagbato ini sa mga operatiba.
english: This is after a drug pusher was killed in Barangay Lanit Jaro, Iloilo City after he threw stones at the operatives.

text: Ang napatay amo si amo si Jason Espaltero alias “Don- Don”, 32, tumandok sang Antique.
english: The deceased was identified as Jason Espaltero alias “Don-Don”, 32, a native of Antique.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga siya mismo ang nakaagi man preso, apang wala ini ginsakit sang mga militar.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Treñas said he himself was imprisoned, but he was not tortured by the military.

text: ILOILO CITY- Kanselado sa gihapon ang byahe sang mga fastcrafts nga may ruta nga Iloilo City- Bacolod City and vice versa.
english: ILOILO CITY- The flights of fastcrafts with the route Iloilo City-Bacolod City and vice versa are still cancelled.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Rowel Gresos, boat captain sang Weesam Express, iya ginpahayag nga nagalaum sila nga mabalik na ang byahe sa pinakamadali nga tion bangud nga apektado ang ila sweldo sa diin delayed ini sa sulod sang halos duha na ka bulan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Rowel Gresos, boat captain of the Weesam Express, said they hope to resume the flight as soon as possible because their salaries have been affected and have been delayed for almost two months.

text: Apang suno kay Gresos, apisar makabalik na sila sa pagbyahe, mangin dako nga problema ang tuman ka gamay nga numero sang pasahero nga tugutan nga magsakay nga limitahan lang sa 60 apisar nga 296 ang seating capacity sang ila barko.
english: However, Gresos said that even if they can resume sailing, the small number of passengers allowed to board will be limited to 60 despite the 296 seating capacity of their ship.

text: Naghakot na gilayon sang million followers si anay US President Donald Trump pila ka oras matapos nga nag-intra naman ini sa TikTok, isa ka China-based application nga gintinguhaan man sini anay nga i-ban sa Estados Unidos base bangud sa pamahog sa national security.
english: Former US President Donald Trump immediately attracted a million followers hours after he joined TikTok, a China-based application that he also tried to ban in the United States based on threats to national security.

text: Paagi sa TikTok, mas mapalapit ni Trump ang iya kampanya sa mas bataon nga mga botante para mabuligan siya sa iya tuyo nga magbalik sa White House.
english: With TikTok, Trump can bring his campaign closer to younger voters to help him in his bid to return to the White House.

text: Siya ang presumptive nominee sang Republicans apang sang nagligad lamang nga semana, napamatbatan siya nga guilty sa 34 counts sa hush money trial nga amo ang nagamarka sang labing-una nga tion nga na-convict ang presidente sang USA sa kaso-kriminal.
english: He was the presumptive nominee of the Republicans but just last week, he was found guilty of 34 counts in the hush money trial which marks the first time that the president of the USA has been convicted of a criminal case.

text: Sa Hulyo 11 pa natalana ang sentensya.
english: Sentencing is scheduled for July 11.

text: Sa iya account, nag-post si Trump sang video nga nagatamyaw sa iya fans sa Ultimate Fighting Championship fight sa Newark, New Jersey.
english: On his account, Trump posted a video greeting his fans at the Ultimate Fighting Championship fight in Newark, New Jersey.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang Democratic incumbent nga si President Joe Biden nga magapa-reelect man sa November 5 presidential election ang naglunsar naman sang iya kampanya sa TikTok.
english: Democratic incumbent President Joe Biden, who will also be reelected in the November 5 presidential election, has launched his campaign on TikTok.

text: Ini apisar nga ginpirmahan sini ang hagna nga maga-ban sa application kun indi ini pag-ibaligya sang Chinese owner nga ByteDance sa lain nga tag-iya.
english: This is despite the fact that he signed a bill that will ban the application if the Chinese owner ByteDance does not sell it to another owner.

text: Ang pag-dumili sini sa Estados Unidos ang naka-base sa national security grounds bangud ginakahangaw-ang nga ihatag sa Chinese government ang data nga makuha sang TikTok gikan sa 170-million ka American users.
english: Its ban in the United States is based on national security grounds because it is feared that the data that TikTok will collect from its 170-million American users will be given to the Chinese government.

text: WESTERN VISAYAS – Nagsaka sa 13.7% ang unemployment rate sa Western Visayas bangud sa Coronavirus Disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic.
english: WESTERN VISAYAS – The unemployment rate in Western Visayas has risen to 13.7% due to the Coronavirus Disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Niezel Sabrido, information officer sang Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE) , iya ginpahayag nga ang pagsaka sang unemployment rate sa rehiyon 6 ang base sa ginpaguwa nga data sang Philippine Statistics Authority.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Niezel Sabrido, information officer of the Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE), said the increase in the unemployment rate in Region 6 is based on data released by the Philippine Statistics Authority.

text: Suno kay Sabrido, tuman nga naapektuhan ang trabaho sang mga mamumugon sa bahin sang service industry kaangay sang hotel, restaurant , travel and tours kag iban pa.
english: According to Sabrido, the work of workers in the service industry such as hotels, restaurants, travel and tours and others has been severely affected.

text: Apisar nga nagbukas na ang iban nga mga establisimento bangud yara na sa Modified General Community Quarantine ang Western Visayas, indi sa gihapon mahinago nga may iban nga mga kompaniya ang sirado sa gihapon.
english: Although some establishments have reopened as Western Visayas is now under Modified General Community Quarantine, it is no secret that some companies are still closed.

text: Dugang pa sang natungdan, sang nakaligad nga data sang Philippine Statistics Authority, yara lang sa 6% ang unemployment rate sa Western Visayas.
english: He added that according to the latest data of the Philippine Statistics Authority, the unemployment rate in Western Visayas is only 6%.

text: Masako na sa pagpanghanda ang Iloilo City para sa Iloilo Bike Festival 2025 nga ginakabig nga pinakadako nga selebrasyon sang biking culture.
english: Iloilo City is busy preparing for the Iloilo Bike Festival 2025 which is considered the biggest celebration of biking culture.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Architect Welfredo Sy Jr., chairman sang Bike Festival 2025, iya ginpahayag nga kapin sa 150 ka bike organizations sa Iloilo ang ginalauman nga magpasakop.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Architect Welfredo Sy Jr., chairman of the Bike Festival 2025, said more than 150 bike organizations in Iloilo are expected to participate.

text: Suno kay Sy, ginaengganyo man nila ang iban nga mga grupo halin sa Luzon para mag-intra sa festival.
english: Sy said they are also encouraging other groups from Luzon to participate in the festival.

text: Pila sa mga events sa Iloilo Bike Festival amo ang Food Trucks/ Mobile Cart Festival, Bike Exhibit, Bike Expo, Push bike race, bike clinic, BMX street competition, Grand Funride, Battle of the bands, i-bike to work, Tour de Iloilo, ambitious bike race, run-bike-run duathlon kag mega criterium race.
english: Some of the events at the Iloilo Bike Festival are Food Trucks/Mobile Cart Festival, Bike Exhibit, Bike Expo, Push bike race, bike clinic, BMX street competition, Grand Funride, Battle of the bands, i-bike to work, Tour de Iloilo, ambitious bike race, ruterium-run-bike mega race and mega race.

text: Magaumpisa ini sa May 30 kag magalawig tubtob sa Hunyo 15.
english: It will start on May 30 and run until June 15.

text: ILOILO – Kinahnaglan nga may yara sang price tag ang tanan nga ginabaligya sa physical store man ukon sa online.
english: ILOILO – Everything sold in physical stores or online must have a price tag.

text: Ini ang may kaangtanan sa Fair Trade Law kag Price Tag Law nga ginapatuman sa tanan nga produkto nga yara sa sakop sang Department of Trade and Industry.
english: This is in relation to the Fair Trade Law and Price Tag Law applicable to all products within the purview of the Department of Trade and Industry.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Felisa Judith Degala, Provincial Director sang Department of Trade and Industry – Iloilo, iya ginpahayag nga kinahanglan nga mangin hayag ang tanan nga seller paagi sa pagbutang sang price tag sa ginabaligya nga produkto.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Felisa Judith Degala, Provincial Director of the Department of Trade and Industry – Iloilo, said all sellers should be transparent by putting price tags on the products they sell.

text: Suno kay Degala, katuyu-an sini nga mahibalu-an kun bala ginasunod ang Suggested Retail Price nga ginpaguwa sang Department of Trade and Industry.
english: According to Degala, the purpose of this is to determine whether the Suggested Retail Price issued by the Department of Trade and Industry is being followed.

text: Ginpahayag ni Degala nga kalabanan sa mga may violation sa nasambit nga mga layi amo ang online sellers nga wala nagabutang sang presyo sa ginabaligya nga produkto.
english: Degala said most of the violators of these laws are online sellers who do not set prices on the products they sell.

text: Ginhalimbawa sang natungdan amo ang ‘PM Sent’ ukon ginapaagi sa Private Message ang transaksyon kag wala nahibalu-an sang iban kun pila gid ang presyo sang produkto.
english: He cited the example of 'PM Sent' or through Private Message transactions and some do not know how much the price of the product.

text: Gin-athag sang natungdan nga humalin sang Styembre 30, 2019, wala pa sang may ginpaguwa nga Suggested Retail Price ang Department of Trade and Industry.
english: He explained that as of September 30, 2019, the Department of Trade and Industry has not released any Suggested Retail Price.

text: Ginpadala sang Estados Unidos sang Amerika ang military aircraft sini agud nga magdul-ong sang humanitarian assistance and disaster response (HADR) equipment sa Pilipinas.
english: The United States of America has sent its military aircraft to deliver humanitarian assistance and disaster response (HADR) equipment to the Philippines.

text: Sa tunga ini sang lapnagon nga baha sa nagkalain-lain nga parte sang pungsod bangud sa epekto sang habagat kag sunod-sunod nga mga bagyo.
english: This is amid widespread flooding in various parts of the country due to the impact of the southerly winds and successive typhoons.

text: Suno kay Major Joseph Richard Calma, assistant chief sang Philippine Air Force (PAF) Public Affairs Office, ang KC-135 aircraft ang ginpadala sang US kag ginalauman nga maghugpa sa Clark Air Base sa Mabalacat, Pampanga, apang wala lang sang ginhatag nga eksakto nga oras sa pag-abot sini.
english: Major Joseph Richard Calma, assistant chief of the Philippine Air Force (PAF) Public Affairs Office, said the KC-135 aircraft was sent by the US and is expected to land at Clark Air Base in Mabalacat, Pampanga, but no exact time of arrival was given.

text: Wala man sang detalye nga nahatag kun magabulig ini sa disaster response magluwas sa pagdul-ong sang equipment.
english: No details were given on whether it will help in the disaster response besides the delivery of equipment.

text: Ini nga KC-135 Stratotanker amo ang aerial refueling and airlift aircraft sang US Air Force nga mahimo maka-karga sang cargo kag mga pasyente sa tion nga may aeromedical evacuations.
english: This KC-135 Stratotanker is the aerial refueling and airlift aircraft of the US Air Force that can transport cargo and patients in the event of aeromedical evacuations.

text: Sa bahin naman sang PAF, naka-standby ang masobra 40 ka air assets sini kun sa diin ang pila ang naka-preposition sa Clark Air Base kag sa Basa Air Base nga lunsay sa Pampanga.#
english: On the other hand, the PAF has more than 40 air assets on standby, some of which are prepositioned at Clark Air Base and Basa Air Base, both in Pampanga.

text: Ginabanta nga 10,000 ka mga bakante nga trabaho ang nagahulat para sa mga Ilonggo nga nagapangita sang ubra sa Labor Day Job Fair sang Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE) sa Iloilo.
english: An estimated 10,000 job vacancies are waiting for Ilonggos looking for work at the Labor Day Job Fair of the Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE) in Iloilo.

text: Hiwaton ini sa Robinson’s Place sa Ledesma Street, Iloilo City .
english: It will be held at Robinson's Place on Ledesma Street, Iloilo City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Jorge Ferraris II, OIC-head sang Technical Support Service Division-Employment Promotions and Workers Welfare, iya ginpahayag nga magapasakop sa job fair ang 106 ka lokal nga mga kumpaniya kag lima ka overseas companies.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Jorge Ferraris II, OIC-head of the Technical Support Service Division-Employment Promotions and Workers Welfare, said 106 local companies and five overseas companies will participate in the job fair.

text: Suno kay Ferraris, may yara man sang 16 ka mga ahensya sang gobyerno nga magatanyag sang nagkalain-lain nga mga serbisyo.
english: Ferraris said there will also be 16 government agencies that will offer a variety of services.

text: Yara man ang Department of Health para sa mga job seeker nga mabaton gilayon sang employer kag i-require sang medical examination.
english: There is also the Department of Health for job seekers who are immediately accepted by the employer and require a medical examination.

text: Kadungan sang job fair, may yara sang pag- release sang TUPAD Assistance nga nagabalor P264 million para sa kapin 40,000 nga informal workers kag DOLE Integrated Livelihood Program assistance nga nagabalor P34.5 million para sa kapin 1,400 ka mga benepisyaryo.
english: Along with the job fair, there was the release of TUPAD Assistance worth P264 million for more than 40,000 informal workers and DOLE Integrated Livelihood Program assistance worth P34.5 million for more than 1,400 beneficiaries.

text: Nadakpan ang duha ka lalaki sa separado nga drug buy bust operations sa Iloilo City kagab-i, Pebrero 22.
english: The two men were arrested in separate drug buy bust operations in Iloilo City last night, February 22.
