english: In Brgy Bolilao, Manduriao, a street-level individual, Benjie Gella, 36, resident of the same barangay, was arrested.

text: Suno sa police report, apat ka plastic sachets ang natigayon nga nakuha sa possession ni Gella lakip na ang duha nga buy-bust item.
english: According to the police report, four plastic sachets were recovered from Gella's possession along with two buy-bust items.

text: Pareho nga preso ang duha kag natalana nga pasakaan sang kaso nga paglapas sa Republic Act 9165 ukon Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.
english: Both are in custody and are scheduled to face charges of violation of Republic Act 9165 or Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.

text: MANILA– Kinahanglan nga sabton sang mga Employers suno sa Department of Labor and Employment, ang gasto sa coronavirus testing, kun ini ang kinahanglanon sang mga empleyado antes magbalik sa trabaho.
english: MANILA – Employers must bear the cost of coronavirus testing, according to the Department of Labor and Employment, if it is necessary for employees before returning to work.

text: Ini matapos nakabatun sang reklamo ang Labor Secretary nga mismo ang mga empleyado, ang kinahanglan magbayad sa ila pagpaidalom sa testing.
english: This is after the Labor Secretary received a complaint that the employees themselves, had to pay for their testing.

text: Suno kay Department of Labor and Employment Secretary Silvestre Bello III, indi mahimo piliton ang mga empleyado nga magpatest, apang kun kinahanglanon, mismo ang employer ang natalana nga magbayad sini.
english: According to Department of Labor and Employment Secretary Silvestre Bello III, employees cannot be forced to undergo testing, but if necessary, the employer itself is scheduled to pay for it.

text: Dugang pa ni Bello, wala man ginarequire ang mga kumpaniya nga ipaidalom sa testing ang mga empleyado sa liwat nga pagbalik sang ila operasyon.
english: Bello added that companies are not required to subject employees to testing upon the resumption of operations.

text: Nahibaluan nga nagbalik na sa trabaho ang mga empleyado, matapos naghagan-hagan ang mga restrictions, lakip na ang pagbukas sang mga establisimento nga yara sa Modified Enhanced Community Quarantine,partikular na sa Metro Manila.
english: Employees have returned to work after restrictions were eased, including the opening of establishments under Modified Enhanced Community Quarantine, particularly in Metro Manila.

text: La Paz, Iloilo City – Dakop sa ginpatigayon nga drug buy-bust operation ang isa ka high value individual sa Barangay Nabitasan, La Paz, Iloilo City.
english: La Paz, Iloilo City – A high value individual was arrested in a drug buy-bust operation in Barangay Nabitasan, La Paz, Iloilo City.

text: Ang durugista amo si Anjo Abello alyas “Part”, 26, kag residente sang Zone 1, Barangay Rizal, La Paz, Iloilo City.
english: The drug pusher was identified as Anjo Abello alias “Part”, 26, and resident of Zone 1, Barangay Rizal, La Paz, Iloilo City.

text: Narekober kay Abello ang 26 tanan nga sachet sang suspected shabu nga ginabanta nagabalor sang P918,000 kag nakuha man ang P20,000 nga buy-bust money.
english: Abello was recovered with 26 sachets of suspected shabu worth P918,000 and P20,000 buy-bust money.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Punong Barangay Chichi Narandan sang Barangay Rizal, La Paz, Iloilo City, iya ginpahayag nga indi ini ang una nga bes nga napreso si Abello bangud naangot man ini sa kaangay man nga kaso sang 2020.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Punong Barangay Chichi Narandan of Barangay Rizal, La Paz, Iloilo City said that this is not the first time that Abello has been jailed because he was also involved in a similar case in 2020.

text: Suno kay Narandan, ginakahangaw-an niya ang natabo kay Abello bangud maski ang iya asawa ang nagpanugid sa iya opisina nga liwat na naman nagagamit sang droga si Abello.
english: Narandan said he is concerned about what happened to Abello because even his wife told his office that Abello was using drugs again.

text: Sa subong, ara na sa kamot sang mga kapulisan si Abello kag magaatubang sang kaso nga paglapas sa Republic Act 9165 ukon ang Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.
english: Abello is now in police custody and will face charges of violation of Republic Act 9165 or the Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.

text: Nanindugan si Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu nga wala sang permanent ceasefire sa Gaza tubtub nga wala pa napapas ang military kag governing capabilities sang Hamas kag wala pa nahilway ang tanan nga mga bihag.
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has insisted that there will be no permanent ceasefire in Gaza until Hamas' military and governing capabilities are destroyed and all hostages are released.

text: Ini ang iya statement kasunod sang anunsyo ni US President Joe Biden nga nagduso ang Israel sang three-stage plan sa Hamas agud nga may makasugtan nga permanent ceasefire.
english: His statement follows US President Joe Biden's announcement that Israel has proposed a three-stage plan to Hamas in order to agree on a permanent ceasefire.

text: Ini nga ginaalegar negosasyon ang natabo kadungan sang opensiba sa Rafah kun sa diin may nagakadalahig na nga mga sibilyan.
english: The alleged negotiations took place during the offensive in Rafah where civilians were already involved.

text: Apang sa latest statement ni Netanyahu, ginpahayag sini nga wala naglain ang mga kondisyon sang Israel sa gyera.
english: But in Netanyahu's latest statement, he said Israel's war conditions had not deteriorated.

text: Gin-insister man sini nga wala ini sang pirmahan nga kasugtanan tubtub wala pa nalab-ot ang kondisyon nga ila gin-set kaangot sa Gaza war.
english: He also insisted that he will not sign an agreement until the conditions they set regarding the Gaza war are reached.

text: “Under the proposal, Israel will continue to insist these conditions are met before a permanent ceasefire is put in place.
english: “Under the proposal, Israel will continue to insist these conditions are met before a permanent ceasefire is put in place.

text: The notion that Israel will agree to a permanent ceasefire before these conditions are fulfilled is a non-starter,” suno sa statement.
english: The notion that Israel will agree to a permanent ceasefire before these conditions are fulfilled is a non-starter,” according to the statement.

text: Matandaan nga sa proposal nga gin-anunsyo ni Biden, may yara sang tatlo ka phases kun sa diin anum ka semana ang kalawigon sang una nga phase kun sa diin nalakip ang full ceasefire, withdrawal sang Israeli forces halin sa populated areas sa Gaza, kag pagbayluhanay sang prisoners.
english: It can be recalled that in the proposal announced by Biden, there are three phases where the first phase lasts six weeks and includes a full ceasefire, withdrawal of Israeli forces from populated areas in Gaza, and prisoner exchange.

text: As of press time, masobra na sa 36,000 ka Palestinians ang napatay sa Gaza bangud sa pagtimalos sang Israel sa pag-atake sang Hamas sang Oktubre 7, 2023.
english: As of press time, more than 36,000 Palestinians have been killed in Gaza as a result of Israeli retaliation for the Hamas attack on October 7, 2023.

text: INDI naton malarawan ang isa ka plastic-free nga kalibutan bisan pa sa daku nga kabalaka naton sa mabug-at nga mga problema ng dala sini sa aton mga komunidad.
english: WE cannot imagine a plastic-free world despite our deep concern about the serious problems it brings to our communities.

text: Ina tungod indi na naton mapaiway ang paggamit sang mga bagay nga himo sa plastic.
english: That's because we can't stop using things made of plastic.

text: Indi lang tungod maangkon naton ini sing mas barato sangsa mga himo sa kahoy kag salsalon sa puluy-an sang aton ordinaryo nga mga pumuluyo.
english: Not only because we can have them cheaper than those made of wood and iron at home by our ordinary citizens.

text: Ang kamag-an sang mga plastic nga kagamitan gapahapos man sang aton pagginawi.
english: The lightweight of plastic utensils also makes our behavior easier.

text: Easily available man ang madamo nga kagamitan nga himo sa plastic sa kinahanglanon naton sa pagpauswag sang  aton kinaalam sa siyensya, technolohiya kag ekonomiya.
english: Many plastic equipment is also easily available for our needs to improve our knowledge in science, technology and economy.

text:
***

Ang una nga klase sang plastic na-imbento sadtong 1856 ni Alexander Parkes sang UK.
english:
***

The first type of plastic was invented in 1856 by Alexander Parkes of the UK.

text: Ini ang Bioplastic nga himo halin sa plant-based (biomass) products, katulad sang mais kag sugarcane.
english: It is Bioplastic made from plant-based (biomass) products, such as corn and sugarcane.

text: Nagsunod ang Bakelite nga himo sa synthetic components nga nangin una nga artificial plastic.
english: Bakelite, made of synthetic components, followed, becoming the first artificial plastic.

text: Gin-develop ini sang Belgian chemist nga si Leo Baekeland sadtong 1907.
english: It was developed by Belgian chemist Leo Baekeland in 1907.

text: Ang ulihi kag pinaka-popular sa subong nga mga plastic products amo ang himo sa fossil fuel – oil, natural gas kag coal.
english: The last and most popular of the current plastic products are those made from fossil fuel – oil, natural gas and coal.

text: Sa karon, ang kadamuon sini sobra sa 90 ka porsyento (%) sang tanan nga plastic product sa mga merkado.
english: Currently, its volume is more than 90 percent (%) of all plastic product in the markets.

text:
***

Unfortunately, may “dark side” man ang dalagku nga mga benepisyo nga matigayon naton sa paggamit sang plastic products.
english:
***

Unfortunately, there is also a “dark side” to the great benefits that we can get from using plastic products.

text: Labi na gid sang madiskubrihan nga ang produksyon sang plastic products halin sa fossil fuel kag ang mga produkto sini, upod man ang iban pa nga mga produkto, naga-producir gali sang Greenhouse gas (GHG) sa palibut.
english: Especially when it was discovered that the production of plastic products from fossil fuels and its products, along with other products, actually produce Greenhouse gas (GHG) in the environment.

text: Daku nga kabangdanan gali ini sang pagtuhaw sang ginakulbaan naton nga Global Warming kag “disastrous result” sini sa Climate Change.
english: This is a major cause of the global warming we fear and its “disastrous result” in Climate Change.

text: Gin-estimate sang mga siyentipiko ang “disastrous level” sang Global Warming sa 2 degrees Celsius pataas.
english: Scientists have estimated the “disastrous level” of Global Warming at 2 degrees Celsius and above.

text: Kag nagapalapit na kita sa amo nga kahimtangan kon indi naton mapunggan ang pagtaas sini!
english: And we are approaching such a situation if we do not stop its rise!

text: Partikular sa mga gatong (diesel fuel, gasoline, etc.) sa salakyan nga himo halin sa fossil fuel, mga 80% sini halin sa kabug-usan sang fossil fuel nga ginatayon sa global market.
english: Particularly in vehicle fuels (diesel fuel, gasoline, etc.) made from fossil fuels, about 80% of which come from the total fossil fuel supply in the global market.

text:
***

Partikular sa problema naton sa plastic products, luas sa plastic pollution, nadiskubrihan man sang mga siyentipiko kon ano ini ka mahaliton.
english:
***

Particularly in our problem with plastic products, besides plastic pollution, scientists have also discovered how harmful it is.

text: Sunu sa ila, ang plastic, labi na gid ang synthetic plastic kag ang indi dale-dale maagnas (non-biodegradable) nga plastic nga himo halin sa fossil fuel, pwede makaon sang mga isda kag iban nga marine animals nga tungod indi matunaw magadulot sang pagmasakit nila kag ikamatay sa ulihi.
english: According to them, plastic, especially synthetic plastic and non-biodegradable plastic made from fossil fuels, can be eaten by fish and other marine animals which because it does not dissolve will cause them to get sick and die later.

text: In fact, pwede man ini makahalit sa mga kasapatan nga nagapuyo sa duta kag sa kahanginan, kag pati sa mga tawo.
english: In fact, it can also harm animals that live on the ground and in the air, and even humans.

text: Labi na gid ang mga plastic sa ila gagmay kaayo nga forma (microplastics) nga maupod naton sa pagkaon, por ejemplo, sang isda, ukon upod mainom sa sapa kag sa public drinking water mismo sang mga pumuluyo.
english: Especially the plastics in their very small form (microplastics) that we can eat, for example, with fish, or drink with the river and the public drinking water of the people themselves.

text:
***

So, ano ang mahimo naton diri?
english:
***

So, what can we do here?

text: Sa matuod, ang ining problema naton sa Global Warming kag Climate Change angot sa basura kag produksyon sang mga bagay nga nagatuga sang GHG indi lang problema sang gobyerno, kundi sang tanan nga pumuluyo.
english: In fact, our problem of Global Warming and Climate Change regarding waste and production of GHGs is not only a problem of the government, but of all citizens.

text: Ginapanugyan sang DENR ang pagsabat sa problema nga ini paagi sa 5R’s nga programa sini – Reduce, Reuse, Recover, Repair, Recycle.
english: The DENR proposes to address this problem through its 5R’s program – Reduce, Reuse, Recover, Repair, Recycle.

text: Yara man ang suhestyon sa paglimpyo sang Iloilo River kag mga tributaries sini sang mga plastic wastes.
english: There is also a suggestion to clean up the Iloilo River and its tributaries of plastic wastes.

text: Gin-suhestyon man ang pagtukod sang isa ka recycling plant sa siyudad sang Iloilo agud diri na ma-producir ang pila ka plastic products nga indi mahimo sang pribado nga sector tungod indi ini profitable sa ila.
english: It was also suggested to build a recycling plant in Iloilo City to produce some plastic products that the private sector cannot do because it is not profitable for them.

text: Lakip diri ang 4B’s nga programa sang Iloilo provincial government kag kasubong nga lihok sang mga eskwelahan.
english: This includes the 4B's program of the Iloilo provincial government and similar initiatives by schools.

text: May lihok man gani agud i-ban ang mga single-use plastic products nga pwede man wala ini tungod indi gid man kinahanglanon gid, katulad sang drinking  straw.
english: There is even a move to ban single-use plastic products that can be done without because they are not really necessary, such as drinking straws.

text: Yara man ang Paris Agreement of 2015 nga naga-limite sang GHG emission sang mga industrial countries.
english: There is also the Paris Agreement of 2015 which limits the GHG emission of industrial countries.

text: Kinahanglan ta man seguro ang isa ka kasuguan agud ma-obligar ang mga pumuluyo agud indi manglapta sang ila basura sa kon diin lang.
english: We probably need a law to oblige residents not to spread their garbage everywhere.

text: Ining kasuguan pwede naton tawgon nga Illegal Waste Dumping in Public Act nga may penalidad sa madakpan.
english: This law can be called Illegal Waste Dumping in Public Act with penalties for those caught.

text: Kuha naton ini sa kasubong nga kasuguan sa Japan, kon diin sa kultura na nila ang pagpanglimpyo sa ila palibut bisan indi mo suguon./PN
english: Let's take this from a similar law in Japan, where it's their culture to clean up their surroundings even if you don't tell them to./PN

text: ILOILO CITY- Manamit ang langka ilabi na kun luot, pero kun hilaw, perfect man ini ilakot sa baboy kag kadiyos.
english: ILOILO CITY- Langka is delicious especially when it is raw, but when it is raw, it is also perfect to be mixed with pigs and gods.

text: Suno sa Dietitian nga si Mira Ilic, ang langka may mas mataas nga vitamins kag minerals kun ipaanggid sa apples, apricots, bananas, kag abukado.
english: According to Dietitian Mira Ilic, langka has higher vitamins and minerals compared to apples, apricots, bananas, and avocados.

text: Naga-contain man ini sang folate, niacin, riboflavin, potassium, magnesium kag antioxidants.
english: It also contains folate, niacin, riboflavin, potassium, magnesium and antioxidants.

text:
Suno kay Ilic, ang nutrients sa langka mahimo nga magpanubo sang risgo para sa pila ka health issues nga nagalakip sang masunod:

1.High blood pressure- ang potassium sa sini nga tropical fruit ang makabulig panubo sang imo blood pressure  agud makalikaw sa heart disease, stroke, kag bone loss.
english:
According to Ilic, the nutrients in langka may reduce the risk for several health issues which include the following:

1.High blood pressure- the potassium in this tropical fruit can help lower your blood pressure to prevent heart disease, stroke, and bone loss.

text: 2.Skin problems- ang mataas nga amounts sang vitamin C sa langka ang makabulig protekta sa panit gikan sa sun damage.
english: 2.Skin problems- the high amounts of vitamin C in langka can help protect the skin from sun damage.

text: 3.Cancer-ang phytonutrients nga makit-an sa langka ang natural compounds nga mahimo may cancer-fighting benefits, kaangay sang paglikaw sang cancer cells nga magporma sa lawas.
english: 3.Cancer-the phytonutrients found in langka are natural compounds that may have cancer-fighting benefits, such as preventing cancer cells from forming in the body.

text: Gin-abisuhan na ang pila ka mga personnel sa isa ka key U.S. military base sa Qatar nga mag-evacuate.
english: Some personnel at a key U.S. military base in Qatar have already been advised to evacuate.

text: Suno ini sa isa ka U.S. official sa tunga sang paandam ni President Donald Trump sang posible tikang sang US matapos ang deadly crackdown sa mga protesters sa Iran.
english: A U.S. official said this amid President Donald Trump's warning of possible US action after the deadly crackdown on protesters in Iran.

text: Ini nga desisyon ang natabo matapos ginmitlang sang isa ka senior official sa Tehran ang retaliatory attack sang Iran sang Hunyo sa Al Udeid Air Base sa gwa sang Doha, Qatar.
english: This decision came after a senior official in Tehran cited Iran’s retaliatory attack in June on Al Udeid Air Base outside Doha, Qatar.

text: Ang anti-government demonstrations sa Iran ang nagsugod sang Disyembre kag ginsiling ni Trump nga handa ini magpatigayon sang military operations batok sa Iran kun padayunon sang Tehran government ang pagpamatay kag pag-aresto sa mga protesters.
english: Anti-government demonstrations in Iran began in December and Trump said he was ready to conduct military operations against Iran if the Tehran government continued to kill and arrest protesters.

text: Kabahin na sa billionaires list sang Forbes magazine si tennis legend Roger Federer.
english: Tennis legend Roger Federer is now on Forbes magazine's billionaires list.

text: Base sa estimate nga Forbes nga may yara sang kabug-usan nga manngad ang20-time Grand Slam Champion nga $1.1 billion.
english: According to Forbes estimates, the 20-time Grand Slam Champion has a net worth of $1.1 billion.

text: Halin ang manggad sang 44-anyos nga retired Swiss tennis star sa iya clothing kag shoe company.
english: The 44-year-old retired Swiss tennis star's wealth comes from his clothing and shoe company.

text: Apisar retired na ini, magahampang sagihapon si Roger sa isa ka exhibition game sa Shanghai Masters ukon “Roger Federer and Friends Celebrity Doubles Match”.
english: Although he is retired, Roger will still play in an exhibition game at the Shanghai Masters or “Roger Federer and Friends Celebrity Doubles Match”.

text: USA – Ginpamatbatan nga guilty si anay United States President Donald Trump sa 34 ka counts sang pagpeke sang business records agud maimpluwensyahan ang resulta kag integridad sang 2016 election.
english: USA – Former United States President Donald Trump was found guilty of 34 counts of falsifying business records to influence the outcome and integrity of the 2016 election.

text: Ini nga maragtason nga desisyon ang ginpaguwa kadungan sang ikaduha nga adlaw sang deliberasyon sang 12 ka jurors sa New York.
english: This historic verdict was issued during the second day of deliberations by 12 jurors in New York.

text: Si Trump nga isa man subong ka presumptive Republican presidential nominee amo ang labing-una nga presidente sa maragtas sang Estados Unidos sang Amerika nga na-convict sa kaso-kriminal.
english: Trump, who is also the presumptive Republican presidential nominee, is the first president in the history of the United States of America to be convicted of a crime.

text: Sandig sa unanimous nga desisyon sang 12 ka jurors, gin-falsify ni Trump ang record agud nga matabunan ang $130,000 ukon P7.6-million nga hush money payment sa adult film star nga si Stormy Daniels agud maimpluwensyahan ang eleksyon.
english: According to the unanimous decision of 12 jurors, Trump falsified records to cover up a $130,000 or P7.6-million hush money payment to adult film star Stormy Daniels to influence the election.

text: Ini nga verdict ang ginpaguwa man matapos nga gin-indict sang grand jury si Trump sang Marso 30, 2023 nga amo man ang labing-una nga tion nga na-indict sa kaso-kriminal ang former ukon sitting president sang Estados Unidos.
english: The verdict also comes after a grand jury indicted Trump on March 30, 2023, which is also the first time a former or sitting president of the United States has been indicted on a criminal charge.

text: Gin-schedule naman ang pag-sentensya sa Hulyo 11 subong nga tuig.
english: Sentencing is scheduled for July 11 this year.

text: Gintawag naman ni Trump nga indi patas ang hush money trial batok sa iya.
english: Trump has called the hush money trial against him unfair.

text: Suno kay Trump, biased ang judge nga si Judge Juan Merchan kag nagareklamo man ini sa gag order.
english: According to Trump, Judge Juan Merchan is biased and he is also complaining about the gag order.

text: Sa iya social media platform, gintawag man ni Trump nga “UNFAIR, MISLEADING, INACCURATE, AND UNCONSTITUTIONAL” ang instructions sang huwes kag ginahambalan man sini ang judge nga “HIGHLY CONFLICTED”.
english: On his social media platform, Trump also called the judge’s instructions “UNFAIR, MISLEADING, INACCURATE, AND UNCONSTITUTIONAL” and also referred to the judge as “HIGHLY CONFLICTED”.

text: Ginasulit man ni Trump nga ini nga trial ang isa ka witch hunt kag election interference bangud magapadalagan ini liwat sa eleksyon subong nga tuig.
english: Trump also repeats that this trial is a witch hunt and election interference because he will run again this year.

text: Ginsiling man sini nga ginalapas sang trial ang iya nga civil rights.
english: He also said the trial violates his civil rights.

text: Ginbasol man ni Trump ang Biden administration bangud sa pamatbat sa iya.
english: Trump also blamed the Biden administration for interpreting him.

text: Iloilo – Ginbasura sang Iloilo Provincial Prosecutor’s Office ang motion for reconsideration may kaangtanan sa kaso nga three counts of murder batuk sa lone survivor sang Estancia massacre nga si Jevron Parohinog kag sa apat ka iban pa nga mga identified suspects kag anum ka mga John Does.
english: Iloilo – The Iloilo Provincial Prosecutor's Office has dismissed the motion for reconsideration in connection with the case of three counts of murder against lone survivor of the Estancia massacre Jevron Parohinog and four other identified suspects and six John Does.

text: Matandaan nga natabo ang pagpangluthang sa Villa Panian, Estancia, Iloilo sa diin tatlo ka mga mag-abyan ang ginpamatay sang Septyembre 14, 2022.
english: It can be recalled that the shooting occurred in Villa Panian, Estancia, Iloilo where three friends were killed on September 14, 2022.

text: Ang mga biktima amo sanday Chrysler Floyd Fernandez, residente sang Jereos, La Paz, Iloilo City; John Paul “JP” Mark Bosque sang Lopez Jaena Sur, La Paz, Iloilo City; kag Mark Clarenz Libao sang Tacas, Jaro, Iloilo City.
english: The victims were identified as Chrysler Floyd Fernandez, resident of Jereos, La Paz, Iloilo City; John Paul “JP” Mark Bosque of Lopez Jaena Sur, La Paz, Iloilo City; and Mark Clarenz Libao of Tacas, Jaro, Iloilo City.

text: Ang iban pa sa mga ginpasakaan sang kaso amo sanday Jix Parohinog, Michael Porras, Michael Quiatchon, Benzen Llamado, kag anum ka mga John Does.
english: Others charged were Jix Parohinog, Michael Porras, Michael Quiatchon, Benzen Llamado, and six John Does.

text: Sa ginauyatan sang Bombo Radyo Iloilo nga desisyon ni Assistant Provincial Prosecutor Ronilo Pamonag kag pirmado ni Provincial Prosecutor Ma.
english: In a decision held by Bombo Radyo Iloilo and signed by Provincial Prosecutor Ma.

text: Elena M. Hofileña-Gerochi nga napetsahan Pebrero 17, nakit-an nga wala sang panibag-o nga mga substantial arguments ang Iloilo Police Provincial Office agud ma-reverse ang pag-dismiss sang kaso.
english: Elena M. Hofileña-Gerochi dated February 17, found that the Iloilo Police Provincial Office had no new substantial arguments to reverse the dismissal of the case.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang nagpasaka sang kaso amo sanday Flover Fernandez, Remy Bosque, kag Jose Rabiel Libao nga pamilya sang mga napatay.
english: The case was filed by Flover Fernandez, Remy Bosque, and Jose Rabiel Libao, families of the victims.

text:
(ESTANCIA)

Ini ang gin-updan nanday Iloilo Police Provincial Office chief kag commander sang Special Investigation Task Group PALIBOSFER Police Colonel Noel Aliño kag Lieutenant Colonel Raymond Celoso nga amo ang Special Task Group Inter-Agency Coordinator sang Iloilo Police Provincial Office.
english:
(ESTATE)

He was accompanied by Iloilo Police Provincial Office chief and commander of the Special Investigation Task Group PALIBOSFER Police Colonel Noel Aliño and Lieutenant Colonel Raymond Celoso who is the Special Task Group Inter-Agency Coordinator of the Iloilo Police Provincial Office.

text: Matandaan nga gin-dismiss ang criminal complaint nga gin-file batok sa mga suspek nga sang Disyembre 10, 2022 bangud wala nakitaan sang meritorious ground agud mapadayon ang kaso kag magpatigayon sang preliminary investigation.
english: It can be recalled that the criminal complaint filed against the suspects on December 10, 2022 was dismissed because no meritorious ground was found to continue the case and conduct a preliminary investigation.

text: Nag-post si anay Philippine National Police (PNP) chief kag subong Senador Ping Lacson nga may “credible source” nga nagpanugid sa iya nga may chief executive officer (CEO) nagikan sa bantog nga casino hotel nga ginaalegar nga nagtanyag sang ila ballroom bilang venue sang “charity boxing match” sa tunga nanday Police Chief General Nicolas Torre III kag Davao City Acting Mayor Baste Duterte.
english: Former Philippine National Police (PNP) chief and current Senator Ping Lacson posted that a “credible source” told him that a chief executive officer (CEO) from a famous casino hotel allegedly offered their ballroom as a venue for a “charity boxing match” between Police Chief General Nicolas III and Acting Davao City Mayor Baste Duterte.

text: “A credible source told me last night, the CEO of a popular resort casino hotel, a well-known philanthropist is willing to open their ballroom for the “charity boxing match” between Nick Torre and Baste Duterte.
english: “A credible source told me last night, the CEO of a popular resort casino hotel, a well-known philanthropist is willing to open their ballroom for the “charity boxing match” between Nick Torre and Baste Duterte.

text: For the sake the many poor flood victims, let’s do it,” post ni Lacson sa X subong nga aga, Hulyo 24.
english: For the sake of the many poor flood victims, let’s do it,” Lacson posted on X this morning, July 24.

text: Matandaan nga nanghangkat si Baste sang tapungulay, kag nagsabat si Torre nga handa siya mag-atubang sa isa ka charity boxing match bisan sa Araneta sa Domingo.
english: Baste challenged him to a fight, and Torre replied that he was ready to face a charity boxing match even in Araneta on Sunday.

text: “Kasi matapang ka lang naman you have the position.
english: “Because you're brave, you have the position.

text: Pero kung suntukan tayo alam kong makaya kita.
english: But if we fight I know we can handle it.

text: But then  you’re a coward,” kabahin sang paghangkat sang acting mayor sa vlog nga gin-upload sang Domingo.
english: But then you’re a coward,” the acting mayor challenged in a vlog uploaded on Sunday.

text: Ginsuguran na ang deliberation sa verdict kaangot sa criminal hush money trial batok kay anay US President Donald Trump.
english: Deliberation on the verdict in the criminal hush money trial against former US President Donald Trump has begun.

text: Ginabug-usan sang 12 ka New Yorkers ang panel — pito ang lalaki kag lima ang babaye — nga amo ang magatumod kun guilty si Trump sa 34 ka felony charges sang pag-peke sang mga business records nga naangot sa hush money payment sa adult film star nga si Stormy Daniels antes ang 2016 presidential election.
english: The panel of 12 New Yorkers — seven men and five women — will determine whether Trump is guilty of 34 felony charges of falsifying business records linked to a hush money payment to adult film star Stormy Daniels ahead of the 2016 presidential election.

text: Si Trump nga may tatlo ka iban pa gid nga separado nga kaso-kriminal samtang nga nagapadalagan liwat sa pagka-presidente, ang una na nga nag-plead sang “not guilty” sa sini nga mga kaso.
english: Trump, who has three other separate criminal cases while running for president again, was the first to plead “not guilty” to these cases.

text: Dapat nga unanimous ang desisyon sang korte kag dapat nga magkasugot nga guilty si Trump beyond a reasonable doubt para nga maka-seure ang prosecutors sang conviction.
english: The court's decision must be unanimous and must agree that Trump is guilty beyond a reasonable doubt for prosecutors to secure a conviction.

text: Pananglitan madesisyunan nga guilty, mangatubang ini sang maximum sentence nga apat ka tuig nga pagka-preso sa kada count,ukon mahimo mas ang mas gamay nga silot sang probation kag multa nga kuwarta.
english: If found guilty, he faces a maximum sentence of four years in prison on each count, or possibly a lesser sentence of probation and a monetary fine.

text: Nagnubo sang 79% ang kita sang mga puerto sa gintalikdan nga bulan sang Marso bangud sa epekto sang Coronavirus Disease 2019 pandemic.
english: Port revenue fell by 79% in the previous month of March due to the impact of the Coronavirus Disease 2019 pandemic.

text: Suno kay Philippine Ports Authority General Manager Jay Daniel Santiago, apisar nga padayon ang ila nga operasyon para sa mga shipment wala naman ginatugutan nga makabyahe ang mga de pampasahero nga mga barko.
english: According to Philippine Ports Authority General Manager Jay Daniel Santiago, although they continue to operate for shipments, passenger ships are not allowed to sail.

text: Nahibaluan nga sang gintalikdan nga tuig nakarecord ang Philippine Ports Authority sang P7.280 bilyon nga revenue.
english: Last year, the Philippine Ports Authority recorded P7.280 billion in revenue.

text: Sa pagbanta ni Santiago, apisar nga magbalik na sila sa full operation, indi mangin mahapos nga mabalik ang bilyon-bilyon nga napierde sang mga puerto sa pungsod.
english: Santiago estimates that even if they return to full operation, it will not be easy to recover the billions lost by the country's ports.

text: Gin-ako man sang natungdan nga apisar nga mabalik na ang byahe sang mga barko, tunga lang ang tugutan nga makasakay sa mga passenger vessel tubtob nga i-rekomenda na sang Department of Health nga mahimo na sila makapitagayon sang normal operation.
english: He also acknowledged that although the ships will resume operations, only half of the passenger vessels will be allowed to board until the Department of Health recommends that they can resume normal operation.

text: Ipatuman ang mas mahal nga balayran para sa maga-book sang flights sa Agusto.
english: Higher fees will be implemented for those booking flights in August.

text: Sa abiso sang Civil Aeronautics Board (CAB), ginhatagan sang awtoridad ang carriers nga pasakaan ang fuel surcharge sa Level 4 sa masunod nga bulan halin sa record-low Level 3 subong nga Hulyo.
english: In a notice issued by the Civil Aeronautics Board (CAB), carriers have been given the authority to raise the fuel surcharge to Level 4 next month from the record-low Level 3 this July.

text: Sa Level 4, mahimo makapanukot ang airlines sang fuel surcharge nga P117 tubtub sa P342 para sa domestic flights kag P385.7 tubtub sa P2,867.82 para sa foreign departures depende sa distansya.
english: At Level 4, airlines can charge a fuel surcharge of P117 to P342 for domestic flights and P385.7 to P2,867.82 for foreign departures depending on the distance.

text: Ini nga saka sa fuel surcharge ang ginpatuman sa tunga sang manubo nga demand sa airlines bangud sa pag-ulan-ulan diri sa pungsod.
english: The increase in fuel surcharge was implemented amid low demand in airlines due to heavy rains in the country.

text: Kun lantawon naman sa global level, may pagsaka sa jet fuel bangud sa madamo nga factors suno sa oil producers lakip na ang nangin mataas nga tensyon sa Middle East nga nag-resulta sa mataas nga taripa sa US.
english: On the global level, there is an increase in jet fuel due to many factors, according to oil producers, including the high tensions in the Middle East that resulted in high tariffs in the US.

text: Nahibaluan nga ginapasugtan sang CAB nga ipasa sang airlines ang fuel surcharge sa mga pasahero agud nga makabangon man sila sa costs halin sa fluctuations sa global market.
english: It is known that the CAB allows airlines to pass on the fuel surcharge to passengers so that they can also recover from costs from fluctuations in the global market.

text: Narumpag ang portion sang kisame sang Zuri Hotel sa Mandurriao, Iloilo City.
english: Portion of the ceiling of Zuri Hotel in Mandurriao, Iloilo City collapsed.

text:
Kasunod ini sang pagbubo sang mamunog nga ulan kagab-i.

Ang kisame ang kabahin sang covered entrance para sa mga salakyan nga nagapapanaog kag nagapasakay sang pasahero.
english:
This follows heavy rains last night.

The ceiling is part of the covered entrance for vehicles dropping off and picking up passengers.

text: Sa impormasyon nga nakuha sang Bombo Radyo, isa ka driver sang motorsiklo ang nahulugan sang debris kag padayon nga ginabulong.
english: According to information obtained by Bombo Radyo, a motorcycle driver was hit by debris and is undergoing treatment.

text: Samtang may mga salakyan naman nga nagkslagupi matapos nahulugan sang kisame.
english: Meanwhile, some vehicles crashed after the ceiling fell.

text: Nagpagwa naman ang hotel sang statement nga nagapangayo sa pasaylo bangud sa natabo
english: The hotel issued a statement apologizing for the incident

text: Nagbaskog pa ang Bagyo Emong kag nahimo na nga Severe Tropical Storm samtang yara sa sulod sang Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR).
english: Typhoon Emong has strengthened into a Severe Tropical Storm while within the Philippine Area of ​​Responsibility (PAR).

text: Ulihi ini nga nakit-an sa kalayuon nga 245 kilometros nakatundan sang Bacnotan, La Union.
english: It was last seen 245 kilometers west of Bacnotan, La Union.

text:
Dala sini ang kabaskugon sang hangin nga 110 km/h malapit sa sentro kag pagmadlos nga tubtub sa 135 km/h. Nagahulag ini sa direksyon nga pa-nabagatnan-nakatundan sa kadasigon nga 25 km/h.

Napaidalom na sa Signal Number 3 ang northern portion sang Pangasinan kag ang western portion sang La Union.
english:
It brought winds of 110 km/h near the center and gusts of up to 135 km/h. It is moving in a southwesterly direction at a speed of 25 km/h.

The northern portion of Pangasinan and the western portion of La Union are already under Signal Number 3.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, nabatak naman sa Signal Number 2 ang areas sa Luzon kaangay sang Ilocos Norte, Ilocos Sur, nabilin nga bahin sang La Union, ang western portion sang Apayao, Abra, Kalinga, Mountain Province, Ifugao, Benguet, ang central portion sang Pangasinan, kag ang western portion sang Nueva Vizcaya.
english: Meanwhile, areas in Luzon such as Ilocos Norte, Ilocos Sur, the rest of La Union, the western portion of Apayao, Abra, Kalinga, Mountain Province, Ifugao, Benguet, the central portion of Pangasinan, and the western portion of Nueva Vizcaya are under Signal Number 2.

text: Nagapabilin naman sa Signal no.
english: Signal no.

text: 1 ang Batanes, Cagayan lakip na ang Babuyan Islands, ang western kag ang central portions sang Isabela, nabilin nga bahin sang Nueva Vizcaya, Quirino, nabilin nga bahin sang Apayao, nabilin nga bahin sang Pangasinan, ang northern kag central portions sang Zambales, Tarlac, kag ang western kag central portions sang Nueva Ecija.
english: 1 the Batanes, Cagayan including the Babuyan Islands, the western and the central portions of Isabela, the rest of Nueva Vizcaya, Quirino, the rest of Apayao, the rest of Pangasinan, the northern and central portions of Zambales, Tarlac, and the western and central portions of Nueva Ecija.

text: Sa track forecast, ginalantaw nga magahulag si Emong sa direksyon nga pa-nakatundan nasidlangan antes magliso pa-naaminhan-nasidlangan sa masunod nga 24 oras.
english: In the track forecast, Emong is expected to move in a west easterly direction before turning northeast over the next 24 hours.

text: Mahimo ini maglabay malapit sa Pangasinan karon sa hapon kag mag-landfall sa Ilocos Region karon sa gab-i ukon sa buwas sa aga.
english: It could pass near Pangasinan this afternoon and make landfall in the Ilocos Region tonight or tomorrow morning.

text: Nagbaskog ini sa severe tropical storm 2:00 AM kaina sang kaagahon, kag posible mahimo nga typhoon antes ang landfall sini sa Ilocos.
english: It strengthened into a severe tropical storm at 2:00 AM this morning, and may become a typhoon before landfall in Ilocos.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, padayon nga gina-monitor ang Tropical Storm “DANTE” sa sulod sang PAR, apang sa latest weather bulletin, wala na sang areas nga napaidalom nga areas sa wind signal bangud sa sini nga bagyo.
english: Meanwhile, Tropical Storm “DANTE” continues to be monitored within the PAR, but in the latest weather bulletin, there are no areas under wind signal due to this typhoon.

text: Magluwas sa sini, sa latest weather bulletin, ang isa ka Low Pressure Area (LPA) sa guwa sang PAR ang may yara sang mataas nga potensyal nga mag-develop sa tropical depression sa masunod nga 24-oras.
english: Apart from this, in the latest weather bulletin, a Low Pressure Area (LPA) outside the PAR has a high potential to develop into a tropical depression in the next 24-hours.

text: Patay ang anay alkalde sang Kalibo, Aklan kag beterano nga journalist nga si Johnny Dayang matapos gintiro sa sulod sang ila balay sa Barangay Andagao, Kalibo, Aklan.
english: Former Kalibo, Aklan mayor and veteran journalist Johnny Dayang was shot dead inside his house in Barangay Andagao, Kalibo, Aklan.

text: Suno sa imbestigasyon, natabo ang krimen pila ka minutos lang ang nakaligad sang nakatapos kaon sang iya panyapon ang 79-anyos nga biktima.
english: According to the investigation, the crime occurred a few minutes after the 79-year-old victim finished eating his dinner.

text: Ginpahayag nga yara ini sa sulod sa ila nga sala sang nagsulod ang armado nga mga lalaki kag gintiro ini sang makapila ka beses.
english: He was reportedly inside their living room when armed men entered and shot him several times.

text: Sa inisyal nga impormasyon, igo sa liog kag likod ang kabangdanan sang kamatayon sang biktima.
english: According to initial information, the victim sustained multiple gunshot wounds to the neck and back.

text: Antes ang insidente, ginpahayag nga makapila ka beses na nga nagpa-blotter sa pulis si Dayang bangud sa ginapahayag nga may mga armado nga mga indibidwal nga nagapanilag sa gwa sang ila balay.
english: Before the incident, Dayang had reportedly filed a complaint with the police several times over alleged armed individuals patrolling outside her house.

text: Napalpak ang pagpalupad sang North Korea sang rocket nga nagadala sang ila ikaduha nga spy satellite nga natalana kuntani nga mag-abot sa direksyon sang Yellow Sea kag nasidlangan sang Luzon sa Pilipinas.
english: North Korea failed to launch a rocket carrying its second spy satellite that was scheduled to arrive in the direction of the Yellow Sea and east of Luzon in the Philippines.

text: Suno sa official Korean Central News Agency, ginlunsar ang spy satellite sakay sa bag-o nga rocket sa main northwestern space center.
english: According to the official Korean Central News Agency, the spy satellite was launched aboard a new rocket at the main northwestern space center.

text: Apang ginpahayag nga naglupok ang rocket sa first-stage flight kasunod sang liftoff bangud sa ginasuspetsahan nga engine problem.
english: However, the rocket reportedly exploded during the first-stage flight following liftoff due to a suspected engine problem.

text: Antes sini, ginpahibalo sang North Korea sa Japan ang plano sini nga magpalupad sang rocket sa direksyon sang Yellow Sea kag nasidlangan sang Luzon sa tunga-tunga sang Mayo 27 kag Hunyo 4.
english: Earlier, North Korea informed Japan of its plan to launch a rocket in the direction of the Yellow Sea and east of Luzon between May 27 and June 4.

text: Ginkumpirma man sang South Korean government nga nag-isyu ang North sang notice of a military reconnaissance satellite launch.
english: The South Korean government also confirmed that the North had issued a notice of a military reconnaissance satellite launch.

text: Nag-istorya man ang mga opisyal sang United States, Japan, kag South Korea kaangot sa sini nga notice kag pareho nga nadiskusyunan nga ang North Korean satellite launch nga nagagamit sang ballistic missile technology ang isa ka paglapas sa resolutions sang United Nations kag isa pa ka daku nga risgo sa regional security.
english: Officials from the United States, Japan, and South Korea also spoke regarding the notice and both discussed that the North Korean satellite launch using ballistic missile technology is a violation of United Nations resolutions and another major risk to regional security.

text: Nagsugtanay man ang mga opisyal nga mag-demand sa North Korea nga indi pagdayunon ang plano sini.
english: The officials also agreed to demand that North Korea not go ahead with its plan.

text: Matandaan nga sang Nobyembre sang ginlunsar sang North Korea ang ila una nga military spy satellite kun sa diin ila pa gin-claim nga ang satellite ang nakakuha sang surveillance photographs sang US White House, ang Pentagon kag South Korean military installations.
english: It can be recalled that in November, North Korea launched its first military spy satellite where it claimed that the satellite captured surveillance photographs of the US White House, the Pentagon and South Korean military installations.

text: Una man nga ginpabugal sang North Korea nga tatlo ka dugang nga spy satellites ang ila igalunsar subong nga tuig.
english: North Korea also earlier boasted that it would launch three additional spy satellites this year.

text: Kapin sa P156 bilyon ang gin nubo sang revenue collection sang Department of Finance kadungan sang ginpatuman nga Enhanced Community Quarantine sa Luzon.
english: More than P156 billion was reduced in revenue collection by the Department of Finance during the implementation of Enhanced Community Quarantine in Luzon.

text: Suno sa Department of Finance nagdangat sa P600.85 bilyon ang koleksyon sang Bureau of Internal Revenue kag Bureau of Customs sa first quarter sang tuig.
english: According to the Department of Finance, the collection of the Bureau of Internal Revenue and Bureau of Customs reached P600.85 billion in the first quarter of the year.

text: Ini mas manubo sang P156.26 bilyon sa P757.12 bilyon nga revenue target sa bilog nga tuig mas manubo sang P10.17 bilyon sa revenue collections sang gintalikdan nga tuig.
english: This is lower than the P756.26 billion revenue target for the whole year, lower than the P10.17 billion revenue collections last year.

text: Sa kabilugan, nagdangat na sa P455.45 bilyon ang nakolekta sang Bureau of Internal Revenue nga mas manubo sang 2.86% sa P468.86 bilyon nga nakolekta sang 2019 kag manubo man sang 22.86% sa P590-43 bilyon nga target.
english: In total, the Bureau of Internal Revenue collected P455.45 billion, 2.86% lower than the P468.86 billion collected in 2019 and 22.86% lower than the P590-43 billion target.

text: Samtang nagdangat naman sa P154.41 bilyon ang nakolekta sang Bureau of Customs nga mas mataas sang P2.28% kun ipaanggid sa P142.17 bilyon sang gintalikdan nga tuig apang mas manubo sang 12.75% sa P166.69 bilyon nga target.
english: Meanwhile, the Bureau of Customs collected P154.41 billion, P2.28% higher than last year's P142.17 billion but 12.75% lower than the P166.69 billion target.

text: Suno kay Department of Finance Secretary Carlos Dominguez, lauman nga mas magnubo pa sa P318 bilyon ang revenue kun magnubo sang 1% ang ekonomiya subong nga tuig kag P286.4 bilyon kun wala pa sang mangin pagbag-o sa sitwasyon.
english: According to Department of Finance Secretary Carlos Dominguez, revenue is expected to fall by P318 billion if the economy shrinks by 1% this year and P286.4 billion if there is no change in the situation.

text: Nagsaka na sa 21 ang napatay sa apat ka states sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika bangud sa thunderstorms nga may dala pa nga mga buhawi.
english: The death toll from thunderstorms in four states in the United States has risen to 21.

text: Sa sini nga casualties, walo ang na-rekord sa Arkansas, pito sa Texas, apat sa Kentucky kag duha sa Oklahoma sandig sa latest tally sang state emergency authorities.
english: Of these casualties, eight were recorded in Arkansas, seven in Texas, four in Kentucky and two in Oklahoma according to the latest tally of state emergency authorities.

text: Sa Kentucky, nagdeklarar na si Governor Andy Beshear sang state of emergency samtang ginpahayag naman sang National Weather Service nga may ginpaguwa nga severe thunderstorm watch sa mga parte sang Georgia kag South Carolina tubtub Lunes sang hapon sa amo nga mga lugar.
english: In Kentucky, Governor Andy Beshear has declared a state of emergency while the National Weather Service said it has issued a severe thunderstorm watch for parts of Georgia and South Carolina until Monday afternoon in those areas.

text: Sa Texas naman, ginkumpirma ni Governor Greg Abbott nga sa pito nga napatay, nalakip ang duha ka tuig kag lima ka tuig nga mga bata samtang malapit 100 naman ang pilason bangud sa buhawi nga naglaslas sa mga komunidad sa north Texas malapit sa border sa Oklahoma.
english: In Texas, Governor Greg Abbott confirmed that the seven dead included two-year-old and five-year-old children while nearly 100 were injured in a tornado that tore through communities in north Texas near the Oklahoma border.

text: Sa Arkansas, lakip sa napatay amo ang residente nga may chronic obstructive pulmonary disease kag nadulaan sang oxygen sang nautod ang suplay sang kuryente.
english: In Arkansas, among the dead was a resident who had chronic obstructive pulmonary disease and lost oxygen when the power supply was cut off.

text: Sa latest data sang PowerOutage.US tracking website, ginatos ka libo nga mga Americans ang naka-eksperyensya sang power outages kun sa diin pinakadamo sa Kentucky nga may 180,000 outages.
english: According to the latest data from the PowerOutage.US tracking website, hundreds of thousands of Americans have experienced power outages with the highest number in Kentucky with 180,000 outages.

text: Nagpaandam man ang National Weather Service nga lauman ang malain pa nga tyempo sa Ohio kag Tennessee kun sa diin mahimo makaguba sang balay ang kabaskugonsang hangin kag posible pa magtuga sang flash floods ang mga mabaskog nga pag-ulan.
english: The National Weather Service also warned of more severe weather in Ohio and Tennessee where strong winds could destroy homes and heavy rains could cause flash floods.

text: Naga-preparar man ang US sa ginasiling sang government forecasters nga potensyal nga “extraordinary” 2024 Atlantic hurricane season nga magasugod sa Hunyo 1.
english: The US is also preparing for what government forecasters say is a potentially “extraordinary” 2024 Atlantic hurricane season that begins June 1.

text: Nakabalik na diri sa Pilipinas si President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos, Jr.
english: President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos, Jr. has returned to the Philippines.

text: kasunod sang tatlo ka adlaw nga official visit sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika nga nagalakip sang meeting kay US President Donald Trump.
english: following a three-day official visit to the United States of America that included a meeting with US President Donald Trump.

text: Sa iya arrival statement, nagpasalamat ang presidente sa US government kag sa mga pumuluyo sini sa pag-abi-abi sa iya kag sa delegasyon sang Pilipinas.
english: In his arrival statement, the president thanked the US government and its people for welcoming him and the Philippine delegation.

text: Ginpatpat man sini ang nangin aktibidad niya sa luwas sang pungsod lakip na ang na-istoryahan sa nagapanguna nga mga isyu kaangay sang seguridad, negosyo, kag defense cooperation.
english: He also explained his activities abroad including discussions on key issues such as security, trade, and defense cooperation.

text: Ginsugid sini nga nagpromisa ang US government sang dugang nga bulig para sa Luzon Economic Corridor initiative kag iban pa nga foreign assisted projects.
english: He said the US government has promised additional assistance for the Luzon Economic Corridor initiative and other foreign assisted projects.

text: Dugang sini, nakipagkita siya sa business leaders kag top executives sang nagkalain-lain nga mga kumpaniya kun sa diin nakakuha siya sang masobra $21 billion sa investment pledges.
english: In addition, he met with business leaders and top executives of various companies where he obtained more than $21 billion in investment pledges.

text: “We return to the Philippines with over $21 billion in investment pledges that have the potential to create thousands of direct and indirect jobs for Filipinos within our country,” pahayag sini.
english: “We return to the Philippines with over $21 billion in investment pledges that have the potential to create thousands of direct and indirect jobs for Filipinos within our country,” it said.

text: Dugang pa sang chief executive, gin-imbitar sini si Trump nga magbisita sa Pilipinas para sa Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) meetings sa 2026 sa idalom mismo sang chairmanship sang Philippine government.
english: The chief executive added that he invited Trump to visit the Philippines for the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) meetings in 2026 under the chairmanship of the Philippine government.

text: “I look forward to hosting President Trump next year to attend the ASEAN meetings under the Philippines chair, which also coincides with the commemoration of the 80th anniversary of the Philippines, US diplomatic relations and 75 years of the Mutual Defense Treaty,” dugang sa iya nga arrival statement.
english: “I look forward to hosting President Trump next year to attend the ASEAN meetings under the Philippines chair, which also coincides with the commemoration of the 80th anniversary of the Philippines, US diplomatic relations and 75 years of the Mutual Defense Treaty,” he added in his arrival statement.

text: Antes ang pahayag ni Marcos, nauna na nga ginkumpirma ni Trump nga ginbuhinan niya sang 1% ang kuntani 20% nga taripa sa Philippine exports.
english: Before Marcos' statement, Trump had earlier confirmed that he had reduced the 20% tariff on Philippine exports by 1%.

text: Ginpasalamatan man ni Marcos ang paninguha sang Estados Unidos nga masuportahan ang mga Pilipino nga apektado sang habagat.
english: Marcos also thanked the United States for its efforts to support Filipinos affected by the south.

text: Pahayag sini, magapadayon ang gobyerno sa paghatag sang bulig sa mga nagakinahanglan.
english: He said the government will continue to provide assistance to those in need.

text: “Sa gitna ng kalamidad, inuuna ng inyong pamahalaan ang kaligtasan, kalusugan at kapakanan ng bawat Pilipino.
english: “In the midst of disaster, your government prioritizes the safety, health and welfare of every Filipino.

text: Patuloy ang ating pagtugon sa epekto ng malakas na pag-ulan at pagbaha dulot ng habagat sa iba’t-ibang panig ng bansa.
english: We continue to respond to the impact of heavy rains and flooding caused by the south monsoon in different parts of the country.

text: Ang ating mga ahensya, katuwang ang mga lokal na pamahalaan ay walang patid sa pagsasagawa ng mga rescue and relief operations upang masigurong agad na makarating ang tulong sa mga pamilyang apektado,” pahayag sang presidente.
english: Our agencies, together with local government units, are working tirelessly to conduct rescue and relief operations to ensure that assistance reaches the affected families immediately,” the president said.

text: Nagpangabay man ang punong ehekutibo sa mga pumuluyo sa ginabaha nga mga lugar nga magpamati gid sa abiso sang gobyerno kag magkooperar sa awtoridad.
english: The chief executive also urged residents in flood-hit areas to heed the government's advice and cooperate with the authorities.

text: “Hinihikayat ko ang lahat na makipagtulungan sa mga otoridad, sundin ang mga babala ng panahon at agad na lumikas kung kinakailangan.
english: “I encourage everyone to cooperate with the authorities, follow the weather warnings and evacuate immediately if necessary.

text: Sa ating pagkakaisa at pagtutulungan, malalampasan natin ang pagsubok na ito,” dugang sini.#
english: With our unity and cooperation, we will overcome this challenge,” he added.

text: Iloilo City – Arestado ang tatlo ka myembro sang isa ka pamilya sa ginpatigayon nga drug buy bust operation sa Iloilo City Proper.
english: ILOILO CITY – Three members of a family were arrested in a drug buy bust operation in Iloilo City Proper.

text: Ang mga nadakpan amo sanday Roger Sabado, 59; Dexter alyas “Ar-ar” Sabado, 28; kag Romar Sabado, 35 kag lunsay mga residente sang Barangay Hipodromo, Iloilo City Proper.
english: Those arrested were Roger Sabado, 59; Dexter aka “Ar-ar” Saturday, 28; and Romar Sabado, 35 and both residents of Barangay Hipodromo, Iloilo City Proper.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Mavin Laraño, hepe sang Iloilo City Police Station 1, iya ginpahayag nga narekober sa mga durugista ang 10 tanan ka sachet sang suspected shabu, buybust money nga P2,500 kag mga drug paraphernalia.
english: Police Captain Mavin Laraño, chief of Iloilo City Police Station 1, said 10 sachets of suspected shabu, buybust money of P2,500 and drug paraphernalia were recovered from the drug pushers.

text: Suno kay Laraño, nagabug-at sang duha ka gramo ang narekober nga droga nga ginabulubanta nagabalor sang P13,600.
english: According to Laraño, the recovered drugs weighed two grams and were estimated to be worth P13,600.

text: Nahibaluan nga indi ini ang una bes nga nadakpan sang mga kapulisan ang mga suspetsado kun sa diin ginakabig ang mga ini nga high value individual.
english: It is known that this is not the first time that the police have arrested the suspects who are considered high value individuals.

text: Yara na karon ang mga ini sa kustodiya sang Iloilo City Police Station 1 kag magaatubang sang kaso nga paglapas sa Republic Act 9165 ukon ang Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.
english: The suspects are now in the custody of Iloilo City Police Station 1 and will face charges of violation of Republic Act 9165 or the Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.

text: ILOILO CITY- Gusto mo bala magpahubog apang ang beer nga imo inumon naghalin sa imburnal?
english: ILOILO CITY- Do you want to get drunk but the beer you drink comes from the sewer?

text: Didto sa Germany, ginhimo nila nga beer ang tubig nga halin mismo sa imburnal bilang pamaagi sa pag-recycle sang tubig kag batuan ang water shortage kag climate change.
english: In Germany, they turned sewage into beer as a way to recycle water and fight water shortages and climate change.

text: Suno sa kompaniya, ang purification process ang tuman ka komplikado kag ginahimo ini sa apat ka stages.
english: According to the company, the purification process is very complex and is carried out in four stages.

text: Ang resulta amo ang manamit nga brew.
english: The result is a delicious brew.

text: Sa tion nga na-treat na ang tubig, ginasimpunan ini sang barley, hops kag yeast agud mangin sampat nga beer nga ila ginatawag nga “Reuse Brew”.
english: Once the water is treated, it is mixed with barley, hops and yeast to make a delicious beer that they call “Reuse Brew”.

text: Suno sa mga nakatilaw sini, manamit ang beer nga halin sa tubig sa imburnal.
english: According to those who have tasted it, beer from sewage is delicious.

text: Gin-athag naman sang kompaniya nga wala pa ini ginabaligya sa merkado.
english: The company clarified that it is not yet sold in the market.

text: Ulihi nga nasiplatan ang sentro sang bagyo Emong sa ginabulubanta 150 km West sang Laoag City, Ilocos Norte sini nga hapon, July 23, suno sa PAGASA.
english: The epicenter of typhoon Emong was last spotted about 150 km west of Laoag City, Ilocos Norte this afternoon, July 23, according to PAGASA.

Dala sini ang maximum sustained winds nga 65 km/h malapit sa sentro kag pagmadlos nga tubtob sa 80 km/h samtang nga nagahulag pa-Southwestward sa 20 km/h.

english:
It brought maximum sustained winds of 65 km/h near the center and gusts of up to 80 km/h while moving southwestward at 20 km/h.
