text: Pagalauman naman ang mabaskog nga balod sa kadagatan nga posible maglab-ot sa tubtob sa 2.0 meters nga kataason sa southwestern seaboard sang western seaboard sang Guimaras, Negros Occidental kag Iloilo.
english: Strong waves of up to 2.0 meters are expected in the southwestern seaboard of Guimaras, Negros Occidental and Iloilo.

text: Iloilo City- Nagpatigayon sang consultative meeting ang Iloilo City Police Office sa mga resto bar managers, security officers kag bouncers agud malikawan ang insidente sang kinagamo sa syudad sang Iloilo.
english: Iloilo City- The Iloilo City Police Office held a consultative meeting with resto bar managers, security officers and bouncers to prevent incidents of violence in Iloilo City.

text: Ini matapos marekord ang duha ka mga kaso sang kinagamo sa kada bulan sa syudad.
english: This comes after recording two cases of violence every month in the city.

text: Nagtambong sa amo nga pagsinapol amo sanday Police Colonel Joeresty Coronica, director sang Iloilo City Police Office, Mr. Nestor Canong, pinuno sang Iloilo City Compliance Team, Police Lieutenant Colonel Rolando Mapile, Police Lieutenant Colonel Albert Sy, hepe sang Mandurriao Police Station, kag mga katapo sang Iloilo Bars Operators Association.
english: The meeting was attended by Police Colonel Joeresty Coronica, director of the Iloilo City Police Office, Mr. Nestor Canong, head of the Iloilo City Compliance Team, Police Lieutenant Colonel Rolando Mapile, Police Lieutenant Colonel Albert Sy, chief of Mandurriao Police Station, and members of the Iloilo Bars Operators Association.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Major Shella Mae Sangrines, spokesperson sang Iloilo City Police Office, iya ginapahayag nga nagpirma ang mga nagadumala sang establisyemento sang Affidavit of Undertaking agud magbulig nga mahilway sa kinagamo ang syudad.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Major Shella Mae Sangrines, spokesperson of the Iloilo City Police Office, said the establishment managers signed an Affidavit of Undertaking to help free the city from chaos.

text: Suno kay Sangrines, nagpasiguro ang Iloilo Bars Operators Association nga magapaidalom sang nagakaigo nga trainig ang mga security officers agud mangin aligmat sa tanan nga tion.
english: According to Sangrines, the Iloilo Bars Operators Association has assured that the security officers will undergo proper training to be alert at all times.

text: Nahibaluan nga gindiskusyunan man sa pagsinapol ang crime statistics, crime situation updates, kag mga security measures nga ipatuman sa distrito sang Mandurriao.
english: The meeting also discussed crime statistics, crime situation updates, and security measures to be implemented in Mandurriao district.

text: Ginpatunog liwat ang mga sirena sa Tel Aviv kag sa pila ka parte sang central Israel bangud sang mga rockets nga ginpalupad halin sa Rafah area sang southern Gaza.
english: Sirens were sounded again in Tel Aviv and parts of central Israel because of rockets fired from the Rafah area of ​​southern Gaza.

text: Ginkumpirma sang Israel Defense Forces nga walo ka rockets ang napalupad kag nakatabok sa Israel apang ini ang na-intercept.
english: The Israel Defense Forces confirmed that eight rockets were launched and crossed into Israel but were intercepted.

text: Ini ang labing-una nga tion nga napalupadan ang rockets ang capital city sang Israel halin sang ulihi nga bahin sang Enero subong nga 2024.
english: This is the first time rockets have been flown over Israel's capital city since late January 2024.

text: Sunod man nga gin-claim sang Hamas militants nga sila ang responsible sa rocket attack sa Tel Aviv.
english: Hamas militants later claimed responsibility for the rocket attack in Tel Aviv.

text: Suno sa ila military wing nga Izzedine al-Qassam Brigades, ini nga atake amo ang sabat sa pag-massacre sang Israel sa mga sibilyan.
english: According to its military wing Izzedine al-Qassam Brigades, this attack was in response to Israel’s massacre of civilians.

text: Gindungan ini sang militante sa military operation sang Israel sa Rafah apisar pa nga may mandu na ang International Court of Justice ukon ang pinakamataas nga korte sa United Nations nga dapat untaton na sang militar ang ila opensiba sa amo nga lugar.
english: The militants coincided with Israel's military operation in Rafah despite the International Court of Justice or the highest court in the United Nations ordering the military to stop its offensive in the area.

text: Ini nga atake sang Hamas ang natabo man antes ang ginalauman nga pagbalik sang negosasyon para sa ceasefire sa Israel-Hamas war sa masunod na kuntani nga semana.
english: The Hamas attack also came ahead of the expected resumption of negotiations for a ceasefire in the Israel-Hamas war next week.

text: Naglab-ot sa 32 ka tawo ang patay matapos nga nahulugan sang crane ang isa ka tren sa North-eastern Thailand.
english: At least 32 people have been killed after a crane overturned a train in north-eastern Thailand.

text: Naguba kag nawasak ang pila ka mga carriages sini bag-o masunog ang tren kag nahulog ang construction crane.
english: Several of its carriages were damaged and destroyed before the train caught fire and the construction crane fell.

text: May ara sang masobra 170 tanan ka mga pasahero ang nagasakay sa tren sang natabo ang insidente.
english: There were more than 170 passengers on board the train when the incident occurred.

text: Nagpatigayon sang imbestigasyon ang State Railway of Thailand kun sa diin ila ginpasiguro nga pasabton ang construction company sa responsible sa aksidente.
english: The State Railway of Thailand conducted an investigation and assured that the construction company responsible for the accident will be held accountable.

text: Hain sa Bangkok ang tren kag padulong ini kuntani sa Ubon Ratchathani sang natabo ang aksidente.
english: The train was in Bangkok and was heading to Ubon Ratchathani when the accident occurred.

text: Napatay gid ang apat ka tuig nga bata nga babaye matapos ginpahayag nga ginlumsan sa dagat sang iya iloy sa Zamboanga del Sur.
english: A four-year-old girl died after being allegedly drowned by her mother in Zamboanga del Sur.

text: Suno sa report, gindala ang bata sa dagat sang iya mismo iloy kag amay agud maligo apang wala na ini makit-an nga buhi.
english: According to the report, the child was taken to the sea by his own mother and father to bathe but he was not found alive.

text: Una nga naaresto ang amay apang ginpanginwala nga siya ang naglumos sa bata kag gintudlo naman ang iloy nga naghimo sang krimen.
english: The father was initially arrested but denied drowning the child and identified the mother as the perpetrator.

text: Ginpahayag nga may isa ka testigo nga nakakita sa ginhimo sang iloy.
english: A witness reportedly saw the mother's actions.

text: Natigayon naman nga naaresto ang iloy kag padayon nga ginaimbestigaran sang otoridad ang insidente.
english: The mother was arrested and the incident is being investigated.

text: Magabalik ang volleyball legend nga si Leila Barros sa Pilipinas para sa pag-host sang pungsod sang Men’s World Championship 2025.
english: Volleyball legend Leila Barros will return to the Philippines for the country’s hosting of the Men’s World Championship 2025.

text: Magatambong ang Brazilian superstar sa semifinals kag finals sa tournament sa Septyembre 27-28 sa Mall of Asia Arena kasunod sang personal nga imbitasyon nagikan kay Asian Volleyball Confederation kag Philippine National Volleyball Federation president Ramon “Tats” Suzara.
english: The Brazilian superstar will attend the semifinals and finals of the tournament on September 27-28 at the Mall of Asia Arena following a personal invitation from Asian Volleyball Confederation and Philippine National Volleyball Federation president Ramon “Tats” Suzara.

text: “She’s the icon who once captured the hearts of Filipino fans — and now, she’s returning for the biggest volleyball event in our nation’s history,” kabahin sang post sang tournament.
english: “She’s the icon who once captured the hearts of Filipino fans — and now, she’s returning for the biggest volleyball event in our nation’s history,” the tournament’s post read.

text: Nakahampang anay si Barros sa Manila sang 2000 FIVB Grand Prix kun sa diin nakuha sini ang suporta sang Pinoy volleyball fans.
english: Barros previously played in Manila in the 2000 FIVB Grand Prix where he won the support of Filipino volleyball fans.

text:
Kabahin man siya sang Brazilian national team nga nagdaog sang bronze medals sa 1996 kag 2000 Olympics

Sa pihak nga bahin, makasumpong naman sang Alas Pilipinas sa imbukada nga hampang sa tournament ang African powerhouse nga Tunisia apang wala ang ila star scorer nga si Wassim Ben Tara.
english:
He was also part of the Brazilian national team that won bronze medals at the 1996 and 2000 Olympics

Meanwhile, Alas Pilipinas will face African powerhouse Tunisia in the opening match of the tournament but without their star scorer Wassim Ben Tara.

text: Nagapang-42 ang Tunisia sa world rankings kag nagpang-lima sa 2023 African Championship kag nagpang-16 naman sa 2022 World Championship.
english: Tunisia is 42nd in the world rankings and finished fifth in the 2023 African Championship and 16th in the 2022 World Championship.

text: Ang Italian tactician nga nagserbe nga deputy sa 2008 Beijing Olympics bronze-medal team sang Russia nga si Camillo Placi amo ang head coach sang Tunisia samtang si Angiolino Frigoni naman ang para sa Alas Pilipinas Men.#
english: Italian tactician who served as deputy to Russia's 2008 Beijing Olympics bronze-medal team Camillo Placi is Tunisia's head coach while Angiolino Frigoni is for Alas Pilipinas Men.#

text: Maga-umpisa na sa Biyernes, Disyembre 5, ang pagpatuman sang Department of Agriculture (DA) sang maximum suggested retail price (MSRP) para sa baboy kag carrots.
english: The Department of Agriculture (DA) will start on Friday, December 5, the implementation of the maximum suggested retail price (MSRP) for pork and carrots.

text: Suno kay Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr., iga-sapinal na ang mga presyo agud mapabilin nga stable ang presyo sang mga nagapanguna nga balaklon subong nga holiday season.
english: According to Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr., the prices will be finalized to keep the prices of basic commodities stable this holiday season.

text: Gintalana ang Maximum Suggested Retail Price sa P370 kada kilo para sa pork liempo, P350 kada kilo para sa pigue kag kasim, kag P120 kada kilo para sa carrots.
english: The Maximum Suggested Retail Price is set at P370 per kilo for pork liempo, P350 per kilo for pigue and kasim, and P120 per kilo for carrots.

text: Base sa monitoring sang Department of Agriculture tubtob Disyembre 1, ang presyo sang pork ham sa Metro Manila ang yara sa P270–P390 kada kilo, samtang ang pork belly ang naglab-ot sa P320–P470 kada kilo.
english: Based on the monitoring of the Department of Agriculture as of December 1, the price of pork ham in Metro Manila is at P270-P390 per kilo, while pork belly reached P320-P470 per kilo.

text: Halos P300 gid ang nadula sa kita sang pila ka mga tricycle drivers sa syudad sang Iloilo umpisa sang nagtimbuok ang presyo sang gatong bangud sa epekto sang gyera sa Middle East.
english: Some tricycle drivers in Iloilo City have lost nearly P300 in income since the price of fuel rose due to the impact of the war in the Middle East.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Leon Manderico, nagabyahe sang tricycle sa Cuartero, Jaro, Iloilo City, iya ginpahayag nga antes ini nga semana, may limpyo pa siya nga P800 kada adlaw.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Leon Manderico, a tricycle driver in Cuartero, Jaro, Iloilo City, said that before this week, he had a clean P800 per day.

text: Apang subong suno sa iya, P500 kada adlaw na lang ang iya madala pauli.
english: But now, he said, he can only bring home P500 a day.

text: Sa baylo nga maglibot para nga makapangita sang pasahero, nagapundo na lang sila suno sa iya kag nagahulat sang pasahero agud nga makakinot sa gatong.
english: Instead of going around to find passengers, he said, they just stop and wait for passengers to save fuel.

text: Matandaan nga gin-umpisahan sang Martes ang pagpahat-pahat sang pagpatuman sang big-time oil price hike para sa gatong.
english: It can be recalled that the implementation of the big-time oil price hike for fuel began on Tuesday.

text: Sa gasolina, may pagsaka nga P7 tubtub sa P13 kada litro sa isa ka semana.
english: For gasoline, there is an increase of P7 to P13 per liter in a week.

text: Ini na ang ika-siyam nga sunod-sunod nga semana nga pagtaas sa gasolina.
english: This is the ninth consecutive week of gasoline increases.

text: May ginalantaw pa gid nga big-time price hike sa masunod nga semana ilabi na nga wala pa nagatahaw ang tension sa Middle East.
english: Another big-time price hike is expected next week especially as tensions in the Middle East have not yet subsided.

text: INDI gid man problema ang basura kon matipon naton ini sa isa ka lugar nga indi maka-perhwisyo, ukon mamedyosan pa gani nga mapuslan.
english: GARBAGE is not a problem if we can collect it in a place that is not harmful, or even useful.

text: Pero kon nagalinapta gid lang ini bisan diin lang, daku ini nga perhwisyo.
english: But if it's just spreading everywhere, it's a big problem.

text: Luas nga malaw-ay tan-awon, ang iban sini – ang mga non-biodegrable, ukon indi ma-decompose nga bagay – segurado ma-problema pa kita sa halit nga mahimo sini.
english: Besides looking ugly, some of these – the non-biodegradable, or non-decomposable substances – are sure to cause us problems with the harm they can cause.

text: Katulad abe kon mabangdan ini sang pagbara sang mga kanal kon tig-ululan kag magdulot sang baha sa dalanon nga kinahanglan pa gani sulsugon kay didto na sa sulod sang drainage pipe nagagutok.
english: For example, if it causes blockage of canals during the rainy season and causes flooding on the road that even needs to be cleaned because it is already inside the drainage pipe is crowded.

text: Labi na gid seguro kon ang basura mga plastic materials nga nagalinutaw lang sa mga sapa kag suba kay ginapanghabyog ta lang sa likud balay ukon sa tubig sa idalom sang taytay.
english: Especially if the garbage is plastic materials that float in rivers and streams because we just throw them in the backyard or in the water under the bridge.

text: Nga  dayon  maanod ini sa lawod kag mapadpad sa kon diin nga baybayon tubtub makalab-ut pa gani sa iban nga mga pungsod kon diin maka-perhwisyo pa ang aton basura nga plastic sa ila.
english: That it will then be washed away in the sea and washed ashore until it reaches other countries where our plastic waste can harm them.

text: Samtang ang iban nga malugdang sa idalom sang dagat makaon ini sang mga isda kag iban nga marine animals, nga tungod indi matunaw sa ila tiyan magadulot ini sang pagmasakit nila kag ikamatay pa.
english: While others that sink to the bottom of the sea are eaten by fish and other marine animals, which because they cannot be digested in their stomachs can cause them to get sick and die.

text: Ang lain pa gid kay kon ining mga plastic materials sa lakat sang panahon amat-amat nga mapihak-pihak (break) sa pinakagagmay nga bahin (microplastics), pwede pa maupod ini sa pagkaon sang tawo kag sa pagpanughot-nughot sini sa madamo nga bahin sang aton kalawasan makadala ini sing balatian sa aton nga pwede ta man ikamatay.
english: Another thing is that if these plastic materials over time gradually break into the smallest pieces (microplastics), they can be included in human food and in many parts of our body it can bring diseases to us that can kill us.

text:
***

Tungod sa sining daku nga problema sa mga plastic products, katulad sang mga plastic bags, food wrappers, single-use straws, water bottles kag iban pa nagtililipon ang mga 45 ka stakeholders sadtong Marso 9, 2022 sa siyudad sang Iloilo.
english:
***

Because of this big problem with plastic products, such as plastic bags, food wrappers, single-use straws, water bottles and others, about 45 stakeholders gathered on March 9, 2022 in Iloilo City.

text: Ginsugilanunan nila kon ano ang mahimo parti sa aton problema sa plastic products sa siyudad, nga problema man sang iban nga mga lugar kag pungsod.
english: They discussed what can be done about our problem of plastic products in the city, which is also a problem in other places and countries.

text: Diri gintumod nila ang problema sang plastic waste nga ginahaboy lang sang mga pumuluyo sa Iloilo River, sa mga tributaries sini kag higad sang dagat.
english: Here they pointed out the problem of plastic waste that is thrown by the residents in the Iloilo River, its tributaries and the seashore.

text: Sa subong, ang siyudad may average per capita (kada pumuluyo) generation sang basura nga 0.88 kg.
english: Currently, the city has an average per capita (per capita) waste generation of 0.88 kg.

text: kada adlaw, ukon may kabug-usan nga 500,000 kg.
english: per day, or a total of 500,000 kg.

text: kada adlaw nga solid waste.
english: per day solid waste.

text: Mga 63% sini ang ginakolekta sang siyudad, samtang mga 37% sini ang indi ma-manage, nga ma-recover lang paagi sa informal waste recovery ukon mahaboy lang sa palibut.
english: About 63% of it is collected by the city, while about 37% of it is unmanageable, being recovered only through informal waste recovery or thrown away.

text: Samtang, ang indi ma-recover nga plastic waste sa siyudad nagalab-ut sa mga 93,500 kg.
english: Meanwhile, the unrecoverable plastic waste in the city amounts to about 93,500 kg.

text: kada adlaw.
english: daily.

text: Ining consultation workshop gintukod sang Developing Plastic Waste-free Cities program nga jointly gina-implementar sang Alliance to End Plastic Waste and ICLEI – Local Governments for Sustainability Southeast Asia Secretariat.
english: This consultation workshop was established by the Developing Plastic Waste-free Cities program jointly implemented by the Alliance to End Plastic Waste and ICLEI – Local Governments for Sustainability Southeast Asia Secretariat.

text: Lakip diri sa ginsugilanunan ang “Generation, Collection and Transport, Sorting, Processing, and Recycling, Disposal, and Institutional sectors” kon paano ma-solbar ining problema sa plastic wastes, nga indi lang sa siyudad kundi sa iban nga mga lugar tubtub sa iban nga bahin sang kalibutan.
english: The discussion included how to solve the problem of plastic waste, which is not only in the city but also in other places to other parts of the world.

text: Ang end-goal sini amo ang pagpatuman kon paano ma-reduce kag ma-recycle ining mga plastic wastes, nga mapunggan ang pagduging sini kag kon paano ini mapuslan.
english: Its end-goal is to implement how to reduce and recycle these plastic wastes, prevent their accumulation and how to use them.

text: Kag ma-kwartahan pa gani!
english: And even make money!

text: In fact, ginahimo naman ini sang Iloilo provincial government sa idalom sang ila 4Bs nga programa – “Basura, Baylo, Baligya, Bangko”.
english: In fact, the Iloilo provincial government is doing this under its 4Bs program – “Garbage, Exchange, Trade, Bank”.

text: Tungod ugaling kay daku nga puhunan (investment) ang kinahanglan sa pagpatukod sang isa ka plastic recycling plant, madamo sang potential investors ang nagpang-alag-ag nga kapitalan ini.
english: However, because of the large investment required to build a plastic recycling plant, many potential investors were reluctant to invest in it.

text: Well, pwede man ini tukuron sang gobyerno diri sa siyudad paagi sa pag-subsidize sang sining proyekto, kon diin ang balik-kita sa ma-producir nga mga produkto – plastic chairs, por ejemplo, kag iban pa nga kagamitan kag gadgets – pwede malimitahan sa recovery cost ukon minimum profit lang sang recycling business.
english: Well, the government can also build it here in the city by subsidizing this project, where the return on the products produced – plastic chairs, for example, and other equipment and gadgets – can be limited to the recovery cost or minimum profit of the recycling business.

text: Pwede, indi bala?/PN
english: You can, can't you?/PN

text: Ginduso ang isa ka resolution sa Kamara agud i-nominate sa Order of National Artists ang Comedy King nga si Rodolfo “Dolphy” Quizon, Sr.
english: A resolution was moved in the House to nominate to the Order of National Artists Comedy King Rodolfo “Dolphy” Quizon, Sr.

text: Si Manila 3rd District Rep.
english: Manila 3rd District Rep.

text: Joel Chua ang nag-file sang House Resolution No.
english: Joel Chua filed House Resolution No.

text: 41 kahapon, Hulyo 9, isa ka adlaw antes ang 13th death anniversary sang anay aktor.
english: 41 yesterday, July 9, a day before the 13th death anniversary of the former actor.

text: Nakasulat sa resolution ang “magnificent body of work” ni Dolphy kag ang iya pagtib-ong sa Filipino values para sa tanan nga henerasyon sang mga Pinoy.
english: The resolution states Dolphy's “magnificent body of work” and his commitment to Filipino values ​​for all generations of Filipinos.

text: Ang National Artist amo ang pinakamataas nga national recognition nga ginahatag sa mga indibidwal nga may daku nga kontribusyon sa arts and culture sang Pilipinas.
english: The National Artist is the highest national recognition given to individuals who have made significant contributions to the arts and culture of the Philippines.

text: Sa amo nga resolution, ginahingyo ang House committees on Creative Industries kag ang Basic Education & Culture nga magpatigayon sang hearings kag iban pa nga mga tikang agud pormal nga ma-nominate si Dolphy sa National Commission for Culture and the Arts.
english: The resolution urges the House committees on Creative Industries and the Basic Education & Culture to conduct hearings and other steps to formally nominate Dolphy to the National Commission for Culture and the Arts.

text: 2012 sang nagtaliwan si Dolphy bangud sa multiple organ failure.
english: 2012 when Dolphy passed away due to multiple organ failure.

text:
Popular siya bilang “King of Comedy” nga nakit-an sa tuman ka damo nga iconic shows kaangay sang long-running shows nga “John en Marsha” kag “Home Along da Riles” amo man sa mga pelikula nga “Omeng Satanasia” kag “Markova Comfort Gay.”

Masobra anum ka dekada ang ginlawig sang iya karera sa entertainment industry bilang komedyante, indi lamang sa telebisyon kag sa pelikula kundi mangin sa entablado kag sa radio.#
english:
He is popular as the “King of Comedy” who has been seen in so many iconic shows like the long-running shows “John en Marsha” and “Home Along da Riles” as well as in the movies “Omeng Satanasia” and “Markova Comfort Gay.”

His career in the entertainment industry as a comedian has spanned more than six decades, not only on television and in film but also on stage and radio.

text: Nasamaran ang 12 ka mga tawo sang naka-eksperyensya sang turbulence ang Qatar Airways flight nga halin sa Doha, Qatar kag pakadto sa Dublin, Ireland.
english: Twelve people were injured when a Qatar Airways flight from Doha, Qatar to Dublin, Ireland, experienced turbulence.

text: Sa statement sang Dublin Airport, anum ka mga pasahero kag anum ka crew ang injured kag walo diri ang gindala sa ospital kasunod sang inisyal nga assessment.
english: According to a statement from Dublin Airport, six passengers and six crew members were injured and eight of them were taken to hospital following initial assessment.

text: Ginsaad man nga natabo ang turbulence sa Qatar Airways flight QR107 sang yara ini nagalupad sa hurisdiksyon sang Turkey.
english: It was also promised that the turbulence occurred on Qatar Airways flight QR107 while it was flying in Turkish jurisdiction.

text: Ginkumpirma naman sang Qatar Airways nga safe ang ila nga paghugpa sa Dublin kag ginpasalig man nga hatagan sang assistance ang mga pasahero kag crew samtang nga magasunod ang internal investigation.
english: Qatar Airways confirmed that they landed safely in Dublin and assured that they will provide assistance to passengers and crew while an internal investigation follows.

text: Ini nga insidente ang natabo pila ka adlaw matapos nasamaran man ang masobra 100 ka tawo kag napatay ang isa ka British national bangud sa severe turbulence sa isa ka byahe sang Singapore Airlines nga halin sa London.
english: The incident came days after more than 100 people were injured and a British national was killed in severe turbulence on a Singapore Airlines flight from London.

english: Philippine National Police (PNP) chief Police General Nicolas Torre III accepted the challenge of Davao City Acting Mayor Baste Duterte to fight.

text: MANILA– Mahimo makapadayun sang operasyon ang food industry apisar nga 50% lang ang kadamuon sang ila trabahador bangud sa pagpatuman sang Enhanced Community Quarantine.
english: MANILA – The food industry can continue operations despite only 50% of its workers due to the implementation of Enhanced Community Quarantine.

text: Suno kay Cabinet Secretary Karlo Nograles, ang mga establisimento nga yara sa patag sang produksyon ang ginalakipan sang  manufacturing, packaging, processing kag lakip na diri ang sa food distribution.
english: According to Cabinet Secretary Karlo Nograles, the establishments in the field of production include manufacturing, packaging, processing and including food distribution.

text: Ginpahayag ni Nograles nga ang Department of Trade and Idustry ang otorisado nga mag-apruba sang temporaryo nga pagdugang sang workforce apang nagakinahanglan nga mag-observe sang istrikto nga social distancing.
english: Nograles said the Department of Trade and Industry is authorized to approve temporary increases in workforce but requires strict observance of social distancing.

text: Liwat man nga nagpanawagan si Nograles sa mga food industry firms sa pungsod nga maghatag sang akomodasyon para sa  ila mga trabahante.
english: Nograles also once again called on food industry firms in the country to provide accommodation for their workers.

text: Arevalo, Iloilo City- Ginkastigo sang duha ka mga barangay officials ang isa ka lalaki matapos nangawat sang duha ka hakop nga bugas sa Barangay Sto.
english: Arevalo, Iloilo City- Two barangay officials beat up a man after he stole two handfuls of rice in Barangay Sto.

text: Domingo, Arevalo, Iloilo City.
english: Domingo, Arevalo, Iloilo City.

text: Ginapahayag nga may problema sa paminsaron ang nangawat nga lalaki.
english: The robber is said to have a mental problem.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Chief Master Sergeant Mark Olano, imbestigador sang Arevalo Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga gilayon nagresponde ang mga pulis sa lugar, apang nadakop na ini sang mga opisyal.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Chief Master Sergeant Mark Olano, investigator of the Arevalo Police Station, said police immediately responded to the scene, but the officers arrested him.

text: Suno kay Olano, sang ginapangayuan na sang impormasyon ang lalaki nahanungod sa naagom nga mga lagob kag narekober nga bugas, diri na kag natukiban nga wala ini sa husto nga paminsaron, rason nga ginbuy-an nalang ini.
english: According to Olano, when the man was asked for information about the injuries and rice recovered, it was discovered that he was not in the right mind, so he was released.

text: Ginpahayag sang natungdan nga indi magpasaka sang kaso ang barangay bangud sa kondisyon sini.
english: He said the barangay will not file a case because of its condition.

text: Sa subong, kaupod na sang lalaki ang iya pamilya.
english: The man is now with his family.

text: Madamo naman ang nagpakamalaot sa mga opisyal bangud sa ila pagkastigo sa amo nga lalaki.
english: Many others condemned the officers for beating the man.

text: Samtang, nagpanindugan ang Punong Barangay sang Sto.
english: Meanwhile, the Punong Barangay of Sto.

text: Domingo, Arevalo, Iloilo City nga self-defense ang natabo rason nga ginkastigo sang duha ka mga barangay officials ang kawatan.
english: Domingo, Arevalo, Iloilo City that the thief was beaten by two barangay officials.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Punong Barangay Carolyn Selorio, iya ginpahayag nga may yara sang binangon ang amo nga lalaki.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Punong Barangay Carolyn Selorio said the man had a binangon.

text: Suno kay Selorio, didto na kag ginkastigo sang duha ka barangay officials ang lalaki.
english: According to Selorio, the man was beaten by two barangay officials.

text: Ginpahayag sang natungdan nga kun nahibaluan lang nila nga may problema sa paminsaron ang lalaki, wala na nila ini ginsakit.
english: He said that if they had known that the man had a mental problem, they would not have hurt him.

text: Ang duha ka opisyal nga ginpahayag nagsakit sa amo nga lalaki amo sanday Kagawad Carleone Gison kag si Romeo Selorio nga bana sang punong barangay.
english: The two officials who allegedly assaulted the man were Kagawad Carleone Gison and Romeo Selorio, husband of the barangay captain.

text: Nagmandu ang pinakamataas nga korte sang United Nations (UN) nga untaton na gilayon sang Israel ang military operations sini sa Rafah — ang syudad sa Gaza kun sa diin minilyon ka Palestinians ang nagapuyo humalin sang nagtal-as sila sa ila kaugalingon nga mga puluy-an bangud sa Israel-Hamas war.
english: The United Nations (UN) highest court has ordered Israel to immediately cease its military operations in Rafah — the Gaza city where millions of Palestinians have been living since they were displaced by the Israel-Hamas war.

text: Ini nga hulag sang International Court of Justice (ICJ) nga naka-base sa The Hague ang kasunod man sang aplikasyon sang South Africa kun sa diin gin-akusahan sini ang Israel nga nagakomiter na sang genocide.
english: The move by the International Court of Justice (ICJ) based in The Hague also follows an application by South Africa where it accused Israel of committing genocide.

text: Lakip man sa ginmandu sang korte amo ang paghatag sang access sa UN body nga magakadto sa Gaza agud nga imbestigaran ang genocide nga ginaalegar nagakatabo na sa lugar.
english: The court also ordered access to the UN body that will go to Gaza to investigate the genocide that is allegedly taking place in the area.

text: Ginsulit man sa ruling sang korte nga dapat tugutan sang Israel ang pagsulod sang basic services kag humanitarian aid para sa mga tawo sa Gaza.
english: The court ruling also reiterated that Israel should allow the entry of basic services and humanitarian aid for the people of Gaza.

text: Ini nga order sang World Court ang na-adoptar sang panel sang 15 ka judges sa 13-2 nga boto kag duha lamang ang nagpamatok nga amo ang Uganda kag mismo ang Israel.
english: The World Court's order was adopted by a panel of 15 judges in a 13-2 vote with only two objections, Uganda and Israel itself.

text: Makabig nga final and binding ang desisyon sini nga korte, apang pila ka beses naman ini nga ginbalewala sang Israel bangud wala man sang enforcement powers ang top UN court.
english: The court's decision is final and binding, but Israel has repeatedly ignored it because the top UN court does not have enforcement powers.

text: Sa sini nga landmark ruling, nagsabat lamang ang Israel nga isa ini ka “public suicide” kag nanindugan pa ang amo nga pungsod nga wala sang bisan ano nga gahum sa kalibutan nga makatulod sa ila nga untaton ang ila operasyon.
english: In this landmark ruling, Israel only responded that it was a “public suicide” and insisted that no power in the world could force them to stop their operation.

text: Matandaan nga ginsuguran sang Israel ang ila nga opensiba sa Rafah halos tatlo ka semana na ang nagligad sa tuyo nga dalayon nga papason ang battalion sang Hamas sa area.
english: It can be recalled that Israel launched its offensive in Rafah nearly three weeks ago with the aim of permanently wiping out the Hamas battalion in the area.

text: Nagapati man sila nga may Israeli hostages pa sa amo nga lugar.
english: They also believe there are still Israeli hostages in the area.

text: Ginsiling man sang UN nga masobra 800,000 Palestinians na nagbiya na sa Rafah halin sang nagsugod ang opensiba.
english: The UN also said that more than 800,000 Palestinians have left Rafah since the offensive began.

text: Ini nga atake sa Rafah ang kabahin gihapon sang pagtimalos sang Israel sa Hamas nga amo ang una nga nag-atake sa southern Israel sang Oktubre 7,2024 kun sa diin 1,200 ka tawo ang napatay lakip ang apat ka Pinoy samtang 252 naman ang ginbihag.
english: The attack in Rafah is part of Israel's revenge against Hamas, which first attacked southern Israel on October 7, 2024, killing 1,200 people including four Filipinos while taking 252 captives.

text: Sa pagbalos sang mga Israelinhon, masobra na sa 35,800 ka Palestinhon ang napatay suno sa Hamas-run health ministry apang nagapadayon gihapon tubtub subong.
english: In Israeli retaliation, more than 35,800 Palestinians have been killed according to the Hamas-run health ministry but are still ongoing.

text: Nadismaya si Vice President Sara Duterte sa estilo sang Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) sa pag-anunsyo sang suspensyon sang klase kag trabaho sa tion sang malain nga panahon.
english: Vice President Sara Duterte is disappointed with the style of the Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) in announcing the suspension of classes and work during bad weather.

text: Ginpahayag ni VP Sara nga dapat mangin propesyonal ang DILG, ilabi na sa pagpamuno ni Secretary Jonvic Remulla, kag indi paghimuon nga daw kaladlawan ang mga anunsyo nga ginapalab-ot sa publiko.
english: VP Sara said the DILG should be professional, especially under the leadership of Secretary Jonvic Remulla, and not make fun of the announcements made to the public.

text: Ginpaanggid pa ni Duterte ang ginahimo sang DILG sa mga pahayag sang Office of the Vice President (OVP), kag gintumod nga bilang kabahin sang institusyon sang gobyerno, may responsibilidad sila nga mangin seryoso sa tanan nga impormasyon nga ginahatag sa katawhan.
english: Duterte compared the DILG's actions to the statements of the Office of the Vice President (OVP), and pointed out that as part of a government institution, they have a responsibility to be serious about all information given to the public.

text: Madumduman nga damo sa mga netizens ang nagpakita sang kasubo kag pagkadismaya sa paagi sang DILG sa paggamit sang mga tinaga nga daw indi angay, ilabi na sa tion sang kalamidad.
english: It can be recalled that many netizens expressed their sadness and disappointment with the way the DILG used words that seem inappropriate, especially during times of disaster.

text: Angot sini, nagpangayo na si Remulla sang pasaylo sa publiko kag ginsiling nga ginhimo lamang nila ini agud nga mapamag-an ang sitwasyon.
english: In this regard, Remulla has already apologized to the public and said that they only did this to ease the situation.

text: Siyam ka mga tawo ang napatay kag 121 ang napilasan sang nag-collapse ang stage sa Mexico kadungan sang isa ka campaign rally para sa presidential candidate nga si Jorge Álvarez Máynez.
english: Nine people were killed and 121 injured when a stage collapsed in Mexico during a campaign rally for presidential candidate Jorge Álvarez Máynez.

text: Natabo ini sa northeastern city sang San Pedro Garza García kun sa diin ang ginatudlo nga rason amo ang hinali nga mabaskog nga hangin.
english: The incident occurred in the northeastern city of San Pedro Garza García where the reason is believed to be sudden strong winds.

text: Ginkumpirma naman ni Governor Samuel García Sepulveda nga isa ka bata ang nalakip sa mga napatay, samtang ang iban naman nga pilason ang stable na kag ang iban nga nagapaidalom sa surgery.
english: Governor Samuel García Sepulveda confirmed that one child was among the dead, while the other injured are stable and others are undergoing surgery.

text: Sa nagguwa nga footages, sang nag-collapse ang stage kag natumba ang daku nga video screen nga nahulog sa entablado kag sa audience area rason nga nagkinaran-karan ang mga tawo.
english: According to the footage, when the stage collapsed and the large video screen fell on the stage and the audience area, people were shocked.

text: Kasunod sini, ginpahibalo ni Álvarez Máynez nga suspendido anay ang tanan nga campaign activities.
english: Subsequently, Álvarez Máynez announced that all campaign activities are temporarily suspended.

text: Ini nga 38-anyos nga congressman ang nagarepresentar sa center-left Citizens’ Movement party kag nahingadlan nga party candidate sang nagligad nga Enero sang nag-drop out si García Sepúlveda nga nagbalik naman sa iya katungdanan bilang governor.
english: The 38-year-old congressman represents the center-left Citizens' Movement party and was named party candidate last January when García Sepúlveda dropped out and returned to his post as governor.

text: Hunyo 2 ang eleksyon sa Mexico apang napatung-an sang kalakasan kaangay sang political violence kag assassinations.#
english: Mexico held elections on June 2 but was marred by violence such as political violence and assassinations.

text: Nagapasalig ang Department of Labor and Employment nga may yara sila sang natalana nga P1.2 bilyon nga bulig para sa mga empleyado nga apektado sang Coronavirus Disease 2019.
english: The Department of Labor and Employment assures that it has a scheduled P1.2 billion assistance for employees affected by Coronavirus Disease 2019.

text: 250,000 ka mga empleyado ang mangin benepisyaryo sang nasambit nga pondo sa diin ang tagsa sa ila mahimo makabaton sang P5,000 anuman ang ila nga employment status.
english: 250,000 employees will be beneficiaries of the said fund where each of them can receive P5,000 regardless of their employment status.

text: Suno sa Department of Labor and Employment, indi mahimo nga piliton sang employer ang ila mga employees nga magsulod sa trabaho sa tion sang enhance community quarantine.
english: According to the Department of Labor and Employment, employers cannot force their employees to come to work during the enhanced community quarantine.

text: Nagpasalig man ang DOLE nga mahatagan sang bulig ang mga informal workers sa ipatuman nga emergency employement program sang nasambit nga ahensya.
english: The DOLE also promised to provide assistance to informal workers in the agency's emergency employment program.

text: Sa diin ipaidalom sa programa nga “Barangay ko.
english: Where under the program “Barangay ko.

text: Bahay ko” ang mga apektado nga informal workers sa pihak sang ginpatuman nga enhance community quarantine.
english: Bahay ko” to the affected informal workers despite the implementation of enhanced community quarantine.

text: Naobserbahan na ang phenomenon nga ginatawag nga “saot sang duwa ka bagyo” ukon Fujiwhara Effect, kun sa diin nagabutungay kag naga-interact ang duha ka bagyo nga yara sa sulod sang Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR).
english: The phenomenon called the “dance of two typhoons” or Fujiwhara Effect has been observed, where two typhoons within the Philippine Area of ​​Responsibility (PAR) meet and interact.

text: Suno sa mga meteorologist, ang bagyo nga Emong indi pa makagwa sa PAR bangud sa pagbutong ukon interaction sini kay bagyo Dante.
english: According to meteorologists, Typhoon Emong has not yet left the PAR due to its interaction with Typhoon Dante.

text: Possible nga magatenir pa si Emong sa West Philippine Sea sa sulod sang pila ka adlaw samtang may posibilidad nga lagson pa niya si Dante padulong sa Ilocos Region sa Byerner kag sa Extreme Northern Luzon subong nga weekend.
english: Emong is likely to stay in the West Philippine Sea for a few days while there is a possibility that he will chase Dante towards the Ilocos Region in Byerner and Extreme Northern Luzon this weekend.

text: Bangud sini nga pag-uyat sang duwa ka bagyo, ginpahibalo sang PAGASA nga posible ang mabaskog nga pag-ulan sa madamo nga parte sang Luzon ang ginapabaskog pa gid sang Habagat (Southwest Monsoon) nga ginabatak sang duwa ka bagyo.
english: Due to the collision of the two typhoons, PAGASA announced that heavy rains are possible in many parts of Luzon, exacerbated by the Southwest Monsoon, which is being driven by the two typhoons.

text: Ginaengganyo ang publiko nga magmonitor sa mga balita kag advisory halin sa PAGASA kag mangin handa sa mga posible nga pagbaha ukon landslide sa mga delikado nga lugar.
english: The public is encouraged to monitor news and advisories from PAGASA and be prepared for possible floods or landslides in dangerous areas.

text: Iloilo – May yara na sang duha ka persons of interest ang Estancia Municipal Station sa pagpangluthang patay sa isa ka lalaki sa sulod sang iya balay.
english: Iloilo – The Estancia Municipal Station has two persons of interest in the shooting death of a man inside his house.

text: Ang napatay amo si Zaldy Cabuyoc, 55, kag residente sang Barangay Botongon, Estancia, Iloilo.
english: The deceased was identified as Zaldy Cabuyoc, 55, resident of Barangay Botongon, Estancia, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Arniel Buraga, hepe sang Estancia Municipal Station, iya ginpahayag nga padayon sa gihapon ang ginpatigayon nga hot pursuit operation sang mga kapulisan agud madakpan ang mga suspek.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain Arniel Buraga, chief of the Estancia Municipal Station, said the police are still conducting a hot pursuit operation to arrest the suspects.

text: Ginapahayag nga ang duha ka mga persons of interest ang pangayaw sa lugar kag ginakabig nga isolated incident ang natabo.
english: The two persons of interest are reportedly strangers to the area and the incident is considered an isolated incident.

text: Suno kay Buraga, posible nga pagbinauisay sa lupa kag balay ang motibo sa pagpangluthang sang mga suspetsado.
english: According to Buraga, it is possible that a dispute over land and house was the motive behind the shooting.

text: Ginahulat man sang Estancia PNP ang resulta sa nangin imbestigasyon nagikan sa Scene of the Crime Operation.
english: Estancia PNP is also awaiting the results of the investigation from the Scene of the Crime Operation.

text: Nagalab-ot sa 1.5 million bags sang palay ang yara subong sa mga warehouses sa Western Visayas.
english: A total of 1.5 million bags of rice are currently in warehouses in Western Visayas.

text: May yara sang 21 ka mga warehouses sang National Food Authority sa rehiyon 6.
english: There are 21 National Food Authority warehouses in Region 6.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Jasmin Lintag, Regional Manager sang National Food Authority, iya ginpahayag nga bastante sa bugas ang Western Visayas kag ginakabig ini nga source region sa mga lugar nga wala sang palay production.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Jasmin Lintag, Regional Manager of the National Food Authority, said Western Visayas is sufficient in rice and is considered a source region in areas without rice production.

text: Kaangay na lang suno sa iya sa Region 7 sa diin naghatag sang 23,000 bags sang bugas ang NFA Region 6 kag may dugang nga 31,000 bags nga ihatag antes magtakop ang tuig 2025.
english: He said it is similar to Region 7 where NFA Region 6 distributed 23,000 bags of rice and an additional 31,000 bags will be distributed before the end of 2025.

text: Sa Western Visayas sa subong, may yara sang 105,000 bags sang bugas sa 50 kilograms.
english: In Western Visayas, there are currently 105,000 bags of rice in 50 kilograms.

text: Kun lantawon suno sa iya, yara sa 60 tubtob 85 percent ang unod sang mga bodega sa rehiyon.
english: He said the warehouses in the region are 60 to 85 percent full.

text: Nangin isa na ka bagyo ang isa pa ka low pressure area (LPA).
english: Another low pressure area (LPA) has become a typhoon.

text: Suno sa Pagasa, duha na ang malain nga panahon sa sulod sang Philippine area of responsibility (PAR) subong nga adlaw.
english: According to Pagasa, there are two severe weather events within the Philippine area of ​​responsibility (PAR) today.

text: Ginalakipan ini sang bagyo Dante nga yara sa 800 km sidlangan sang Extreme Northern Luzon.
english: It is covered by Typhoon Dante which is 800 km east of Extreme Northern Luzon.

text: Samtang ang ikaduha amo ang bagyo Emong nga malapit sa nakatungdan sang Babuyan Island.
english: The second is Typhoon Emong near Babuyan Island.

text: Magluwas diri, nagapabilin sa gihapon ang tyansa sang iban nga LPA nga magbaskog sa masunod nga inadlaw.
english: In addition, there is still a chance that other LPAs will strengthen in the coming days.

text: Ang isa nga weather disturbance ang ginalauman man nga maghurma bilang bagyo sa sulod sang masunod nga 24 oras.
english: One weather disturbance is also expected to develop into a typhoon within the next 24 hours.

text: Ginkaakig sang Israel ang gin-anunsyo sang Ireland, Spain kag Norway nga kilalahon nila ang Palestine bilang isa ka state.
english: Israel was outraged by the announcement by Ireland, Spain and Norway that they would recognize Palestine as a state.

text: Ini nga tikang sang tatlo ka pungsod ang ginhimo agud nga madayon na ang ceasefire sa Israel-Hamas war sa Gaza kag mapaguwa na ang mga bihag.
english: The move by the three countries was taken to ensure a ceasefire in the Israeli-Hamas war in Gaza and the release of the hostages.

text: Para kay Norwegian Prime Minister Jonas Gahr Store, ang nagaisahanon nga political solution sa away sang Israelis kag Palestinians amo nga kilalahon sila bilang separado nga mga estado nga nagakabuhi nga may kalinong kag seguridad.
english: For Norwegian Prime Minister Jonas Gahr Store, the only political solution to the conflict between Israelis and Palestinians is to recognize them as separate states living in peace and security.

text: Nagpanginit naman ang Israel kag nagsiling nga ang pagkilala sa Palestinian state ang katumbas lamang sa pag-award sa Hamas militants nga nag-atake sa Israel sang Oktubre 7,2023 nga amo ang panugod sang gyera sa Gaza.
english: Israel has been angry and said that recognizing the Palestinian state is only equivalent to awarding the Hamas militants who attacked Israel on October 7, 2023, which was the beginning of the war in Gaza.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, nalipay naman ang Palestine sa desisyon sang tatlo ka nasyon.
english: Palestine, on the other hand, is pleased with the decision of the three countries.

text: Nahibaluan nga 144 sa 193 member states sang United Nations ang nagakilala sa Palestine bilang state lakip na ang Russia, China, kag India.
english: It is known that 144 of the 193 member states of the United Nations recognize Palestine as a state including Russia, China, and India.

text: Kumpirmado nga may lima ka Pilipino nga nakasakay sa eroplano sang Singapore Airlines nga naka-eksperyensya sang mabaskog nga turbulence nga rason sang kamatayon sang isa ka British national.
english: Five Filipinos were confirmed on board a Singapore Airlines plane that experienced strong turbulence that caused the death of a British national.

text: Suno sa kumpaniya, kabug-usan nga 211 ka mga pasahero ang sakay sini kag 18 ka crew.
english: According to the company, a total of 211 passengers and 18 crew members were on board.

text: Na-identify ang ginbawian sang kabuhi nga amo ang 73-anyos nga pasahero nga posible nagsuprer sang heart attack.
english: The deceased was identified as a 73-year-old passenger who may have suffered a heart attack.

text: Sa una nga impormasyon halin sa airlines, 30 ka mga pasahero ang nasamaran apang sa latest nga update sang ospital, nagsaka ang numero sa 71 kun sa diin nalakip ang mga citizens sang Malaysia, the United Kingdom, New Zealand, Spain, the United States kag Ireland.
english: According to initial information from the airlines, 30 passengers were injured but in the latest update of the hospital, the number rose to 71 which includes citizens of Malaysia, the United Kingdom, New Zealand, Spain, the United States and Ireland.

text: Kumpirmado man nga may lima ka Pilipino sa flight.
english: It was also confirmed that there were five Filipinos on the flight.

text: Anum sa ila ang may severe injuries nga mas manubo sa nauna nga report sang kumpaniya nga pito gid ang critically injured bangud sa insidente.
english: Six of them sustained severe injuries, which is lower than the company's previous report that seven were critically injured in the incident.

text: “Singapore Airlines offers its deepest condolences to the family of the deceased.
english: “Singapore Airlines offers its deepest condolences to the family of the deceased.

text: We deeply apologize for the traumatic experience that our passengers and crew members suffered on this flight,” pahayag sang airline kag nagpasalig nga ihatag ang tanan nga nagakaigu nga assistance sa mga biktima.
english: We deeply apologize for the traumatic experience that our passengers and crew members suffered on this flight,” the airline said and promised to provide all necessary assistance to the victims.

text: Nahibaluan nga nagaserbe ang cabin crew sang breakfast sang na-encounter ang turbulence sa Boeing 777-300ER plane rason nga nag-request ang mga piloto sang emergency landing sa Bangkok, Thailand 3:45p.m. local time.
english: The cabin crew was serving breakfast when the Boeing 777-300ER plane encountered turbulence, prompting the pilots to request an emergency landing in Bangkok, Thailand at 3:45p.m. local time.

text: Pagkahugpa sang eroplano, nakit-an nga kalabanan sa mga pasahero ang nagreklamo sa pagkabali sang ila nga mga butkon, napilasan kag nabagrasan, kag nagkalabunggo ang ulo.
english: After the plane landed, it was found that most of the passengers complained of broken arms, bruises and bruises, and head injuries.

text: Sa mga laragway sa sulod sang eroplano, nakit-an man ang gas masks kag panels nga nagakabit sa ceiling samtang nagalalapta naman ang items sang hand luggage.
english: In the pictures inside the plane, gas masks and panels were also seen hanging from the ceiling while items of hand luggage were scattered.

text: Suno naman sa aviation tracking site nga FlightRadar24, base sa nakit-an sa data, ang turbulence sa Singapore Airlines flight SQ321 ang natabo sang yara malapit sa Irrawaddy Basin sa Myanmar nga 37,000 ka tapak ang kataason sang lupad sang aircraft kag 10 ka oras ang nakaligad sa ila nga departure.
english: According to aviation tracking site FlightRadar24, based on data, the turbulence on Singapore Airlines flight SQ321 occurred near the Irrawaddy Basin in Myanmar at an altitude of 37,000 feet and 10 hours after their departure.

text: Sa data sang aviation tracking site, halos nagalukso-lukso na ang eroplano sang ginatos ka tapak sa sulod sang 90 segundos antes ini nagbalik sa husto nga cruising altitude.
english: According to data from the aviation tracking site, the plane was almost bouncing hundreds of feet for 90 seconds before it returned to the correct cruising altitude.

text: Lakip sa naghatag sang mensahe sang simpatiya sa pamilya sang napatay amo ang transport officials kag mangin si Singapore President Tharman Shanmugaratnam.
english: Among those who offered messages of sympathy to the family of the deceased were transport officials and Singapore President Tharman Shanmugaratnam.

text: “We do not have the details of those affected, but know that the government ministries and agencies, as well as SIA, are doing their utmost to support all those affected and working with the authorities in Bangkok, where the plane had been diverted to,” kabahin sang pahayag ni Shanmugaratnam.#
english: “We do not have the details of those affected, but know that the government ministries and agencies, as well as SIA, are doing their utmost to support all those affected and working with the authorities in Bangkok, where the plane had been diverted to,” Shanmugaratnam said in a statement.

text: Lima ang arestado kag duha ang nakapalagyo sa drug buy bust sa isa ka ginapahayag drug den sa Barangay Benedicto, Jaro, Iloilo City.
english: Five were arrested and two escaped in a drug buy bust at an alleged drug den in Barangay Benedicto, Jaro, Iloilo City.

text: Ang mga nadakpan amo sanday Rodel Bayoneta Sr., 46, residente sang Brgy.
english: The suspects were identified as Rodel Bayoneta Sr., 46, resident of Brgy.

text: Benedicto, Jaro; Edmund Bedia, 34, residente sang Brgy.
english: Benedicto, Jaro; Edmund Bedia, 34, resident of Brgy.

text: Bagungbung, Barotac Nuevo; Joebert Amolong, 50, residente sang Brgy.
english: Bagungbung, Barotac Nuevo; Joebert Amolong, 50, resident of Brgy.

text: Desamparados, Jaro; Christian Magallanes, 37, residente sang Brgy Benedicto, Jaro; kag Ronald Palomar, 44, residente sa Brgy.
english: Desamparados, Jaro; Christian Magallanes, 37, resident of Brgy Benedicto, Jaro; and Ronald Palomar, 44, resident of Brgy.

text: Benedicto, Jaro.
english: Benedicto, Jaro.

text: Ang main target nga nakapalagyo amo si Rodel Bayoneta Jr., 22, residente sang Brgy Benedicto, Jaro.
english: The main target who escaped was Rodel Bayoneta Jr., 22, resident of Brgy Benedicto, Jaro.

text: At large man si Romel Bayoneta,20, residente man sang amo nga lugar.
english: Romel Bayoneta, 20, also a resident of the same place, is also at large.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Lester Oliveros, hepe sang Jaro Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga pasado 1:00 kaina sang kaagahon ginpatigayon ang operasyon sa balay nanday Bayoneta, Jr.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain Lester Oliveros, chief of Jaro Police Station, said the operation was conducted around 1:00 am yesterday at the house of Bayoneta, Jr.

text: Na-recover ang anum ka sachet sang suspected shabu nga may balor nga P204, 000.
english: Six sachets of suspected shabu worth P204,000 were recovered.

text: Ginpahayag nga yara sa sulod sang balay ang mga arestado sang ginhimo ang operasyon.
english: The suspects were reportedly inside the house when the operation was conducted.

text: Suno kay Oliveros, isa ka bulan ang monitoring antes ginpatigayon ang drug buy bust.
english: Oliveros said the monitoring took a month before the drug buy bust was conducted.

text:
REKLAMO SANG PAMILYA

Nag-reklamo naman ang pamilya ni Christian Magallanes nga may makaduluda nga natabo sa operasyon.
english:
FAMILY COMPLAINT

The family of Christian Magallanes complained that something suspicious happened during the operation.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Amalia Magallanes, tiya ni Christian, iya ginpahayag nga ginpwersa lang nga posasan ang iya nga hinablos kag pasudlon sa balay nanday Bayoneta.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Amalia Magallanes, Christian's aunt, said her nephew was forced to handcuff himself and enter the house of Bayoneta.

text: Suno sa tiya, nagpugusay pa ang operatiba kag ang iya hinablos sa bomba kag nagkalatumba pa ini.
english: According to the aunt, the operative and his nephew struggled with the bomb and it fell.

text: Gin-alegar pa sang tiya nga may ginsulod sa bulsa sang iya hinablos sang amo nga tion.
english: The aunt alleged that her nephew had something in his pocket at the time.

text: Ginrason sini nga yara pa sa guwa si Christian apisar kaagahon bangud naga-inom-inom ini kaupod ang abyan.
english: He argued that Christian was still outside even though it was early in the morning because he was drinking with his friend.

text: Nagpahayag naman ang Jaro Police Station nga alegasyon ini sang pamilya kag kinahanglan lang nila nga pamatud-an sa korte kun ipasaka na ang kaso.
english: The Jaro Police Station said that this is an allegation of the family and they only need to prove it in court when the case is filed.

text: Suspendido ang trabaho sa gobyerno kag ang mga klase sa tanan nga lebel sa pila ka mga lugar sa subong nga adlaw, Hulyo 23, 2025.
english: Government work and classes at all levels are suspended in some areas on today, July 23, 2025.

text: Kasunod ini sang rekomendasyon sang National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council sa tunga sang padayon nga pag-ulan tuga sang habagat.
english: This follows the recommendation of the National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council amid continuous rains caused by the southerly monsoon.

text: Base sa Memorandum Circular No.
english: Based on Memorandum Circular No.

text:
90 halin sa Malacañang, sakop sang suspensyon sang klase kag opisina ang masunod nga mga lugar sa Visayas:

Ang iban nga mga lugar nga sakop man sang circular amo ang:Metro Manila, Pangasinan, Zambales, Tarlac, Bataan, Pampanga, Bulacan, Cavite, Batangas, Rizal, Occidental Mindoro, Ilocos Norte, Ilocos Sur, La Union, Quezon, Oriental Mindoro, Marinduque, Romblon, Masbate, Sorsogon, Albay, Camarines Sur, Catanduanes, Palawan, Abra, Mountain Province, Ifugao, Benguet, Nueva Vizcaya, Nueva Ecija, kag Laguna

Apang, magapadayon naman ang operasyon sang mga ahensya nga naga-atender sang basic, vital kag health services, amo man ang preparedness kag response duties.
english:
90 from Malacañang, the following areas in the Visayas are covered by the suspension of classes and offices:

Other areas also covered by the circular are: Metro Manila, Pangasinan, Zambales, Tarlac, Bataan, Pampanga, Bulacan, Cavite, Batangas, Rizal, Occidental Mindoro, Ilocos Norte, Ilocos Sur, La Union, Quezon, Oriental Mindoro, Marinduque, Romblon, Masbate, Albay, Sorso, Camarigon, Sur, Camarigon Catanduanes, Palawan, Abra, Mountain Province, Ifugao, Benguet, Nueva Vizcaya, Nueva Ecija, and Laguna

However, agencies attending to basic, vital and health services, as well as preparedness and response duties, will continue to operate.

text: Ang localized cancellation ukon suspension of classes kag trabaho sa government offices sa iban nga rehiyon ang magadepende sa ila Local Chief Executives.
english: The localized cancellation or suspension of classes and work in government offices in other regions will depend on their Local Chief Executives.

text: Ang private sector magadepende sa desisyon sang ila mga opisina.
english: The private sector will depend on the decision of their offices.

text: Iloilo City – Dakop sa ginpatigayon nga buy bust operation ang mag live-in partner sa Ledesma Street, Barangay Gloria, Iloilo City.
english: ILOILO CITY – A live-in partner was arrested in a buy bust operation in Ledesma Street, Barangay Gloria, Iloilo City.

text: Ang arestado amo sanday Robert Martinez, 43, residente sang Brgy.
english: The arrested were identified as Robert Martinez, 43, resident of Brgy.

text: Tanza Esperanza, City Proper kag Glory Uriarte, 37, residente sang Brgy.
english: Tanza Esperanza, City Proper and Glory Uriarte, 37, resident of Brgy.

text: Villa Anita, City Proper.
english: Villa Anita, City Proper.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Mavin Laraño, hepe sang Iloilo City Police Station 1, iya ginpahayag nga nakuha sa mga durugista ang pulo tanan ka mga sachet sang suspected shabu nga nagabalor sang P20,000 kag iban pa nga drug paraphernalias.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain Mavin Laraño, chief of Iloilo City Police Station 1, said ten sachets of suspected shabu worth P20,000 and other drug paraphernalia were recovered from the drug pushers.

text: Nanawagan naman ang natungdan sa mga durugista nga untaton na ang ila opisyo bangud ang mga kapulisan ang yara lang nga nagatutok sa pagdakop sa mga ini.
english: He called on the drug pushers to stop their office because the police are only focused on arresting them.

text: Preso na subong ang duha sa Iloilo City Proper Police Station kag magapangatubang sang kaso nga paglapas sa Republic Act 9165 ukon ang Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002- Sections 5, 11, kag 26.
english: The two are now detained at the Iloilo City Proper Police Station and will face charges of violation of Republic Act 9165 or the Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002- Sections 5, 11, and 26.

text: Madamo nga mga lugar sa pungsod ang nagdeklararna sang state of calamity bangud sa naeksperyensyahan nga pag-ulan.
english: Many areas in the country have declared a state of calamity due to the heavy rains experienced.

text: Ang mga ini ang ginalakipan sang Cavite, Cebu City, Sebastian, Antique, Malabon City, Quezon City, Lungsod ng Maynila; Calumpit sa Bulacan, Malasiqui kag Umingan sa lalawigan ng Pangasinan.
english: These include Cavite, Cebu City, Sebastian, Antique, Malabon City, Quezon City, Manila City; Calumpit in Bulacan, Malasiqui and Umingan in Pangasinan province.

text: Tinutuyo sang pagdeklara sang state of calamity para magamit sang mga munisipalidad ang ila calamity fund.
english: The purpose of declaring a state of calamity is for municipalities to use their calamity fund.

text: Magapatuman man sa mga nasambit nga lugar sang price freeze sa mga nagapanguna nga balaklon.
english: Price freezes on basic commodities will also be implemented in these areas.

text: Iloilo City – Tatlo ka mga pasahero ang nagapabilin sa ospital matapos nagtakilid ang isa ka bus sa dalan sa Barangay Calacja 1, Hamtic, Antique.
english: ILOILO CITY – Three passengers remain in hospital after a bus overturned on the road in Barangay Calacja 1, Hamtic, Antique.

text: Nahibaluan nga may sakay nga 31 ka mga pasahero ang bus nga nagikan sa Iloilo City kag padulong sa Aklan.
english: The bus was carrying 31 passengers from Iloilo City to Aklan.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Senior Master Sergeant Oliver Villanueva, imbestigador sang Hamtic Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga nadulaan sang preno ang bus rason nga nagtakilid ini.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Senior Master Sergeant Oliver Villanueva, investigator of the Hamtic Municipal Police Station, said the bus lost its brakes and overturned.

text: Ang driver amo si Loven Magbanua, 43, residente sang Barangay Aglosong, Concepcion, Iloilo.
english: The driver was identified as Loven Magbanua, 43, resident of Barangay Aglosong, Concepcion, Iloilo.

text: Suno kay Villanueva, indi pamilyar si Magbanua sa lugar bangud bag-uhanon pa lang ini sa pag-drive sang bus.
english: According to Villanueva, Magbanua was not familiar with the area because he was new to driving a bus.

text: Ginpahayag sang natungdan nga yara na sa estable nga kondisyon ang tanan nga mga pasahero kun sa diin tatlo nalang diri ang nagapabilin sa ospital.
english: He said all the passengers are in stable condition with only three remaining in hospital.

text: Yara na subong ang driver sa kustodiya sang Hamtic, Antique Municipal Police Station.
english: The driver is now in the custody of the Hamtic, Antique Municipal Police Station.

text: Posible naman pasakaan sang kaso ang driver sang Reckless imprudence resulting to multiple physical injuries and damage to properties.
english: The driver may be charged with reckless imprudence resulting to multiple physical injuries and damage to properties.

text: Linibo nga mga Iranians ang nag-upod sa funeral procession para kay anay Presidente Ebrahim Raisi, Foreign Minister Hossein Amir-Abdollahian, kag anum ka iban pa sini nga kaupdanan nga napatay sa pagtibusok sang helicopter sa kabukiran malapit sa border sa Azerbaijan.
english: Thousands of Iranians joined the funeral procession for former President Ebrahim Raisi, Foreign Minister Hossein Amir-Abdollahian, and six others who were killed in a helicopter crash in the mountains near the border with Azerbaijan.

text: Nagasuksok ang mga pumuluyo sang itom nga panapton kag may dala nga Iranian flags kag laragway sang 63-anyos nga late president sang naghalin ang prusisyon sa central square sa northwestern city sang Tabriz nga amo kuntani ang kadtuan ni Raisi sang adlaw nga natabo ang helicopter crash.
english: Residents were dressed in black and carried Iranian flags and portraits of the 63-year-old late president as the procession left the central square in the northwestern city of Tabriz, where Raisi was supposed to go on the day of the helicopter crash.

text: Halin sa Tabriz, dal-on ang bangkay sang presidente sa Qom nga ginakonsiderar nga ikaduha sa pinakabalaan nga syudad sa bug-os nga Iran sunod sa syudad sang Mashhad.
english: From Tabriz, the president's body will be taken to Qom, which is considered the second holiest city in all of Iran after the city of Mashhad.

text: Sunod nga pagadal-on ang lawas sini sa capital sang pungsod nga amo ang Tehran.
english: His body will be taken to the country's capital, Tehran.

text: Natalana naman nga magapanguna si Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei sa pagpangamuyo sa farewell ceremony antes ilubong si Raisi sa iya nga dutan-natawhan sa Mashhad sa Huwebes.
english: Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei is scheduled to lead a farewell prayer before Raisi's burial in his homeland in Mashhad on Thursday.

text: Matandaan nga halin si Raisi sa inagurasyon sang dam joint project sang natabo ang helicopter crash kun sa diin nalakip sa mga biktima amo ang provincial officials, myembro sang iya security team kag ang flight crew.
english: Raisi was returning from the inauguration of the dam joint project when the helicopter crash occurred. The victims included provincial officials, members of his security team and the flight crew.

text: Una na nga gin-report nga ang madamol nga fog ang rason sang pagtibusok sang helicopter apang nagapadayon pa subong ang high-level investigation kaangot sa amo nga insidente.#
english: Earlier it was reported that heavy fog was the cause of the helicopter crash but a high-level investigation into the incident is still ongoing.

text: Tuluyan nang naging ganap na bagyo ang namataang Low Pressure Area sa loob ng Philippine Area of Responsibility.
english: The Low Pressure Area within the Philippine Area of ​​Responsibility has become a full-fledged typhoon.

text: Ito na ang pang-apat na bagyong pumasok sa teritoryo ng bansa na tatawaging bagyong Dante.
english: This is the fourth typhoon to enter the country's territory called Typhoon Dante.

text: Huling namataan ang sentro ng bagyo sa layong 1,115 km East Northeast ng Central Luzon.
english: The center of the typhoon was last felt 1,115 km East Northeast of Central Luzon.

text:
Ito ay may lakas ngayon ng hangin na aabot sa 45 km/h malapit sa gitna at pagbugso na aabot sa 55 km/h.

Patuloy itong kumikilos pa Westward na direksyon sa katamtamang bilis.
english:
It now has winds of up to 45 km/h near the center and gusts of up to 55 km/h.

It continues to move in a Westward direction at moderate speed.

text: Maliban sa bagyong Dante, patuloy ring minomonitor ang dalawang LPA na nasa loob at labas ng PAR kung saan ang unang LPA ay nasa layong 170km East Southeast ng Basco Batanes at ang LPA na nasa labas ng PAR ay matatagpuan sa layong 2705km East ng eastern Visayas.
english: Apart from Typhoon Dante, two LPAs inside and outside the PAR are still being monitored where the first LPA is located 170km East Southeast of Basco Batanes and the LPA outside the PAR is located 2705km East of Eastern Visayas.

text: Sa ngayon, tanging habagat ang may direktang epekto sa ilang bahagi ng bansa na nagdudulot ng walang humpay na pag-ulan.
english: Currently, only the southerly monsoon has a direct impact on some parts of the country causing heavy rains.

text: Positibo ang nangin sabat sang mga nagabakal sang mangga nga nagikan sa Pilipinas sa Paris France, United Arab Emirates kag Dubai.
english: The response of mango buyers from the Philippines in Paris, France, the United Arab Emirates and Dubai has been positive.

text: Suno kay Department of Agriculture 12 Agribusiness and Marketing Assistance Division Director Mike Intao, yara sa good quality kag pang-export ang kalidad sang mga mangga nga nagikan sa probinsya sang Cotabato gani nakapasar ini sa panabor sang mga dumuluong.
english: According to Department of Agriculture 12 Agribusiness and Marketing Assistance Division Director Mike Intao, the mangoes from Cotabato province are of good quality and export quality so they passed the taste of foreigners.

text: Nahibaluan nga sang damlag lang, ginhiwat ang Ceremonial Send off sang mga Fresh Mango sa General Santos City International Airport padulong sa iban nga pungsod kaangay sang France, Dubai kag UAE.
english: Recently, the Ceremonial Send off of Fresh Mangoes was held at General Santos City International Airport to other countries such as France, Dubai and UAE.

text: Ginalauman nga kada semana, tone-tonelada nga mangga ang iga-export sa tatlo ka pungsod kag posible nga madugangan pa.
english: It is expected that every week, tons of mangoes will be exported to the three countries and possibly more.

text: Isa naman ini ka maayo nga balita para sa industriya kag produksyon sang mangga sa pungsod matapos ang nangin pag-atake sang peste nga Cecid fly ukon mas kilala sa tawag nga “kurikong” sa produksyon sang mangga sa Pilipinas.
english: This is good news for the mango industry and production in the country after the attack of the pest Cecid fly or better known as “kurikong” in mango production in the Philippines.

text: Sa diin nagdangat sa 737,928 metriko tonelada ukon katumbas sang P24 bilyon na sang mga mangga ang naapektuhan sang nasambit nga peste.
english: A total of 737,928 metric tons or equivalent to P24 billion of mangoes have been affected by the pest.

text: Ginklaro sang actor nga si Jameson Blake nga wala sila sang romantic relationship ni Barbie Forteza.
english: Actor Jameson Blake clarified that he and Barbie Forteza are not in a romantic relationship.

text: Nagguwa ang dating rumors matapos nakit-an ang duha sa isa ka fun run sa Pampanga sang Hunyo, kun sa diin sa isa ka picture, magka-holding hands ang mga ini samtang naga-akomodar sang photo requests halin sa fans.
english: Dating rumors surfaced after the two were spotted on a fun run in Pampanga in June, where in a picture, they were holding hands while accommodating photo requests from fans.

text: Pahayag ni Jameson, gina-assist lamang sini si Barbie samtang nagapaguwa bangud madamo sang mga tawo, apang wala na ini sang iban pa nga buot-silingon.
english: Jameson said he was only assisting Barbie while she was going out because there were many people, but he didn't mean anything else.

text: “Honestly, we are not together.
english: “Honestly, we are not together.

text: The reason why nahuli kami holding hands kasi andaming tao nung nagpa-picture sa kaniya… I was just assisting her palabas.
english: The reason why we were caught holding hands was because there were many people who took pictures with her... I was just assisting her show.

text: Gets ko naman people will think different,” suno sa actor paagi sa vlog ni Ogie Diaz.
english: I get people will think different,” the actor said through Ogie Diaz's vlog.

text: Pila ka beses na nga nakit-an sanday Barbie kag Jameson nga nag-updanay sa fun run lakip na ang sa “Lights Camera Run” sa Pasay sang Mayo.
english: Barbie and Jameson have been seen together several times in fun runs including the “Lights Camera Run” in Pasay in May.

text: Natalana sila nga mag-updanay sa isa ka project nga “Kontrabida Academy” kaupod kanday Eugene Domingo, Michael De Mesa, Ysabel Ortega, Xyriel Manabat kag Carmina Villaroel.
english: They are set to collaborate on a project called “Kontrabida Academy” with Eugene Domingo, Michael De Mesa, Ysabel Ortega, Xyriel Manabat and Carmina Villaroel.

text: Sang nagligad nga adlaw, sa 75th anniversary event sang isa ka network, nakit-an man si Barbie nga ka-istorya ang ex-boyfriend sini nga si Jak Roberto.
english: The other day, at the 75th anniversary event of a network, Barbie was also seen talking to her ex-boyfriend Jak Roberto.

text: Apisar sadto, ginaklaro ni Barbie nga indi na sini gusto nga istoryahan ang breakup bilang respeto na lang sa ila nga relasyon nga naglawig man sang masobra sa pito ka tuig.
english: However, Barbie clarified that she does not want to talk about the breakup as a respect for their relationship that lasted more than seven years.

text: Nagpaguwa sang memo ang administrasyon ni US President Donald Trump paagi sa U.S. State Department nga pagapa-untaton sini ang tanan nga nagaproseso sang visa sa 75 ka mga pungsod kag ini maga-umpisa halin Enero 21.
english: The administration of US President Donald Trump issued a memo through the U.S. State Department that it will suspend all visa processing in 75 countries effective January 21.

text: Kabahin sa apektado nga pungsod amo ang Somalia, Russia, Iran, Afghanistan, Brazil, Nigeria, kag Thailand.
english: The affected countries include Somalia, Russia, Iran, Afghanistan, Brazil, Nigeria, and Thailand.

text: Wala gilayon ginsunod sang representante sang State Department ang mando samtang giuna-review sang departamento ila nga pamaagi.
english: The State Department representative did not immediately comply with the order while the department reviewed its procedures.

text: Wala naman sang gintalana nga petsa kun asta san o ang suspension.
english: There is no set date for the suspension.

text: Ang nasambit nga pagpa-untat kadungan sang lapanagon nga immigration crackdown nga ginpatuman sang Republican U.S President Donald Trump halin sang siya ang namuno halin Enero sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: The suspension coincides with the widespread immigration crackdown implemented by Republican U.S. President Donald Trump since he took office in January last year.

text: Sang Nobyembre, nangako si Trump nga ”permanently pause” ang migrasyon halin sa tanan nga “Third World Countries” kasunod sang pagpangtiro malapit sa White House sang isa ka Afghan national nga nagpatay sang isa ka National Guard member.
english: In November, Trump promised to ”permanently pause” migration from all “Third World Countries” following a shooting near the White House by an Afghan national that killed a National Guard member.

text: Nag-abot na sa New York si Alex Eala samtang nagapreparar para sa iya debut women’s main draw sang US Open.
english: Alex Eala has arrived in New York as she prepares for her debut women’s main draw of the US Open.

text: Gin-share sang 20-anyos nga Filipina tennis player ang iya nga laragway sa Big Apple antes mag-umpisa ang iya ikatatlo nga Grand Slam main draw tournament subong nga tuig, kasunod man sang iya pagpasakop sa French Open kag Wimbledon.
english: The 20-year-old Filipina tennis player shared a picture of herself in the Big Apple ahead of the start of her third Grand Slam main draw tournament this year, following her participation in the French Open and Wimbledon.

text: Ini ang iya una nga tournament halin sang Montreal Open sa Canada kun sa diin nalutos siya sa first round sa kamot ni Markéta Vondroušová sang Czech Republic.
english: This is her first tournament since the Montreal Open in Canada where she lost in the first round to Markéta Vondroušová of the Czech Republic.

text: Antes sini, ginlaktawan ni Eala ang Cincinnati Open kag Monterey Open rason nga nag-us-os sa World No.
english: Earlier, Eala skipped the Cincinnati Open and Monterey Open, dropping to World No.

text: 70 sa rankings kasunod sang iya ginsuprer nga shoulder injury.
english: 70 in the rankings following his shoulder injury.

text: Nakakuha si Eala sang spot sa main draw sang 2025 US Open bangud sang padayon sini nga pagsaka sa Women’s Tennis Association (WTA) rankings nga nag-umpisa sa iya maayo nga performance sa Miami Open.
english: Eala earned a spot in the main draw of the 2025 US Open thanks to her steady rise in the Women’s Tennis Association (WTA) rankings that began with her excellent performance at the Miami Open.

text: Ginaduso sang pila ka mga traditional jeepney driver-operator sa syudad sang Iloilo ang dos pesos nga saka sa plete subong nga nagatimbuok ang presyo sang gatong.
english: Some traditional jeepney drivers-operators in Iloilo City are pushing for a two pesos fare hike as fuel prices rise.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Robert Ventura, iya ginpahayag nga kun mapasakaan ang P13 nga regular fare subong sa tradisyonal nga jeep, masarangan pa ini sang commuters.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Robert Ventura said that if the regular fare of traditional jeeps is increased to P13, commuters will still be able to afford it.

text: Kun indi man pag-aprubahan sang gobyerno suno kay Ventura, magasunod man sila sa protocol, ilabi na nga ginapanumdom man nila ang epekto sini sa mga pasahero.
english: Even if the government does not approve it, Ventura said, they will follow the protocol, especially considering the impact on passengers.

text: Nagahingyo ini nga kuntani pamatian man sang gobyerno ang panawagan nga dulaon na ang Oil Deregulation Law kag i-suspend ang excise tax sa produktong petrolyo agud nga makabenepisyo ang kadam-an subong nga may krisis.
english: He urged the government to listen to the call to abolish the Oil Deregulation Law and suspend the excise tax on petroleum products so that the masses can benefit during the crisis.

text: Una na nga nagpahayag si Department of Transportation (DOTr) Secretary Giovanni Lopez nga ginatun-an na subong sang Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) ang pending petition para sa fare hike, apang wala pa ginpatpat ang detalye kun pila eksakto ang isaka sa plete.
english: Earlier, Department of Transportation (DOTr) Secretary Giovanni Lopez said the Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) is now studying the pending petition for the fare hike, but has not yet clarified the details of the exact fare hike.

text: Nasalbar ang isa ka bag-o ginbun-ag nga lapsag nga lalaki nga ginsulod sa ecobag kag ginhaboy sa atop sang balay sa Cagayan de Oro City.
english: A newborn baby boy who was stuffed in an ecobag and thrown from the roof of a house in Cagayan de Oro City was rescued.

text: Suno sa tag-iya sang balay, hinali lang nga may nabatian sila nga hibi sang lapsag halin sa atop sang tunganggab-i sang Huwebes.
english: According to the homeowner, they suddenly heard a baby crying from the roof at midnight on Thursday.

text: Sang ila ginlantaw, nakibot sila nga may yara gid man sang lapsag nga nagatabid pa ang pusod.
english: When they looked, they were surprised to see that there was a baby with the umbilical cord still attached.

text: Gindala naman sa health center ang lapsag kag yara na sa maayon nga kondisyon.
english: The baby was taken to the health center and is in good condition.

text: Ginahibalo pa sang otoridad kun sin-o ang ginikanan sang bata.
english: Authorities are still investigating the identity of the child's parents.

text: Gindumilian sang Pilipinas ang pagsulod sang imported nga karne sang baboy halin sa Espanya bangud sa outbreak sang African swine fever (ASF).
english: The Philippines has banned the entry of imported pork from Spain due to the outbreak of African swine fever (ASF).

text: Suno kay Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr., nag-umpisa ang ban sang Nobyembre 11 kag magalawig tubtub nga makumpirma nga wala na sang kaso sang ASF ang amo nga pungsod.
