english: According to Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr., the ban began on November 11 and will last until the country is confirmed free of ASF cases.

text: Ginsiguro sang tiglikom nga indi maapektuhan sang import restriction ang local pork supply.
english: The secretary assured that the import restriction will not affect the local pork supply.

text: Pahayag sini, puno pa subong ang tanan nga cold storage facilities sa Pilipinas samtang stable naman ang retail prices sa mga mercado.
english: He said all cold storage facilities in the Philippines are still full while retail prices in the markets are stable.

text: Dugang niya, reasonable man ang presyo sang karne sang baboy subong nga Christmas Season; apang bangud sa demand, posible nga may gamay nga pagsaka.
english: He added that the price of pork is also reasonable this Christmas Season; however due to demand, there is likely to be a slight uptick.

text: Sandig sa data sang Bureau of Animal Industry, nakapasulod ang Espanya sang 132.05 million kilograms sang karne sa Pilipinas sang Enero tubtub Septyembre subong nga tuig nga naga-reflect sang 11.1-percent nga market share.
english: According to data from the Bureau of Animal Industry, Spain imported 132.05 million kilograms of meat into the Philippines from January to September this year, reflecting an 11.1-percent market share.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang Espanya amo ang nagapangaduha sa Brazil sa pinakadaku nga source sang Pilipinas sang karne sang baboy.
english: Spain is the second largest source of pork in the Philippines after Brazil.

text: SA ISTRIKTO gid nga paghangop, lain ang Realidad sa Kamatuoran.
english: IN a very strict sense, Reality is different from Truth.

text: Ang Realidad sang isa ka bagay nagatumod sa wala nagaliwat nga kinaiya sini nga kinahanglan mo lang ma-diskubre.
english: The Reality of something refers to its unrepeating nature that you just need to discover.

text: Katulad sang pagkakita mo sini, nabatian ini, napanimplahan, napanimahuan, ukon nabatyagan.
english: Like seeing it, hearing it, tasting it, smelling it, or feeling it.

text: Samtang, ang Kamatuoran katulad sa isa ka imbensyon nga kinahanglan mapamatud-an mo gid kon ano ang mahimo sini.
english: Truth, on the other hand, is like an invention that you need to prove exactly what it can do.

text: Ukon isa ka bagay ukon hitabo nga wala ka personal sing ihibalo nga kinahanglan matul-id mo anay kag mapamatud-an sandig sa masaligan nga palahandigan.
english: Or something or event that you have no personal knowledge of that you need to correct and prove based on a reliable source.

text: Ukon napamatud-an mo na ugaling nagliwat ang pagkilala mo sini tungod sa bag-o nga ebidensya.
english: Or you have already proved it but you have changed your view of it because of new evidence.

text: At best, katulad ini sa pagpati sang hwes kon ano gid ang natabo “to certainty” agud ma-justify kag indi siya ma-konsyensya sa iya paghulog sang mabug-at nga sentensya sa isa ka kriminal.
english: At best, it is like the judge believing what really happened “to certainty” in order to justify and not feel guilty for imposing a heavy sentence on a criminal.

text: Sa aton nga wala sing kinaalam sang hwes, basi tubtub lang kita sa aton ordinaryo nga pagpati  sa istorya ni Lolo Teban kag sang byuda nga tamawo nga isaysay na naton diri agud makapanabi-nabi kon makalabay sa Lunok Tree.
english: For those of us who do not know the judge, maybe we are limited to our ordinary belief in the story of Lolo Teban and the widow tamawo that we will tell here so that we can talk when we pass Lunok Tree.

text:
***

Diri sa Guimaras kag Panay ordinaryo man ang magpati sa ispirituhanon nga mga tinuga, nga kon tawgon mga engkanto, nga ginapatihan pwede makahalit sa tawo.
english:
***

Here in Guimaras and Panay, it is also common to believe in spiritual beings, called fairies, who are believed to be able to harm people.

text: Lakip diri ang kapre, mantyo, kag tamawo.
english: These include copper, mantyo, and tamawo.

text: Sa Bibliya, ginasiling nga may malain nga mga ispirtu nga ginpangtabog ni Kristo.
english: In the Bible, it says that there were evil spirits that Christ cast out.

text: Wala ugaling gasiling diri kon paano sila nagtuhaw.
english: However, it does not say how they came about.

text: Luas lang ang parti sa tamawo sunu sa pagpati lang sang mga katigulangan.
english: Except for the tamawo according to the belief of the ancestors.

text: Mga anghel ini sila kuno nga nangin sumulunod ni Lucifer nga nag-rebelde sa Diyos, nga tungod mamag-an lang ang ila pagpakasala gintapok lang sa kalibutan sang tawo kag indi sa Impyerno kaupod si Lucifer.
english: They are supposed to be angels who became followers of Lucifer who rebelled against God, who because of their light sin were thrown into the human world and not into Hell with Lucifer.

text: Ginapatihan nga luyag sang tamawo ang magpuyo sa dalagku nga mga kahoy katulad sang Lunok.
english: It is believed that the tamawo likes to live in large trees such as Lunok.

text: Ang ginapuy-an sadto nanday Lolo Teban kag Lola Felina, kag ila 11 ka kabataan (Kaluy-an ang ila mga kalag!) sa Brgy.
english: The former residence of Lolo Teban and Lola Felina, and their 11 children (Have mercy on their souls!) in Brgy.

text: Sinapsapan, Jordan, Guimaras malapit lang sa isa ka daku nga kahoy sang Lunok.
english: Sinapsapan, Jordan, Guimaras near a large Lunok tree.

text: Nagatindug ini sa putok-putokan gid sang bukid sa tunga sang duha ka patag nga ginapanag-iyahan nila, nga karon lain na ang nagapanag-iya.
english: It stood at the very top of the mountain between two fields that they owned, now owned by someone else.

text: Nagsugod kuno ang pag-abyanay ni Lolo Teban kag sang biyuda nga tamawo sang masami na nagaaway sanday lolo kag lola tungod  sa “pagpasaway” ni lolo sa iya edad nga sobra 70 anyos na sadto.
english: The friendship between Lolo Teban and the widow tamawo allegedly began when the grandparents often fought because of the “discipline” of the grandfather at his age of more than 70 years.

text: Kon kis-a ginakadlawan gani ini sang iya mga apo nga makita ang iya kwan sa iya lawlaw nga short nga wala sing “brief” samtang nagapungko sa hagdanan.
english: Sometimes her grandchildren even laugh at her when they see her kwan in her shorts without a brief while sitting on the stairs.

text: Naluoy kuno kay lolo ining biyuda nga tamawo nga nagapuyo sa Lunok nga mga 300 ka metro gid lang ang layo sa puluy-an nanday lolo kag nakig-abyan ini kay lolo.
english: This widow, who lives in Lunok, about 300 meters away from my grandfather's house, felt sorry for my grandfather and became friends with him.

text: Masami sini ginasugat si lolo sa iya kuno awto sa ila mismo ugsaran pakadto sa ila puluy-an kon sanag ang bulan.
english: He often met my grandfather in his car in their own yard to go home when the moon was bright.

text: Sunu kay lolo, sementado nga dalan ang ginaagyan sang iya awto bisan pa, sa matuod, masiut kag matalom nga kabatuhan ang maagyan pakadto didto.
english: According to the grandfather, his car was on a paved road even though, in fact, it was a narrow and sharp rock to get there.

text: Nabatyagan man ni lolo kuno nga daw naluyag ang biyuda nga tamawo sa iya kay mawilihon ini sa pag-istorya sa iya, kaupod ang iya duha ka hamtong nga mga kabataan, lalaki kag babaye.
english: The grandfather also felt that the widowed tamawo seemed to like him because she was interested in talking to him, along with her two adult children, a boy and a girl.

text: Apang wala gid si lolo nagkaon sang ila handa agud indi kuno nila mabihag.
english: But grandfather never ate their food so that they would not be captured.

text:
Wala gid sadto nagsugid si lolo sa iya pamilya parti sini tubtub isa ka gab-i.

Nagob na ang kagab-ihon apang wala pa makapauli si lolo.
english:
My grandfather never told his family about it until one night.

It was late at night but my grandfather had not come home yet.

text: Gani nalangkag na sanday lola.
english: So the grandmothers were excited.

text: Nagasinggitan gid si lola sa pagtawag kay lolo.
english: Grandma was screaming when she called Grandpa.

text: Hinali lang, halin sa bukid kon diin nagatindug ang Lunok nakita nila si lolo sa sanag sang bulan nga nagadalagan  paubos.
english: Suddenly, from the mountain where Lunok stood, they saw grandfather in the moonlight running down.

text: Natingala sila.
english: They were surprised.

text: Nanugid na si lolo.
english: Grandpa told me.

text: Siling niya nga nagadalagan siya sa sementado nga dalan halin sa matahum nga balay sang mga tamawo.
english: He said that he was running on the pavement from the beautiful tamawo house.

text: Daw mapati man kag indi ang iya pamilya.
english: His family seemed to believe it and not.

text: Indi butigon si lolo.
english: Grandpa is not a liar.

text: Kag yara ang pamatuod ang indi mapatihan sini nga pagdalagan paubos sa mabatuhon kag masiut nga kaaghoan pauli.
english: And there is the proof of this incredible run down the rocky and narrow valley home.

text: Madugay na nga wala si lolo kag lola kag ang iya ka kabataan, apang ang istorya ni lolo kag sang byuda nga tamawo nagpabilin indi lang sa ila kaapohan kundi sa mga nangin kasilingan man nila.
english: The grandparents and their children are long gone, but the story of the grandfather and the widow tamawo remained not only in their grandchildren but also in their neighbors.

text: Ako, ugaling, indi man makasiling gihapon nga matuod ining istorya ni Lolo Teban.
english: I, however, still cannot say that this story of Lolo Teban is true.

text: Pero kon matuod, nagapasalamat ako sa pasalig nila, sunu kay lolo, nga bantayan nila ang pamilya ni lolo batok sa ano man nga kahalitan.
english: But if it is true, I am grateful for their assurance, said grandfather, that they will protect grandfather's family against any harm.

text: (Wala na sing  kasugpon)/PN
english: (Not attached)/PN

text: ILOILO CITY- Haaaay, kanami gid ya magtulog!
english: ILOILO CITY- Haaaay, it's so nice to sleep!

text: Pero kun sa imo pagbugtaw, magpalanakit man lang ang imo lawas, basi indi ka na manamian magtulog.
english: But if you wake up and your body hurts, you may not be able to sleep well.

text: May panugyan ang pain medicine specialist nga si George Girgis.
english: Pain medicine specialist George Girgis has advice.

text: Simple lang ang mga solusyon.
english: The solutions are simple.

text: Maglikaw sa pagkaon nga naga-promote sang inflammation.
english: Avoid foods that promote inflammation.

text: Pilion mo ang madamo nga utan, prutas, whole grains kag seafood bangud ginapataas sini ang antioxidants nga nagabulig sa pag-reduce sang inflammation.
english: Choose plenty of vegetables, fruits, whole grains and seafood as they increase antioxidants which help reduce inflammation.

text: Likawan ang pagpanigarilyo bangud ang sigarilyo nagapugong sa oxygenated blood nga makalab-ot sa tul-an kag tissues.
english: Avoid smoking as cigarettes prevent oxygenated blood from reaching the bone and tissues.

text: Ginalimit man sini ang exchange sang oxygen kag carbon dioxide sa dugo gani naganubo man ang blood quality nga nagaresulta sa mahina nga muscles.
english: It also limits the exchange of oxygen and carbon dioxide in the blood thus reducing blood quality resulting in weak muscles.

text: Mag- exercise apang indi mo ini pagpatam-an.
english: Exercise but don't overdo it.

text: Ang movement naga- lubricate sang joints gani nga makalikaw sa pain kag stiffness.
english: The movement lubricates the joints thus preventing pain and stiffness.

text: Apang maghalong bangud ang pag-exercise kun malapit ka na lang magtulog ang mahimo nga magresulta sa insomnia.
english: But be careful because exercising when you are close to bed can lead to insomnia.

text: Isa ka malip-ot apang maisog ang reaksiyon nga ginhatag ni Acting Davao City Mayor Baste Duterte sa panawagan ni Philippine National Police (PNP) Chief General Nicolas Torre III para sa mga tagasuporta sang pamilya Duterte.
english: Acting Davao City Mayor Baste Duterte gave a short but bold reaction to Philippine National Police (PNP) Chief General Nicolas Torre III's call for supporters of the Duterte family.

text: Matandaan nga nagpanawagan si Gen.
english: It can be recalled that Gen.

text: Torre nga panahon na agud mag-move on kag kalimtan na ang mga isyu nga natabo.
english: Torre said it's time to move on and forget the issues that happened.

text: Dugang pa sang hepe sang national police, dapat nga maghugpong ang tanan para sa kalinong kag katawhay.
english: The national police chief added that everyone should unite for peace and order.

text: Apang sa baylo nga malaba nga paathag, isa ka direkta nga “Pakyu!” ang nangin sabat ni Baste Duterte.
english: But instead of a long explanation, a direct “Pakyu!” was Baste Duterte's response.

text: Anilao, Iloilo – Yara na sa restrictive custody ang pulis nga nagluthang-patay sang iya bayaw sa Barangay Sta.
english: Anilao, Iloilo – The policeman who shot dead his brother-in-law in Barangay Sta.

text: Rita, Anilao, Iloilo.
english: Rita, Anilao, Iloilo.

text: Ini amo si Police Master Sergeant Rodel Rodriguez, imbestigador sang Anilao Municipal Police Station.
english: This is Police Master Sergeant Rodel Rodriguez, investigator of the Anilao Municipal Police Station.

text: Ang natiruhan naman amo si Eduardo Demavivas Jr., 40, residente sang nasambit nga lugar.
english: The victim was identified as Eduardo Demavivas Jr., 40, resident of the said place.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Colonel Noel Aliño, Director sang Iloilo Police Provincial Office, iya ginpahayag nga nagapabilin si Rodriguez sa kustodiya sang Anilao Municipal Police Station.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Colonel Noel Aliño, Director of the Iloilo Police Provincial Office, said Rodriguez remains in the custody of the Anilao Municipal Police Station.

text: Matandaan nga gintuyo nga bun-on sang biktima ang iya amay nga si Eduardo Demavivas Sr.
english: The victim tried to stab his father, Eduardo Demavivas Sr.

text: Nagpangayo naman sang bulig si Demavivas Sr., kay Rodriguez.
english: Demavivas Sr. asked Rodriguez for help.

text: Sang nagsugat-anay ang banas ni Rodriguez kag ni Demavivas Jr., diri na nga gintuyo niya nga labuon ang pulis.
english: When Rodriguez and Demavivas Jr. met, he tried to stab the policeman.

text: Ini ang nagresulta sa pagluthang sang pulis kay Demavivas Jr.
english: This resulted in the police shooting Demavivas Jr.

text: nga amo gintunaan sang iya kamatayon.
english: which caused his death.

text: Kaangot sini, gin-athag naman ni Aliño nga nagdepensa lang ang pulis sa iya kaugalingon.
english: Aliño explained that the policeman was defending himself.

text: Natalana naman nga ipaidalom sa paraffin test ang pulis kag ipaidalom naman sa ballistic examination ang armas sini.
english: The policeman is scheduled to undergo a paraffin test and his weapon will undergo a ballistic examination.

text: Gin-ako sang Iloilo City General Services Office (GSO) nga apektado ang pila ka mga tanom sa syudad bangud sa mataas nga heat index.
english: The Iloilo City General Services Office (GSO) acknowledged that some plants in the city were affected due to the high heat index.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Engr.
english: In an interview with Bombo Engr.

text: Niel Ravena, Head sang General Services Office, iya ginpahayag nga kalabanan sa mga apektado amo ang santan sa center island sa Diversion Road, Mandurriao kag sa Iloilo esplanade.
english: Niel Ravena, Head of the General Services Office, said most of the affected are the santan in the center island on Diversion Road, Mandurriao and the Iloilo esplanade.

text: Suno kay Ravena, plano sang talatapan nga islan sang bougainvillea ang nasambit nga tanom bangud ini ang wala na nagakinahanglan sang adlaw-adlaw nga pagpamunyag kaangay sang iban nga bulak.
english: According to Ravena, the office plans to replace the plant with bougainvillea because it does not require daily watering like other flowers.

text: Ginpahayag man sang natungdan nga mas nagapamulak ang bougainvillea kon ini ang stress kag wala mabunyagan.
english: He also said that bougainvillea blooms more when it is stressed and not watered.

text: Madumduman nga sang nagligad nga tuig, lakip ang mga royal palm trees nga una gintanom sa pila ka parte sang syudad ang may 100% succession rate nga nabuhi sa pihak sang nagatagiti nga init.
english: Last year, even the royal palm trees that were first planted in some parts of the city had a 100% succession rate that survived despite the scorching heat.

text: Nabutang subong sa peligro ang produksyon sang pinaka matam-is nga mangga sa bilog nga kalibutan nga nagikan sa pungsod Pilipinas bangud sa pagpang-atake sang Cecid fly nga isa ka sahi sang peste.
english: The production of the world's sweetest mango from the Philippines is now at risk due to the attack of the Cecid fly, a type of pest.

text: Ginmanduan na ni Department of Agriculture William Dar si Undersecretary Evelyn Lavina nga magpatigayon sang high-value programa agud mabuligan ang research and development intiatives sang ahensya nga makasolbar sa problema sa Cecid fly ukon mas kilala bilang ‘kurikong’.
english: Department of Agriculture William Dar has directed Undersecretary Evelyn Lavina to conduct a high-value program to assist the agency's research and development initiatives to solve the problem of the Cecid fly or better known as 'kurikong'

text: Sa subong gina tapos na sang Department of Agriculture ang ila pagpanalawsaw kun paano masolbar ang nasambit nga problema kag nagalaum sila nga gilayon na ini nga matapos agud masugudan na ang proyekto sa masunod nga mga semana.
english: The Department of Agriculture is currently completing its research on how to solve the problem and hopes to complete it soon so that the project can begin in the coming weeks.

text: Nahibaluan nga nagdangat ba sa 737,928 metriko tonelada ukon katumbas sang P24 bilyon na sang mga mangga ang naapektuhan sang nasambit nga peste.
english: It is known that 737,928 metric tons or equivalent to P24 billion of mangoes have been affected by the said pest.

text: Base sa data sang Philippine Statistics Authority, nagdangat na sa $17.88 milyon ukon masobra sa P8 bilyon sang gintalikdan nga tuig ang na export nga fresh mango kag dried mangoes sang pungsod nga mas mataas sang $% sang 2018.
english: Based on data from the Philippine Statistics Authority, the country's exports of fresh mangoes and dried mangoes reached $17.88 million or more than P8 billion last year, up $1% in 2018.

text: Preso ang imbestigador sang Anilao Municipal Police Station matapos naluthangan-patay ang isa ka lalaki nga gina-alegar malabo kuntani sa iya.
english: The investigator of the Anilao Municipal Police Station is in custody after he shot dead a man who allegedly tried to stab him.

text: Ang police personnel amo si Police Master Sergeant Rodel Rodriguez samtang ang natiruhan naman amo si Eduardo Demavivas Jr., 40.
english: The police personnel was identified as Police Master Sergeant Rodel Rodriguez while the victim was identified as Eduardo Demavivas Jr., 40.

text: Natabo ang insidente sa Barangay Sta.
english: The incident occurred in Barangay Sta.

text: Rita sa amo nga banwa.
english: Rita in that town.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Jersey Besas, hepe sang Anilao Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga nag-ugat ang insidente sang nag-away si Demavivas, Jr.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain Jersey Besas, chief of Anilao Municipal Police Station, said the incident stemmed from a fight between Demavivas, Jr.

text: kag ang iya amay nga si Eduardo Demavivas, Sr.
english: and his father, Eduardo Demavivas, Sr.

text: Sang hana nga bun-on sang anak ang iya amay, nagpalagyo kag nagdalagan ang amay sa balay sang pulis nga ila kasilingan.
english: When the son tried to stab his father, the father fled and ran to the police station next door.

text: Naguwa man ang pulis kag ma-responde kuntani, apang sunod nga nag-abot ang anak nga Demavivas nga may dala nga binangon.
english: The policeman also went out and was about to respond, but Demavivas' son arrived with a binangon.

text: Ginpahayag nga gintuyo man sini nga labuon ang pulis, apang nag-sige atras ang pulis tubtub nga na-corner ini kag wala na sang sarang nga maisulan.
english: He reportedly tried to stab the policeman, but the policeman kept retreating until he was cornered and had nothing to do.

text: Didto na suno sa hepe kag nag-gamit na lang ang pulis sang iya nga pusil kag gintiro ang anak nga Demavivas.
english: The policeman used his gun and shot Demavivas' son.

text: Nagsungka ang imbestigador sa Anilao Municipal Police Station samtang gindeklarar naman nga dead-on-arrival ang iya nga natiruhan.
english: The investigator surrendered at the Anilao Municipal Police Station while the victim was declared dead-on-arrival.

text: Gin-abisohan sang Iloilo City Public Safety Transportation Management Office (PSTMO) ang mga truck owner kag pila ka drivers nga likawan ang iligal nga pag-park sa dalan.
english: The Iloilo City Public Safety Transportation Management Office (PSTMO) has advised truck owners and some drivers to avoid illegal parking on the road.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Ret.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Ret.

text: Police Col.
english: Police Col.

text: Uldarico Garbanzos, head sang Iloilo City Traffic and Transportation Management Office, iya ginpahayag nga classified bilang isa ka national highway ang dalan rason nga wala ini kontani sang obstruction sang mga salakyan.
english: Uldarico Garbanzos, head of the Iloilo City Traffic and Transportation Management Office, said the road is classified as a national highway so it should not be obstructed by vehicles.

text: Suno kay Garbanzos, masami nga matalupangdan ang mga iligal nga naga-park sa Circumferential road 1 nga sakop sang Jaro kag Pavia.
english: According to Garbanzos, illegal parkers are often noticed on Circumferential road 1 in Jaro and Pavia.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga sugod sang nagpungko siya nga head sang amo nga opisina, nagpakig-angot na sila sa mga kabarangayan agud mag-abiso sa amo nga sitwasyon sang dalan.
english: He also said that since he took over as head of the office, they have been contacting the barangays to inform them of the road situation.

text: Dugang sini nga nagpanugyan sila sa tagsa ka opisyal ilabi na sa coastal area sang C1 road nga gilayon magpakig-angot sa ila agud nga mapadulongan ang lugar nga may iligal nga naga-park.
english: He added that they advised every official especially in the coastal area of ​​C1 road to immediately contact them so that they can visit the place where there are illegal parkers.

text: Ginpasigurado man sang natungdan nga sa agsa ka roving may bitbit ang ila personnel sang mga wheel clamp agud nga takdan ang mga naga-obstruct sa dalan.
english: He also assured that during the roving, their personnel will carry wheel clamps to measure the obstructions on the road.

text: Nagwangal si Vice President Sara Duterte sa ginaalegar nga pagbasol sa iya amay nga si anay Presidente Rodrigo Duterte sa pagbaha sa Metro Manila.
english: Vice President Sara Duterte has slammed her father, former President Rodrigo Duterte, for allegedly blaming the floods in Metro Manila.

text: Suno kay Vice President Duterte, ini isa ka “political scapegoating” ukon paglikaw sa responsibilidad sang administrasyon ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: According to Vice President Duterte, this is a “political scapegoating” or avoidance of responsibility by the administration of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: Suno sa iya, sa baylo nga basulon ang nagligad nga administrasyon, dapat mangita sang solusyon ang gobyerno.
english: He said instead of blaming the previous administration, the government should find a solution.

text: Bilang sabat naman sa suhestiyon ni Marcos na kolektahon ang tubig-baha para sa irigasyon, sarkastiko nga ginsiling ni Duterte nga dapat ini nga tipunon kag dal-on sa Malacañang.
english: In response to Marcos' suggestion to collect flood water for irrigation, Duterte sarcastically said it should be collected and taken to Malacañang.

text: “Ipunin po nating lahat tapos i-deliver natin sa Malacañang para may mainom siya, para meron silang mainom doon.
english: “Let's fill it all up and deliver it to Malacañang so he can have something to drink, so they can have something to drink there.

text: Ganoon na po ang gagawin natin,” suno kay VP Sara.
english: That's what we're going to do,” according to VP Sara.

text: Nagduso na sang application ang chief prosecutor sang International Criminal Court (ICC) para madagdagan sang arrest warrants si Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu kag ang lider sang Hamas sa Gaza nga si Yahya Sinwar bangud sa war crimes.
english: The chief prosecutor of the International Criminal Court (ICC) has filed an application to increase the arrest warrants of Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Hamas leader in Gaza Yahya Sinwar for war crimes.

text: Suno kay prosecutor Karim Khan, may yara sang malig-on nga mga rason nga pareho nga responsable ang duha ka mga lider sa war crimes kag crimes against humanity halin sang gin-atake sang Hamas ang Israel sang Oktubre 7, 2023 tubtub nga nagpadayon ang gyera bangud sa pagtimalos naman sang Israel sa Gaza.
english: According to prosecutor Karim Khan, there are strong reasons that both leaders are responsible for war crimes and crimes against humanity from the time Hamas attacked Israel on October 7, 2023 until the war continued due to Israel's retaliation in Gaza.

text: Nag-apply man ini para sa warrant of arrest kanday Israeli defence minister Yoav Gallant kag political leader sang Hamas nga si Ismail Haniyeh amo man ang military chief sang militante nga grupo nga si Mohammed Deif.
english: It also applied for warrants of arrest for Israeli defense minister Yoav Gallant and Hamas political leader Ismail Haniyeh as well as the militant group's military chief Mohammed Deif.

text: Nahibaluan nga yara lang sa Gaza sanday Mohammed Deif kag Yahya Sinwar samtang si Ismail Haniyeh naman ang naka-base sa Qatar.
english: Mohammed Deif and Yahya Sinwar are in Gaza while Ismail Haniyeh is based in Qatar.

text: Lakip sa ginaalegar mga krimen nga nahimo sang Hamas leaders suno kay Khan amo ang extermination, murder, hostage taking, rape kag sexual violence, kag torture.
english: Among the alleged crimes committed by Hamas leaders, Khan said, are extermination, murder, hostage taking, rape and sexual violence, and torture.

text: Yara na subong sa kamot sang korte ang pagdesisyon kun bastante bala ang mga ebidensya agud magpaguwa sang arrest warrants apang ginapatihan nga kinahanglan pa ang sinemana ukon binulan antes ini matabo.
english: It is now up to the court to decide whether there is enough evidence to issue arrest warrants but it is believed that it will take weeks or months before this happens.

text: Ang Israel kag ang Qatar ang lunsay indi myembro sang ICC, apang ang Palestinian territories ang nakasulod na bilang member state sang 2015.
english: Israel and Qatar are both non-members of the ICC, but the Palestinian territories joined as member states in 2015.

text: Pananglitan maka-isyu ang korte sang warrants, igatugyan naman sang ICC sa member countries ang pagpatuman sang pag-aresto.
english: If the court issues warrants, the ICC will leave the execution of arrests to member countries.

text: Makaluluoy ang gindangatan sang isa ka lalaki sa Zamboanga Sibugay matapos nga nagsulod ini sa kurungan sang buwaya.
english: A man in Zamboanga Sibugay was injured after he entered a crocodile cage.

text: Santo sa impormasyon, gindumdom sang lalaki nga plastic lang ang buwaya rason nga iya ini ginpalapitan kag ginhikap.
english: According to reports, the man thought the crocodile was plastic so he approached it and touched it.

text: Samtang ginahikap ang buwaya, didto na ini kag gin-angkab sang sapat.
english: As soon as the crocodile was touched, it was there and the animal grabbed it.

text: Natigayon naman nga ma-rescue ang amo nga lalaki apang madamo na ini sang naangkon nga mga kapilasan.
english: The man was rescued but sustained multiple injuries.

text: Nagpagwa ang Department of Agriculture sang ₱133.09 milyon nga ayuda para sa mga mangunguma nga naapektuhan sang Severe Tropical Storm Crising (Wipha) kag Habagat.
english: The Department of Agriculture has released ₱133.09 million in assistance for farmers affected by Severe Tropical Storm Crising (Wipha) and Habagat.

text: Lakip sa bulig amo ang mga binhi sang humay, mais, kag mga utan nga halin sa mga regional offices sa Central Luzon, MIMAROPA, Central Visayas, Zamboanga Peninsula, Soccsksargen, kag Caraga.
english: The assistance included rice, corn, and vegetable seeds from regional offices in Central Luzon, MIMAROPA, Central Visayas, Zamboanga Peninsula, Soccsksargen, and Caraga.

text: Na-activate man ang Quick Response Fund para sa rehabilitasyon sang sektor sang agrikultura.
english: The Quick Response Fund for the rehabilitation of the agricultural sector was also activated.

text: May yara man sang pautang nga hasta ₱25,000 nga wala sang interest kag bayaran ini sa sulod sang tatlo ka tuig, sa idalum sang Survival and Recovery Loan Program.
english: There is also a loan of up to ₱25,000 that is interest-free and repayable within three years, under the Survival and Recovery Loan Program.

text: Ginpahibalo man nga makabaton sang bayad ang mga insured nga mangunguma halin sa Philippine Crop Insurance Corporation.
english: It was also announced that the insured farmers will receive compensation from the Philippine Crop Insurance Corporation.

text: Base sa datos, naglab-ot sa ₱96.9 milyon ang ginbanta nga danyos, nga nakaapekto sa 4,665 ka mangunguma kag 2,236 ka metriko tonelada nga produkto sa 6,037 ka ektarya.
english: Based on the data, the estimated damage amounted to ₱96.9 million, affecting 4,665 farmers and 2,236 metric tons of produce on 6,037 hectares.

text: Padayon subong ang validation sang DA samtang ginabantayan man ang epekto sang sarado nga kalsada sa transportasyon.
english: The DA is currently conducting validation while monitoring the impact of the closed road on transportation.

text: Ginapatigayon man sang mga regional office ang field validation, needs assessment, kag price monitoring agud mamentinar ang suplay kag presyo sang agrikultura.
english: Regional offices also conduct field validation, needs assessment, and price monitoring to maintain agricultural supply and prices.

text: Ginlakip ni Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor Jr.
english: Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor Jr.

text: sa Executive order number 40 series of 2025 ang Sipag at Tiyaga for MoRProGres sa Bagong Pilipinas ukon ang P20 per kilo nga bugas nga tuyo ibaligya sa target population sa Iloilo.
english: in Executive order number 40 series of 2025 the Sipag at Tiyaga for MoRProGres in Bagong Pilipinas or the P20 per kilo of rice intended to be sold to the target population in Iloilo.

text: Subong nga adlaw, nagpatawag ang gobernador sang coordination meeting sa mga natungdan nga talatapan agud matapos ang preparasyon sa paglunsar sang amo nga inisyatibo.
english: Today, the governor called a coordination meeting with the concerned offices to complete the preparations for the launch of the initiative.

text: Ini kasunod man sang ginmanduan ni Agriculture Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
english: This is also in line with the directive of Agriculture Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.

text: ang National Food Authority (NFA) nga sugdan na ang pag-reposition sang rice stocks sa Visayas bilang preparasyon sa paglunsar sang P20-per-kilo rice program.
english: the National Food Authority (NFA) to begin repositioning rice stocks in the Visayas in preparation for the launch of the P20-per-kilo rice program.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Governor Defensor, iya ginpahayag nga ang makabakal sang tag-P20 kada kilo nga bugas amo ang mga pamilya nga undernourished.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Governor Defensor said that those who can buy P20 per kilo of rice are undernourished families.

text: Suno kay Defensor, may yara subong sang 11,000 ka kabataan sa Iloilo ang undernourished.
english: According to Defensor, there are currently 11,000 children in Iloilo who are undernourished.

text: Gin-athag man sini nga ang pagbaligya sang well milled rice sang Provincial Government ang wala nasakop sang programa sang National Government sa hunger mitigation.
english: He also clarified that the sale of well milled rice by the Provincial Government is not covered by the National Government's hunger mitigation program.

text: Dugang niya nga ang tikang ang isa ka suporta sa panawagan ni President Ferdinand Maros, Jr., nga makabaligya sang P20 nga kilo sang bugas.
english: He added that the move is in support of President Ferdinand Maros, Jr.'s call to sell P20 per kilo of rice.

text: Sa diin ang probinsya ang magahatag sang subsidy para sa galastuhon.
english: The province will provide a subsidy for the expenses.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang probinsya mismo ang mahimo sang produksyon sang palay kag i-proseso sa ART Center sa Pototan.
english: The province itself will produce the rice and process it at the ART Center in Pototan.

text: Iloilo – Arestado sa syudad sang Iloilo ang ginakabig top 2 most wanted sa Laguna.
english: Iloilo – The top 2 most wanted in Laguna were arrested in Iloilo City.

text: Ang suspek amo si Renato Dela Cruz, 69, residente sang Purok 6, San Juan Poblacion Kalayaan, Laguna, nga may kaso nga paglapas sa Republic Act 7610 ukon an act providing for stronger deterrence and special protection against child abuse, exploitation and discrimination, and for other purposes.
english: The suspect was identified as Renato Dela Cruz, 69, resident of Purok 6, San Juan Poblacion Kalayaan, Laguna, who has a case of violation of Republic Act 7610 or an act providing for stronger deterrence and special protection against child abuse, exploitation and discrimination, and for other purposes.

text: Natigayon nga nadakpan si Dela Cruz sa Guanco Street, Barangay Nonoy, City Proper.
english: Dela Cruz was arrested in Guanco Street, Barangay Nonoy, City Proper.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Major Shella Mae Sangrines, spokesperson sang Iloilo City Police Office, iya ginpahayag nga nakig-angot ang pamilya sang nabiktima ni Dela Cruz sa barangay officials sang Calumpang, Molo kun sa diin ulihi ini nasiplatan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Major Shella Mae Sangrines, spokesperson of the Iloilo City Police Office, said the family of Dela Cruz's victim contacted barangay officials in Calumpang, Molo where he was later spotted.

text: Suno kay Sangrines, nangin madinalag-on pagdakop sa suspek bangud sa joint collaborative effort kaupod ang Kalayaan Laguna Municipal Police Station kag Iloilo City Police Office.
english: According to Sangrines, the suspect was successfully arrested thanks to a joint collaborative effort with the Kalayaan Laguna Municipal Police Station and Iloilo City Police Office.

english: 336 of the revised penal code in relation to Sec 5 B of Republic Act 7610.

text: ILOILO CITY- Kinahanglan nga magtutok sa domestic tourists ang mga tourism stakeholders sa Visayas bilang pamaagi agud indi mamierdehan ang industriya sang turismo sa tunga sang coronavirus 2019 ukon COVID-19 outbreak.
english: ILOILO CITY- Tourism stakeholders in the Visayas must focus on domestic tourists as a way to avoid losing the tourism industry in the midst of the coronavirus 2019 or COVID-19 outbreak.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Office of the Presidential Assistant for Visayas Assistant Secretary Jonji Gonzales, iya ginpahayag nga bangud sa travel ban nga ginpatuman kasunod sang COVID-19 outbreak, dako nga numero sang mga international tourists ang madula.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Office of the Presidential Assistant for Visayas Assistant Secretary Jonji Gonzales said that due to the travel ban implemented following the COVID-19 outbreak, a large number of international tourists will be lost.

text: Suno kay Gonzales, mayorya sang mga turista gikan sa iban nga pungsod ang nagapadulong sa Visayas.
english: According to Gonzales, the majority of tourists from other countries come to the Visayas.

text: Suno pa kay Gonzales,dako ang potential sang mga domestic tourists nga mangin revenue generating sa mga tourist destinations.
english: According to Gonzales, domestic tourists have great potential to be revenue generating in tourist destinations.

text: Sa subong suno kay Gonzales, kinahanglan nga magdihon sang mga programa ang sektor sang turismo agud maengganyo ang mga domestic tourist nga mag-padulong sa tourist spots sa Visayas.
english: Gonzales said the tourism sector needs to develop programs to encourage domestic tourists to visit tourist spots in the Visayas.

text: Natalana naman nga magsapol ang mga stakeholders sa industriya sang turismo agud makahimo sang mga promotional efforts.
english: Stakeholders in the tourism industry are scheduled to meet to make promotional efforts.

english: 1 Most Wanted in Western Visayas for serial rape cases.

text: Ang arestado amo si Julito Chua Porras, 62 anyos, kag residente sang Primitivo Ledesma Ward, Pototan, Iloilo.
english: The arrested was identified as Julito Chua Porras, 62, resident of Primitivo Ledesma Ward, Pototan, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Colonel Noel Aliño, officer in charge sang Iloilo Police Provincial Office, iya ginpahayag nga sang tuig 2019, ginhimuslan sang suspek sang makapila ka beses ang 16-anyos nga biktima.
english: Police Colonel Noel Aliño, officer in charge of the Iloilo Police Provincial Office, said that in 2019, the suspect raped the 16-year-old victim several times.

text: Suno kay Aliño, masobra tatlo ka tuig nga nagpanago si Porras kag nadiskubrehan nga nagatinir sa Laguna.
english: According to Aliño, Porras had been hiding for more than three years and was discovered living in Laguna.

text: Sang natukiban sang kapulisan ang lokasyon sang suspek, gilayon nga ginsundan ini kag nadakpan sa Barangay Niugan, Cabuyao, Laguna.
english: When the police discovered the location of the suspect, they immediately followed him and arrested him in Barangay Niugan, Cabuyao, Laguna.

text: Nahibaluan nga nagaserbe pa anay si Porras sa Philippine Marines apang ginpahalin.
english: Porras was serving in the Philippine Marines but was dismissed.

text: Sa subong, preso na ang suspek sa Pototan Municipal Police Station.
english: The suspect is currently detained at the Pototan Municipal Police Station.

text: Nagtibusok sa kabukiran ang helicopter kun sa diin nakasakay ang presidente sang Iran kag foreign minister sang Iran.
english: The helicopter carrying the Iranian president and foreign minister crashed into the mountains.

text: Wala pa subong sang maathag nga detalye kun kamusta ang kondisyon ni Iranian President Ebrahim Raisi kag Foreign Minister Hossein Amirabdollahian apang gin-report nga nangin mabudlay ang rescue operation bangud sa malain nga tyempo.
english: There are no clear details on the condition of Iranian President Ebrahim Raisi and Foreign Minister Hossein Amirabdollahian but the rescue operation was reportedly hampered by bad weather.

text: Halos naputos sang gal-um ang lugar sandig sa nakit-an sa live coverage sa rescue teams nga nagpatigayon sang rescue operation.
english: The area was almost covered with clouds according to the live coverage of the rescue teams that conducted the rescue operation.

text: Nahibaluan nga 2021 sang na-eleher ang 63-anyos nga si Raisi bilang president sang amo nga pungsod.
english: The 63-year-old Raisi was elected president of the country in 2021.

text: Sang natabo ang insidente, ginpahayag nga naghalin sa isa ka event agud inagurahan ang Qiz-Qalaisi Dam nga isa ka joint project kaupod sa Azerbaijan.
english: When the incident occurred, he was reportedly leaving an event to inaugurate the Qiz-Qalaisi Dam, a joint project with Azerbaijan.

text: Suno sa state-linked media, tatlo ka helicopters ang yara sa convoy sang president kag duha lamang ang safe nga nakahugpa.
english: According to state-linked media, three helicopters were in the president’s convoy and only two landed safely.

text: Nakapadala pa sang emergency call ang mga kaupdanan sang president nga amo ang nagahatag sang paglaum sa otoridad nga wala sang patay sa amo nga helicopter apisar pa sang insidente.
english: The president's colleagues were able to send an emergency call which gave hope to the authorities that no one was killed in the helicopter despite the incident.

text: Ginbasura sang Pasig RTC Branch 159 ang petisyon para sa piyansa ni Apollo Quiboloy, lider sang Kingdom of Jesus Christ, kag lima pa nga kaupdanan sini sa kaso nga qualified human trafficking kag sexual abuse.
english: The Pasig RTC Branch 159 dismissed the bail petition of Apollo Quiboloy, leader of the Kingdom of Jesus Christ, and five others in the case of qualified human trafficking and sexual abuse.

text: Sa 23 ka pahina nga desisyon sang Hulyo 20, ginsiling sang korte nga may mabakod nga ebidensiya batok sa mga akusado.
english: In a 23-page ruling on July 20, the court said there was strong evidence against the defendants.

text: Gin-athag sang korte nga wala ini nagakahulugan sang prejudgment sang kaso kundi desisyon lamang sa isyu sang piyansa.
english: The court clarified that this does not constitute a prejudgment of the case but only a decision on the issue of bail.

text: Suno sa reklamo, ang mga biktima nga nag-upod sa KOJC sang 2011, ang ginmolestiya sa idalom sang ginatawag nga “bodily connection ministry” kag ginpabaligya sang pagkaon bilang ispiritwal nga obligasyon.
english: According to the complaint, the victims, who joined KOJC in 2011, were molested under the so-called “bodily connection ministry” and sold food as a spiritual obligation.

text: Si Quiboloy ang nagapangatubang sa non-bailable qualified human trafficking charge sa idalom sang RA 9208 kag separar nga kaso nga child abuse sa idalom sang RA 7610 sa Quezon City.
english: Quiboloy is facing a non-bailable qualified human trafficking charge under RA 9208 and a separate case of child abuse under RA 7610 in Quezon City.

text: Gin-evacuate na sang Estados Unidos sang Amerika ang 17 ka American doctors nga na-trap sa Gaza halin sang ginsirado na ang border sa Egypt kadungan sang pagsakop sang Israel sa Rafah.
english: The United States of America has evacuated 17 American doctors trapped in Gaza since the border with Egypt was closed during Israel's occupation of Rafah.

text: Naghulag ang American diplomats sa embassy sa Jerusalem agud nga mapabiya ang mga doctor paagi sa Kerem Shalom tabok sa Israel.
english: American diplomats moved to the embassy in Jerusalem to get the doctors to leave via Kerem Shalom across Israel.

text: May mga impormasyon nga may yara sang tatlo ka US citizen doctors nga kabahin man sang volunteer medical mission nga nagpili nga magpabilin sa amo nga lugar apisar wala sang kasiguruhan kun san-o sila liwat maka-tyansa nga makahalin.
english: There are reports that there are three US citizen doctors who are also part of the volunteer medical mission who chose to stay in the area despite the uncertainty of when they will have a chance to leave again.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang alagyan sa Rafah pakadto sa Egypt amo ang mayor nga ginatabukan sang mga ayuda kag mga tawo nga pasulod sa Gaza.
english: It is known that the Rafah road to Egypt is the main crossing for aid and people entering Gaza.

text: Ginsirado ini halin sang gin-anunsyo sang Israel sang Mayo 7 nga nasakop na sini ang border post halin sa Hamas militants.
english: It has been closed since Israel announced on May 7 that it had captured the border post from Hamas militants.

text: Ang closure nga ini ang ginpatuman antes ang ginapanan-aw nga full-scale Israeli invasion sa syudad sang Rafah kun sa diin minilyon ka Palestinians ang nagatinir.
english: The closure was imposed ahead of an expected full-scale Israeli invasion of the city of Rafah where millions of Palestinians live.

text: Si US President Joe Biden ang una na nagsiling nga indi ini maghatag sang mga armas kag artillery shells sa Israel kun maglunsar ini sang ground offensive sa Rafah bangud possible nga madalahig ang mga sibilyan.
english: US President Joe Biden has previously said he will not provide weapons and artillery shells to Israel if it launches a ground offensive in Rafah because civilians may be involved.

text: Apisar sini, nagsabat man si Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu nga magapadayon sila sa ila plano sa operasyon kag makumpleto na ini sa masunod nga sinemana.
english: However, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu replied that they will continue with their operation plan and it will be completed next week.

text:
Ginapatihan sang Israel nga ang Rafah amo ang ginahukmungan sang iban pa nga katapo sang Hamas militants kag tuyo sang militar nga maubos-papas ukon mapanas ang mga ini.#

AFP / Mohammed Abed
english:
Israel believes that Rafah is the stronghold of other Hamas militants and the military aims to wipe them out.

AFP / Mohammed Abed

text: Francis Escudero ang panawagan sang mga student groups kag mga kritiko nga mag-inhibit ini sa impeachment trial ni Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: Francis Escudero the call of student groups and critics to inhibit the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte.

text: Ginpahayag ni Escudero nga indi patas ang hingyo sang mga kritiko kun ang buot silingon lamang sang “katarungan” amo ang pagpasugot sa ila ginapangayo.
english: Escudero said the demands of critics are unfair if “justice” only means agreeing to their demands.

text: Matandaan nga nagpadala sang sulat ang mga student leaders gikan sa 24 ka mga unibersidad sa opisina sang Senate President kag nagapanawagan nga magbiya ini bilang presiding officer sang impeachment trial.
english: Student leaders from 24 universities sent a letter to the Senate President's office calling on him to resign as presiding officer of the impeachment trial.

text: Suno sa ila, ang pagka-delay sang proseso ang nagapakita sang pagdampig ni Escudero kag amat-amat nga pagkaguba sang kredibilidad sang Senado.
english: They said the delay in the process shows Escudero's bias and the gradual deterioration of the credibility of the Senate.

text: Kalakip sa mga nagpirma sa sulat ang mga estudyante sang University of the Philippines, Ateneo de Manila University, De La Salle University, Adamson University, Bulacan State University, kag iba pa.
english: Among those who signed the letter were students of the University of the Philippines, Ateneo de Manila University, De La Salle University, Adamson University, Bulacan State University, and others.

text: Ginpanginwala man ni Escudero ang akusasyon nga ginahungod sang Senado ang pagka-delay sang impeachment proceedings.
english: Escudero also denied the accusation that the Senate is covering up the delay in the impeachment proceedings.

text: Magpatigayon sang reshuffling schedule ang Iloilo City Traffic and Transportation Management Office (TTMO) matapos naka-record sang duha ka patay bangud sa heat related illness samtang naga-duty.
english: The Iloilo City Traffic and Transportation Management Office (TTMO) will conduct a reshuffling schedule after recording two deaths due to heat related illness while on duty.

english: Uldarico Garbanzos, head of the Iloilo City Traffic and Transportation Management Office, said they submitted the medical statuses of traffic personnel with comorbidities to set their schedule in the afternoon.

text: Albert Sy, officer in charge sang Mandurriao Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga nadakpan ang duha samtang ginapatigayon sang pulis ang saturation drive sa anti-illegal drugs campaign sa amo nga barangay.
english: Albert Sy, officer in charge of the Mandurriao Police Station, said the two were arrested while the police were conducting a saturation drive in the anti-illegal drugs campaign in the barangay.

text: Nagtuyo pa nga magpalagyo ang duha suno kay Sy apang natigayon nga malagas sang pulis.
english: Sy said the two tried to flee but were chased by the police.

text: Ginkumpirma pa ni Sy nga si Gonzales amo ang isa ka subject nga nakapalagyo sang gin-conduct sang Lapaz Police Station ang isa ka drug buy bust sang nagligad nga Disyembre 2022.
english: Sy also confirmed that Gonzales was one of the subjects who escaped when the Lapaz Police Station conducted a drug buy bust last December 2022.

text: Matandaan nga sa Bakhaw, Mandurriao man natabo ang pagdakop sa 32 ka mga persona sang nagligad nga semana sa isa ka ginapahayag boardinghouse-turned-drug den.
english: It can be recalled that in Bakhaw, Mandurriao, 32 persons were arrested last week in an alleged boardinghouse-turned-drug den.

text: Nagpasalig si President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos, Jr.nga kumpleto ang iya mandu para sa government response diri sa Pilipinas apisar nga didto siya subong sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika para sa official visit kag para sa high-level meeting kay US President Donald Trump.
english: President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos, Jr. assured that his mandate for the government response here in the Philippines is complete despite the fact that he is currently in the United States of America for an official visit and for a high-level meeting with US President Donald Trump.
